We were able to recoup the funds, but I would beware of ordering here. Yes, it wasn't the smartest decision to read out the card number on the phone, but the people here also aren't trustworthy. We were regulars and haven't ordered from them since.
Ordered chicken while shopping and came back to pick up fresh chicken. Some of the best I've had in the area. Their Honey garlic is a must have mixed in. Will be going back here again while I shop.

Was craving a fried chicken sandwich, so I ordered the Ugly  Spicy Crispy. It was neither. What I got looked nothing like the picture. Inside was a THIN piece of thigh meat(had I known I would have passed), with hardly any breading. Served on a generic hamburger bun with a small limp piece of romaine and a couple of pickle slices. The bbq sauce was decent, sandwich tasted ok, but not worth $11 nor a repeat visit. Came with small fries which were ok. The wings may be good here, but after this feeling of being ripped off I won't be returning. I already have a go to place for Korean wings @ the other Hmart plaza.
The white powder french fries are delicious!! Make sure you don't close the box right away or else your fries will get soggy. A must have every time I go to hmart!
This place was pretty good, I got a SMORES Latte with a extra shot but tbh it wasn't significantly "SMORES Flavored" maybe due to the extra expresso shot. The croissant was bomb af

My favorite coffee spot in the Francisville neighborhood (and quite possibly in the city, too). I look forward to getting an iced latte from them every weekend! They have so many interesting (and yummy!)  flavors to choose from and plenty of non-dairy milk options as well. The owners and people working there are so friendly and kind as well. They always go above and beyond to make their customers happy.

this is my new favorite spot for flavored coffee drinks in the city. i am constantly in search of floral flavored coffee & their lavender honey latte is the best.
the baristas (possibly also owners? i'm shy but eavesdrop on my husbands small talk) are also so sweet and friendly, and will go out of their way to make sure your drink is perfect. this morning i had to insist on taking my delicious drink, because they weren't positive it was perfect  
cold brew and simple drinks and pastries here are all great too. lots of vegan options and variety :)
strongly recommend !!!!

Do me a favor and SPRINT to Bold Coffee Bar...you won't be disappointed. Fantastic service, several amazing gourmet coffee and tea options, all in the cutest little coffee shop. I ordered the chocolate peanut butter latte and it was so delicious I had to have it again the next morning! I purchased a bag of coffee beans to go so I can attempt to recreate it some day and a bag for my mom for Mother's Day.
Best spiced chai I've had in the city, and I once took a job at an Indian restaurant simply to learn how to make it...

This one is a cozy spot in a cozy part of Philly. Sitting outside, you can people watch the quiet strolls people are taking or even peep into the barber shop across the street.

I love the 'daily bread' at Rival Bros - this time it was potato bread that was soft and fluffy but delicious all the same with salt, butter, and jam. Sometimes it's a heftier, crusty bread too. I also tried a different toast on a grainy bread with ricotta and honey. The simple things in life are really the most satisfying!
Capuchino very tasty, served fast and HOT, as it must be. Cinnamon roll was delicious and decadently buttery. A perfect little neighborhood coffee shop experience.

Not many coffee shops rival this one. A cute little corner coffee shop with friendly staff and a great atmosphere. I got a classic oat milk latte and it was quite good (standard price for a latte). Overall, I'd take the bros to get coffee here again!

Was  Philadelphia when we walked down to the down to the restaurant set outside had a wonderful way buy had a wonderful waitress very informative and quite Attentive we had the combo with the it's oh with the chicken and steak which was very good which was very good but it was kind of a Skippy amount of meats it's a piece of meat they couldn't add a little more for what you put labor for what you what you were paying seem to be a lot of vegetables.

VERY GOOD TACOS! I got the sea bass one and the pumpkin purée was 10/10! Guac was amazing too, but maybe not worth the price. Overall service was one of the best I've had and the atmosphere was so fun! Definitely recommend

This was my second time at El Vez, and it surpassed my first experience in so many positive ways. The food was delicious and the classic El Vez margarita pitchers were so tasty and refreshing! Let me start off by saying you cannot go wrong with their chips and guac. For our meals, my friend ordered the chicken quesadilla with jalapeños, and I ordered it without--I really appreciated our server giving me the option to leave them out. My other friend ordered the enchiladas. For dessert we had the churros. Everything came out better than expected. I really like their outdoor set-up and hope they can continue it. Our server, Carly, really made the whole experience. She was amazing! She constantly checked on us and didn't rush us out at all. Her demeanor was so warm and friendly. Can't wait to visit again and ask for her!

We finally tried el vez with friends from out of town. It was extremely good and my bf was blown away by the carnitas tacos. I personally don't like Mexican but I did love the queso and the guac was also extremely delicious (I don't like guac usually either ). I got the carnitas taco too and although it wasn't my cup of tea I could recognize it was a great meal and very high quality. GET THE MELTED MANCHEGO QUESO it was my fave. I also threw some on the carnitas taco. Service was good. Waters were filled promptly. Everyone was super nice. The vibe inside is pretty fun! Very cool dark ambiance with upbeat people. We sat outside because of how cute it looked. Was soooo cute and fun. Make reservations way ahead, it's a very hot spot.

Eh. I don't see the hype. I've had better.  Food is just ok. Not good not bad. 
Went there on a Tuesday and they were beyond busy. Which made me think the food must be great. But not really. Since it was so busy the service was very slow. Waited 45 minutes to be seated which I was ok with. But we ordered 2 appetizers and each came out every 35 minutes or so. We had 2 appetizers and 3 meals. Took 3 hours which was very annoying. It wasn't the waiters fault as she stated the kitchen was backed up. 
For the appetizers we ordered Grilled Lobster Tostadas and the Open Face Shrimp Quesadilla. The tostada was just ok. I could've gone without it. 3 tiny mediocre tostadas for $16 was absurd.  Maybe $10 would've been appropriate just because of the "upscale atmosphere". Now the shrimp Quesadilla was great! Super flavorful and wished I'd gotten another one instead of the tostada. So the quesadilla gave me hope. However after waiting for a while the main course finally came out which was steak tacos, shrimp tacos and shrimp enchiladas. One again the tacos were small and just average. Not worth the price. The enchiladas...well it was just ok. We did get the dessert on the house due to the long wait. Tres leches was trash. And the churos were ok again. Won't be returning unfortunately.
Excellent food, love the bread and bean dishes. Good to excellent choices for veg and non-veg entrees

The lamb fahsah is quite possibly the greatest piece of meat I had ever eaten. The price was affordable, the portions are very generous and their delivery someone manages to keep the lamb nice and hot even in the dead of February winter.

Went here on a holiday morning, when the entirety of queens village was sold out of bagels... despite all that, I'm so thankful to have found this gem! I would urge any & everyone to do a side by side comparison against another bagel sandwich. It's just indescribably better! Come here when you're tired of wasting your time on stupid people. Maybe not for u if you're looking to sip coffee & free wifi for hours... can't wait to come back and try the rest of the menu

I've been coming here for years and have zero complaints about this place. Bagels are very good and reasonably priced. Iced coffee is awesome too. The staff is pretty friendly too compared to some other bagel spots around the corner.

Is this a joke? $3.75 for a bagel and this amount of strawberry cream cheese, $3 for a bagel and TWO plain cream cheese. This amount barely covered one half of my bagel. I paid more to throw out half of my breakfast. 
What I ate was delicious, but this is absurd. Was this a mistake? Did they forget to throw the other in the bag? Was there supposed to be two? That's the only reasonable excuse. I'm very disappointed (and hungry)

Let me set the vibe. El Taco is that old friend. The one you smile at when you see in passing, but sometimes you lowkey forget about. Yet, when y'all catch up, it's a pretty wholesome time. Welcome to El Taco! 

I've had their chicken tacos ($8.45) multiple times and they're a staple. Three tacos for $8.45 aren't going to blow your mind, but they're classic and make for a tasty and filling bite. The creamy jalapeno sauce was a nice touch, but it didn't carry a kick, so I'll upgrade to something spicier next time.

I've had the El Burrito Bowl ($11.95) before and I could only eat 85% of it, bc it was too dense and salty towards the end for me to finish. My stomach is also weird about oil heavy foods, so I didn't eat all of the fried tortilla bowl. If you're still hungry after eating a loaded halal then this is for you! 

They had horchata as a seasonal drink and it was my first time having it. The horchata was a nice lite cinnamony milk drink. I'd probably get it in a smaller serving and not with tacos.

I ordered this not realizing it came in an actual taco shell like the classic trump jawn, but oh well. The food itself was tasty and the meat tender, etc. Definitely enjoyed my meal after not eating all day too. The initial salsa they gave me was weirdly watered down but thick and kind of tasted like apple sauce. But then I went back and asked for hotter sauce and they hooked it up for sure. Maybe the first was made for weak university students idk haha

My only downside is that I changed my order slightly on the bowl and they charged me twice as much to do so, which I understand cuz it was extra meat and two kinds, but rhey could have given me the option of smaller amounts of each meat which is kinda what I was hoping for. I understand they wanna make extra bread when I substitute and make their job slightly more difficult. But twice as much more difficult? not sure. 

Either way like I said food was good lol so im happy

We found El Taco at the beginning of the pandemic, looking for a rival to our favorite mexican restaurant. From our first order on, we have been blown away by the consistently delicious, massive amounts of quality food. Honestly, we haven't ventured far from the pollo nachos and burritos, but I honestly don't think you have to. The scorpion sauce will sting the next day, but I keep ordering it. Throw the onion/cilantro mix on everything, and dabble in some added jalapeno.  Never before has nachos delivered in styrofoam held up so well. I hold my burrito with two hands because one would be foolish. We probably order once a week and I don't think that's going to change any time soon. El Taco is king. And if you're reading this, El Taco, we're the Beechwood St orders. Keep it comin!

What an experience!!! The entire family just loved the fresh ingredients and amazing flavor. We were fortunate to try many of the items on the menu and they were all consistently delicious. Will come again!!
Always get good food that's well packaged for delivery. The portions are big and are enough for a second meal of leftovers the next day.

This place is disappointing. We love Nifty Fifty's and have been eating there for years at their other locations. The food was always consistently good but the south Philly takeout place is not. I have gotten cheesesteaks and the bread was stale. Another time they forgot the cheese. We started ordering our fries without cheese and putting our own wiz on because their cheese fries would be soggy like they were sitting around for hours. Last time I ordered a single cheeseburger that was so burned I just threw it away. I give up.

I've given this location a chance 4 times now, and I never wrote a review until now because I believe post Covid hiccups are a thing in the food industry, and that I needed to have some sympathy. After tonight I won't be returning unless I'm in the mood for one of their S'mores milkshakes and feel like waiting a half hour for it. Seriously, the food isn't worth it at all. Just go for the milkshakes. 

Not only is the clientele extremely obnoxious (every time I've embarked on waiting for over 30min for any size order I've ever placed, I've witnessed some extremely obnoxious patrons just screaming and being insanely rude to the staff). So, it's already a hostile environment, which is obviously uncomfortable. One of the worst parts about visiting this NF location, is that you will not wait for less than 30min for your order regardless if you ordered a single soda, or a full meal. The second (and main) worst part is that all of the food is really terrible. Literally everything I've ordered from them over the past year has been barely edible. Just get the milkshakes if you really need to go here. 

Also, pro tip: if you order a cheeseburger, it is literally a burnt burger patty with a slice of cheese on top. Nothing else. Make sure you ask for something else on it if you don't just want a patty and cheese on a dry bun.  But keep in mind that if you ask for say, lettuce and tomato, after getting your order - you will wait another 10-15min for that side of condiments that should have come on the burger automatically. Such a strange place.
Yummy food! Love their cheesesteaks and milkshakes! The service is phenomenal and quick. Their outdoor dining set up is great- they even have tents. Clean and new restaurant.

This location isn't it! They need to pull it together and soon! Service is so so. Milkshakes are ok. Food is F'n horrible. I'd rather ride up to grant ave when I'm really in the mood for this place. From here on out I'll only go when I'm in the mood for milkshakes, nothin else unless they really revamp some things!

Best milkshake for the best price in the city! I've tried the Oreo cookies n cream which I loved and would get over and over and over again. I couldn't finish it all myself but it was even good the next day. Also tried the caramel cheesecake with toffee added in. That one was good, but a little too sweet. And the toffee - I was expecting toffee candy bar prices but they were kore like crunchies. Again, couldn't finish it myself, but a couple hours later, the toffee crunchy pieces got soggy and gross so this one definitely isn't good for later. Finally, got a single patty burger with fried onions, tomato, lettuce, pickle and ketchup (those toppings are freebies) and it was solid! Would definitely order again.

Maybe it was the fact that we got there at 5 when they opened, I don't know. There was no children's menu, no house sale available, and a limited menu. The food was not bad and the service was ok. Just my experience.
Super cute spot and great sushi. Everything was very fresh and their rolls had unique, tasty combinations. Not that many tables so there is a good wait, but it's worth it.

Amazing sushi!  I've had sushi in many places in the US like New York City, Miami, San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle and this sushi is up there with the best I've had.  Service is a bit slow but Highly recommended.

My friend and I stopped by this place near closing time one night, excited to try it. They sat us outside within a few minutes. The menu looked so good, and we were hungry, so we ended up getting three rolls and a bunch of appetizers. 
 
Apps: The chicken dumplings were excellent. We also ordered the sushi fries, which were really interesting. My friend ate most of the krab from the top, but I really enjoyed the presentation of the fries themselves.

Sushi: We ordered a couple common-named rolls, and they tasted fine. We also ordered the Ybor Cali roll and ... wow! Here's the menu description: "krab, guava and cucumber, topped with sweet plantains, cuban style pork, spicy mayo, sweet kabayaki sauce and scallions" I'd never had anything like this before. The Cuban pork on top - so interesting and so delicious. I think I was most impressed by the uniqueness of the roll, but the flavors were amazing together. Super impressive. 
 
The service was fine.

COVID Stuff: I visited in May 2021. We sat outside. Recently, the Florida governor banned municipal mask mandates, so businesses in Tampa no longer post signs about local regulations requiring masks.

Finally made it to the Ybor Sushi House and I will certainly be back! I came across this restaurant on a drive around Ybor a while back and it has been on my list of places to try. They are currently only offering seating outside. We had a nice big table outside and were able to enjoy the atmosphere of Ybor - chickens and roosters and all. 

We enjoyed the garlic lime edamame which was delicious. The rolls we shared were: Lightning, Executive Roll, Khalessi, Screamer. The sushi was all extremely fresh and had delicious flavors in each roll. I am a huge sushi fan and Ybor Sushi House quickly just took a spot at the top of my favorite list. I cannot wait to come back and explore the rest of the menu, if I can stray from these incredible rolls we shared. The sushi was seriously so fresh, perfectly done and the sauce was just the right amount. 

Our server Carla was INCREDIBLE! She immediately asked if it was our first time and made sure we were perfectly taken care of. She explained the rolls, shared her favorites, and was extremely attentive. Thank you Carla for making this experience so wonderful! 

Overall, Ybor Sushi House gets a glowing rating from me! I love finding new spots in Tampa and this will quickly become a regular stop for me.

We were in Tampa for the weekend. We had walked to a local grocery store.  We had walked a few miles so I was getting hungry! My wife initially did not want to eat here. She said its a chain. You can get that anywhere.  Well this experience changed her mind!

It was packed when we got there. But a wait right on the water was not too bad! 

The service once we sat down was excellent!  The drinks were amazing. We were happy then. But when the food got there we were super happy!  The food was hot and amazing latin flavors.  We were pleasantly surprised with everything.

It may be  a chain. But it was dang good! I can not wait to go here again.
Food was very tasty, piña coladas are AMAZING. The stuff we're super friendly and food was served very fast. We loved this place!
A F-ing dog walking on the bar the sign clearly says no pets. Hopefully your food is walking on the ground
Just stopped in for a drink and an appetizer and we can't wait to come back for a longer experience!! Ashley the day bartender is the Bahama Momma! Her attitude and energy was EVERYTHING! Love it!

Had the jerk shrimp pineapple bowl and it was horrible. Not much food with this dish. Sweet taste, no jerk seasoning to be found on tiny shrimp. White rice was over cooked, stuck together and cold. The pineapple bowl was clearly cut out; however, my pineapple pieces were missing in action. Counted a total of five pieces mixed in with a sweet sauce and onion pieces. I felt like a jerk ordering from this place and I don't understand the hype.

First time having breakfast at the Broken Yolk Cafe and I must say it was really good!  Has a diner feel and for a Sunday morning it wasn't overly crowded as other places tend to get. 

The chicken and waffle Benedict was A+. I've never had it prepared this way. Usually it's one or the other so i was pleasantly surprised to see the combo and i was sold. Very tasty and i was not disappointed. Everyone enjoyed their food. 

Would def go back again. Our waiter Jon was amazing.

My family of 5 went on Father's day for brunch. The wait was less than most places for a holiday although they were busy which was good. However the temperature was very hot inside to the point that numerous customers complained to the wait staff. Also some of our items were brought out wrong, my daughter actually sent her home fries back because they were extra extra crispy only to be given a smaller portion. Our waitress was great but the food runners could use better service skills my husband almost had a plate dropped on him due to the rush they were in.

If you haven't visited Broken Yoke yet, give them a try. Variety menu for breakfast and lunch. I have to mention their fruit is fresh, ripe and sweet. No bland, tasteless fruit like some other restaurants. Portions are very generous and very nice presentation too! The only neg - I don't like my location's coffee. If you like it an extra strong arabica coffee, we'll there you go!

I notice there are other locations around the US, I'll definitely look for one when I travel. I like them better than Cracker Barrel too.

Decent customer service, server forgot to bring straws and forgot to bring grape jelly with the toast. The food tasted ok I ordered the bacon egg and cheese sandwich and that was fantastic. The home fries where terrible they need to change that recipe. I love the fact that the menu had lots of pictures of the food they offer. Would come back here again.

My family and I went here to get a nice breakfast after an early morning walk. It's become almost a weekly ritual where we would go out and try a new breakfast spot every week and finally came about to this place. 
Having lived in Los Angeles for half my life, we were ecstatic to see California/Mexican-inspired dishes on the menu and promptly ordered some (Sope Benedict and the Ranchero Skillet [pictured]) with the rest ordering a burger along with the buttermilk pancakes with sausage patties and eggs.

The Sope Benedict, while had a good taste profile, was bland, with the shredded beef being pretty dry and the cotija cheese nowhere to be found. The ranchero skillet which I ordered for myself once again also tasted good, but was again blander than what I was expecting. Back in California there would be more of a kick to the dishes and I just didn't get that with the skillet (perhaps the chorizo was good but didn't bring enough heat or maybe I'm just used to the ones in Cali adding more hot sauces). I feel maybe that the dishes were also lacking salt, which was further reinforced by the fact that the waiter actually asked us if we wanted salt and brought some to our table. What really turned me off from the dish however was the sheer amount of almost raw onion that was in the dish. I'm a home cook, but you don't need kitchen experience to know the sulfuric pungency of an onion that hasn't been properly sautéed, if at all. Add to that the fact that it seemed like I was crunching on onions and tasting them more than savoring the potatoes and chorizo and it should be easy to see why I was left disappointed. 

The pancakes themselves were lackluster. They tasted like the kind I would get ordering pancakes a la carte at school years ago and are overshadowed by the rest of the myriad of local breakfast eateries along Dale Mabry. The $4.99 spent for sausage and eggs felt like a rip-off considering they seemed like "complementary breakfast at the Holiday Inn" level, which is to say, painfully average for the price asked. The burger (which I believe is the Good Morning Burger) was the one item that was really good, with nice toasted bun and a patty that stayed juicy the entire course of the meal. 

Our server, though friendly enough, also didn't even care to take our menus AT ALL, despite us collecting them and placing them at the edge of the table. Not only that, but when we got his attention he would dart out as soon as one of us was done speaking even though another person began to speak about getting a refill, leading to a service that is NOT worth the 18% recommended minimum tip (which is already in itself quite egregious since they're recommending such a high tip as a baseline, remember tipping is not normal outside the U.S., and in some countries is even frowned upon!!!) 

Overall, we were mostly left sorely disappointed. A lot of the disappointment came from unrealized potential, either because of employee mistakes or recipes that I feel have been toned down in flavor due to different palettes here as compared to a place like Los Angeles. The pancakes tried to compensate for their lack of anything special by just being so darn large, even though it wasn't even good enough to take home. But what really salted the wound was the prices. ALMOST $15 FOR SUBPAR, BUTTERMILK PANCAKES, TWO SAUSAGE PATTIES AND SCRAMBLED EGGS! At that price might as well go to IHOP and spend $10 For better food (that aren't just buttermilk, mind you!) + the addition of hash browns. The skillet was also a  bit pricier than other options in the area like Brunchies, with once again the burger being the exception and being priced comparatively well for what you get. (~$13 but it's a big burger and it's tasty so..) To add just one last grain of salt they also don't have refillable Arnold Palmer. :'( If I were the one in charge, I would definitely lower *several* of the prices on the menu down a touch as some of them range from mildly overpriced to pretty ridiculous. I'd also have the kitchen staff perhaps chop their fruits and veggies into smaller sizes (if you want to keep the portion sizes the same just add more small pieces!) and please, please cook the onions more and don't put so much in the skillet! From what I've read from other reviews perhaps other items on the menu taste better, but from my experience alone and if I'm comparing it to past experiences with both Mexican food and breakfast food, I can't recommend for much more than a try-once for this place. For some people I guess some of the food is good if you can stomach the price tag on some items, and I really wish eventually in the future I can come back and get the experience I was hoping for, but for now if you're expecting to get that "wow" flavor from border state Mex-fusion cuisine, or want that new "weekly go-to breakfast spot" or simply just want a good breakfast for a good price, there are better options close by.
One of my favorite spots to eat in Philly but there has been no update online whether they are back open. Hope to find out soon.

Thank goodness for Yelp. I am always on the lookout for a good Italian hoagie (hero). One would never find and this without Yelp and it's only 3 miles from where I live. South Philadelphia and Port Richmond and places like that aren't places one usually explores but they have some great food shops. I walked in. Nice and spacious for a South Philly shop. Signs indicating where you order are clear. People are pleasant enough for South Philly. I ordered an Italian. The next person takes your topping. Then you slide down to the cashier. I love seeded rolls and this place had them. I will NOT eat at a shop that doesn't have seeded rolls with the exception of Chick's in jersey. The ratio of meat to cheese to bread was spot on. Too little meat and cheese and the bread overwhelms. Too much meat and cheese and not even a seeded roll can hold it and meat and cheese are sliding out and you're chewing off the overflow without bread. Bottom line, deal with the parking or lack of and GO!

As an update, I went a second time and seems there are consistency issues... I ordered the same hoagie (Old fashioned Italian with the works, with hot peppers & pickles). Unfortunately what I received  is not the hoagie I fell in love with. Very dry, very little meat & cheese. It's also missing a few of the requested items (i.e. hot peppers, pickles).  They were busy (which is great to see) but it's unfortunate to see their quality greatly decrease during busy times. 

I called ahead as suggested to avoid the wait and was told about 30 minutes (I waited closer to 50), but the line ended up going faster. I'd suggest going in line vs calling ahead so you can see your hoagie made in real time as well.

I finally found it - the best Italian hoagie in the city! Ricci's Old Fashioned Italian Hoagie are what sandwich dreams are made of. I have no idea what makes it 'old fashioned' and have no idea what's exactly on it since their menu doesn't include descriptions, but I do know it's delicious!! 

My best bet is - it includes the typical meat (high quality) , LTO, with pickles. The garlic-looking stuff in the middle is actually provolone chunks (I think provolone, but don't hold me to it- it's definitely some sort of cheese..).  

There is also mayo on it (not oil & vinegar) which I thought went really well together but if mayo isn't your thing, be aware. 

Overall I enjoyed every last bite of this hoagie & already can't wait for my next one!

Had the pleasure of eating dinner last night at Friday Saturday Sunday and it was WONDERFUL!!! Didn't know quite what to expect, didn't know if I'd like the food or what the sizes of each course would be and I was delighted. Not only was the food delicious but the wait staff was fabulous also--friendly, accommodating, knowledgeable, and we enjoyed playful banter with them. I know it seems pricey but it was worth every penny!

I forgot to publish this 2019 review draft, but better late than never:

Prob my new fav dinner/date/business spot in Philly.  Drinks are impeccable and the food balance is pretty stellar.

Minor tip: Reservations are hard to come by, but I actually prefer their walk-in bar on the first floor - show up either super early or late.  Great ambiance and the waitstaff know what they're talking about - so if you wanna pass on the tasting menu you can always listen to their recs instead.

Cocktails are stellar as well.  Expect to spend ~$100ish/head... but you probably knew that coming in.

Absolutely amazing!!! This place is a legit experience ! Everything from the ambiance upstairs to the service THE COCKTAILS(wow) and THE TASTING MENU! Most tasting menus have a very linear taste profile which frankly is kind of boring. BUT NOT HERE! the tasting menu is a legit culinary road trip to flavor town. We will definitely be return!

I made reservations here for two friends visiting out of town and me. My friends are familiar with Philadelphia and its restaurant scene from their time living in the area a few years back, but somehow, we never made it to Friday, Saturday, Sunday. When it popped up high on a best restaurant list, I figured we should try it.
We arrived understanding that we would be served a prix fixe menu. At the time I made the reservation, I sent a screenshot of the menu to my friends to make sure it was a place they would be interested to try. What none of us noted was the disclaimer that the menu would change frequently due to "availability of seasonal ingredients."  One of my friends does not eat red meat, which would not have been an issue if we were being served from the menu available when I made the reservation. Alas, when we arrived, we realized the menu that evening featured three dishes with red meat.
Now obviously, this was not the restaurant's fault. I did not pay attention to the fact that the menu would change. I had every opportunity prior to our dinner to disclose dietary restrictions and did not. Once we alerted our server, they made every effort to accommodate her by bringing her extra portions of other courses. I mean, short of sending someone to the butcher, there was not much they could do. Now, my beef - free friend is probably the biggest foodie of the three of us and has a pretty impressive appetite, so we spent a few minutes teasing her about what her second dinner that night was going to be.  Unfortunately, I feel like some of our jesting may have been overheard and taken seriously. Towards the end of our meal, a woman who introduced herself as the chef's wife came over to our table to apologize if they hadn't met expectations. She said her husband would have been happy to accommodate any of our restrictions. Folks? She seemed so upset and sincere that my friends and I felt absolutely horrible. We assured her that it was our (my) fault, not hers, and the truth was, we did have a great time.
Some of my favorites that evening included the beet cappelletti, halibut, and a perfectly cooked New York Strip. And for someone who finds that high end restaurants can miss the mark with their dessert by trying a bit too hard, their bay leaf semifreddo with rhubarb and crispy meringue was amazing.
Anyway, if you are up for a creative and well-prepared menu with a side of excellent service, this is your place!

Came here for a birthday and was not disappointed. They are only doing tasting menus now but almost everything was just to my taste. COVID precautions are taken pretty seriously here with plastic dividers between groups and tables left empty to ensure enough distance is left between parties. 

The meal starts a few small bites and oxtail tea which I would have loved a large glass of.

Highlights of the meal included the roasted duck breast, sweetbreads and halibut in that rich buttermilk dashi.

The staff were very professional and attentive without being overbearing and gave us plenty of space to enjoy our night while also making sure our water was filled and we always had a drink if we wanted one. Once they bring the aged duck back onto the menu I will be first in line on the reservation list.

Thank you so much for the food it was wonderful I couldn't finish it so I have to get a to go box and let me tell you about the customer service my waiter was Lauren she has the best customer I've received in a long time. And zida has good customer service also. very friendly atmosphere you feel at home.. and lil T.J has good customer service also at a young age.. teach them young... and the manager is Gus he's all over asking the customer how is the service..  And the Food you get plenty of it.. bring your stomach..  ENJOY

I love this place. I order door dash all the time and especially for breakfast. They have the best pancakes you can find in Tampa. I've ordered here many times and never had any issues. I went in the restaurant to dine one time and everyone was really nice. I recommend this place for the best breakfast in Tampa and a great restaurant overall.

Most satisfying diner I've ever been to. Would definitely recommend to everyone who's looking for some delicious breakfast / lunch comfort food. Also, Lina is the sweetest server. Made us feel so comfortable and was always looking out.

Neat little diner and great location. Love the old Tampa picture decor. Lots of selections on the menu and everything tasted good. Friendly staff. I would say the price point is TWO $$ rather than one $.  Sandwiches are a la carte don't include side and are priced about $2 more than what is typical. Breakfast is pretty pricey too. Is an ok place for an occasional drive-by.

The food was really good honestly deserves 5 stars. The bus boy was polite and attentive. The reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because it was still early and the waitresses looked tired. Your waitresses speak for your restaurant. It's not only about serving it's about being attentive. All in all food was great.

This McDonald's and the workers can go right to hell i know fast food jobs are trash but damn can I get 1 order right or hot. I don't need the best service but shit can I get some hot fries. Y'all need to hire 16 year olds that wanna make a check not 20+ year old trying to pay for bills and feed their kids with this money.

Everything about our experience was great including our waitress (Nicole) she was awesome! HOWEVER the hostess was very rude and uninviting. There was no one in the restaurant and she refused to seat us inside in 90 degree heat. For the duration of our stay the restaurant was empty, only some people at the bar. The hostess continued to be really negative towards the friends in my group even when we asked to go to the bathroom.

This establishment requires a credit in order to be seated outside.
If you have made a prior reservation.
I was with a guess, we both found this to be rule offensive. Being of a certain age, not a college student I couldn't believe it!
We decided this wasn't for us and we left.

I was in town visiting a friend and she recommended this place, she went to Penn university for the last several years and lives in university city, this is one of her go to spots. It has good atmosphere and has indoor or outdoor seating. The menu is American Mexican food. The staff were very friendly. I ordered their house salad with grilled chicken and my friend ordered her go to meal of chicken tenders with Mac n cheese. We also ordered drinks she got a blue margarita with a sugar rim which she said was delicious. I had a mojito, which was basic but tasted good. The salad I ordered came with a lime vinaigrette that was amazing. My friend liked her meal as she orders the same thing every time she comes. This is a cool spot to hang out at in a college town. If you're in the area and need a spot to chill and have some drinks this is a great spot to stop at.

I just had lunch with my family at Copa University City. It was a party of 8 and Copa did a fabulous job of accommodating us. 
We did reserve our tables using the Open Table App which worked like a dream. The process was very easy and with a large party it is better to make reservations. Although we didn't know it  when reserving our tables we were part of Copa's "soft opening" for inside dining. It was a great experience , good food great drinks and a very accommodating and efficient staff. Our party was very pleased with the Copa Experience. I absolutely recommend this place. Our server Eleanor was great!
Thank you Copa

Copa's will forever by my MVP! This is the place my girls and I would go to pre-game before a night out in Philly 10 years ago and the margaritas are still unmatched!

COVID Regulation: Reservations only. No walk-ins allowed unless you luck up like I did and a party has just cancelled (I guess God really wanted me there that night lol). The tables upstairs are few & far between to honor social distancing (which is a good thing) and now they have a dining space downstairs.

The MARGARITAS though - they still get the job done! That tin can still pours 2-3 drinks for $10 (can't beat that) and you really can't go wrong with any flavor. AND if you can't finish it all, now worries you can take it to go! The Spanish Fries are still as tasty as they've always been. I even noticed they now have a Vegan Cheesesteak on the menu which is nice their catering to the plant based community! So happy that Copa's has survived COVID and the quality of their offerings has not diminished!

Not sure of the specifics on the gratuity policy, but with a party of 4 the gratuity is automatically included so be sure to review your total so you won't double tip...unless you want to :)

Absolutely LOVE this place!  Since moving here it has been challenging finding a place that is totally 100% Organic and delicious!  Their baby broccoli and chicken salad wrap on the gluten free coconut wrap are my current favorites.  Been here almost daily now and definitely worth a drive in the rain for. 

So far have met Linda, Pat, Sophia and Logan.  All so wonderful and friendly.  Very grateful for the beautiful service and a go-to cafe!

What a find! Delicious vegan offerings including potato salad, avocado with cilantro cashew creme, chickpea salad, kale, cranberry and tofu almond salad and refreshing teas. Our server, Brian, was most helpful in advising what we might enjoy. Owner and chef, Linda, clearly has a knack for combining ingredients for delicious and nutritious meals. We enjoyed every bite. Great atmosphere, attentive service and fabulous food.
Brian was so friendly, I got a couple to go sides for lunch and the food tastes AHMMAAZZING!!! I wish I lived in town, I would be there daily.

First time here and I will definitely be back. Immediately greeted by Bryan who assisted my mother and I in our options for keto friendly food. We ended up getting the spaghetti squash lasagna, chicken piccata with an arrowroot crust, keto chicken crust pizza and the broccolini. Everything was outstanding! I couldn't choose a favorite because they were all delicious. Bryan was extremely helpful throughout our entire lunch date here and his energy was electric. You will not be disappointed!!

We had an amazing experience at Intelligent Gourmet!! The good was fresh and delicious and it is hard to find keto friendly food, especially desserts in restaurants. So we were so happy to find them. The atmosphere and staff were
Just overall inviting and friendly. Keto/paleo and Vegan friendly choices.
We will be back again.
Delicious pastries and coffee! The owners are amazing and the baristas are always so friendly. I'm not even vegan but I'll stop in here any chance I get!
Great hidden spot in old gandy area. Highly recommended everything there . All the bake goods are very tasty. Love the coffee and the pies (picadillo and ziti).
Went on Saturday. Got a delicious latte and a pastry. Love it. Great owners. Great vibe. Will definitely be back soon!

Such a cute new addition to South Tampa! Stopped in this morning and was so impressed with everything. The staff was so sweet when helping me make a decision with my coffee. I got the strawberry bread and a latte and will definitely be returning! 10/10

Excellent new vegan gem in S Tampa! Bought the vegan banana bread and its moist & delicious! I've tried to make vegan banana bread myself and always comes out half baked! Thanks for offering great vegan healthy desserts!

*sigh* my last time I'll listen to anyone's recommendation without without doing my research...

Why do bars (not nightclubs) charge a cover charge?....$20. I'm from out of town so I'm thinking this place would be really nice for a $20 entry fee. No. 
We went to the rooftop but the city view was blocked by decorated walls. We wanted to get a table with bottle service but we noticed the waiter was quoting a higher price to us and a lower price to other groups. 

I just want my $20 back! LOL

Had a great bday gathering here 6/26/21 The atmosphere was great the energy was EVERYTHING!!!! My server I think her name is Damani was so cool.. Drinks were on point and the food was goooood! The lemon pepper wings and sweet chili wings were perfect.The music was lit!!! Would definitely return Oh and the hookah was just right. Only con was the ceiling was leaking (droplets) and restroom nasty
Cover charge on a Monday evening??!! Haven't been in but going by the other reviews doesn't seem like much.

I wish I would've listened to all the horrible reviews before I went firstly let's start with the $30 COVER CHARGE??? I didn't see anyone else complain about 30 maybe $20 or $10 but $30? Ridiculous and on top of that one of the guys outside was so rude and made us feel like we shouldn't even go in. Secondly the service there is horrible the girls just get you seated and then you need to flag them down and get ignored or get attitude when you ask for something (18% tip included btw so I'm guessing this is why they don't care if they're rude) it took me around 15 minutes just to get my receipt and an additional 20 to get my card and ID back. Definitely will not be returning to this scam of a business oh also I almost forgot what's the point of having a "rooftop lounge" if it's covered by a tent. Waste of money and time go literally ANY WHERE else for a better and cheaper time.

I'm obsessed with this restaurant. Honestly all of Ciccio's eatery spots are so . We need one at The Grove Wesley Chapel. I literally drive this far to get my shoe plant based mushroom pizza fix and everything on the menu are insanely delish!!!! Best part is it fits my lifestyle and clean eating habits. I love it here!

Finally checked this place out after they rebranded it. Because it's part of the Ciccio chain we pretty much knew what to expect. Two of us came for lunch. I would recommend getting there right when they open at 11:30 because it filled up quickly on a Friday midday. We both ordered the mango frozen margarita. It was very good. I ordered the Local Bowl and added cauliflower avocado rice for an extra $1.50. It was very good. The shrimp was cooked very well and the overall flavor was tasty. My friend ordered a couple of sushi rolls. I remember one being the Diablo Roll and I believe the second was the Crab Roll. The Diablo was our favorite of the two. Overall everything was good and it was a good experience.

Interesting restaurant... Tacos and sushi on Tuesday! Roll with it! Lol ... they also have pasta and pizza. 

Actually, the tacos ( $2 on Tuesday) were to die for! We had an assortment of tacos, but the best was The spicy Brazilian! 

Also came on a weekend for brunch... excellent! 

Omelette was delicious and the burger was cooked Med rare like I like.

Great service too (thank you, Sara!!)
Their plant-based Alfredo sauce is indistinguishable from the traditional kind that will choke off all the blood flow to your heart, killing you to death. Highly recommended.

My favorite place to eat Have brought friends in from out of town and they loved it. 
Their rice bowls are my favorite along with sushi.  Drinks are great and the staff could not be better. Location is great as well. Trying to think of a bad thing but there is not one.  Go visit and see if I'm right

Was literally the only one in the drive thru just trying to order for me and my fiancé I got a number 8 and when I went to order my fiancé's combo the manager came on and said we needed to come in because our order was too big and they only had one person on the line ..... I was the only customer. Even when we drove by the and looked inside..... no one was there ....This is not our first run in with horrible customer service at this location Taco Bell should really close down this location or bring in new management honestly just a terrible terrible location and the worst is that this is not a new thing I started noticing this location going down hill in like 2019 we use to stop by here on our way home from Busch Gardens but now we avoid it and then we forget and drop by the location to give them another chance and it is worse every time. Just no don't even try this location just find another location (there are so many close by) if you want Taco Bell .
Wrong order every time.. take the extra 3 minutes and go to the other one on Fowler. Cockroach crawling outside of window as I was handed my food. Really, just go to The other one.

Update -

after waiting 5 minutes and repeatedly asking if anyone was there, an employee answers rudely "the store is closed". 
AT 6:30 ON A MONDAY??? FOR A 24/7 MCDONALDS??? 
I could clearly see at least two employees through the drive through window. The employee refused to give me an explanation and said they couldn't process my mobile order since they were closed - in the most rude and infuriating encounter to date. 
I stand by my previous review - Please do not let this location's shining golden arches tempt you - you will only find disappointment, frustration, and lost faith in this entire establishment.  
My Mcdonalds cravings will forever be tainted by this dumpster fire of a fast food restaurant.
This is a perfect example as to why these workers do not deserve $15 hourly rate.  Corporate needs to shut this location down!  Horribly ran store!
Always missing items with every order. Bad attitude when confronted with their mistakes. The fries are usually stale. Avoid it if you can.
honestly this is probably the worst mcdonald's i've been to, awful service, never fail to mess up orders and forget orders. Would not recommend.
Our Tampa go-to for Cuban toast and cafe con leche! We never miss this on our trips to Tampa. Formerly know as Pipo's, many of the same employees still work there.

Came here on a random Tuesday and the place was lively and the staff was pleasant. It is a little small on the inside and people were constantly bumping into me because I was seated near the bar. The loaded nachos were recommended to us and they didn't disappoint. Gooey cheese goodness and roasted to perfection. A lot of meat and piled high. Great value and flavor. The guac was a little bit under seasoned and a bit expensive for the serving we got. Overall food I'd rate 4/5 and the drinks were solid at 4/5 as well. Definitely good spot for a date or casual dining experience.

I came here for brunch. The food was good. I had the Baja fish tacos with avocados, and my friend had the churros French toast.  The service was terrible. Our waitress forgot about us several times! About 70 minutes in, I was about to order another drink when she told us we had to leave because there was a 90 minute limit due to the pandemic. She said she could have my drink packed to go. I declined and we wrapped up and left.  We were never informed about the time limit in the beginning, but we just decided to leave because the service was terrible anyway.

Where to even begin...I come here with my friends at least once a week (minimum). There have been times where I've come here twice a week, plus ordering take out...it's THAT GOOD!!! The food is phenomenal and I highly recommend the Grilled Shrimp Bowl. We've made friends with the staff and they are all AMAZING!! Julisa & Marvin, you're the real MVPs! Probably will see you tomorrow at happy hour  100000% recommend!!!!!

Welp. My table ordered the guac sampler which was very inventive and tasty. The bacon and fig guac was worth trying! Now... the steak burrito and steak tacos weren't what we expected.  I probably should've assumed that the food would have a twist after trying the guac. My friend asked for no cheese in the burrito and she still got cheese in hers. The steak in the tacos and the burrito was so bland. Im not some connoisseur of Mexican food but this food was completely different than what we expected and pretty disappointing especially since we wouldn't need need much to be satisfied. Any of the food we didn't finish we did not bring home. I would not recommend this place nor come again.

The atmosphere is pretty nice as is the seating inside.

I have eaten at La Calaca Feliz several times, and each time has been such a pleasant experience... especially last night! The restaurant hosted a Dine & Donate fundraiser for an organization that I have been volunteering with for a while now, called The JoyJ Initiative. JoyJ offers direct outreach programs to provide aid and comfort while engaging in conversations and making connections with individuals experiencing homelessness and other communities undergoing hardship. We started a chapter here in Philly after volunteering with them in NYC. When I discovered that La Calaca does Dine & Donates for worthy causes, I immediately contacted them. Kelly responded and was extremely helpful organizing it from beginning to end. Our server, Pete, was so accommodating and friendly, along with the additional servers who helped serve our large party. To top it off, the food is delicious and I highly recommend their Tropical Margarita! We will continue to visit and are very grateful for their support and hospitality.

Okay so first of all the staff is racist. They chose to sit black people at this wobbly table next to the door outside. This was when they had four beautifully lit tables that were empty, but chose to sit us at this table with no light.  My party and I insisted on moving. Lo and behold the next black couple that came in were seated at this table. For any naysayers, this table was not chosen for any of the white couples that followed us. Did I mention that their version of cleaning the table for us was a waiter dusting the table with the back of his hand? The pasta is okay. The linguini barese is oily as hell. We were virtually ignored all night outside of them bringing our food. We got no napkins. And these folks have the nerve to charge you a fee for opening a bottle! The staff practically sneered at us when we made simple requests. Half the staff passed and ignored us when we entered. 

Racist, bad service, mid grade food.
Is it the best in the world, no. But everything i ate was tasty. Not overly priced. And overall a decent meal. Chicken parm was large and in charge. Will come back again. Always a fan of a byob.

This is a cute Italian restaurant that is BYOB and has amazing food! This is not a well known place but after walking by it multiple times we decided we had to try it.  To start we got the bruschetta which had large pieces of bread and was very refreshing. The place has a huge menu which made it very hard to choose what to get for dinner.  We decided on the fetuccini bolognese and homemade gnocchi in a pink sauce as they both were rated highly by our waiter.  We were not disappointed! The food came out quickly and was very filling.  The fettuccini was our favorite as the meat sauce was very flavorful.  This place was slow in checking in on us and giving us the check but all in all we had a great time.  The staff is very friendly and the food was great! This spot is perfect for date night or just when you want to drink a bottle of wine and catch up with some friends!

The service was awful and I feel we experienced a bit of racism. Our table was seated outside near a tree. The residue of the tree bark and leaves were all over the table and preset plates. I kindly asked for clean plates and glasses from the waitress. She seemed to be middle eastern and she had long black hair. She grabbed the plates and appeared to have an attitude with the request. About 10 minutes later another waiter came out and gave us our plates and glasses. The original waiter refused to come back to the table. My family and I waited about a good 20 minutes and she never came back. Other waiters walked past our table several times and saw that we hadn't been served at all yet and no one asked us if we needed anything. Our waitress even came outside and looked at us but went back inside.  Finally I asked a random waiter if our waitress planned on coming to our table. He said she should be but he just decided to take our order. Although the new waiter was pleasant, his follow up times could have been better. Please don't get me wrong. I know a waiter has more than 1 table. I'm not one of those people who are very demanding either. We had to flag him down every time we needed something. At first we were the only black family there and then another black family came later. I felt like we weren't particularly wanted there. The bad service started with me requesting clean plates. I don't think that that's an unreasonable request. It's not wise to preset a table that's placed outside underneath a tree. I should be able to eat on clean plates. The food was good, but I won't be back.

I am always super hesitant about going to places that are 3 stars or below but figured I'd take a chance this time. I couldn't be happier with the chance I took! 

The food was delicious, brought out in a timely manner, and easy to make reservations. Gratuity is added even if there's only two people. They do not sell wine but you can bring your own and they will charge a small corkage fee. 

The outdoor cabana/cabin seating is shared with another couple, so not much privacy and certainly not socially distant. There are however other outdoor single tables which allow for more privacy and distance from others.

The PBR was excellent but they need to do something about the soggy bread. After just 10 minutes in its wrapper, the bread nearly disintegrated in my hands. The saving grace was the pork. It was so incredibly tender and just the right amount of seasoning. The chunks of pork in the PBR is unlike the roast pork sandwiches I've had elsewhere in Philly. George's version actually reminds me of the tongue sandwich I had in Italy (tender, fatty, full of flavor and simply delicious). The extra sharp provolone makes it even better. I could've done without the broccoli rabe. It didn't really add much to the sandwich in my opinion. I think long hots on the side would be a better alternative for next time.

I've been wanting to try the pork sandwich at George's for 20 years or so.  I was disappointed.  The meat was chunky and a bit grisly, the sharp provolone wasn't sharp, and the rabe had no taste.  The roll was OK and it was a huge sandwich overall for just $10.  If the pork isn't any good what's the point?  Oh well...

Wish you could give zero stars bc every time u order which I spend atleast 35-40$ 2xs a week yet the retards still can't get a simple order rite hope they enjoy cleaning up the mistakes i the row at the door each week and we are now done with these retards

It's 2021 and they still suck. Horrible customer service. Like Jesus. You can tell they hate their job. Was waiting for my pizza for 2 plus hours. When I asked about it they snapped like damn tell me it's still cooking or something.

I'm sitting at twisted turtle as I type this.  DO NOT EVER GO HERE.   The bartenders are terrible the manager hates anyone that's not a big spender. The DJ on Saturday nights is absolutely terrible.  Not even worth spending money to sit and listen to; no matter how hot the bar tenders are.  DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME.  Never go here. Save your money and go to some place like green parrot or whiskey north. Also, NEVER GO HERE.  Ever since Scott and his father were pushed out this place is trash.  I've tried to give it a chance and have gotten food poisoning twice for my efforts which they say is my own fault. They are all worthless.

I really don't leave many bad reviews. This place is an ownership clusterf$&@.  The bar tenders are trying hard. But they have patrons and other people behind the rail doing bar back stuff. Patrons are all friends of somebody who knows somebody. Leadership and standards are void.  Somebody who has money to piss away thought he would open a bar. Anyhow, be nice and tip the bartenders who are working hard and the only reason this place is marginal.

This place is in the old O'Brien's spot and I stopped by to check it out. It was a Friday and there was maybe 8 people. They opened right before Covid, bad luck. I sat at the tiki bar, as the inside was empty. They have an impressive bourbon selection, I got a Knob creek. Good pour. The dragon berry mule was ok, not my style. It'll get ya buzzin though. For food i got bone in wings, hot parmesan mixed. They were big wings and the flavor was right on point. 
The owner was sitting next to me talking to the bar staff and encouraging them to post on facebook. I haven't heard anything about this place except scrolling through Yelp. They need to drop some money on ads, or have a college night or something. It's a story told over and over in Tampa, great place nobody knows about. 
The inside is renovated and I liked the mural on the wall.  Cigars are welcome and sold on site, as are dogs. The smoker outside is a good sign, can't go wrong with wood and fire. With so many choices old and new along dale mabry, I fear this place will get lost in the shuffle. 
The bartenders were fun, pretty, and bored. A few more elite yelpers swing by and it might jump start them a little.

I am really surprised there are only  12 reviews for this establishment. 

Abbreviated review: Clean, staff is nice, food is delicious, atmosphere fun, DJ Fri, Sat, Sun, outdoor seating, full bar, large dining room, bar seating, televisions

I was really impressed by this place, it was about 10pm at night so it was more of a club at the time my BFF and I went. The music was loud but not to loud a good mix of new and old R&B music. 

We sat down at the end of the bar to social distance, we wore our masks in but when we sat down we took our masks off. Taylor was the bartender and he immediately came over and took our drink order. I asked what is good on the menu and he suggested the chicken skillet so  I ordered it and my BFF ordered the quesadillas. Watching the staff I could see how well they worked together. Food went up in the window and it was brought to you without having to sit in the window and get cold. When we both had our food the manager came over and asked what we thought. 

It was all delicious! I was completely surprised. When I asked Taylor how long the chef has been cooking he said 10 years but even the newer chef new how to cook really well. 

Do yourself a favor and no matter what you are looking for do not overlook this little gem. You might find adventure at the end of the bar.
Such a cute little spot with a very delicious menu. Their appetizer was excellent and their spider roll is amazing. Highly recommend!

The vibe in this restaurant is vibrant, they played upbeat music, and the service was great! The restaurant itself is small but the flavors were big! I got the chicken Pad Thai and ordered a jasmine milk boba to go, the boba was soft and delicious! Best I have ever had!! Truly authentic Thai restaurant!
I ordered on doordash and literally nothing was sealed. One of the boxes even had holes. The Thai tea wasn't covered. The red curry dish was smaller than I was anticipating.

Adorable small little place in the corner of the strip mall. We were the only table in there which I usually hate but it was good there. Lots of shenanigans on the walls. There's a fish tank that seemed clean but one of the fishes eyes were messed up, a little unsettling sight while eating. We got sushi and some Thai dishes. For a Thai restaurant, or any restaurant, the sushi was really good, very fresh. I'll definitely be back here. Service was really friendly too.

The food wasn't bad but the portion size was the smallest I have ever had in a Thai restaurant. Very disappointed since I was hoping to come here often. I probably won't come back again but if you don't eat much or trying to portion control, this is the place for you.

Chef Michael is an angel! We met back in 2019 when my now husband and I wondered in to his bakery and he without warning he did an amazing and in depth cake tasting. We were sold! He then let us book another tasting with our parents, free of charge of course. He let our family members rank their favorites and help us select our perfect design! He even set up a special cupcake for my very picky mother. Our cake was perfect on the day of! He didn't let us worry about saving a tier and sure enough over a year later, made us a complimentary anniversary cake that was just as stunning and yummy as our actually wedding cake! Safe to say, when the time comes, he'll be making our baby shower cake!

Through the years this is my neighborhood diner that I walk to. It kept its legacy with great food and service. Even through the COVID-19 pandemic, it remained open and served the neighborhood with all the love it always had. The food is awesome and the waitresses are so patient and attentive and lovely. Kathy is my favorite!

My absolute favorite breakfast spot in Philly. It's small and quant so on weekends there's usually a wait but it's definitely worth it. Their breakfast sandwich and chicken and waffles are both amazing. They also have a great bloody marry!
The waitresses are so disrespectful and rude to the costumers. The place did not adapt well to Covid and is very disorganized.

Good food, good service & a nice atmosphere. Had the Pastrami Rueben. Very good ... tasty thick cut Pastrami on fresh Rye. Good & speedy service in a really cool Phillies baseball themed space. Indoor and Outdoor bars are available when waiting for your table. We'll be back!
I think is Expensive for not so good food, everything spicy and I had a stomachache after eating there
Been coming here for years and never had any major issues. Food is great, fast service and nice employees. There's also outdoor seating if you're into that. The atom bombs are to die for

Very solid Chinese. We ordered Bourbon Chicken, Sweet & Sour Shrimp, Chicken Pad Thai, and crab rangoons. All was pretty tasty and pretty good quality. Would def say one of the best Chinese take out spots I've tried in tampa.

Always been our fall back restaurant for Chinese dining but the funny thing is they do more Vietnamese food. I can't really complain about anything except the delivery service we ordered through for our food really screwed up. We ordered food through them, 30 minutes later they canceled my order and refunded my money. So we called the restaurant and complained...staff was nice and took our order. Ten minutes later the door bell rings and it's the food from the canceled order. Wow! Surprised and hungry we sat down to enjoy and 10 minutes later the doorbell rings again and it's our second order!!!! Two for the price of one???? Tried to explain but the driver smiled and kept saying OK, OK.  Haven't ordered through a service with them again.

The egg roll was good, but the lowmein was not so good.

I don't know how you can mess up lowmein but they have figured it out. The chicken was dry and not flavorful.. why hao wahhhh whyyy have you foresaken the lowmein! 

I had high hopes. The portion was generous, but if you give me a lot of not so good lowmein then it doesn't matter.

My stomachs heart is sad. Farewell....
Get the beef pho and it's one of my favorites in tampa! Reliable and consistent, and they're also on uber eats.
Ordered here again and I love their fried rice - so good!!!! The food is packaged well and delivery is precise. Very good try it.

We have a second home in the north east and Bishos is our favorite place to visit when we are in town.

We always order sandwiches and appetizers and Bishos never disappoints. 

This new location is also better than their old location in my opinion, very comfortable to dine in. 

Highly recommend!

I ordered the Falafel wrap combo at 7:11 and it was delivered by 7:25. It was so delicious- the Bishos recommended toppings were perfect. It tasted fresh and flavorful. The fries were a bit soggy but that is to be expected with delivery and I love the seasonings they put on top. I'm excited to try a different dish next time. Don't sleep on this place!
The meat was very dry and chewy. The sauce is also too sour, I would not order from here again.

This is the spot to be if you want a great brunch. The flavors and variety of the food are great. Service is also a great aspect of this place. This is a must-try again place. I was so sad that this place closed during COVID, but then later on I found out it had moved to a new location

We drove down from Doylestown after hearing a review and following on Instagram. It was so worth the drive. I don't even know where to start, the food was excellent. I have never tasted fries like this and the taste was just perfect. Hummus and falafel were both amazing. My husband grew up right around the corner and said the cheesesteak was a+. Chicken rice bowl and the chicken topped fries were also so flavorful. What a gift to the community to have a place like this. I wish we lived closer but we will absolutely be back to try more.

There are not enough good things that I can say about this restaurant!! The food was absolutely delicious, and very well priced for the healthy sized portions. 

As a vegetarian, there were plentiful options for me, which is always appreciated. I had the Menu Turista, which is 3 plates for $35. (Talk about getting Restaurant Week deals all year round!) My main dish was the ravioli. It was sooo good, and actually dinner sized. None of that "here's 4 raviolis on a plate" nonsense.

My partner had the fish special and he was extremely impressed, he had to resist clapping his hands and making a scene, lol. According to him, people should be fighting over reservations because the food is that good 

The interior is very cool and eclectic, and has a lively atmosphere. The service was really great too, very attentive and knowledgeable. Overall, it's the perfect spot for a casual date night, dinner with friends, or for bringing out of town guests! We'll definitely be repeat customers

We had a lovely meal last night at Modo Mio. First off, they offer a nightly tasting menu that is $45/person, which, given the quality of the food, is a really good deal! (You can put choose any of the antipasti, primi, or segundi for your tasting menu.) They brought us an amuse bouche of burrata and honey, which was divine. For our antipasti, I ordered the burrata (again), and it was so creamy and delightful. My partner got the fried risotto, which was outstanding! I've never had anything like that -- think huge fritter with creamy filling. Yum. For our primi, we each got a pasta. The gnocchi was so good: perfect spice level and texture. My pasta (cacio e pepe) was clearly homemade and had the perfect texture and creaminess, though the sauce could have used slightly more pepper. For the segundi, the salmon special was fabulous, cooked and seasoned to perfection! The lamb chops were a bit over-cooked, but the sauce on top was really nice. And, finally, dessert -- YUM! The flourless chocolate cake had the best balance of bitterness with sweetness, and we also had a piece of the pine nut cake. I've never had anything like it! The pine nuts were so airy and crunchy, and the overall slice had incredible flavor. Will definitely be coming back soon!

Stellar Italian cuisine that is generously priced based  on quality and quantity. We selected their 'Turista', a sumptuous 4 course dinner.

First, we were served Bruschetta compliments of the chef...a tasty piece of focaccia ricotta and olive oil on top, light but enjoyable.
Monte e Mare, very well balanced appetizer with pieces of grilled squid & potatoes, this is highly recommended. Carrozza, egg dipped grilled cheese is just fine.. Mussels with white wine sauce (special of the day) is the best among the three.

For pasta dish, their lasagna was traditional. Rotolo, is a ricotta roll that is dense but good. I enjoyed the most is their Tagliatelli Modo Mio, very refreshing dish with egg noodles, with artichoke and some lemony flavor but overall light and sumptuous.

Secondi, opted for Bistecca Siciliana & Fish Of the day... the latter is a filet of white fish with shaved almonds, loved it! The former is a good size portion of breaded ribeye with egg, a heavy dish and a tad salty to my personal taste.

Tiramisu and their Pana Cotta are soft and creamy dessert.  Olive Oil cake is moist and fun. All were enjoyable pieces of Heaven. 

Overall, this is good dinner which will fill you up. 3 persons on a 4 course meal (Turista), 2 cocktails, 2 glasses of wine, a beer, espresso...ran $250 with tip.
Well worth dinner.

This was a tough review trying decide between 4 and 5 stars (I rarely ever give 5 stars).
There were a few negatives so let's get those out of the way first. The wait time to receive the entree portion of our meal was terribly long. We sat there and sat there for what seemed to be at least a half an hour after finishing our initial course. Also the portion size of my entree left something to be desired like more food. Now the good stuff.
My entree was amazing. The Agnolotti was the  Best pasta dish I have ever had. Have been thinking about it ever since. The fusilli lungi was also tasty. The carrozza starter was well done and was a great start to the meal. We sat outside on a cold night but the heaters kept us completely warm. Overall I deff recommended and you must get the Agnolotti. I do wish they would of given a larger portion of it.

The food here is delicious! This is a local gem in the upcoming fish town area. The service is great and there is plenty of seating outside with great service. I had brunch there and the "Sopa De Tortillas" is definitely the best I've ever had! Very creamy and you can taste all the different fresh components like the Guacamole and the tomato broth is so rich and made with love. The Charro skillet is served with big chunks of Carne Asada and topped with delicious hollandaise sauce. There is a lot on the menu that I still want to try so this will definitely become a destination for me. There is also plenty of free parking around which is a plus!

The food was good but the service was poor. There is an automatic 20% gratuity regardless of the party size, so there's probably less of an incentive to have good service. The food took way too long to arrive, around 45min to an hour. Beware their drinks are spicy. I didn't like how spicy one of the drinks were and the waitress was very condescending about it. They did give a replacement drink which was nice.
The food itself tasted good. The nachos were a good size and tasted amazing. Two people from my party got burritos and the sizes were very different. Overall, I think this place is probably better for takeout, as the service wasn't amazing.

Lots of good reviews and pretty disappointing.

1. Update your menu. Nothing on it has been updated for months. 
2. They still have a 20% gratuity regardless of party size which i could understand during covid but theyre at full capacity with no restrictions and have both indoor and outdoor. 
3. I usually tip 20% but the service is trash. We waited thirty mins just to have them figure out our bill bc they charged us for just drinks and we gave them the courtesy of correcting our bill to include our food. Constantly having to ask for everything. Utensils didnt come w the food. Water had a piece of a stick in it. Have to grab someone begging them to take our check away from us. 
4. The food is honestly subpar. Tacos are small portions especially the shrimp and fish tacos. The enchiladas arent bad but can get dry. Theres a lot of great mexican food options in the area and this place is probably the most disappointing. 
5. Drinks are cheap which is great, the red rice is bomb the only thing i finished. 

Tbh service probably sucks bc the automatic gratuity. I am honestly not sure how this place has such great reviews.

Been to this place twice primarily for their take out margs. They're excellent quality, only complaint is too much ice, but i wont knock a star for that, they gotta make their buck. The chorizo potato burrito is fire, but i would love a just chorizo option. Again, not a reason to knock a star because it was delicious. Highly recommend off my few visits.

This is my go to place for good burritos and margaritas. Their staff is always super nice and helpful. I recommend the carne asada burrito, and try their green salsa! Not spicy unfortunately but super flavorful! 
They nachos are also good!! Enough for 2 as a meal.
Always decent rolls with quick pickup times. Great for lunch special. Deff recommend the wasabi maki and dragon rolls
Great food, reasonable price, and the delivery is almost always gets to me at least 20 min faster than estimated
Always quick and a great menu of options to choose from. They have been one of my delivery staples for years.

I absolutely LOVE the Samurai Platter. Aside from being a great deal, the sushi is fresh and delicious. Also, while probably not authentic, the crab and cream chees filled Volcano roll is a gunky, sloppy but a deliciously guilty pleasure. I felt I needed to go to confession afterwards. :-) The staff is friendly and highly organized.

They're beyond rude here. I've never had multiple staff members be this incredibly rude to me. I stood in the to-go line watching staff pass by me for 10+ minutes. I was told my order would take about 15 minutes, it took a lot longer. I asked one gentlemen if my order was ready and he said "what order" and then walked in the back came back out and continued assisting other customers. Finally a woman came and assisted me I asked if my order was ready she said no. I then asked if I could get a refund because I was going to miss my flight if I had waited any longer and the woman assisting me was very rude and said, " if there was a manager here I would." I waited another five minutes and then she gave me my food and sarcastically kept telling me to have a nice day. I had chose to order here because it was the closest thing to my gate but avoid coming here, there's plenty of other options available.

The let us wait in line 30 minutes then closed the kitchen with me and another couple to go refusing to seat us. You couldn't seat us then post the closed podium after us? Just 2 tables to seat as other patrons were finishing? Very rude and inconsiderate. Don't waste your time on line here.

It's an airport bar so I know it's not safe to compare to an outside joint. That being said some things can remain even in this setting. 

The bar tender was nice but warned me that I could only have one red Bull regardless of how many shots of Tito's I ordered, which seemed odd. I had to flag him down to get a food order put in and he acted like he had no idea what was on their very limited menu. I finally ordered the Cezar salad with blackened mahi-mahi, sounds yummy right?  It took a solid half hour to produce, even though we all know salad and a piece of fish doesn't take that long and they were not at all busy. When it finally arrived I was so disappointed...the salad wasn't dressed but rather their very bland dressing was on the side. The croutons looked and tasted burned and the romane was on its last legs and only the worst, super interior of the lettuce. Also, romane should be green and not white. Worse yet was the fish. It was bland and tasted like it had somehow been packed in water....it was chewy in all the worst of ways. I couldn't eat it, the combo was to much so I boarded my plane starving even more than when I arrived despite spending $50 for lunch.

Not many options so we picked this place since it didn't seem too busy. We waited nearly 40 mins for our food - had to ask to get it in a to go box so we wouldn't miss our flight. Rushed to the gate to eat some of the mostly inedible food. Airport food is never great but this is by far the worse I ever had. We essentially threw away $30 bucks. 
Even while waiting for food, server didn't check on us or offered any apology about the delay. 
Better off going hungry!
Rude staff. Tried to order take out, the entire staff ignored a line of 6 people for 10 minutes. someone asked for help and was told "we're short staffed so we're only helping tipping customers"

Visited July 2021. This restaurant is charming, the wait staff works hard and the food good (not great, but good). We were ok with that because of the ambiance but our experience fell flat overall due to the lack of bartending professionals and the lack of options. The drinks were terrible and the wine on the list not in house. I truly hope this place doesn't go down for lack of talent. I would love to go back when they staff up to see how they're doing.

Let me start by saying the service here SUCKS!!! SERVICE IS SLOW!! For starters it take 30 minutes just to get drinks another 30 mins just to order food and another 30mins before the food even comes out. The food is soo BASIC in taste! The veggies aint even seasoned. The manager (black guy) has a NASTYYY attitude. I came all the way from Maryland because of the wonderful reviews but it was a big MISTAKE. The lemonade is veryyy bitter. And I will never be back again! They charge $4 extra for egg whites $5 for a little lemonade its just ridiculous.
