Delicious!... I was introduced to this restaurant in 2017.... I can say, they are consistent, fresh, delicious, keeps you wanting more, etc.... great choice for a latin meal... I  totally recomend dining here!... feels like a meal from home away from home.
This was an excellent spot to have a late lunch/early dinner and talk. Delicious salads and bread. Lovely atmosphere upstairs, with the window open.

Who doesn't love Mixto?! No one I've ever taken there! Ropa Vieja is my favorite, but I've had plenty of delicious plates, like their seafood dishes. Happy hour deals are good too. I've had one disappointing brunch, but I just won't order that dish again. Love the location, the servers, the food, and the atmosphere! Glad you survived the pandemic!

The "Wit" was delicious. Great blend of chip keilbasi, onions, and cheese sauce. The fries tasted like fresh cut fries. 

The portions were good. I am very impressed by the food.

The bartender/Server was friendly and open to questions I had. 

Definitely coming back again!

First time visit since COVID on Saturday and what a surprise. The bar had patrons in every seat. At the bar. No masks worn by staff. Just a heads up to potential customers. Yes I created this account right now to make this review because as a matter of health it I felt it necessary to do my part and share.

I really enjoy coming here with my friends and on occasion my family will come up as well. We all LOVE the food and the staff. The food is always amazing and the staff is always welcoming and so helpful! Our only issue is that every single time we have come here our beer is either flat (draft) or warm (bottle). It's so weird! We even brought this up to our sever and she was so kind about it. When she returned with new beer they were warm too and we didn't have the heart to tell her again. This has happened every single time we have come here, in total...six times! We now call it "warm beer house" and just order food or mixed drinks when we come in now. We know they will be cold because of the ice lol You guys either have to run your lines more often or check your gas tanks because the draft beers are flat. Also, please for the love of God start serving cold beer! I'm sure we're not the only people who notice this. Let me know when ya do and we'll come back for beers! We're not a bunch of Karen's lol we just want cold beers :)

Gaul used to be my favorite place for take out. I would go here once a week or every other week. Food was always excellent. For some reason, every time I've gone since around Thanksgiving, the food has not been good and even a couple times, inedible (and I hate wasting food). 

I know it could be a "bad night," not enough staff, etc. so I keep giving it another chance hoping it'll be great like it used to be. But, with the prices of food going up and the quality going so far down, I can't say I'll return. I've had too many orders of almost totally black-burned fried mozzarella, cold and soggy fries, orders of Buffalo cauliflower with more styrofoam box than actual food, mac and cheese seems like microwaved noodles with shredded cheese on top? It seems like the kitchen is trying to short cut things. I'd say maybe this is just me but my household feels the same way. 

My last visit was last weekend. The specials (which should be extra fresh) seemed microwaved. The potato soup special was actually cold and just not good, tried to not waste it but I just couldn't eat it. Fish and chips were alright. Buffalo Mac and cheese just tasted like dry, cooked pasta with hot sauce on top. On top of it, the younger staff is friendly BUT they usually seem too preoccupied with serving beers to larger parties of people rather than serving customers in small groups looking to order food. Waited 25 min. to order, and 15 min. for a spoon. 

I really hope Gaul finds a good, consistent chef, doesn't take short cuts (I'd rather wait 45 min. for take out if it's actually good), and focuses on it being a restaurant more than a watering hole. I've given it 7 or 8 "one last shot" 's.

Great food and awesome selection of beer on tap. Been wanting to get here for a long time and it lived up to all the hype. The cheese sauce is one of the best I've had. Wit or Witowski was outstanding!
Always delicious! Anything on the menu, can't go wrong. Super friendly and courteous staff.

Best high quality Asian restaurant in NorthTampa.  Big chains and Mom and Pops have come and gone along this stretch of Bruce B Downs but Liangs has been here 18 years . Never empty.  Attention to detail is big here, like all the veggies being cut the same size, someone has got good knife skills.  The tuna poke bowl is huge and so fresh.  FRESH.  Rice slightly warm, cucumber, avocado, macadamia nuts, ahi, ponzu on the bottom so you can mix in the quantity you like.  Korean beef stir fry, classic gochujang notes and pleasantly hot.  Served with a big bow of rice. 

Pad Thai is next soon
Had the best teriyaki steak on a sizzling platter finished table side YUM. Attentive staff. Good food good atmosphere. We will be back

The food here is fantastic.  The soups are not greasy or watery.  They are fresh and delicious.  The lunch entrees are plenty of food.  Service is great also.  Very high end.  Our server Patrick was always on time with what we needed.  This is the best Asian food we have ever had and could not believe all we got for the price.  1st place restaurant.

Pretty average food at a somewhat high price. I order the Chinese Fried rice with beef, sesame chicken, spring rolls, and their creamy cheese puffs? (Crab rangoons), everything was pretty plain tasting other than the rangoons which were great.

Food- Chicago Deep Pizza, Veggie (Not Olive Fan). I'm a huge pizza fan and by far this was delicious! You can tell the mushroom, green peppers and onions were sooooo freessshhhh! And the cheese --- its just chesse heaven! 

Service- Excellent, they didn't have cherry coke (which was kinda sad but life went on). I had water and the water was delicious! Florida water can taste weird at times but this place had good water!

Overall, get this pizza worth it!

10/10
We love Cappy's pizza! First place we ever dined in Tampa and it remains a staple. Take out or dine in- Greek salad and a pizza are great!

Food was great as was service! However the new high chairs are missing a clip, so that made our dinner a little stressful (we have an 18 month old who was trying to I climb across the table). Please fix the high chairs so we can come back.

We ordered a Cappy's special pizza on Sunday for pickup. We ordered it crispy and we got it just like we like it crispy and delicious. It was full of ingredients made just right. We also got a Greek salad which was also wonderful. It was also ready in under twenty minutes as promised.

We ONLY eat pizza and Greek salad from Cappy's. The fresh made dough and sauce is amazing, every time!  Place is cute and quirky. Staff is awesome and prices are great. We also enjoy the variety of beers offered. You will not be disappointed!!!

With the amazing reviews we had to try!   The service is friendly.  The restaurant is small and cozy. I had the California burrito. Unfort, I am not sure how they cook the steak as it was a grayish brown color. 

The wife had a chicken burrito. Not a lot of flavor. 

The portions are huge so do come hungry!!
Duuude!!! best friggin burrito i've ever had!!! best hole in the wall spot around for a massive filling meal. their signature burrito is insanely addicting, i could not stop eating it.
Americanized, low quality. Pretty girl at the counter, though, so that was nice.
Great food. Good prices. The wait was longer, but it was the height of the lunch hour. So a wait is to be expected. I'd definitely recommend this place.
Love love love. Every time we shoot a commercial in town I gotta stop here. Burritos are amazing and the Birria tacos are stellar

It takes a LONG TIME for your drinks and food to arrive.  Then it just sits there and gets cold as you try to play within the window of your time constraints of what you've paid for.

Then, you have the LONG LINES waiting to get in.  When you think you are going to get in someone extends their bay time and they you need to add at least another 30-60 minutes before your name comes up on the list again to get a bay.

Not worth the wait!

This place is what I call .. Energy Packed, Fun, Edgy and just down right put together. I think this is one place where I can say the front of the house , back of the house runs together. I understand TopGolf maybe because I worked for them 4 years from the beginning so I definitely understand their core values and know they work hard to live up to that. Food never disappoints me neither the management. My friends go all the time and they love it. This place is absolutely great for the entire family and for birthday parties. I've had corporate parties here and they have always been a great hit with the employees. So when you're looking for something different look no more this will do the trick. Oh wait one more thing try those injectable donut holes with Bavarian cream and raspberry together .. mouth watering goodness

Poor experience and would not recommend. We booked for 6 people and paid for 2 hours of golf. We had chairs for only 5 people and were told we could not have 6 seats as someone needed to be golfing at all times. So despite eating dinner there it was musical chairs constantly. Plus, we had large puddles of water all over our table as they gave no coasters and the condensation from the heat caused puddles everywhere.  Wait staff were hardly present and dismissive of any needs. We won't be back.
This place is always a fun time! The vibes are great, music is good and the injectable donut holes are delicious if your looking for a fun dessert!
Alexis (Lex) was the best--friendly and professional. The kids felt at home and responded to his generous and friendly demeanor.  We had a great time at this clean and mask compliant facility.

This review is for the Pharmacy. I have two young children that are sick and I CAN NOT say enough about this pharmacy. They made sure to get the meds by tonight. I'm literally crying. After such a hard day with sick babies they made a little part of it so much better! Thank you!

Excellent place.  During COVID and before my son would stop here and bring dinner home.  Their meat choices are unbelievable.  You can cut into the meat with just a fork, that's how soft they get it and the outside is crisp and dripping in the most delicious sauces ever.  I had never had Brazilian food prior to this place, but certainly love it now.  I'm stating DON'T hesitate choosing this place for lunch/dinner.  The food is amazing.  We've had maybe 6 different meals from here so far and all of them have been what I'd call exceptional.  I'm almost positive they also do dine in, since they aren't close to our residence take out has been best for us.  But either way I'm whole heartedly recommending this restaurant.  ENJOY.....

Me and my fiancé went here because of the great reviews. We walked in and were greeted by high school girls who laughed in our faces and didn't know what they were doing. When we're asked for a table for two the were confused what I was asking for. We told them it was our first time there. The girl who seated us didn't know anything about the place and needed someone else to give us directions. When we finally got directions to go up and serve ourselves, in a STEAKHOUSE... there was about 5 meats to choose from for $34. Safe to say we didn't eat there.

If you're looking for the upscale, servers in fancy attire experience you get from fogo or Texas de Brazil, you won't find that here.

What you will find is perfectly cooked and seasoned meat, quick service and awesome people.

Cheaper, but better.

First time trying Roman style pizza. The crust is so airy and light it reminds me of a focaccia! I love the texture it's so easy to digest and I don't feel stuffed after eating about 2 slices. I'm usually a fan of flat bread pizza and dislike the thick chicago style deep dish. Depends on what kind of pizza dough you like you'll have different opinion on this pizza place. But if you like focaccia bread, this is your place! 

We tried the ham & mushroom pizza slice, truffle pizza slice, and the carbonara slice. They were all really good but the topping is very lacking. I was hoping there would be more toppings on the Pizza but that's my strange personal preference. I've yet to really find a pizza place that's impressed me with their quantity of toppings. The bread and flavors were all good though - but nothing spectacular. 

My boyfriend told me they usually will sprinkle some oregano/spice and then add some fresh basil after they toast your pizza. They didn't do that for me...  *Ask about that when you go, I'm sure it'll add good flavor to the pizza.
The pizza was just fantastic!!!  The crust.  The sauce.  The toppings.  Everything was delicious.  It was like a melody in my mouth.
Love it! The dough is incredible. Looks like they're now back in operation after a covid hiatus.

They offer a variety of different pizzas, each with their own superb flavor profile.

I recommend the mushroom truffle pizza, spinach artichoke pizza, and the vodka sauce pizza.
Great variety of pizza and their salads are nice and fresh.  Service is always friendly and their delivery service is timely.  Try them!

This place is the real deal! Totally authentic Mexican food! Great prices,too. Friday is taco friday, and tacos are $1.00. Staff is great. Inside dining is available with just a few tables, but we take out at least a couple times a month. We have never had a bad dish, and we have had breakfast, lunch, and dinner! I just wish they were more visible, so more people would know about this wonderful family owned business. They are located in West Tampa just north of 275 off the Howard/Armenia exit. Very convient, but if you didnt know it, you would think they were closed. Open everyday 7am-9pm,
Except Sundays.

This place was so damn good! They had fresh fruit juice which was very refreshing.  The food was homemade.  I am definitely going back to try other items.  Thus far the gordita and barbacoa were delicious.

This place is the best. Great food, great service, overall, wonderful experience. 

I had the quesadilla which was amazing. My friends had tacos that also looked wonderful.

Small family run Mexican restaurant. Authentic Mexican food. Had a chicken quesadilla this visit it was big, excellent quality and delicious. Prior visit had chicken fajitas. Big portion enough to take leftovers home food and quality were also excellent that visit.

**Bring cash to tip. We owe the ladies in here! 

Anyway- we drive by here all of the time & finally made it in on Saturday for some takeout:

2 chicken tacos
2 beef tacos 
1 quesabirria 
1 chicken quesadilla 
Chips & salsa

Grand total -$29.00
Freaking steal.

Everything was so fresh!! Flavors quite good. My other half compared the tacos to those he's had in Baja, no complaints out of him!! We both inhaled our food. We will be back. 
Probably Friday.

The food quality was good but as for quantity terrible. I payed $40 for tacos rice and beans and got nothing what I expected. So cheap and skimpy with serving. I was shocked they even allowed to send this out. I never write reviews but this was terrible. They also automatically add a gratuity without even letting you know until after it's paid. So disappointed.

I have been going here since they opened. The chips and salsa recipe has remained exactly the same...perfect. I no longer live in the area so to be fair I can't really talk about the service or atmosphere. However when I was coming in to dine the waitstaff was always a hit or miss but the bartenders were always on point. We had a bartender once who took 10 orders and didn't write anything down, they were mixed drinks! Ok let me get back to the food. Nowadays I take to go when I'm in town and the tacos, veggie wings  and chips and salsa are all still just as fresh and delicious as they always were.

This place has absolutely done a 180.....the service was absolutely awful.....maybe because they kno no matter what they are at least getting 20%..... I gotta be honest ....that 20% sign at the front made me uneasy.... As a looked around and saw mostly black people there a light bulb went off.... 20% is for the clientele(black)that they feel as tho don't tip ..... THIS PLACE CAN EAT A BAG OF DICKS

I liked this place and the servers were great. The drinks were good too. I liked the shrimp tacos a lot. Not too spicy and just the right amount of flavor. I wish the queso came with chips instead of tortillas but it was good. I'd come again and try something new.

I've gone here a couple times and every time the food as well as the service has been good. I came here earlier than my party and they still were able to seat me even though I was the only one out of the five is us that were here. The waiter, Brandon, was super laid back and extremely pleasant to have. He made sure I was well taken care of even when it was just me, he was super polite, and he was able to get our food out quick. The food itself too was really good. I wasn't expecting any great west coast type tacos and of course these weren't like those but nevertheless they were still great. Would I eat here again? Absolutely. Would I give all of my life savings to tip Brandon for his hospitality? Realistically no but I would want to. And lastly, this place is tucked in a cute area in northern liberties. The only complaint really is finding parking but when you're in/around the city, that's just how it is.

Grilled Salmon Platter (w/Broccoli and Garlic butter rice) was very tasty, juicy, and fulfilling. This was my first time visiting and I'm very impressed with the food. I will be coming back to try other items on the menu.

Had a craving for fried fish and this place deliveredt! The fish, shrimp, and fries were cooked and seasoned to perfection. I also ordered shrimp pasta which was slightly in the bland side but with a little salt and pepper this dish was perfect also. The kids tore it up & kids are picky so that says something. Everything was so good it all hit the spot, there will be a next time.
This place is so good not somewhere to sit and eat tho more like take out! Never disappoints pretty affordable and definitely worth the money

I stopped by this location on a busy Saturday evening after leaving the Adventure Island water park close by. 
I was pleasantly surprised to see that in their menu was an order for fried snapper with French fries. They also have fried shrimp and yellow rice on the menu. 
We ordered all that and red velvet cake and strawberry cheesecake. Everything tasted delicious. Delicious!
The location is a little run down. The service is good though. I've been back twice now and the food has been great twice! Seasoning is good and the oil that the food is fried in is clean. 
The parking lot is small and can get a little hectic but worth the visit.
I definitely recommend!

3.5 stars is about right rating for this restaurant. They are popular among the local neighborhoods. We saw many African Americans customers when we visited this place. Fried seafood is one of their favorite food. Parking is kind of limited. The seat down table also limited if you want to eat there. Many people ordered to go.  

We got the fried conch as appetizer. This is my first time to have fried conch. The coating is good. We also got the oyster and fish combo box. The oyster is in good pieces. We like the fried shrimp. It was delicious. The fish can have a choice like Basa, tilapia, salmon or mullet. For fried food I like to eat it there. 

There is a wait after ordering. I don't mind with fresh fried seafood. It is good to eat there instead of take home.

So how was it? My dining companion s enjoyed it. I however would like fans blowing whilst dining in 99° weather. And is a spoon with soup to much to ask for? Check include a 20% gratuity. Now consumer covers the low employers wage too. Gotta say they do ask still, "can I get you anything else while walking away".
Ask for SALT and Pepper. Or bring your own. Geesh.
Very disappointed. Made reservations on line.  Came with guests and was told they had no record. 45 min wait and no apology. Just shrugged.

Absolutely love this place! I am gluten free and the food was still incredible for me and my non-gluten free friends. The smoothies and coffee were the "cherry on top." All of this in an adorable setting. Not to mention, it was nice to see diverse staff who feel comfortable being themselves.

Live close by and have given multiple chances. Service isn't good my waitress disappeared for 20 minutes while waiting for a new drink. If you're gonna charge 20% gratitude you should probably do your job. Food is good but overpriced IMO.

Several months back I stopped by for a coffee, not realizing Front Street Cafe was closed because of COVID at the time. I tried the door which was locked. A tall, bald guy stormed out of a side door, approached me, and proceeded to give me a bunch of attitude for no reason whatsoever. Then he turned and walked away down the street. It was so weird. Prior to this experience I had been a customer at Front Street Cafe for years. I'll never step foot in there again.
VERY RUDE! Manager Would not let me use a fully functioning bathroom. stating its for employee use only.....

Went in with my 2 kids to get donuts.  My check out time was 4:29 18 seconds.  I turned around to throw my gum in the garbage and take my keys out of my purse.  Less than 60 seconds later another employee said to me "sweetie ya'll can't be eating in here don't you see our dining room is closed.". I  turned around from the garbage and said "we aren't eating in here". Then she says very nasty "Ugh why do I even bother people don't care or read the signs". I then said to her "excuse me it's only been 60 seconds since I checked out look at my receipt. What is your name?"  She ignored me so I had to ask her again "what is your name".  She said very rude "it's TAMMY. Make sure you spell it right Tammy with 2 M's". I called and left a message for corporate. Don't know why DD would allow their staff to talk to customers like that.   Won't be going back to this location ever again. Yet , maybe that's what she wanted

"we don't carry cinnamon donuts" my ass 

DAY 163 of Dunkin fucking your order up 
- Fuck you and I'll see you tomorrow

My husband has been treating himself to a single, glazed donut every time he passes an exam for an industry certification. He has passed 5 recertification exams in the last month. It has been a struggle getting the donuts because several locations locally have been out of the donuts forcing us to go to another location. This location had them today after going to the Hillsborough and Countryway and finding they were out. Hubby said this was the best one out of the 5. It was fluffy, fresh, and perfect!! I got an iced, black coffee. Can never go wrong with a Dunkin coffee

Lmao - NO!

The Caution sign was on the floor, an easy tripping hazard. I put it to the side. Also, a new employee that I've not seen before wasn't wearing a mask while serving me my coffee. They def. have improvements to make. I'll prob. Just go through the drive through since the guy that usually makes a Latte for me is always wearing a mask working the drive through vs. The lady that was taking walk up customers at the counter - no dining since we're still in a pandemic.
Flavors are ok, portions are very small especially for over $15. The Cuban sandwich had hardly any meat. Very disappointed.  Maybe if we went to the restaurant it would have been better. Not sure.

I have been having trouble trying to find a responsive restaurant to cater my wedding this month and HEIDI with the 4 Rivers Catering team is so personable, knew exactly what we needed and even helped with the quantity of the food/beverages that we would require on my wedding day! Such a fast turnaround time and was extremely responsive, give that woman a raise!!!!

We ordered the 2 plus 2 for $12.99 plus an extra side to share, and a couple bottled beers.  We chose double burnt ends, (after we asked for a sample), plus fried okra, mac and cheese, and baked beans.  Yes, the double burnt ends were so good, double was better!   The okra was very tasty, crispy, and a generous portion as well.  The other sides were 4 ounce portions, and enjoyed, but nothing to write home about.  Even though we shared, we actually had burnt ends to box up and take home.  We will definitely return.

Visiting from Atlanta (where a 4 rivers recently closed) so I was excited to try 4 rivers again... Extremely rude staff walked in the restroom just after close as I was washing my hands in the handicap stall sink and walked out and yelled to the rest of the staff "OH MY FU**ING GOD.... THERES A N-WORD IN THERE TAKING A SH*T!!!!" 

Will NEVER come back to this establishment again. Hope this location closes too

I was not impressed by the moist brisket, it was lukewarm. The sides were delicious and the bread was lackluster. Didn't realize it was cafeteria style, but I would try the place again (just not the brisket). BBQ sauce was delicious. I wish the cashier gave us our receipt because it seemed like we were overcharged, but owell.

As a recently transplanted New Yorker in Philly, I looked for any pizza to try. When this place's menu showed up in my mailbox, I figured I might as well.
If i could go back and stop myself, I'd go back and never move to Philly instead: just to avoid this pizza, that is. This pizza, if you can really call it such, is a heinous crime: the sauce was insipid and tasteless, the cheese was tough and overdone. The bread was nothing more than a vehicle to deliver this abomination (pictured below) woefully into my mouth. 
The girl on the phone was also pretty rude. No thanks.

Just gross. Pizza was clearly made hours earlier and reheated. See picture. Chicken fingers were tough, cold and salty as hell. Greek salad was weak, no olives, and dressing was gross. With so many good pizza places we are never coming back.

I ordered a chicken parm from this place it was one of the nastiest things I have ever eaten the spaghetti was mushy the chicken with hard and old
NEVER ORDER FROM THIS PLACE THEY USE OLD FOOD

Finally checked out Mama's for lunch today. Everything was delicious! We shared fried pork chops and kettle chicken. Got sides of collards, lima beans, potato salad and black-eyed peas. All nicely seasoned and the cornbread was delish, too! We'll be back!

Jerk chicken was great but the smothered chicken was tougher than a boot otherwise descent food.  They charged me for a large drink without asking me what size I wanted - I noticed it on my ticket when I sat down to eat. Those two things determined the outcome of three stars

1. ABSOLUTELY NEVER ORDER THE LIVER [the dog didn't even find it appealing, immediately went to the water]. Whom ever make it, should be fired, it's dry, and very hard to chew, a waster.

2. Could be number one, be sure to get your order right, check before you leave, as if it isn't Luke warm, it's wrong. I ordered lima beans, and switched to black eye peas,  I saw the host tell them, I saw them say it's not to late as it was not prepared yet, ... when I got home guess what they put in my box.... Lisa beans, and most every needed to be warmed up, I waited 40 minutes.

3. They will NOT refund an order even if it's horribly cooked. They will take no responsibility. 

4. The prices on the menue, especially desert are not up to date, and the owner doesn't care, classic example of taking advantage of the community who patronize the business. 

5. You will wait seemingly forever, call in advance.

6. Some dishes like the greens are uber salty,  beware, if you like a lot of salt, you'll be very happy.

7. They are not consistent,  sometimes it's salty and sometimes it's really salty.

8. The Mac and cheese is def over-rated. 

9. The corn bread is fair to good.

10. They will skimp on the Maws and ox tails, tasty but not really a fair exchange.

This restaurant needs competition,  they take the customers for granted. 2 stars plus one because the young lady at the front is awesome.

I've ordered from this place several times and was completely disappointed when I called to place an order and placed on hold for 10 minutes and apparently so was the other guest that also called while the woman at the counter proceeded to take orders from customers that were in the establishment. I hung up repeatedly and called back atleast four times and placed on hold each time so the final time I waited yet again and when I attempted to place my order everything that I tried ordering I was told the only thing that they had available was fried chicken, jerk chicken, baked chicken I was told and I declined. Maybe they need to hire a few more employees to man the phones and take orders instead of continuously leaving patrons on hold and forgetting to come back to take the order. I won't spend another dime in here again as I've spent enough in the past.
Food is delicious, fried catfish and whiting fish. Candied yams is good. Tasty catfish fingers. Call and order. Corn is great.

They are ALWAYS rude with me give nasty looks everytime so uncomfortable and they don't want to give me service unbelievable that people that don't know me have so much against a simple costumer not eating here ever

I went to this Popeyes last night and the drive thru was super slow and they were out of some items. But the reason I gave them a one star is because of the termite infestation they had going on. They were flying into my car at the menu ordering our food and it was worse at the drive thru window. But lucky there was no termites in my food.

Since I was at busch gardens and this is on the same street I said POPEYES YAYYY EXCITEDLY... SO we went and the line was backed into the street but im thinking we'll it will definitely be hot and fresh with this much service. WRONG! flounder Luke warm definitely sat it was so soft and you can see where the tarter sauce and pickle I asked to not be on my sandwich by the way created soggy  madness on my bun and then coleslaw all on my cup top and bottom. Friends got an 8pc to split with Mac and cheese and extra side of mash and gravy also heat lamp hot seems like they were all training so I guests they cooked everything earlier and put under lights...also they didn't turn the mic off as your waiting to order and after ordering you hear them  teaching someone the buttons and the ladies saying in Spanish and English how to  type it in etc. Just 3 months ago I was here there was a wait and the food was piping hot the chicken was very much crispy what happen???

Great to be dining back inside and on the tables, especially on this hot day.  As the same as the other locations, their chipolte chickin wrap, sweet potato fries, and regular size chocolate milkshake left much to my desire.  Ms. Molly is also an excellent cashier.

Most times I order HipCityVeg I end up regretting it. Their gluten free selection has expanded, but it adds several dollars to any meal, and it is already pretty expensive for what you get. Their sweet potato fries and aioli are usually decent, and I have also had okay experiences eating the green smoothie and the gf maitake burger. Overall, I would say it is unfortunately rarely worth the price.
Vegan fast food! Comfort food for those who eshue animal products. Tasty and fun, If high calorie, fair.
1st time eating here did not disappoint. I had the chick'n sandwich and fries and it was really good.

We got the value meal deal for 2 with 2 cookies, 10 piece nuggets with hipcity sauce, Crispy Hipcity Ranch , and the ziggy burger. The Ziggy Burger was decent -- it definitely tasted good overall but it's not comparable to real meat if you're looking for a close substitute since it was definitely lacking the salty, meaty flavor and the juiciness you'd get in a typical beef burger. I liked the Crispy Hipcity Ranch more and thought it was closer to replicating chicken, even though I've had better frozen chick'n patties before. The fake chicken in this sandwich was simlar to that of the nuggets, which were also good, despite the pieces being small. We got the side of hipcity sauce which tasted very similar to Chick-Fil-A sauce (some kind of honey mustard & BBQ sauce combination). The last thing we tried were the chocolate chip cookies from fatbadger bakery. They were definitely unlike any chocolate chip cookie I've had before -- they weren't bad but weren't my favorite, and the taste and texture reminded me of crystalized honey. Overall, I thought the meal was satisfying and it was a good portion for two people. Although the prices are steeper than other meat-serving burger places, I thought the prices were okay and maybe comparable/better than other healthy & meatless restaurants.
The best cheese steaks in the Roxborough/ Manayunk section of Philadelphia, if not the best in Philly. I've been going there for years and they're always top notch. The other menu items are good too!

This was an absolutely delicious and authentic Chinese meal. (Tasted just like my house mates used to make :) )

I had the lamb ramen and the braised sweet pea greens.

The dishes were packed full of flavour, in a rich broth

I will definitely eat here again, and recommend it.

The sweet pea greens were $18 though, so I didn't think they were worth the price- though they were delicious.
Very nice restaurant. Good Chinese food and my always go-to restaurant during covid time. Food is fast and nice packaged and delivered.
This is the best Chinese food hands down in university city! The General Tao's chicken is heavenly and I would eat it every day if I could!! Portions are huge and definitely worth the price!

Nice and Simple spot 
Food was definitely  Delicious and enjoyable
Great if your looking to have a nice quiet lunch

Their Chinese New Years menus is highly superior to all other menus. Everything is delicious and cooked to perfection. The lamb chops and chicken bowl is mouthwatering to the max. The meat was like velvet and the steamed fish was beautiful and cooked to perfection. Really great meal, and we haven't even got to dessert yet!!!  Best meal!! I would give this meal6 (6)  ****** six stars !!! Best Chinese New Years meal I ever had in years!!  The braised pork shoulder was juicy and succulent cooked to a turn. The eight precious pudding was excellent as was the rest of the meal.

The Makkah Market was recommended to me by an 11 year old so I didn't rush to come here and didn't have high hopes.  But since I finally made the trip here I have come to the Makkah Market at least 20 times.  Usually purchase these date filled bars and delicious bread that is near the entrance.  Then move to the back to get some canned goods that are not available at other stores.  Lastly I always leave with a meal from the counter.  

The grilled lamb is sooo tasty.  I get it served over the spicy chicken rice which is some of the best rice on planet Earth. They will also add whatever sides you want from what they have that day.  It's so much food that it's impossible to finish and I will bring the leftovers to work for an awesome lunch the next day.

Sometimes I get fresh baklava or other desserts and every one I have tried has also been delicious.
I literally created an account in order to leave this review. The best halal cart you will find in America, even after having lived in New York for years.

Maybe this is irrational to say but the UCity food trucks were one of three things that kept me sane during my undergraduate career and to them I owe the world, much less a 5 star Yelp review. Yes, this was my first time at this particular truck and no, it wasn't distinct from any of the other halal trucks I've frequented, but hey. Cheap, quick, tasty, could probably last two meals but I was feeling woozy so I ate it all at once = all a girl can ask for. Thank you, I love you, and good night.

Thai Kuu review March/April 2021

Thai Kuu's food is delicious - we love their spicy green curry, warm pad thai, and spring rolls (vegetarian versions) and pad pong karee seafood dishes. They are a bit pricey, but portions are generous and often sufficient for 1.5-2 meals. We have been delighted to support local restaurants via takeaway during the pandemic, but have been so frustrated of late by Thai Kuu. Their customer service is abysmal, and it seems that they cannot handle their order volume in any organised fashion. We have had several orders just canceled, one about which we were never contacted and were just told 'sorry' when I drove to pick up. The gentleman (owner?) who answers the phone (often with a long wait on hold) and handles the take-away pick-up seems overwhelmed and, importantly, entirely unconcerned/stand-offish about his customers not being happy about canceled orders or something not being quite right as ordered. He also does nothing to make it right for the customer ('we canceled all of our ubereats orders tonight since we were too busy' despite me pre-ordering hours in advance before the restaurant opened for a set pick-up time, suggesting to us that this is a not-infrequent occurrence. The chefs always seem to be working very hard in the kitchen and consistently make wonderful creations.

Please improve your customer service, as we love your food and your chefs, but are extraordinarily disappointed in our interpersonal interactions with the Thai Kuu lead customer service/new owner.

Everything was delicious. However, the massaman curry was a rip off. We ordered it with chicken and only had 2 tiny pieces of chicken in our container. $16 for sauce and vegetables doesn't seem right.

This place is close to me in Mt Airy and can accommodate me as a gluten-free vegan. Their food is really tasty with lots of veggies, and they can make many dishes vegan and gluten-free, which i appreciate.

Consistent and delicious from the simple avocado roll my kids love to the sweet potato roll or any of the specials. It's all so good. And during COVID-19,  super respectful and safe. What more could you want?

Friday night sushi was a great success thanks to this place! 

Finding a sushi spot with ample vegetarian options is not always easy - this spot definitely wasn't having that issue! 

This is a short easy walk so ordered pick up over the phone with the attendant. They're also on PostMates if you choose to order via an app. 

We ordered the asparagus, avocado, the orchid (wrapped with crepe paper with mango, fried sweet potato and avocado) and their kanpyo rolls. In addition, we added on strawberry and green tea mochi for dessert! Depending on where you look, the dessert options are not always apparent but when we inquired over the phone, the attendant was very helpful in providing us the options - so be sure to ask! 

Upon arrival, it's a step down entry and it's fairly small on the inside. In COVID times, there is no indoor dining being offered at this establishment. This was a non issue for us but just an FYI. 

The service was great! We were promised a time when we placed our order over the phone but then received a call from the restaurant earlier than expected to notify us that the rolls were ready. This was a nice surprise so we were able to pick up earlier! 

Overall the rolls were ample for the two of us and the mochi was delicious! We enjoyed the orchid rolls the most. 

Thanks for the great service and delicious noms Dasiwa! Hoping to be back soon!

Yup that hit the spot! Traditional African American, American and Gentrification Cuisine. You can get a handmade pan fried salmon cake, hot cakes or a smoothie, something for everyone. iMunch is nestled between a neighborhood where generations of same families struggled to achieve the dream and those who decided the area is 'trendy' aka GENTRIFIERS. On this INAUGURAL YEAR OF THE FEDERAL HOLIDAY....JUNETEENTH I started my day BLACK OWNED! Good start!

I called to make sure I was able to dine-in. The person answering was pleasant so off to PHILLY I go! Although parking can be challenging one loop around I was able to park in front of the restaurant. Everyone was friendly, the place is very clean, my order was taken and delivered timely. There is outdoor seating which I opted for. If you can climb the spiral stairs there is indoor seating. 

The salmon cake was a nice sized filled with diced onions, peppers and pan fried. It was served with Sriracha sauce that took it to the next level. The grits are smooth and the hot cakes fluffy. Yes I went ALL IN! 

It's a drive but on weekends I can treat myself.

This place is amazing! If you live or pass through Brewerytown it's a must. And it's Black-owned! I've had the dairy free smoothie, BLT w/ avocado, and chicken panini. Can't wait to try their breakfast because everything so far has been delicious!

YUM!!!!!!! I ordered the salmon patty and the caribbean dream (dairy free) smoothie. Both were truly amazing! The wait was maybe 10 minutes with the smoothie ready first, but I waited inside with my sister. The smoothie had lots of great flavor and was really refreshing. The sandwich!! It had a great  seasoning on the salmon and the mayo was a full bodied spice that was delicious. The sandwiches are also really big and filling. I was very hungry and I still only had half with my smoothie. They also have a veg sandwich option if you don't eat meat or seafood at all. Great Black owned and halal spot I will definitely visit again next time I'm in Philly!

The foos year definitely tastes homemade in a good way. They have healthy options which is nice, and had great customer service. I only gave it 4 stars because it's kinda cramped inside. There really isn't many places to sit, and unless you're ordering pick up be prepared to move around to make room while you are waiting for your food.

I hate leaving a bad review but this is honestly some of the worst Chinese food I've ever eaten. Ordered wonton soup which they didn't close all the way so 75% of the broth spilled in the bag. Unfortunate but mistakes happen. I go to taste the soup and it's insanely bland pretty much just tastes like wontons in water. The egg roll was so saturated in grease it was inedible, it also tasted old. The steamed dumplings came sitting in half an inch of water. I should've listened to the other low reviews before ordering :(

I should have turned and walked out when seeing that the one person in the kitchen was slumped over in a canvas fold up chair in front of an oscillating fan sleeping, as was the lady behind the counter.... sleeping, sitting up straight, facing the front of the store. I was hungry so I cleared my throat, hoping she'd wake up. 

When we unpacked the food, we found that our shrimo egg foo young was burnt, had absolutely NO vegetables except for a few white onion slices (very, very few), and each of the 3 "pancakes" had no more than 3 tiny shrimp. Awful, just awful! I'll never go back. Wish I could leave zero stars!

Wanted Chinese takeout and I was passing by on my way home from work so I decided to pop in. I went in to place an order for take out and the lady was on the phone so I stood and waited my turn. In the kitchen one of the guys had a large container of noodles he was stirring with his bare hands. No masks, no GLOVES, and he picked up pieces of food that had fallen out of the container off of the table and threw them back into the container. Will not be back. SANITATION IS NOT A PRIORITY. Eat at your own risk.

This little spot is my go to for Spanish food. I've been here several times and the food is always good. The prices are cheap and everything is always fresh. I live about 35 minutes from this place but it's definitely worst a try. If I lived in the city this place would be a problem for me  since I know I would frequent more often.  They also cater for parties if your having an event. Sorry no pictures to post. I couldn't wait to eat my food! Lol
The food is so good here. Every time I place an order, they never disappoint me. The fish is so fresh, the Mac n cheese is on point. And those yams are so sweet and savory.
Big portions! The Basa fish was very fresh. My boyfriend got the pepper steak and he loved it. It's made to order so it's very fresh as well. The Mac and cheese is creamy. Overall great experience!
Turkey wings were good and so was the Mac but i also had yellow rice and it was very very hard

Hidden gem hidden gem!! Thats all Im a start off saying on this review, sheesh. This business will hit the spot when your hungry for some southern taste, cooked good soulfood. Real rap!!

  Its a rainy, slow Sunday which is one of them days you might not feel like cooking but still want a Sunday dinner, well thanks to my Aunt going up that way she asked if I wanted anything from here and its my first time trying so I took a chance and glad I did.

  Ordered the Turkey meatloaf platter with my 2 sides being yams and yellow rice for $16. Definitely well worth it including the portions and definitely the taste, mmm!

  Turkey meatloaf was flavorful with I think a lil bbq sauce, the rice was good mixed in with the meatloaf even by its self and then its the yams for me. They were cooked and sweet like somebody grandma made them for a big dinner.

Everything was good! Definitely worth my money cause I don't like trying too many spots I never been to or came across to check out.

  Thomasena's yall got it popping in that kitchen, keep up the good work.
Soo worth it !! Really i made with pure love and the soul  yams are perfect ! Really melts in your mouth! The mac and cheese hit the spot, collard greens are not that salty just perfect.

Found this place impromptu while visiting Philly and it did not disappoint! Small family-owned shop. Apparently there is no typical pit-style Korean bbq in Philly unfortunately but this place did well.

Soft tofu stew, pancake, and spicy pork on stone bowl. Everything was high quality. Check this place out for sure if you're looking for Korean cuisine in Philly!

Amazing Korean food! We ordered and shared the spicy pork buns for appetizer, prime rib bibimbop, and spicy pork skillet and they all were AMAZING! We also got the grape Korean punch which had chunks of grapes in it and I enjoyed it way more than I thought. The kimchi and Korean chili sauce and garlic soy were also amazing. We were so happy and satisfied with our meal. The server was so friendly and knowledgeable and had amazing customer service. She made sure we got everything we wanted and needed and even gave us suggestions of things to do (and not do) on our trip. We will definitely be back.

Philadelphia has an awesome food scene, and this restaurant is definitely one of them. I enjoyed both of its food and cool vibes. The food was more like a creative(fusion) Korean food, which I found it absolutely delicious. Customer service was also superb and the place was so clean and neat.

Located in Old City Philadelphia(the area is so so so beautiful!!!), it is a good spot to enjoy the rich culture of Philadelphia along with good foods:) Nearby there is a wine/spirit shop where you can buy drinks at reasonable price. So lovely an area full with rich traditions combined with modern innovative vibes.

The food was alright, but the restaurant felt like Korean food for non-Koreans rather than something more authentic. The menu options were quite limited and it felt like their dishes lacked the more authentic spice and flavior.
This place was so good. I 100% will come back again. I actually tried this place because my sister got me a voucher for two people. It was so good, I actually went back a couple times since then

Have eaten here 3x now since Covid- twice I've picked up and once I ate in person. 
1. Eating in person a few weeks ago was for lunch, and it was clear they were understaffed (as many restaurants are) so I recommend patience. 
 2. Each time I've ordered their plant based burger, but get dairy cheese, bread and cheese. It's great and I would give it 5 stars. 
3. The third time, I ordered their plant based burger again and hubby ordered the regular "burger". I use quotes because I was shocked at how small the Patty was. My vegan patty was normal size, but the regular burger was like a small drop of meat. I was already home otherwise I would have asked if this was a joke! I assume it's their normal burger. Subsequently I haven't eaten there again. So I have given them 2.5 stars-average between 5 for the vegan and 0 for the regular. 

It was pretty ridiculously small! If I can find a picture a friend took I will add to this post!

This was my first outing in Philly with my boyfriend and the five stars are beyond deserved. Aside from the fact that the crispy chicken sandwich was super delicious, let me tell you about how caring and thoughtful the servers were after apparent hooligans who have been terrorizing 2nd st. by riding up and down on bicycles and behaving like assholes to random people. I was that random person -- before I knew it, a full cup of water was knocked into me and a stack of thick fliers from a nearby gym were flung at my face. I didn't even have time to process it as Roe, our server came up to me apologizing profusely, asking if I were okay, making sure that my soggy sandwich was remade, and telling us they would comp half of our meal and drinks. She checked in on us every few minutes after that. Another worker came out (I didn't get his name), but he also gave us his apologies and made us laugh. Another server who had only heard 20 minutes after the incident, came out of the restaurant apologizing that she hadn't come up to us sooner. It made me feel so taken care of in a way I don't think I've felt in any restaurant. They went above and beyond with their kindness and I can't thank them enough for that. The food was yummy, but that wasn't the main part of our night.

My girlfriends and I were out and about in the area, and wanted to find a nice place to eat. We checked Yelp and the menu, and it came highly recommended. 
The food was awesome, and the drinks were fantastic! Service was also wonderful! Will definitely be back again!
Super, just super. Nice place good food, atmosphere, seating, and service. Fish TacosFried Chicken SaladTruffle Chips
Amazing amazing vegan options for all their dishes. Rarely see it. Vegan pasta dishes are on point. Great delivery too. A bit dark inside but perfect for dates

This is my second review of this place, I just ordered a burger. What a great burger... the bun hold up to the patty, it's a clean burger, not a messy falling apart kind of burger, like I have been finding recently. This is my fave place for pizza, burger, steaks! 

Side note, the chicken cheese steak is wonderful too

The portion size was good; however, the flavor was bland. Lastly the driver was rude, took 15min to find my place while In building then left it at the door without knocking or letting us know, thankfully we heard her drop the bag against the door.
We're back!  Awesome as the first time.  Today we tried the lunch combos - wow! So much food! All delicious - we ended up eating the parking lot - couldn't wait.
The delivery was 20 mins faster the food was worth every dollar and more thanks so much Ming Gardens

I've written stellar reviews in the past, but today was disappointing.  First the good:  Ann/Annie was training Kelly and they were both polite, prompt and helpful.  The strawberry shortcake didn't have a lot of strawberries, but the ones that were there were red, ripe and luscious.  
However, I think they must also be training one or more line cooks.  Despite a specific request for well-toasted muffin under the eggs Benedict, the muffin was totally untoasted. Request for extra hollandaise "on the side" (repeated twice by the waitress) came atop the  eggs.  Why is that a problem? I can't eat egg white & scraping it away scrapes away the hollandaise (including the extra) off the eggs.  
The Plough was, as always, welcoming, clean and tidy.  The servers were charming.  I guess the cooks find a special request annoying - fine, just send the server back with the information "we can't do that" and I'll order something else.  There's a robust assortment of choices, and I've never had a problem before in more than 10 years patronage.
btw, the waitstaff did offer to replace the plate - I was just too hungry to wait.  The shortcake was good.

This place is freaking awesome. We were caught outside in a HUGE thunderstorm with our puppy (emotional support animal) and everyone from the front of house sprung into action and helped maneuver us to stay under cover, then facilitated a nice transition indoors for the folks outside once it got really bad. They really went above and beyond to ensure that everyone was taken care of. 

The drinks are smooth, the food is amazing, and we had a great time!

I would definitely eat here again! We were looking online at restaurants nearby after checking out the historical sights and this Irish pub definitely stuck out to us. We had great service and there was an awesome drink selection. I am usually hesitant to order shepherds pie but this was hands down one of the top servings of that dish that I have ever had. The meat and veggies were nice and juicy and the potatoes were soft and smooth. The Guinness casserole was also cooked very well with a super tender serving of meat. Tons of great outdoor seating as well.

I would stop again for sure. We were looking for a sit down place on a Sunday night in Old City and didn't want a hoagie sandwich or burger. After yelping, googling and maps-ing this place wasn't on any search. We were walking by and said wow - Irish love that and decided to give it a try. 
So we did the the fish and fries l: seasoned fries and a big thick piece of cod which at first glance looked a bit dark but after a fork- it was moist and flaky cooked perfectly. Seasoned fries were good too. 
I did the shepherds pie which I always worry about but this was darn good. Everything was cut small - the potato crust was still moist but lightly golden brown. 
The Brussels sprouts were touch over cooked but all the flavors were good - the bacon and balsamic really worked. 
Great selection of Irish whisky and scotches as well. 
Tip they serve two kinds of bread - a soda bread that is light with fruit like dates and a dark heavy wheat bread that I didn't care for. Double up on the house made soda bread up front and save yourself the trouble.

Outdoor brunch.

Freedom.

Strong Bloody Marys.

Freedom.

No Masks while sitting outside, on high tops, watching a big screen...outdoors

Freedom.

Attentive waiter, quick and friendly.

America.

Laughing, yelling, having fun while munching on fat burgers and freedom fries.

F yeah.

America First. Always.

This restaurant really hit the spot for me. I had decently high expectations before going because the reviews were so great but was nervous because I know they are owned or operated by the same people as Cheu restaurant (a place that I didn't enjoy very much). Anyways, Bing Bing ended up being delicious! 

The menu is small which I actually enjoyed. Especially for a large group its perfect so then you are able to have a little taste of everything. 

What we ordered: 

Sichuan Chicken Dumplings: BEST DISH WE HAD! Absolutely delicious, stole the show. Could've ordered 5 more. 
Pork Soup Dumplings: My friends loved them but I thought they were average. (it was also their first time trying soup dumplings).
Cheesesteak Bao: Yummy!! Filling and packs a punch. Great item to get. 
Shrimp Dumplings: They were ok. Pretty boring and bland, would not get again. 
Caterpillar Bread: Really delicious! I wasn't going to order this for our table at first but after looking at the reviews online where everyone said this was delicious I knew I had to try it. They weren't wrong, it was really great! 
Spicy Sichuan Cucumbers: I ordered these thinking they would be as good as the Chinese ones I've had in the past from other places but these were a miss. My friends hated them and they were pretty mushy and not very crunchy. 
 Moo Shu Chicken: Very flavorful and pretty much like Thai lettuce wraps which we love.
Dan Dan Noodles: I really loved these. They were super different than other dan dan noodles I've had elsewhere. These were very creamy and rich with flavor! 
Eggplant Mapo Tofu: I really wanted this to be good but it was lacking depth and spice. The eggplant was delicious but overall the dish was very very bland as if someone forgot to add in any spices.

Overall, I would definitely come back to this place and its a perfect spot for large groups or friends who love to share dishes!

Easily one of, if not my favorite restaurants in South Philly. All of the food takes a great spin on their dishes and they all have turned out great. Same with the cocktails in that the combinations are interesting and I haven't had one I didn't like. The restaurant is usually packed, so be aware that may create long wait times.

Pricy and will leave you hungry. Nice atmosphere, would go for happy hour but it's not somewhere I frequent, but end up finding myself here because we live on Passyunk. The scarlet dumplings are my favorite thing on the menu (beet dumplings). I've had duck here I wasn't a fan of in Ramen but not sure if that was a staple or rotating item. There was one good sangria pitcher I had gone back for once (and I usually hate sangria and sweet things) But this had been so delicious and gingery, only to hear it was a rotating menu and they didn't have it, which is fine, but none of the others have been as good or memorable. Usually disappointed with the amount of money I'll pay to still be pretty hungry again soon afterward. Would only go for happy hour. It is a very enjoyable atmosphere and decorated well.

I came here for happy hour with a few friends. Service is great, atmosphere is great; but, the food was eh. 
Our favorite out of the whole experience was the spicy cucumbers. They come in a great sauce and crunchy fried onions. They were so good that we got 2 - would definitely recommend. Everything else on the menu was average. I could get all of this from a dim sum place for way cheaper. Below are some highlights that I think would be important:
Cheesesteak Bao - super salty filling
Scarlet Dumplings - very earthy flavor
Shrimp dumplings - not bad
Caterpillar bread - the bbq pork is shredded meat
Dan Dan Noodles - took a while to come out, not super peanuty, very creamy. 
Cocktails (not pictured) - happy hour cocktail was a mango passion fruit and then pear whiskey. Both were amazing.

Amazing dinner. I was my first time having dim sum. The Shiitake Dan Dan Noodle, I've been dreaming of them since that night. They are rich, creamy and delicious. Affordable food and adorable atmosphere, can't wait to return. I wish they delivered.
Food is amazing, seriously! Drinks are awesome! And Chris the bartender is killin it! We'll definitely be back on our next trip out to Philly.

Great neighborhood bar and food place. Fun vibe, good service, lots of options for all kinds of beers and the food is actually good for a bar joint. It was great to find this place in the Old Historic part of town.

Great local bar that plays records.    Very well laid out and close to all the local traffic.   Best spanakopita  outside of a Greek restaurant.      Delicious burger, fries, and wings.     Service is excellent.

Best mac and cheese of my life. And i have searched far and wide. Dave the owner is a saint, and the staff are wonderful. Great tap list. Reasonable prices. Good atmosphere. Ask Dave for photos of Archie. That's his dog. You won't be disappointed.

Came to Philly and was looking for a quick bite to eat. Found this pub with outside seating and decided to check it out. I ordered the kielbasa with a side salad and a ham and cheese sandwich. The ham and cheese was toasted to
Perfection with grueyer cheese. I'm pretty sure I spelled that wrong . I also got the blueberry cider which was PERFECT! 

I enjoyed the outside seating. The service was good and fast!

I give this restaurant Hawkeye, aka 'The Pasta House' on Uber Eats a 2 star rating, because when I got their food delivered, their pasta bolognese was decent, except there was a piece of plastic in my food. Thankfully when I put food in my mouth, I always feel around before chewing because I've always been paranoid of reasons like this. My previous review was removed for whatever reason, but I promise, if I would've swallowed that piece of plastic, it would've been a liability issue. Please do better.

Great pizza, but poor customer service. I have pizza from them before without any issues. Today the owner says to me we can do that and there is nothing we can do about it. I wanted to purchase a 24" pizza and have it delivered to St. Joseph's Hospital so I can give it to my nurses. I have a heart condition and all they can we can't do that. The last time they delivered the pizza to Advent Hospital on Fletcher and just because I am at St Joseph's Hospital which is over the limit they said and "there is nothing we can do for you". So if you are in the hospital and not doing well and you wanted to do something nice before you leave to your caregivers don't call Hawkeye's pizza because they simply don't care.

Wonderful customer service from initial phone call to coming in, in person and meeting the owner. The pizza is delicious. Went with the Monday deal xl cheese pizza and 12 wings did not break the bank. Family friendly, with exceptional customer service from all. We will definitely be back.
Very cute little spot run by a hardworking old man with authentic beep n bop with good gochujang sauce.
Ordered two turkey cheddar clubs sandwiches w avacado it had no bacon and no cheese and no avocado absolutely ridiculous
my friend and i waiting 30 minutes to get seated and then had to wait an hour and a half for my food and to pay. also the waiter was very disrespectful

Honestly  the wait time was okay but the food came out in parts not all together. The pancakes where dry and not very good the waiters to way to long to ask us for our order. Took long to bring all the food and even had to remind the waiter to bring a missing plate. Won't be coming back here again...
A recurring favorite for brunch. Always a great meal. I also stop in for a to go tea or something from the bakery. Always a fun spot to bring friends from out of town. Plus an authentic Greek feel!

The food here is fantastic.
I've never had a disappointing meal.The servers are fantastic.They go out of their way to please you.
The atmosphere is super....
The brine roasted chicken is so delicious....I order it all the time...as well as their ocutpus salad...
Love this place
Helen G.

If you haven't been here yet, you need to! We did brunch this time and it was phenomenal. The atmosphere, especially outside, makes you feel like you are sitting in the country side. And the food is fresh, flavorful and perfectly portioned. We had the eggs Benedict (pro tip: you can get one bacon and one salmon) which was really great. We also got the blta with an egg on it. The French toast was some of the best we have ever had, with custard between layers of fresh bread. Saturdays there are 5 dollar mimosas, they definitely do not skimp on the champagne here! Our server Clay was super knowledgeable and attentive too! 10/10 would eat here again :)

Visited here with some new clients' a week ago. First thing was, I was surprised how quickly the pastries were gone (get here early!) next... the place is beautifully made. If I had more time to enjoy it, I would have just enjoyed the building. 

Started with the cranberry bread, and definitely enjoyed all of it. Next I went with the chicken platter with potato salad- and extra garlic sauce. The chicken was incredibly well seasoned (maybe I'll visit tomorrow if they're open) potato salad had a good amount of dil and was juicy as well. The pita bread was in the right portion to enjoy all of it.
Fresh food. Nice atmosphere. Really enjoyed the food and bakery items. High recommend.

I've been trying to find a great Asian Restaurant in Tampa for quite some time. In fact, I've been wanting to try this noodle bar. The service was amazing and the food was cooked to perfection. I will definitely be going back to try another menu item. Loved!

Had the BBQ pork and Beef Chow Fun, both were good but not outstanding.

BBQ pork was crispy but I've had both more flavorful and crispier Chinese BBQ pork before. This one didn't have a very thick fat layer (the fat is what becomes the crispy, crunchy exterior on Chinese BBQ pork, this one only had a small layer so it wasn't super crispy), and the flavor was ok.

The beef chow fun was also average. Lots of oil and the beef was very salty. I did like the Chinese chives that they put into the noodles, and the portion was a good size.

Service was good though and we enjoyed our bar seats where we could watch the chefs prepare our meal.

This place was outstanding.
We waited about 25 minutes to get seated, we went around 2pm. As soon as we got to our table our waitress came over and took our order. We ordered everything right away and it came out less than 5 minutes later. The food was hot, fresh and delicious. I was skeptical because it's inside a casino but it doesn't smell like smoke at all and the service was amazing. The food was flavorful and plentiful. I ordered the friend dumplings, bbq pork soup and duck soup. Do not regret one bit. the dumplings were nice and crispy yet not crunchy, or greasy. The soups were sooooo flavorful i can't say it enough. The meats were tender, hot, and seasoned well.  It's a mustttt to visit. We will definitely back to try more items on the menu!

We stood in line for 45 minutes and I was so excited . We were seated in the back and the service was poor. The waiter totally forgot about us. But after a few he finally got himself together. I should have stick with the noodles. Which my friend ordered and loved. I ordered the crispy pork belly and soy Chicken and it was bland without flavor..Hopital food for sure. So disappointed. The only thing I ate was the white rice and explained how I didn't like the food (one bite only). Waiter could care less, we paid for our food and left. I would pass on this place.

I ordered the BBQ pork ribs and the crab Rangoon off of the small plates menu. It was really good ! The Rangoon was made fresh and the sauce on the ribs was delicious. The service was fast however only thing I would suggest is the restaurant allowing take out orders because currently it is only dine in. 
I would suggest going around 2-4 PM (no line at all)

First yelp review!! Woohoo! This south Tampa mama was in need of some quick Chinese food and this places looked great! I quickly ordered delivery from their website and the food was dropped off SO quickly--in almost 20 minutes! My kids were happy and when my husband came home he said we needed to figure out dinner, but thanks to Top China dinner was done! Can't wait to try their hibachi to go!! The food was great will definitely frequent again!
This is my go-to carryout or delivery Chinese cafe because: 1. the food is decent, and 2. the prices are a bit lower than competitors. For dine-in, I would recommend Hao Wah on S. Dale Mabry.

I am highly upset! I went today to get a beef and broccoli and they gave me white rice instead of fried rice! I have never had to request fried rice! It always came that way and I didn't know it until I got home 25 min away! The food is always good and fresh but I wanted my food the way I normally get it! My daughter just told me the same happened to her! Ugh! Why the change now when I've been getting it with fried rice for years with no problem! I will have to seriously think about patronizing them again!
Food is good, vibe is good, waiters are good, but drinks are ridiculously weak (I'm normally DRUNK after 2, but was barely tipsy after 4)

My wife and I had dinner here last night and what a great atmosphere. We played darts waiting for our meal with great music playing. Our server Kendall was phenomenal. She has a great personality and the food was awesome. Thanks Kendall
The bartenders are great and so are the servers but the kitchen staff.  We've been here for almost 1 hour with no food. Terrible. Hire new kitchen staff!

Went to watch the NCAA Frozen Four hockey games.  Haven't been to Maloney's Westchase in 1.5 years because of terrible service and bad food. Thought, let's give it a shot.  Got to Maloney's at 6pm and ordered food right away.  Food came at 7:30pm, 5 chicken wings and a chicken sandwich. Not too tough. Painful. Maybe next time I have to wait 2 years.

Big Props to Jess and Jean Pierre (JP), on there outstanding work at the St. Patricks bash 2021. My wife and family got to the bash at 2pm. Very good size crowd. Jess and JP where amazing with there service and treatment of us all. My wife and I where at Maloneys last Wednesday also for Trivia night, and both Jess and JP where there that night, and where so professional and there hospitality are 2nd to none. My wife and I come back and forth from NY to Tampa many times a year, and have always enjoyed the food and service at Maloneys, but I felt the need to give our appreciation to Jess and JP, on there fantastic work. Thank you, see you Wednesday.
I'm going to give a 5 star because the cannoli was good. This was our first time having cannoli! We shared a cookies and cream! I'm looking forward to trying more from other bakeries...
Love this place! I have been going to this cafe for years. Inside and outdoor seating. Rene is awesome and the cannoli are top notch
The cannolis are FABULOUS! Brought my Italian family to this joint for desert and everyone was pleased and so happy! They are huge too might I add.

Nothing more to add to the 4 & 5  star ratings already here. I love the care and passion that's put into everything on the menu. YES, the cannoli's can come across a lil pricey but this is not some random donut or pastry. These babies are flown in from freaking Sicily. Sicily!!  Who's gonna take care of you better than a chocolate cannoli?  WHO?  I'm fine with the cost. 10 stars easy.

The place is very unique. It feels like I am home, I mean in a comfortable place. Must try!
I didn't try their bakery, but looked very delicious.

First thing we ordered was the chicken tenders. You can see in the picture that only 3 small tenders come with it. If you ask me, paying $14 for this is unfair. When I called to express my disappointment, I was told that this is the standard way that they prepare this order, this is their normal.

I also got a Large pizza, which was advertised as "$14 for 14 inches." The picture shows it is only 13 inches, but before you scoff at me, if you do the math the difference between a 13" and 14" pizza is 22 square inches...thats an entire slice of pizza missing!

To make things even worse the quality of the food was below average. The pizza crust was soggy, it came with barely any amount of sausage/mushrooms and none of the slices were actually completely cut all the way. Lastly, the customer service was disappointing and their problem-solving was poor.

Overall, I am left very disappointed and feeling robbed of about $31. I will not be returning, and would suggest you stay away as well.

We accidentally stumbled on this place, and it appeared to be fairly new.  The food was just OK.  I did ask for a side of meatballs and they didnt know how to do that, so I ordered the meatball sub without the bread and cheese.  The service was very friendly.

I've ordered from them 3 times since they opened and the food has been on point each time.  Read their google or FB reviews.  As far as covid goes, I can't comment because my husband picks up the food each time.  However, there are so many restaurants right now in Philly not following guidelines so you have to decide what's worth it to you.  In addition, I'm sure it's annoying to be charged $1.50 when ordering online because it's a 3rd party service, but you can avoid it by picking up the phone and calling them.  It's free.  As a matter of fact, I've been asked by restaurants NOT to use services like that including GrubHub/online ordering services because they take fees out of the restaurants hands.  If you don't feel a restaurant is taking precautions, then don't order from them
Food is mediocre. Staff is rude and ignores Covid restrictions.

7 minutes ago
They make awesome pizza. We are thin-crust fans, so they press the dough thin for us, and it is delicious. Very nice staff, too. Very reasonable prices, with the first 2 toppings included in the price. We are selective about our pizza, and deemed several establishments in the Ardmore area (our previous home) to be just mediocre, so this new Centre City pizza shop was a very pleasant surprise. The menu has other Italian specialties, and they have a bar and some tables. Worth a visit!

3.5-4/5 previous experience and 5/5 this time - look at the slab of prime rib. What an absolute hunker of a meat - hands down THE BEST place to order this cut of meat - ordered Rare, pic. In natural lighting looks more red than it is. They even add a layer of spices on the outside - excellent. This meal was ENOUGH FOR TWO! 

Two sides accompanied the rib. The sweet potatoe was sweet & side of Ceasar salad was fresh. 

The strawberry cheesecake was super rich. It's identical to the one made at Bonefish & Flemings. For $7.99  - it was worth me getting sick just to eat half of it.

They even brought out my food for me - I was going to go inside and they were so fast to deliver it. I obviously had to give a tip for taking great care of me!
Prime rib was delicious.  Wait staff gets five stars.  Had no complaints.  Nice to see people dining again.

Got a few bad steaks last night as my wife got a fatty ribeye with more fat than meat and had a bad burnt taste. I got a burnt tasting prime rib cut. Sides were okay but hate paying for bad quality and taste.

Lol.   Once again my wife convinced me to go to this place for dinner.  WORST SERVICE EVER!!! We had to ask for our drinks 3 times asked for ranch 3 times and then got our food minus fries??? We had to wait ??  I ordered a $30 bone in ribeye and got a potato with no sour cream?? Asked 3 times then the waiter comes by and asked if I wanted a Togo box????? Are u serious???? I'm still waiting for my sour cream ?   My sons wings were burnt to a Crisp and my wife asked for no drizzle on her chicken fried steak Amazing there's no manager to help or even check on there customers., that waiter must have said I'm sorry 25 times while I was there.  Poor poor poor management .

Visited Outback at their Westchase location. Skylar was an excellent server and very accommodating with each request from my crazy set of friends lol. We waited less than 15 minutes to be seated and the food was delicious. Two thumbs up.
All the cookies I got tasted the same. I wouldn't buy again but the staff was friendly!

Pros: The cookie was $2, there was a big selection of flavors that looked good, there was no line, the person working there was nice.
Cons: I got regular chocolate chip and it wasn't great. It wasn't terrible. But it tasted like a cookie I would make and I'm not the best baker. It had the taste of a homemade cookie with a little too much baking soda. The texture was fine. Hubs or I will still probably finish the cookie. I would be curious about the other flavors.

This is one of the worst Popeyes ever.... They had no chicken sandwiches at all and were out of most sides and had to wait over 40 minutes for the Chicken to be "done" after saying it would only be a "20 minute wait".... Unprofessional.... Not to mention the cashier who took our order had an attitude as well. Highly recommend not coming to this specific Popeyes or buying your chicken somewhere else.... Lesson learned.

This place should close. Poor service, poorly train workers. The chicken was over cooked. The only reason I give a one star, because the zero they deserve I could not write the review. The letter grade that should be place in the window is a "F"
This place is a total failure.  Went to place a large order today and drive thru was closed.  Every time we go here, there is a problem.  Unreal...

After my experience I called the Popeye's customer service phone number and when I told them what happened they seemed shocked that I had this experience and did the district manager would call me with in 5 days. 

It's been 2 weeks and they never bothered to call. It's clear you don't care about your customers. I won't be back.

It's an absolute NO for us.

The drive through lines don't move at all after +15min.

I am not OK with that and have exited as a result.

It's annoying to constantly get coupons, but not be able to use them because they're very slow & don't really seem to be organized at all...I wouldn't return anytime soon - I will try once a yr. - maybe give them another shot and will update.
This place never disappoints! Great food, service and prices. I never get tired of coming here!
Greasy nasty and so expensive for what it is cafeteria grade food will not come back again!

I usually eat here for lunch, food is usually good but today I grabbed some food for dinner for me my wife and kids. Let me tell you I don't think one thing in my to go order was good. Brisket as super dry only ate one peace, thought the grits would at least be good but grits had absolutely no flavor, Mac and cheese was dry like I was eating just noodles with no Mac and cheese, my kids tenders were dry, actually the fries were the only thing you could really eat. Only seen one person with a mask all the other including everyone making the food had no mask on. I had one bad experience a while ago but this is the 2nd time and I probably won't be eating here again

Disrespectful Service Experience

If you want to eat somewhere that respects you or your time, don't pick Hank's. 

We love the food here but won't ever be back again. The day before yesterday, we were celebrating my sister's birthday and her request was BBQ at home. We had 6 family members there waiting to eat. 

I drove in to pick up the order, confirmed with the cashier before leaving that everything was present, and got home to find that half of the meat in our family meal was missing (a tray of pulled pork). 

It was inconvenient but mistakes happen. We would have made it work if we could, but the remaining meat wasn't enough to feed everyone. So I called the store to ask if they could provide the missing tray if I drove back. I also asked if they could replace our hot sides (baked beans and cheese grits) so that everything was hot when I got home since everyone was *very* hungry by this point, especially the birthday girl. The manager I was speaking with said, "Sure!"

I made the drive back (which is 30 minutes round trip) and couldn't believe what I heard when I got there. First, there were snarky side comments about whether I was sure they'd *actually* forgotten the pulled pork. Then I was handed a side of fries. The manager claimed he thought I said fries on the phone rather than sides... even though I clearly asked if he could replace the sides and explained that it was so all the food would be hot.
