When I pointed out the mistake, the manager--the MANAGER--responded with, "Well, don't you have a microwave at home??" It was one of the rudest and most dismissive customer service remarks I've ever heard after driving an hour total that night trying to pick up a to-go meal from this restaurant. 

I was so disgusted by his attitude that I left immediately with the pork but without the sides. They would probably have cost the restaurant $2 against the bottom line to replace and instead, they've earned the permanent loss of our whole family's business.

So don't go to Hank's if you'd like to be spoken to in a respectful manner. Or if you'd like to receive the whole order you paid for (preferably the first time). Or especially if you'd like your food hot... at least unless you have a microwave at home.
I've had the bbq. It was good, but was pleasantly surprised by the catfish. I wasn't expecting something so tasty. If you like catfish, it was da bomb!

Listen guys!   The purpose of this review is to get attention from the owners.  I love this place and go inside frequently and the food is excellent. However, they are using styrofoam and plastic bags for their takeout. This is totally unacceptable and needs to be attended to. There are many better ways to deliver take out food that do not kill our planet.  Please!!!  I cannot in good conscious order take out and neither can anyone else until the styrofoam and egregious plastic is gone.  Thank you!!!

I came here today (7/13/2021) and had my bag stolen. I went to one of the workers and told them what happened and was told there was nothing they could do. They have cameras everywhere but there is nothing they could do? I WOULD NOT recommend coming here. Filthy, dirty place!

The room was beautiful, highly enjoyable social life here going on constantly. My only complaint is that the bartender at the pool, Layla, asked us for our ID multiple times (which after 4 hours at the pool was inconvenient because we had put our purses back in the room) and then proceeded to deny us beverages. After multiple ID showings. MULTIPLE SHOWINGS OF ID. We are all over 30+. Annoying. Bad attitude. The manager came out and also had a bad attitude and defended her behavior as "policy." We get it dude, we are all service industry as well. But there's a difference between enforcing rules and being rude.

Absolutely Horrible experience. 
This was my first time . Perhaps my expectations were set too high . But it was just a horrible experience. The food was awful .  The waitress Leslie she was amazing such a great server . But everything else was horrible . 
When i did mention to a manager about the food they said sorry we will make a note so next time it will be better . 
Asking people for directions in the casino RUDE ! 

None the less just disappointed with my first experience.

Visited here with my friend. We played Blackjack. It was her first time and my second time playing. Our dealer, Tabitha, was patient and kind as she explained to us about the game. Even though we lost, we had fun.
Vegas style casino hotel in Florida. I've had great luck and the staff is awesome! Plenty of games for everyone to enjoy. The table games are wonderful. The decor is legendary!

I ordered a gluten free prosciutto pizza. The crust was too tough and made my jaw tired from chewing. I have had bad gluten free crusts before but this was way off the charts. However the prosciutto was not prosciutto. It seemed like someone put pieces of ham from a leftover carved  half ham on it. The fig jam was too sweet and there disappointingly was no goat cheese on it even though the description on the menu said goat cheese. When I went to pick up my pizza no one was in sight to greet me however an employee was in view. I was waiting in the front for a couple minutes until they acknowledged  that I was there. I 10/10 would not return nor recommend this place.

I really want to like this place because it's near my house and it's a great place to bring the kids. However, being a "great place for kids" doesn't mean all you should serve is greasy bar food. Pizza, ok, it's a pizza place. We'd come here multiple times a week but unless you're just getting a cheese pizza for your kids, it's just all greasy and boring. Seems to be the default menu theme in this area for whatever reason.
Very sub par pizza. And do not order from the chicken place. Better check you bag before you leave as well. I support local small business but this place I can not.

Ordered delivery of build-your-own pizza and homemade chocolate chip cookies. BYOP is a single-serving size and I ordered bacon & Roma tomatoes w/ extra mozzarella on the white crust baked well-done.  Delivery was quicker than promised, pizza & cookies were very tasty. I would order again in the future!

Old highschool spot and looks like one from the entrance .... But u come to this venue for the VIEWS, incredibly rooftop views while sipping a rose with some non-fancy eats on their old school highschool chairs.

I just love it. But the most annoying thing is everyone is taking a selfie or a picture on for their Gram.

Bok Bar is always a great spot especially for sunset! Getting into the actual building is a struggle if you don't know where youre going so allow extra time for that! Once you're inside though it's an awesome feel. You go to the eighth floor and see the city skyline! Best view in the South Philly! 

They take reservations and hold them for 15 minutes if you are running late! They also take walk-ins but that's slightly more risky.

Bok Bar always has a great drink menu and food that changes every now and again. I follow them on Instagram to stay up-to-date with their menu options.

This time around they had food from Strong Roots 9 (Gullah Cusine). The rice fritter was amazing! Very flavorful and filling. The beer bread and feta was delicious and even went well with the fritter. The goobers were soaked in brine and served chilled. They were soggy and not easy to eat. Definitely not my favorite thing but worth is $2 try!

I had heard a lot of good things about this bar but was really wowed by the whole experience. Definitely worth a visit. We watched a beautiful sunset and all of the cocktails were dreamy! I would recommend the "Golden Hour" for any gin drinkers. The menu highlights some philly locally made products, black-owned, woman-owned, and LGBTQIA+ own companies. We will have to go back for a live music event!

Went to Bok Bar around golden hour and wow the view is amazing. I made a dinner reservation about two weeks in advance. It's cool that the site is on the rooftop of an old repurposed high school. Bok Bar features different restaurants every week or so which made the experience really fun. The staff are really friendly. It was the perfect place to chill on a not-too-hot summer day! I recommend going during golden hour so you can watch the sunset from the rooftop!

You are really paying for the views, the drinks are small, and the food servings are tiny. I would also recommend you check the weather before. We came on a cold, windy night and they had no outdoor heaters or anything to keep us warm. The food was cold as soon as they brought it out to us and the drinks were iced, so that did not heelp. It was hard to enjoy the views when we were freezing.

I stopped here on the way home from a Tampa for a late lunch with a friend. I ordered the Cuban Roast pork with 2 sides (I think $6.95).  My sides were yellow rice and black beans. The portion was huge. I ended up taking half of it home. The meat was flavorful and moist. The beans and rice were also good. There was a decent selection of sides, all of them looked good. In fact, everything looked good. I've had more flavorful Cuban, but the 'Rona shut down my favorite place in Oldsmar, so I'm on the lookout for another Cuban place.

Delicious food. Nice staff. My favorite is the chicken. Such good flavor. Black beans are always just right. Yellow rice is delicious. Pressed sandwiches are my friends favorite. Good Parking. Has a Drive thru. Easy to get to. It's not a super clean place though if that bothers you. The bathrooms need a total remodel.

Ok so when I go to this restaurant they usually serve great portions and good food. I ordered dinner for my self and my family which was great but I order the steak sandwich which usually comes with chips and way more healthy i was very dissatisfied to see this in my bag. It's usually my favorite thing to order from here and I know if I was in the restaurant this would never have looked like this....... 
WHO MADE THIS SANDWICH‼‼ 
 NO BUENO

Take a break from the tourist traps, get some hearty delicious food and save some money in a charming atmosphere!

Loved this place. The food was beyond fantastic, flavorful, prepared just right, hearty portions. We got the pork chop and the ropa vieja. Both were tender, juicy and seasoned just right. I got green beans for sides. They they were aiight. Hubby got rice and plantains. They were delish! The deviled crab is a hard pass. Don't order that.

5th star for the super nice people, lovely music & just all around good vibes. Will be back...soon.
Great food. Great service. Great value for your money. We ordered 2 sandwiches (huge), a dinner plate and a soda for less than $20. Outstanding all around.

The food was DELICIOUS but the service was horrible. I ordered food online through Yelp and when my bf went to pick it up he was ignored, and forgotten. I understand how challenging staffing is these days and help is needed however, the staff that is working needs to do a better job with customer service. Doesn't cost a thing to say "hello, may I help you?"

If I could give no stars I would! 
I have NEVER been somewhere that makes a customer feel like an inconvenience. 
Arriving at the restaurant 15 minutes before close should not be a reason to treat customers like they're an inconvenience. Telling people that they'll seat you but you have to order quick is not the way to do business. Then when you do what they ask and they give you raw food that makes the experience even better (dripping with sarcasm).  Can't remake it for you cause they shut off the grill five minutes before your order was even put in!?!?! Who does this? 
When you complain about the service and the management offers excuses to try and make their actions acceptable is a true waste of time, and shows utter lack of appreciation for the people that buy their goods and services. 
My suggestion...
     STAY AWAY FROM THIS LOCATION IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO BE TREATED LIKE YOU'RE AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF THEIR INCOME.

I really, really wanted to love this place.  Based on others reviews I was looking forward to enjoying a hearty omelette.  

Let's start with the positives.  Very pleasant and fast service.  No complaints there at all.  

I ordered the hash and Jack omelette and this is where things started to go downhill.  What I received was essentially a Jack omelette.  There was virtually no meat at all - so little in fact that if I had been blindfolded I would have said it was just an egg and cheese omelette.  

Hash brown portion was stingy at best.  

There was an attempt to toast my English muffin, but it was just a mess of goo with butter on it.  

I'll be back to give it another try.

I first ordered the country fried steak with the gravy on the side and did not like it but then I ordered the corn beef hash meal and it was delicious. They replaced my meal with no problem at all. My date got the cowboy skillet and it was delicious. They did his eggs over easy instead of scrambled like it normally comes. Prices were decent for the sizes of meals. Service was excellent kept making sure everything was okay and we didn't need anything. Definitely would come back.

I usually don't write reviews but this is an exception. Every time we're in Tampa we make it our business to stop at Nicki's but I had an unpleasant experience today. When we arrived I went inside to get seated. And I entered into the restaurant there was a couple in front of me having a conversation with the hostess Ms.Caren they carried on a conversation as if I were invisible not one time did she acknowledge me even to say I will be with you shortly. When they finished the conversation she ushered them to their table. When she came back to the podium, again I'm standing there and still no acknowledgement, so I said I have two in my party and she was like ok I'm waiting for a table nonchalantly. Never once did she ask how many were in my party. So I said "Good morning" because obviously wasn't going to . She responded a dry "good morning "! Never looked up , another customer walked into the restaurant and she greeted them a pleasant "good morning, how many are in your party". I was floored. I hate to play the race card but, yes I'm African American and the other party was Caucasian. Although I love the food at nicki's and have often told my friends and family to visit when they are in Tampa , I will not visit again, that left a bitter taste in my mouth. When working with the public whether you like me or not, it's your job and part of customer service. I hope anyone else that encounters Ms.Caren has a better experience than I had . I will just trump it up to her having a bad morning, "Not". No matter what race, sex etc... you are without your paying customers you wouldn't have a successful business. One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch!
It took over an hour for our order.  I understand you might be understaffed but then your facility should be honest and let the customers know the time delay.

By far some of the worst service 
Even by McDonald's standards 

Waited 10 minutes for fries while the staff just sat there. Rude when anyone asked her to do anything besides sit on her ass

Wasn't even finish making my order nor paying and he already make that shit when I said I didn't want that he started to curse and get all rude they got Hella young people working in there with no respect for people that comes in and order stuff they need to do better they already lost me !!
The manager sent two employees to beat up a Ronald McDonald clown outside the store advocating for $15 wages. I mean my god it's the clown of the company lol
Employees were rude, inattentive, and were not wearing masks. Everyone refused to give me my order for carry out that I was already charged for.

They're open late, outdoor smoking, someone carries a giant flatscreen in & out everyday so that we can all watch the sports outside too. The Cav sauce is bangin! Great customer service. I have nothing bad to say

They have a table outside the business and so my friends and I sat down planning to buy drinks. The man instead of expressing that he needs to ID us. Instead he asks why we think we could just sit at a table. Making us feel beyond un welcomed. I explained they had a sign on the table stating they always have a table available. After that we provide our id instead of asking to see my face he just continues to stare at me with a cold dead look, waiting for me to remove my mask. I asked oh, did you need me to remove my mask? That is when he responded yes in the rudest way as if it was common sense. I just don't understand what made him in such a bad mood and to express it the way he did. But I wouldn't suggest going if your trying to smile and have a good time! Guy is a bummer and beyond rude!!!!!  I wish I could give a zero stars!!! Worst place I have ever experience!

First time ordering take out from Cavs Headhouse. It was a pretty big order and they prepared it fast, efficiently and with all our special requests. While I would of liked the food a bit hotter with some bigger portions of fries, the actual food was very good. I recommend this place for the casual night in!

Went here to grab dinner with some friends. Immediately was greeted by a bouncer who was incredibly rude to myself and the rest of my party. Once seated, the food was very slow to come out (took about 45 mins from ordering for the food to arrive at the table). Overall, this was average at best.
My boyfriend and I were wandering the city for food, and we came across Cavanaughs and were pleasantly happy with the service. The Cav sauce was AMAZING.
no es buena, la pizza es tarta de culo y huele a tripa de pescado
I love they pizza it's so good sometimes it's cold sometimes it's hot sometimes they Alfredo pasta is watery but beside that I love it

Angela was such a great help and she even gave me cheese for my salad ! It was so good and delightful , I had a great time at this location . Great customer service , and worker had hot pizza for everyone . My dishes were bussed for me as soon as I was finish !

I recently moved to Philadelphia and have never eaten at Primo Hoagies before. I went to the location on 3rd and Market Street (Old City) on July 9, 2021. When I arrived at approximately 7:40 PM, I was told that they were no longer excepting orders after 7:30 PM. I understand this completely (because they closed at 8 PM), however when I called ahead at 7:15 PM to place a phone order for pick up (I have the time stamp on my phone) I was told that they did not except phone orders AT ALL and that you could only come in person to place an order for food. That is why I went to the location to try to place an order. When I heard that information prior to my arrival at the Old City location about not being able to place a phone order, I found it odd, but I took it as the truth. The woman at the register told me that they do indeed take phone orders but that all orders cease at 7:30 PM. I now realize that whoever I spoke to when I called at 7:15 PM lied to me about not being able to place orders over the phone for pick up. I completely understand the policy of orders not being placed after 7:30 PM, but I am mostly upset that I was lied to about the ability to place orders over the phone. This lack of integrity makes me want to never attempt to eat at this restaurant again...and I was really excited to eat here, too.

Over 3 1/2 hours for and still waiting for 2 hoagies... would give zero stars if I could. Typically never have bad service or issues with this location. Called, put on hold.. disconnected. Called again, put on hold... still no food delivered.

For what Primo is, it's top notch. Many different hoagies to choose from, fresh cut meats, ample portions, good bread. And the staff at this location has always been nice, which scores brownie points. 

That said, the menu is long. Trying to figure out the differences between some variations on similar sandos isn't that easy. And the online ordering system, especially when using a mobile device, isn't exactly the best experience. I have less problems when using a desktop computer. This digital experience is what makes me knock off a star. If they improve this, I would easily up my rating!
Got wrong order - store blamed it on the driver.  Promised to call me back and did not.  No apology    - just stated I would get a refund but offered nothing for my trouble.

Horrible delivery experience. Order for business mtg set over 24 hrs in advance, arrived 45 minutes late. They did not even call me to tell me what was going on.  If I didn't proactively call the food probably would've just sat there. The sandwiches are frankly so sub par. Massive rolls, barely any meat.
The crust was like cardboard & had barely any sauce on it. Threw away the majority of it.

This pizza place was delicious and the service was awesome. We ordered two pizzas and a large salad to ensure leftovers. The pizzas were meatball and ricotta and the carnivori. Both absolutely delicious and cooked perfectly. The restaurant was clean and friendly, TVs were on but non-obtrusive and staff checked in on us frequently but not overbearing. Highly recommended!
Has great tomato sauce, which you do not find on lesser pizzas. All the ingredients make for a super good pizza.

The pizza is amazing here, they also have awesome wings! Rachel was our server and she is the bomb definitely ask for her if you go there, great service and she was  very talkative, friendly and informative. We can't wait to come back!
Came back yesterday with my husband and was happy to see Dax was working again! Great food and exceptional staff. Tampa Favorite!!!
Ordered a meal for delivery and after an hour when my driver finally arrived to pick it up they said they didn't receive an order even though it says order confirmed.

This McDonald's is awful. The manager sucks at his job. The last 5 times I've gone there has not been salt on my fries at all. This last time I went I even asked for salt on the fries and still didn't get any. I ordered a Carmel frappe and didn't get it till 15 minutes later, while I was waiting for the frappe I went inside and ordered another fry and it took the guy 5 minutes to give me my fry. Never coming back to this McDonald's. I'll go to the one thats a bit farther and I'll still get my food and get back home before I would if I went to the closer one.

This was definitely my favorite Cuban sandwich that I got on my last trip to Tampa. I ordered their regular Cuban sandwich because it was voted one of the best in the areas. You are able to get the sandwich with a few side order options. I decided to get the mac&cheese, which was also delicious. I enjoyed the sandwich because it had a good crunch to the bread, very flavorful and I like the mojo sauce that they serve with the sandwich. I would highly recommend this place and would definitely plan on coming back here on another trip to Ybor City.

The stone soup company is incredible! I can not tell you how welcoming the customer service was after our long road trip! The French Onion soup was easily the best soup I have ever had! The vegan options were excellent and delicious! Even if you aren't a soup person the burger is a great choice! (I do recommend mozzarella cheese). The Stone Soup Company is truly a wonderful restaurant with something for everyone!

I really like Stone Soup Company. They've got one of the best Cubans that I've had in Tampa. I've had the regular Cuban and their  Bad Hombre Cuban sandwich platter. I usually order french fries because they are really tasty and crispy. The Bad Hombre is my favorite and let me tell you why. 

I've had the Bacon and Bleu Burger with Cajun slaw and got the burger all the way. Which is $12. The Bad Hombre platter is $10. They have $2 mimosas when we went one Sunday and they were pretty tasty too. You can't go wrong with $2 mimosas.

On my most recent visit,  I had the Breakfast Bowl. The breakfast bowl has hash browns topped with two eggs of your choice and a choice of protein. You can choose between bacon, ham, sausage, or tofu. I chose bacon. It also comes with tomato and cheese served with Cuban toast. It is really delicious. We also ordered the Panini with fried egg. It comes with spinach, tomato, cheese, and a choice of protein. You can choose from bacon, ham, andouille sausage, or Portobello sausage. That was good too.  Honestly, I haven't had a bad meal there yet. It's one of my go-to places when I want something good to eat and I've always had good, friendly service. The last time I was there, Ian took care of us.  Thanks Ian!
Soup was good, the rest of the menu was ok. Glad we tried it out but not likely to return.
It was alright. Located in Ybor you have to find parking and walk here. The menu selection is pretty diverse.

We stumbled upon Pho Don and we're really happy to come across it! We ordered the chicken pho and the grilled pork with vermicelli (bun) to go. Both were fantastic with generous portions for the price. The vermicelli really hit the spot and the broth in the pho is really tasty.

Pork Vermicelli with egg roll was the best thing I've eaten in a very long time! It was a huge portion that I had to force myself to stop eating because it was so good! I had their Deluxe Beef Pho a few times before and it was delicious as well. Never disappointed here!

Yum yum!! Searching for something hearty and Yelp brought me here. The pho ga was everything I needed and more. So delicious and hot. The shrimp roll was nice and light. I loved the fact that when I was done eating I was full but not overly stuffed. Would've totally gotten some Thai iced tea if I had the space to gulp it down.
They have the most amazing vegan fish with rice! It tastes so close to actual fish. The watermelon juice and espresso are also amazing!

I've been to Daiva's for breakfast a few times and every time I come, they never disappoint. First off, they have a wide selection of breakfast foods to choose from. I highly recommend their stuffed French toasts and omelette's...they are to die for! Aside from the excellent breakfast, the customer service is amazing and we always leave with a smile on our faces!  I have yet to try their lunch/dinner, but the choices are endless!!

My boyfriend and I really enjoy this place. We have gone a handful of times and we continue to keep going back. Service and food was always excellent! Also, the food prices are really good and you get tons of food!!
We had the hibachi. The fried rice was great, but the seafood was poor quality. Also, I really hope they stop using styrofoam to go containers! That's absolutely horrible!!!
We loved this place when we lived in Tampa and make sure to visit every time we're back in town. The food is amazing and the staff are very friendly. Chef Panda is by far our fav!
Sooo Fun! Family Night when we go. The Chefs are all really talented. Salmon is my favorite  Atmosphere is low lit. Oh and the Saki Champagne is Amazing!!!

Had the shrimp & scallops hibachi. The scallops are NOT scallops....stingray, possibly. fishy & disgusting.....
Told the maager she said it was scallops, I know what a sea scallop is. I eat them all the time. Trying to pass stingray as sea scallops is shameful. Just gross. Won't be back.

This place should be called Don Julio's Authentic tasteless Mexican. I'm hoping my review will save someone from wasting their money like I did because I'm not understanding the good reviews at all! It was so tasteless, I wish I could give it no stars because I couldn't eat none of the items I purchased. I ordered the Carnitas Taco, the Fajitas de Carne, the Enchiladas de pollo and the Chimichanga with pork filling. 
The Carnitas taco had the driest pork I've had in a long time. The Fajitas de Carne steak was dry and it tasted like there was no seasoning added while cooking it. The Enchiladas de Pollo had no flavor which came with refried beans that had absolutely no flavor what so ever! The rice that accompanied it was slightly mushy and had nothing authentic about it. Finally the Chimichanga had barely any pork in it which was fine cause the pork in the Carnitas Taco was dry anyways. It was filled with that mushy rice and when I bit into it it was like I bit into a Chimichanga filled with grease. 
I normally get my Mexican food fix from Loli's 
Mexican Cravings and I should have never veered off course and tried this place.
Do your self a favor and go to Loli's , you won't be dissatisfied and there food is always on point!!!

It is a bout 3.5 stars. Definitely a credit for quantity of food and quality of food. The food may just need to tone down the salt level on meat seasoning. Especially the carne Asada. 

We got the carne Asada for the entree. Mexican is a bit different than Columbian. Their meat a bit thicker. The seasoning is on the salty side. The pre fried bean is good and soft. But I like their rice better. My wife have the Enchiladas de pollo. I like the chili sauce. Deep dark red chili sauce is the best. I will recommend this dish. 

The restaurant is nice inside and outside seating. It is great place for snack especially Tuesday taco. Buy three get one free. I saw many customers is USF student. It is good place to hang out. I like their salsa to begin with chips.
Staff is always friendly, food is always great. They have the best queso and the best horchata.

This is a hard review to write. The sign says winner of the best Mexican food and since there is one on every corner how can you go wrong? So here is the problem. The food was good but it didn't taste at all like Mexican. I went with the waiters suggestion and got the pork chimichanga. I'm glad I did. It was good but again didn't taste like any chimichanga I've ever had. My wife had the beef. That wasn't very good. The staff is to their credit. They were welcoming and helpful. This place just didn't do it for me but that's doesn't mean you should pass it up. As I said the food was good just not flavored like any Mexican food I've ever had. It felt very Americanized.

We tried Don Julio's because of the YELP reviews. We all enjoyed it. They make their own corn tortillas, which are very good. I had the tacos de berries which I have never had. Very good! My daughter had the carnitas tacos and said they were great. Indoor and outdoor seating, Quick & friendly service. Reasonably priced. Some of the best tacos that I've had in Florida. We'll be back to try other items on the menu!

I found this place purely by accident. Wonderful food, Great atmosphere and an incredible staff.
Well worth a visit!
Almaz Cafe was great! The veggie combo was delicious and the Injera was great (they offer GF as well!). We had lovely service as well. Definitely will go back!

GLUTEN FREE INJERA. Mic drop. Wait, did I mention gluten free injera?? I have been sooo sad without gluten free injera and now I can have it anytime along with the best veggie combo ever. Also the owners are the nicest people. I've been coming here for 7 years but of course during the pandemic I stayed home. Now that I'm going back, and they have gluten free injera, I'm eating here all the time again. I've eaten the GF injera 5-6 times and haven't gotten the slightest reaction. I'm not celiac but I'm extremely sensitive to gluten and gluten cross-contamination and I trust them to make it safe for me.

Best Ethiopian food in Philly!  Almaz is always fresh, delicious and full of flavor. I have had the vegetarian platter as well as several of the individual vegetarian dishes.  Each has been so delightful.  The Injera is warm and fresh out of the oven.  The women at the restaurant are so nice and accommodating.  For takeout they wrap the container so well that it can withstand any trip home!

Amazing! Veg combination has lots of flavor at a reasonable price as well. Most Ethiopian places are very expensive. The staff is super friendly and there is small seating outside and plenty of room inside.

This Cafe has a warm, cozy, and family friend atmosphere. Not only is the food delicious, but the waiters are friendly and sweet. The opera was beautiful, elegant, and heart warming. I would absolutely recommend coming here to experience the exquisite food, opera, and the atmosphere.

What a fabulous night of drinking and eating while the service staff sang opera.   I'm not an opera fan but these men and women were amazing.   Every 20 minutes a different server would get up explain the story behind the song and belt out amazing sounds that I don't have the words to give them enough praise.   

The meal was delicious.   My Veal Saltimbocca had two nice sizes pieces of thinly cut veal topped with crispy Prosciutto with a mushroom grave on top of Risotto.   Every bite was a mouthful of flavor.   The Shrimp and Scallops Linguine was in a light yet tasty sauce.   The linguine was perfect cooked as was the seafood.   Everyone else at the table verbalized what a wonderful meal they were having.   I would have liked a more aggressive Caesar dressing.  

Desserts were not pictured here as they went too fast.   Frozen Lemon Sorbet,  creme brûlée and warm chocolate cake were enjoyed by the whole table.  

Definitely a place to try at least once.

We recently dined at The Victor Cafe for my husband's birthday. We thoroughly enjoyed the opera and it was such a cool experience! The food isn't the best Italian I've ever had, but the experience makes it a place to check out for a special occasion or first date. We both had Caesar salads to start (which were delish) and I had the Prince Igor and my husband had the Fra Diavolo. Our waitress did seem a bit annoyed or overwhelmed, which would have made or experience 5 stars even if the food isn't out of this world.
This place was absolutely amazing. From the staff to the food to the opera singing, I was blown away. This is now definitely one of my favorite restaurants.

The Victor Cafe served us a special meal. My husband and I both had the bone in veal chop with mashed potatoes, spinach and broccoli rabe. It was all cooked to perfection! Our young girls, 7 and 4 years old had the pasta rusticana. They loved that as well. To top off the wonderful food, the waitresses and waiters serenaded us all night with their beautiful voices. We will definitely come back.
Ordered catfish and didn't receive catfish not sure what type of fish it was. Very disappointed!!

When i say this is fire! Expectations have been met 
I found this place on Yelp. They also have many seafood options that i plan to try next.

cost me and my wife over $20 to eat at this restaurant and the portion size is small, the fish sandwich is for real two slices of sandwich bread and literally a piece of fried fish just like a homemade $2 sandwich nothing special. The meals even when you upgrade are smaller than what you can buy on lunch special for just $6.99 almost any place but they cost over $13...flavor is ok but nothing to brag or talk about

What is the sense in having online ordering or Uber when you can't handle the traffic? If you can't handle the traffic close the store. There has to be someone coming outside handing off the Uber and the online orders is that too hard to figure out? Two orders got canceled by me today because I wasn't sitting in a line for 15 cars and going to make seven bucks for an hour and a half, would you? Damn you should be happy you have all this business instead you're just making people mad anyway. End it was barely 3 o'clock and the cars were all the way up the road and the line was not moving

This is not your mother's strip mall, suburban Chinese takeout joint, so forego the poor reviews complaining because they didn't get the same, tired General Tso or shrimp fried rice that they're used too. Yes, it is in a strip mall and gives off that traditional unkempt "on the verge of closing" vibe which would lead you to believe it's just like the rest, but let me tell you brother - this is hands down some of the most original, interesting Chinese food I've eaten. As in, on a par with some of the off the beaten path Chinatown spots in SF or NY. Now the trick is to order the non-traditional items, which should be easy because there's plenty of options. 
For me that's Chongqing Spicy Chicken - a dish I've come back to a half dozen times - but honestly everything we've tried has been excellent.

The family that owns this restaurant are super friendly and the food is ALWAYS delicious. I have ordered the cumin lamb and general Tao chicken which are always fire. Whenever I have classes at USF I try to order food here. They have the typical Chinese food you can usually get and then they also have traditional Chinese food on a separate menu you can order from.

What a gem this place is.  Amazing products, even better service.  Their breads are the best in the entire Delaware Valley, bar none.  We in the suburbs forget how close Chestnut Hill is, and this place alone is worth the few minute drive.  Great coffee, I'm all about local over Starbucks.  What the heck is a Kouign Amann?  Go ask for one and you'll be hooked!

[1177]

4/2021

Wow! This is probably the worst Wendy's I ever visited.   I went thru the drivethru..  The line was very long.  The cashier/worker was NOT friendly.  Made me feel like I was doing her a favor.   

Something was also wrong w/ my food.  Soda was flat and food was "off".  I can't explain it but it was not right.   I've had Wendy's plenty of times.

Anyway I tossed my food since my stomach started to hurt.  I will NOT be back.

There are so many things wrong with this Wendy's. There is a reason why it is rarely a line in the drive-through. Customer service is ass. It is very frustrating trying to order through the app (i know this location has no control over this). They often forget something in your order such as the dressing or a side. Then when you try to bring it up to the staff they are straight up rude. I don't understand why they are so slow when they are no customers waiting in line SMH. Chick-fil-A is definitely worth the wait most days lol. Some please fix their disorganized system!

Stopped by here because we were waiting for dinner and this place was close by. Came here late afternoon on a Saturday. Place was really large. They have a really good selection of beer and ciders. I'm personally not a huge fan of beer so opted for a cider. The cider selection was so interesting!

We got the honey ginger cider, it came in a normal beer glass and was only $6! Coming from NYC, this was an amazing price. Usually you get $6 beer in a bottle but this looked like it was on tap so that's super awesome.

I was so surprised I liked the taste of the honey ginger cider - it tastes like ginger ale but not as sweet and a little less bubbly, it was literally perfect since the weather outside was so hot, this felt like a little alcoholic detox.

The rest of the bar was also really fun. I really liked that there was a bunch of games we could play and try out after (we tried a racing game, you can do 1v1). I've never been to an arcade bar before so this was super fun for me given the novelty and I finally found a beer / cider that I actually like!
Awesome throwback arcade location with cool vibes .. great drinks .  Fun place to check out

Service was good, they were nice & attentive. I am a regular when it comes to eating sushi... it's a constant craving. I was actually extremely disappointed. Usually I never have a complaint but I didn't like the food here. I ordered 2 different rolls, the black dragon and the spider and neither were good to me. I also wish they would offer different dipping sauces. I would've liked to have more than just soy sauce

Kitchen is open until 2am every night except Sundays! Came in for dinner for the 1st time at this location (if this is the same Sake House that used to be next to USF in the past) upon walking up there were a few tables outside and a makeshift desk for pick up orders. No employees in sight. I walked toward the door and noticed a sign "do not touch door, ring for service". When an employee came out she rushed by to a nearby table but politely told me she would help me in a moment. Apparently there is only outdoor seating as she told us to pick any table available. It was quite muggy out so I reluctantly picked one. There was only one waitress/host/employee that attended to all the tables as well as the to-go orders that walked up. She seemed overwhelmed so I made sure to be extra patient with the wait times between ordering drinks and food. They were out of stock of my favorite Hana Lychee sake so she recommended another one on the menu to me. When she returned she said they were out of that as well but brought out 3 other sake bottles for me to choose from. She couldn't tell me her opinion on them though as she said she never tried them. There are so many sushi rolls to choose from on the menu ... I think close to 75 if I remember correctly! There are apps, meals, soups and salads as well. We got the chicken gyoza as an app, and I ordered the 2011 & crispy spicy dinner rolls. First out was the soup & salad that comes with the sushi rolls. Everything from utensils to bowls/plates was plastic or styrofoam. Soup was hot and had small pieces of tofu, seaweed and onions. The salad was pretty sad. Literally a spring mix of lettuce and dressing. No other additions such as carrots to spruce it up. Gyoza which usually come out like potstickers in other establishments I've been to came out crispy and fried but still delicious! Rolls arrived quickly after and piping hot (mine were tempura) both of my rolls were quite yummy but I was confused as to the crispy Spicy being tempura since the menu did not suggest it being as so. There was a lot of rice and breading but a small amount of actual sushi for that particular roll. Not sure if I would return.

The Basics: Sake House is a sushi spot located on Amberly Drive in Tampa Palms. There was a prior sushi restaurant at this location, but it has since changed ownership. The restaurant is small and features some tables and booths as well as a sushi bar where you can sit. 

Things I like: The sushi is fine and there is a lot of variety to choose from. My favorite roll I have had from Sake House is the Tampa Roll. It is also a convenient spot as you can order pick up or get food delivered via Uber Eats. 

Things I didn't like: I was not very impressed by the quality of the sushi. It did not seem to made with much care. The Spicy Girl roll was fine, but the B-52 was difficult to eat because it was so heavily fried. 

Overall, I am not planning on returning to Sake House at the moment, but I may try to eat inside the restaurant at some
point to see if I enjoy the food more when it is not being picked up for takeout.

This experience (outside of the trouble I had with UberEats) was slightly better than others I've been having! They offered a nice BOGO on certain appetizers, and the pork gyoza did not disappoint. Had it arrived hot, I imagine it would have been much better but was cooked thoroughly and nice, crisp outside with a good dipping sauce. The shrimp tempura was unique from other places as the tail had been removed which was SO NICE to not have to try removing the tail from a roll with no knife. I usually struggle, but this time was easier. One piece did contain some tail which caused me to choke slightly, but got through and it was the only issue I had. The California roll was exactly as expected, nothing less and nothing more though everything tasted fresh. Was pretty happy with this experience, however a good egg roll would have been the perfect touch and I'm confident this place could do it after trying the gyoza. I'd recommend eating in over delivery, not too bad!
Best Sushi in Tampa. Dinner and Lunch special is fantastic value for the quality and quantity you get. Lots of choices available for the $12 option too.
Likely one of the worst run restaurants of any kind, anywhere. Beyond slow, nobody cares about anything. Place will be out of business soon or change owners. Pathetic.

It's ok.

The food arrived on time, was hot and tasty but missing our sauces.

It's little details like that which can be annoying.

I been buying food here for quite sometime. They sent me 2 brunt and greasy eggrolls with a napkin in the bag to catch the grease. Also the fries were half done and cold. I called and the lady said there were real busy and that's why my order was the way it was. I told her I couldn't eat none of it. She said she would take care of it another day. I called tues. A girl answered and i told her what happened..the lady wanted me to pay for one item before she would reimburse me. I paid for the fries and she charged me 2.50 delivery.

Always enjoyed stopping in here for the live entertainment, cocktails and wings. Had company visiting from out of State so we went here for a bite to eat and a beer. First of all, this place was pretty busy, no one had on masks, no social distancing nor was the owner encouraging this as the bar was again pretty packed. Again, No social distancing!! The only  bartender was tending bar, taking food orders and running back and forth. We were finally acknowledged after sitting at the bar for 10 minutes because I timed it before we were greeted and asked if we wanted to order a drink. After the bartender taking his time to fulfill our drink order we also placed an order for wings/fries. After finishing up I had to practically flag the bartender down so that we can pay and leave and he still took his time in ringing us up. What a waste if you're not going to be attentive to your customers or practice social distancing amongst patrons.

No more! Norm and Gabriel are a hot mess. I could hear Gabriel say " the lady on the phone is a bitch"  while waiting for Norm to get on the phone after 15 mins of him talking about random stuff. Gabriel couldn't articulate the order info or issue to poor old Norm. Norms comment to the bar was "you shouldn't order right before 11, she's dumb".  Norm couldn't explain why beefsteak tomatoes, bacon, grilled chicken, ketchup and utensils were missing from a wedge salad.   They rest of the food was horrible too.  I order frequently, because they are "new orleansish" and across the street.  The gulf shrimp were hard..like they were refried. The tater tots were so greasy they weren't edible and the curly fries...hard (refried) and greasy.  This establishment may have another business operations in the kitchen..cause they can NEVER provide what the menu says, that's a consumer issue.  8 on your side.

I love the Tap Room!! It's not perfect but it's a very family friendly place to get a drink and eat some good food. The owner is a sweet heart! We do monthly meetings there and I love that we can give this like minded, local business owner business over brands that don't show their customers appreciation. I think it's cozy and spacious inside. They have the high tables and regular tables, plus outside seating for different types of seating options. There is a back area with pool tables we have our meetings at.

For the food I've had the tatters and the pretzel with the beer cheese dip. I like it. I always get a margarita when I go cus everyone can make a rita. The Tap room is not the fanciest place, but it's laid back and the perfect type of place I like to spend my time at. I love being a customer of Tampa Tap Room!!

Worst chicken wings I have ever seen I couldn't not eat this crap they look a week old and they are fried instead of grilled please don't order wings from here this is terrible I had to take a picture

I was very pleasantly surprised by my experience here. We came in as a group of 11 and the team managed to find a way to seat us all together. We probably tried half the menu. Everything but two dishes got rave reviews around the table - particularly the Bronzizzle and Tuna Usuzukiri. Surprisingly good low key sushi spot.

Had 1 night in Philadelphia and I'm so glad we chose zama. Even though we arrived late and the kitchen was about to close, they were so accommodating and allowed us to order without any rush. The food was 5 star all round and I will definitely be returning for the amazing crab cheese spring rolls. Absolutely fantastic would highly recommend

It was my first time to visit this restaurant. I tried Wasabi Tuna, Surfer, Spicy Crunchy Grilled Avocado, Hummus-San Temaki, Washabi Truffle Escargot, and Sushi Sashimi Combination. I expected good tastes from each one but each one was really disappointed except Wasabi Truffle Escargot but No wasabi flavor even thought it says Wasabi. Nome of rolls was good and the worst one was grilled avocado..  Sashimi was okay but each nigiri uses small fishes.. Learn bad experience with spent $250..

Dined in person last night for the first time celebrating my husband's 30th birthday. I had mentioned his birthday on our reservation but it went unnoticed. We were seated immediately and our waiter brought over refreshing ice water and menus in a timely fashion. The cocktails were good and the sushi is top notch compared to other places in Philly. Our waiter was polite but awkward and it was difficult getting his attention at times. The negatives: there was a table of 4 drunk and loud/disruptive women that were never spoken to about their behavior aside from being told multiple times that they needed to wear masks when walking around. They were slumped over asleep in their booth when we were walking out to leave. I'm very surprised that the restaurant tolerated this behavior, it definitely did not match the vibe/price point of Zama. The bill was also quite high compared to most sushi restaurants in Philly. We really did enjoy our meal, so we will order only take out in the future.

Bought 3 sushi rolls at 6:40pm.  2 avocado 1 shrimp tempura.  Attendant tells me to come in 20 min later .  I show up at 7:00pm and the sushi comes out at 7:40pm.  Waited in their for 40 minutes without anyone saying a word to me.  Once they brought my food out I asked for the manager and told him I have been waiting for a very long time and he pointed at him self and laughed and me and turned around to fulfill more orders.  Classless.  This is the customer service you get ?? This guy should be fired.

My husband and I are from Southern California and are currently traveling the nation to find and experience the best food around!
After seeing TNT Burger on IG we knew that we had to go in person to see if it was worth the hype...

We're happy to say, holy crap...yes, yes it is. You may think to yourself... anyone can make a good burger. NOPE! Patty quality and flavorings make a MASSIVE difference!

We had the cheesy beast and the COVID burger and damn. Their patties were so juicy, flavorful and cooked perfectly! We were slightly hesitant on eating a burger covered in cheese, but this thing was next level! The cheese on the outside gave you such a unique experience, enhanced the flavorings and also gave a creaminess to the burger. The Angus beef hot dog inside also gave it a unique flavor and textural element that was anything we've ever experienced!!

We also tried their TNT Fries and you would also think to yourself... who the heck puts corn on fries... wow! It was super good flavor and texture wise! The fries were super crispy to!

We had such a great experience, from the amazing customer service and hospitality to the unique flavorings and creations that we had to go a second time to try a couple more things! So glad that we did! Cause the second round we had to try two more burgers, the other fries and their crazy delicious hot dog creation!!!

Honestly everything we ate here was incredible and it is definitely one of the best burgers we've ever had period!

Do yourself a favor and visit TNT. They are a foodie destination spot for sure!
Not to poop on anyones territory, but we will tell you right now they are 10000000000% better then Burger Culture, which is legit down the street from them (we had visited them the next day to compare and were sadly super disappointed).

Thanks TNT for infusing your love and passion into your food!! We will definitely be flying out in the future to see ya'll again!

FB: Fitfoodiesonwheels
Excellent food, well worth the money , I guess is the best burger place in Tampa, tried all the burgers , highly recommended.

Now that I've finally tried this place I can tell you that it DEFINITELY lives up to the hype! I had the covid19 vaccine burger and it was so juicy and the flavor was incredibly good. I am in shock. I was expecting a mediocre burger but omg they cooked this with nothing but love. I'm obsessed! The syringe has a sauce to put into the burger and it was so good. TNT is a must go! I'm excited to try their other burgers also. My burger pictured doesn't have bacon because I don't eat pork but if you do I'm sure this burger would taste great! This first time customer will 100% be coming back. With friends!
The food was amazing but then me and my son got very sick the next day uncontrollable diarrhea

We ordered on a Friday evening after a late football game. After calling the restaurant personally twice to confirm our order , the girl said sure sure no problem customization noted in a very reassuring way. It will take an hour for delivery she stated . Its late ..we are tired... sure I'll wait. Fast forward to one hour, our almost $100 order has still not been picked up for delivery . When we called DoorDash to check on the status,  it was the restaurant who did not confirm the order via email therefore a dasher was not assigned...1hour later?! Seriously TNT burger , we were looking forward to trying this new restaurant unfortunately we probably never will . An error in the order details here and there is fine as human error happens ,  but blatantly ignoring and never 'preparing' our order without notification pretty much tells us you don't care to stay in business.

The most relaxing tiny bookshop café ever. The book collection is fantastic, and they also carry some fantastic stuff. This was my third visit, and the barista was really pleasant and kind. 

They have a wonderful selection of lattes, including one named "Kobe"! I wish I lived in the area so I could make it my regular hangout, but I'll definitely be back. The atmosphere is fantastic. There is a decent assortment of literature for all ages. In my view, this is one of the most friendly spaces in Philadelphia! 

The size of the space isn't awful, but I wish it were bigger for one reason: so that more people could experience the positive mood and inspiring atmosphere.
Best! Coffee is SO good. Service is SO good. Books are Soooooo good. Atmosphere and design - they are crushing it!!! Can take a while to get your order but totally worth it !

I LOVE Uncle Bobbie's since it's inception.  I had choral rehearsals at a nearby church, so it was a hop, skip and a jump.  The coffee choices are great, & I usually would eye and select a delicious pastry.   I will be glad when  the pandemic is all clear.   Meanwhile, I'll be glad to return to this café called Uncle Bobbie's.
The staff was not welcoming at all. The staff had their arms crossed when I walked in. Customer service here is definitely lacking. I will not return.

An amazing bookstore/cafe/cultural hub/candle shop that lured me through "fancy" spiced aromas, and held me there by the many works of Audre Lorde that lined the back walls. I come here all the time thinking to myself -- for the love of god, don't break your wallet in this place --  and each time like capitalists clockwork, i'm at the register with more than I can handle and an oaky nutty candle i never knew I needed.
This is literally the best Mexican food I have ever eaten. Carol is a magician in the kitchen.
It's was a good spot to stop for a drink but the food was way overpriced an order of chips and queso was almost 15 buck and you got a small bag of chip

Carol and nick were great! Food and service was 100% I always look forward  to taco Tuesday and I think I found my new favorite spot. My boyfriend and I always look for new places to try for taco Tuesdays but we really liked the food and service here so we will definitely be back!!

I drove by here on my way gone from work one day and saw a sign for taco Tuesday. Friday we finally went. We got guacamole and chips (which are homemade!), margaritas, and two orders of quesabirrias. The food was out of this world. The staff are so friendly; albeit a little understaffed! We have gone multiple days in a row because it really is just that good! I'm not normally one to write reviews but I want everyone to know that this is THE place for quesabirra tacos, guacamole and chips, etc. I recommend this place to everyone now
Everything we got was gluten free and they are very good about this! Most of their menu is made with corn tortillas. My partner has celiacs and is VERY sensitive so we were wary, but we've been a handful of times now and no issues at all.

I visited Cartinas Tacos and Tequila on a Wednesday night with my husband and niece.  They were having drag queen bingo and I was intrigued!

We got there about 30 minutes before bingo started to order our food and drinks early.   I ordered two tostadas and they were fantastic! I could not finish both so I may go for one next time but they are so good you will want two! 

The bingo ended up being in Spanish which added to the fun!  I was like a Spanish lesson with a drag queen with food, beer and prizes! Yes! Sign me up!

The restaurant is a bit small though so if they get busy on bingo night, you will definitely have to call in advance for a table.  

I really enjoyed the entire experience, the food, the owner, the bingo and prizes! I will definitely return to try another bingo night.   They also have a taco Tuesday I believe so want to check that out as well.

Pros-1/2 off if you have a Capital one card
Pooch friendly

Security 
Lots of events offering free advice and food
Cons- a lot since Fiona left
I generally adore most of the baristas, as I come here 3-4 times a week. 
There's been a shift in mood and attitude recently and I wish Christina would address this. 

Their dark roast coffee is delicious-but steer clear of any other bean. I can't even give my light roast

Nothing will make my eyes roll in their sockets like a defective slot machine faster than a bank getting into the coffee house business. 

In order to seriously disrupt the one star service pedigree at most retail banks Capital One opened an honest to goodness java station in Philadelphia's Rittenhouse Square to swaddle their brand in avuncular good feelings and lash millennial tastebuds in yummy (and expensive) caffeine concoctions. 

Frankly, I take my money seriously and I'll easily forego the frothy cappuccino in favor of things like... I don't know... competitive interest rates and an extensive ATM network. 

Maybe I'm just old school about the hipness required of my bank but am I the only one who thinks it odd that a bank whose core values should spin on an axis of responsible personal finance sees their point of difference in the sale of frivolous morning dessert beverages at a usurious $8 a clip. 

I just know I left my copy of Personal Finance for Dummies around here somewhere. Damn, I must have left it between the couch cushions at the Capital One Cafe. Madison, a round of Double Mochas for everyone, on me. Extra Cinnamon and hold the interest.

If craving that saucy, incredible, crisp on the outside, molten on the inside General Tso's chicken, as a takeout, then Tang's is where it's at. That's from my personal experience. Down to earth service and pricing combined with stratospheric quality. From what I hear, it's also the place to get your Kung Pao, sesame, Hunan and Szechuan style chicken/beef/shrimp and various kinds of lo meins too. 

The restaurant has excellent aggregate ratings from close to two hundred reviews on various platforms. 
I asked the employee at the counter what the magic behind this is and she said the main chef puts his heart and soul into the creations; works hard and they're an incredibly soft spoken and humble family and employer. 

I noted the pictures of menu on Yelp were difficult to read....in the interest of the community and out of gratitude to Tang's, I'll humbly provide menu pics that are hopefully readable. 

COVID-19 related:
No indoor dining, takeout only. 
Employees masked appropriately. 
Social distancing reminders present at the establishment. 


Convenience related:
Parking was an issue. I ordered in phone and drove around the block 3 times before I got a parking and food was ready to be picked up in 5 minutes thereafter. 

'Twas my first time in the the neighborhood which had a run down feel I sensed. The stellar reviews being my North Star, I did not let the environment deter me.

How does this place only get 3.5 stars on Yelp!  We stopped by The Bourse and decided to grab lunch.  If I can restore pictures from my sim card, I'll post.  My wife and I split a Freebyrd chicken sandwich, fries and the super tasty fried pickle chips. The chicken was moist and the Alabama white sauce tasty.  The pickle chips had a little heat and were great with both the ketchup and white sauce.  I'd give 4.5 stars if I could ... but with a 3.5 star overall rating, Freebyrd deserves a full 5 to bring the average up!

I had the tenders and they weren't my favorite chicken ever, but it was good. I enjoyed the breading. 
The employees were nice and service speed was okay.

While at the Bourse..checking out other stands..I decided to give Freebyrd a try!
I have heard good things & I needed dinner..so let's go!

I got the dry rub wings and I was glad I did..perfectly crispy and seasoned so well!  I am glad I got the order of 12 v. 6 ..I have a few left over for lunch tomorrow (if I don't finish them off for a late night snack..Lol)!

I will definitely make it my business to get back to Freebyrd to try other items on the menu!!

I love me some curly fries and they surely give you enough, this is an entire meal unless shared with someone. All of the toppings were evenly proportioned though I would've loved more onions, that's just me lol.

We have eaten at FreeByrd many of times.  It's actually one of my favorite spots to go to for a great chicken sandwich here in Philly.

I got the Freebyrd Sandwich Alabama White BBQ and as per usual the sandwich was filled with the usual crunchy yet juicy chicken.  Deliciously seasoned chicken that just can't be denied.  The addition of the pickles gives it that bit of extra saltiness.  The BBQ sauce is not required, but a great addition that gives it a little bit of kick.  As far as the portion of bread to chicken...if I had to choose, I'd always have more chicken then bread (hence, a "chicken sandwich").  I still thought this sandwich to have a good portion of bread to chicken ratio.  This sandwich is a must try.

My girlfriend got the Nash-Vegas Honey Hot Chicken Sandwich.  We thought it needed more chicken for sure.  But, still the sandwich is exceptional especially given the fact that it is a grilled chicken sandwich.

@breeeeezy_sbd
It's really good it's not bad budget plastic forks because your forks dropped on the floor

I had Sweet Lucy's catered for a baby shower. The food was amazing. We had brisket, pulled pork, hot dogs, Mac and cheese, coleslaw, potatoes, rice, and cream spinach, and Mac and cheese. The person who delivered was on time. The price was reasonable. If I need catering again will definitely order again.

Met up with a friend of mine a week ago for dinner.  She picked this spot and it's only about ten minutes from my house, which was great!
I know, I know....why have I never been here before?  I have no idea.  Well maybe I do know.  BBQ sauce doesn't do it for me.  Yes I know most people can't understand that, but it's the truth. 
So.....when you walk in you have to place an order and then sit. They bring your food to the table when it's ready.  You also have to get your drinks yourself l.  I prefer to have a waitress but this wasn't bad at all.
It was easy to order and the person taking the orders was super helpful with questions about the menu and how things were cooked (if they were already in sauce, etc).
I decided on the sliced brisket. I ordered it with corn grits, Mac and cheese and a side salad.  I picked corn bread too.
I liked everything but the Mac and cheese.  Oh I ate it (lol) but it didn't have the real cheese flavor I love.  
It was a lot of food!
My friend ordered the chicken and ribs platter.  I tasted the chicken and it was very good!
Over all it was a good dinner in a large and very clean restaurant!  
Oh and I will go back for more brisket!

Omg! Today was our first time having Sweet Lucy's and did not disappoint! Still licking my chops, ordered chicken bbq platter and beef brisket platter sandwiches with sides, Mac & cheese, tomato & cucumber, cornbread, coleslaw, spicy corn on the cob!!!!! Which is to die for, every single thing was absolutely delicious! Will definitely order again!! . One exception I will order more corn on the cob haha

Went here for lunch today and I feel like I have been derelict In my duty.  Meaning here I am trying to tell the general public about excellent places they should try and having one right under my nose that I myself hadn't tried until today!

We tried this place at lunch and i'm glad we drove over even though we could've done door dash. The inside looks jawsome and I can't wait to come back off hours. 

We're planning to do a happy hour. 

I got the pulled pork meal. It was so good. Corn bread of course. Slaw, beans and the Mac. They have multiple sauces of course. It's not a million like famous Dave's. 

This review is making me hungry.

After nearly 10 years on Yelp, I finally found the food item which is prompting my first review, and it so happens to be in this establishment located completely across the country from where I live. As background, I live in Los Angeles, but my daughter attended a tennis camp in the Tampa area.  While in town to drop her off on June 25, I was determined to have a Cubano sandwich. It was the one food item I was looking forward to eating while in Florida.  Without doing any research, I bought a sandwich from a shop near the hotel where I was staying--it was quite disappointing (I imagine in the same way people are disappointed when going to LA and having bad tacos). 

I was determined to try again, so the following day, I did a little Yelp research and settled on this place--Caribbean Twist, approximately 10-minutes from where I was staying.  When I arrived, the place was clean, bright and staff was friendly, but alas, this is about the sandwich. The Cubano sandwich I ordered was the best and most comforting sandwich I've ever had! I ordered it to go, but I did not leave the parking lot without finishing it. The sandwich was so good, I didn't want to do it a disservice by eating it while driving. The sandwich was ordered "con todo" (meaning "with everything") and it was perfect. It's not often that I have to call someone half-way through a meal to tell them about it, but I had to call my wife for this one. She stayed back in L.A. but I promised her I would bring her when we came back together to pick up our daughter. I'm not sure if these pictures will quite do the sandwich justice. I could wax poetic and go one about how the pork was moist (carnitas style), the pickles were crisp, the ham was fresh, but you get the idea--it was simply put, the best sandwich I've ever had.
The Best Steak Sandwich and there also Big you will definitely get full with a Whole one. I Recommend it 100% go get you a Steak Sandwich. There customer service is On point.

I must leave a review. It was that good. 
The food had incredible flavor and it was obviously very fresh. 
I called to ask a question and the woman was so sweet, kind, and patient with me; I really appreciate that.
I ordered door dash. I had no issues; The food was hot.
Usually delivery results in bad quality but not here!
The food is very good, the staff is also very nice and helpful. Huge portions especially for the price. We love eating here.

Wanted Caribbean food but just got tired of the redundant Jamaican restaurant menus so I decided to try this place since it was highly rated. I called in my order but the lady who answered, I don't think she spoke very much English, she responded " WHAT ? " . It came across very rude but a nice gentleman came to her rescue and took my order . He was very pleasant and professional so I proceeded with my order. Got there , picked up my order , tried a few other items since the food was so nicely displayed. Everyone was very nice and the establishment was very clean. Well, I got home and hubby and I ate, babbbbby they deserve all 5 Stars cause this food was very well seasoned and cooked to perfection. These are the items I tried on my 1st visit : salmon , black rice with beans, baked chicken , yellow rice , plantains , beef empanada and Cuban corn bread. I highly recommend it all! I'm not cooking tomorrow ,  I'm going back just to try other items. Did I mention the prices are reasonable and the serving sizes are enough for two people.

I've never had a bad experience coming here. This location is close to home and convenient. They always have BOGO for their rewards members and given they are so close we go there often. My typical order is the meatloaf with corn and cream spinach. But that was until I discovered their Nashville hot chicken!!  This stuff is absolutely delicious. So tender and just plain good. Now I get mine with the hot sauce on the side. I am not a fan of the hot sauce. It has a funky taste and just too hot for me. So I order and use Chick Fil A's Buffalo sauce (shhhh) lol. Soo good!!!

I ordered curbside takeout (well she brought my food out as I had dog in car). The following day I sent my daughter to pick up.  The manager (a male) told someone not to charge for a portion of fries as the previous day I did not rec. them.  My daughter thanked him but when she got home I saw the receipt. I wouldnt normally let fried bother me but considering their a sep order plus they usually taste good I was disappointed to eat a frie-less burger meal.

I liked my burger so much I ordered another two meals the next day (yea I know); even though I was missing a portion of fries.  The manager told a girl not to charge me for fries the following day, but guess what? Yep she charged me again..
Overpriced for mediocre good food!! Simple as that, besides that enjoyed the place and customer service was great cause she was able to handle me n my wild sister

I tagged in on a friend's selection only to be surprised at what I missed in his order. Needless to say I could not eat it as prepared. The staff was so understanding and accommodating. The food was wonderful especially while sitting outside in the shade.

Definitely has one of the best gluten free burgers in the area but have not had the best carry out experience with them. Last time we ordered just a traditional Monger burger and requested extra sauce on it. Instead they gave us a plain burger with no sauce at all. This was the third time something like this happened ordering carry out. The food is good but recommend that you order in person instead of online!

Last night we decided to try out some food to go from Mulligans, because I have a craving for fish an chips.

We ordered: 
Fish and chips 
Buffalo chicken wrap with tater tots 
Chicken tenders with French fries

The food wasn't bad, but it wasn't mind blowing either, and unfortunately it did not satisfy my craving, because although the beer batter was good, the actual fish didn't taste seasoned. 

My fiancé said that the Buffalo chicken wrap was pretty standard, but the fries were underwhelming. 

The chicken tenders were good. 

Serving over the phone was excellent and the food was prepared promptly. 

I know they feature specials most nights and free pool when spending more than $5. Perhaps we will give this place another go, since it's 10 minutes from where we live.

It's decent at best. There are so many better options. I ordered the orange chicken with house fried rice. The rice wasn't bad but the chicken was over cooked and tough to eat. I will add the sauce was good but that doesn't matter when you are given tough chicken. The price is fair but I wouldn't recommend if there are other options around the area way better. Beware.

I am usually hesitant to try Chinese food restaurants but I was staying at the hotel next door. I ordered a safe dish: sweet and sour chicken. It was good! Their fried rice is a little different than I am accustomed to but it was good. I recommend them.

This is my favorite Philly Pretzel Factory and I'll tell you why.  BECAUSE IT HAS A DRIVE THRU! 
When I'm out running errands, I just want to keep moving and getting stuff done so this location, if I'm up this way, is great!  
The employees are always friendly and the pretzels are always fresh and hot!
I picked up heart shaped pretzels this past Sunday for my nieces and nephew and they were thrilled!
Best sushi in Philadelphia! Staff is always pleasant. Sushi is affordable and fresh. Always consistent, never disappoints!
Ordered the sushi platter - was pretty good for the price.  The fish was definitely fresh and I loved the garden salad and miso.  Can't wit to try to tempura and chirashi bowl.
They are good but every time I order the same thing they always make it different. Which kind of like gmm

Old review warning: I came here while on vacation a over a year ago with some friends for brunch. I immediately loved the homey, country vibe, and I was sold as soon as I saw that they had biscuits and gravy. Everything about our experience was really solid. The biscuits and gravy were done very well with sturdy but tender biscuits and a well-seasoned gravy. There were plenty of chunks of sausage too. My husband enjoyed it as well, and he grew up with a mom who made it all the time. My friends really enjoyed their huevos rancheros and breakfast burrito. They also said the coffee was great. Our waiter was great, and the atmosphere really made us feel like we were at a friend's house rather than in the middle of Philly. While the food wasn't groundbreaking, everything was reliably good, and I would love to come back.

Kudos to yelp for recommending highly Honey's Sit N Eat. I'm so glad to be here and the environment is so pretty. Quite impressed with their menu, lots of great options, Country Fried Steak and Two Eggs Your Way was absolutely great. Wonderful afternoon and the staff is fantastic! It truly was a great experience.

Came here with the boys expecting a buzz and some decent food. What we got: a solid buzz and some dank shpuzz. Elle hooked us up with the danks and was super personable and she deserves a promotion (no commotion). She was polite and and The food was perfectly prepared. The margs were made with a delicious tequila and the perfect amount of wahwahweewow. The buzz paired with the shpuzz was enough for me to ask where we was.

My friend and I had a nice dinner here a few weeks ago but was pretty upset after realizing the next day I had tipped over 20% after they added a 20% gratuity to my bill. The 20% gratuity was added (according to their website which I checked the next day) because of the circumstances of serving during covid. However, as a fellow server, I'm pretty upset about this because the added gratuity was not transparent at all (I was given a paper menu that had no mention of the 20% gratuity) and none of the servers or restaurant seemed to be affected by covid. I was dining after all mask restrictions had been dropped in philly.... no server while I dined was wearing a mask and there was no time requirement on the tables...so I wasn't anticipating this extra charge since it felt like I was dining in a pre-covid atmosphere. I believe this place was taking advantage of customers who were receiving a bill after they already had a few drinks. I left a really nice tip and am in favor of added gratuity but only when it is transparent and in special circumstances. I felt ripped off by this place and wish I had thoroughly checked the bill before leaving a really nice tip for 3 white males. So the servers ended up getting a 45% tip from me.

Tio Flores has a great vibe. The place is on the smaller side, but between the community tables and the bar area, they can pack in a good number of people.  Due to Covid, they also have set up a nice outdoor seating area. Inside, only parties of 3 or more are seated at their own table or booth. The restaurant tends to fill up, so either make a reservation or get their on the earlier side.  

My only gripe is that they've started adding an automatic 20% tip into the bill (regardless of party size) and including taxes in their calculation. 
 
On this visit, we went with the Chicken Enchiladas and the Quesadilla. Both items were really good. The portion sizes are average, so you don't feel overstuffed. However, if you are a big eater, you may be left for wanting more. 

As far as tacos, the Lentil and Cauliflower, Chicken Gringa, and Pork Carnitas are the best!  The Lentil and Cauliflower are surprisingly good!  Way too many restaurants end up "butchering" vegetarian options, but Tio Flores got this one right.  

My husband has also ordered the Tio's Big Burrito.  A word of caution on the Burrito that after adding Pork and Cowboy beans a $11 burrito can end up costing $17.  And despite the name "Big Burrito," their burritos are small, but do come with a little salad.

If I could leave no stars that would be my selection. This place literally charged me $2.50 for sour cream and $2.50 for Pico De Gallo.Additionally they charged me a 20% tip that I was unaware of, even though I picked up my order . The taco shells were card board. Simply put, don't waste your money on this place - Horrible experience... ..

First off I am shocked this place adds 22% gratuity to you bill regardless of your table size. They write 20% on bill but they include taxes in their calculation!!

The food was not good at all. The chicken inside the enchilada is extremely bland. The burrito is salty and tasteless. I hate to say this but chipotle is better than this place by a longshot in terms of food quality only.

The one good side that the atmosphere is good, especially the outdoor area. Consider this place for drinks but definitely not for any meal.

Love this place!!!  This is always a must stop anytime we are near the Tampa area.  Great food and great service.  Have never had a bad meal here whether it be an appetizer, main course or dessert. Definitely make multiple trips here during vacation. Forgot to take pictures of our food but the drunken shrimp is amazing along with the mandarin grouper and key lime pie.
Food was good, once someone took our order and it finally arrived.  Lots of wait staff yet.... Very disorganized.  Wait staff all young, showing midriff but not very efficient. Really missing Holly.
Since I was in the area and had time to kill I decided to treat myself to lunch.  220 is a nice little place with outdoor seating.  The staff is pleasant and the food is ok.
Friendly and attentive staff, live music was good. Ordered the fried fish tacos with black beans and rice. Everything was hot and tasty and menu appears to be well executed.

Perfect massaman curry with pork. The rice was served in the shape of a heart along with a small salad topped with a purple flower! For dessert: sharing the fried banana delight, including coconut ice cream and whipped cream, is simply very nice.

This is my favorite Thai restaurant in Tampa.  But something has changed over the past 2 months.  The service is awesome, but the quality of the food and specifically the red pork has not matched their previous excellent quality.

I will still come here but I'll be monitoring the quality.   I had the steamed dumplings which are normally awesome, but tonight it was not served warm enough.  For the entree, I had the Penang Curry with Red Pork.   The pork was tough.   Other than that it was good.

Love this place and I hope they return to their historic high quality!

Wow! My husband and I are in Tampa for work and we're craving Thai food. Staff was so friendly, the interior was beautifully and authentically designed and the food was excellent! I've spent a few months in Thailand and this brought back so many memories. Delicious. We will be back next time we are in Tampa.

I'm glad I came across this place. The anterior is so beautiful and service was amazing!! I was looking for a place that serve Thai food and close to campus and this was it. They have lunch specials and they come with soup which is chicken rice soup and that was alright. They also have spring roll fried and that was good. We also had their tom kha soup and I would give it 3/5. I have definitely had better. However their meals were good. We had drunken noodles and pad see eww.
