The thing that bothered me was the pico that came with the food. It looked like there was mold on the tomatoes and smelled funky. I let the staff know and was given another one that also looked moldy. Probably not a good idea to have the salsas just sitting out on the counter at room temp. My guess is the whole batch was bad. Don't think we'll be back.

Literally the worst taco I have ever had.  It's chicken soup/stew on a taco leaking everywhere.  Was expecting grilled chicken.  This isn't a taco.  I'm not sure who thinks this is a taco but it's disgusting.  Literally fell apart all over the place because oh I don't know, maybe you're not supposed to put soup on a taco.

Today I was craving some Jimmy John's....my favorite place for sub sandwiches! It was a great experience...clean and Covid-practices in place! Steven and the rest of the staff were all helpful and nice! My sandwich was the best part! So fresh and delicious! Craving satisfied

I order here at least once a week. Best Chinese. They have amazing pizza rolls, sweet and sour chicken, chow ho fun and scallion pancake! Quick and friendly service! 

Recommend it!
Best wonton soup around. Quick delivery that never takes more than 30 minutes even when it says much longer. My go-to for Chinese delivery in south philly!
The food is nice and hot everything taste homemade nothing in a can grease was old one time but other than that it's great customer service
Great food, friendly owners, clean environment, I enjoyed the Turkey wings, cabbage and string beans

Love their TUNA MAC!! So good I just wish it came in a bigger container lol and the muffins are really good too, turkey wings were a little dry to my liking but I will definitely give this place another try!

Used to have these hoagies at work when a coworker brought in the trays.  In the neighborhood  and stopped in for a American Hoagie on a seeded roll and it was as fresh and delicious as I remembered.  I also got the potato salad and macaroni salad.  The best!  Happy to support a family business - especially one that I saw today give a big discount to the local firehouse.  I'll be back!

This place is a gem and always awesome . I just realized they are delivering now which I was so used to picking up didn't know.  The quality is amazing and there prices are unbeatable you get such an amazing portion for such a fair price. This place is and has always been a neighborhood gem and now with all this covid stuff has steeped up for its  patrons. Try there stuff if you haven't and order more to support a local business that truly shows it patrons what a small business should be.

Forget about any other hoagie place. I am 80 years old, lifetime Philly resident, have tried them all. Fink's is NUMBER ONE! He was harassed recently by the city bureaucracy and shut down for a couple days for his staff allegedly not wearing masks, even though Fink's surveillance cameras proved that his workers were all wearing masks when the inspector was there. She obviously had a personal axe to grind. That aside, this place rocks!!! The hoagies are so fresh and tasty. Homemade potato salad and macaroni salad are the BEST! And how they keep the prices so low is a miracle. Who else has delicious hoagies packed with great edibles for $6.48? It is unbelievable! On top of that, owner Dennis Fink is a warm, big-hearted guy, and his son, who works there, is a chip off the old block. And if you are having a party, you have to get their "A Taste of Philly!" A ton of divine food for $7 a person! That's not a misprint. Are you kidding me? And they deliver 7 days a week. What more do you want?  No matter what it takes, go to Fink's or have it delivered. You will be glad you did!

I came out here for a lovely girl's night out with one of my friends at work. I have never been here before, but it has been on my bucket list for the longest time since its first opened for many reasons. Looking over the menu, it has alot of southern faves (fried chicken) with a chic twist (those bowls that have lately been all the rage) so i knew it would have alot to offer any taste. Sooo....today was a cheat day...meaning no bars hold on what I could get to indulge in...but despite of that, i couldn't take my eyes away from their #1 salad with ahi tuna. First off, on my cheat day, i dont do salads, second, unless its Panera, i really dont do salads...period. However, i REALLY love ahi, and the description sounded so fresh and tantalizing, that i just couldnt resist the urge to try it. So i went for it. I had the grilled artichokes as my app, because again, it's not sonething i see often on a menu. Of course, i eas eyeballing the keylime pie before i even got my app ordered. The artichokes were delicious with a nice crisp to them. I really enjoyed digging into the hearts and dipping it into the sauce. When my salad, i was pleased for two reasons, 1) it wasnt a voluminous mass of lettuce with some toppings sprinkled on as dinner salads tend to be and 2) it was nicely plated, a small mound of the salad that had avocado, carrot, and lightly dressed with mango. Of course, i dove into the ahi first. Fresh and delicate in taste, i will never go back to canned. The salad itself had a nice light flavor to it, which was refreshing too from the mango. I took my keylime pie home to go and ravished it immediately upon arriving. It had this nice tart creamy flavor which was balanced by the whipped cream. I normally dont finish the crust, but their crust was airy in texture and went great with the rest of the whipped cream.

The once awesome chicken sandwich has now been replaced by a pathetic disappointment in its place. The chicken itself is now a long thin cut (almost like a cutlet) which is panko breaded ... it's awful & seems mismatched with the slaw/pickles. It's way too thin & the texture is mediocre at best. Thank god we have a local Shake Shack now, so go there instead cause the Doc B's updated version is now just overpriced crap

Ok... I can't give a review of the food since we just had drinks but the drinks we had were mighty tasty!

My friends and I had lunch at another establishment at IP and we felt like hanging out some more so we headed over to Doc B's. The great thing about Doc's is that it is kind of quiet and understated and has great cocktails.

We had the Crazy Beautiful (martini glass) Paloma (middle tall glass) and the International Affair (short glass.) Mine was the International Affair, I figured since I had been having tequila all afternoon that I should stick with it. 

I definitely want to go back another time and try some of the food too because my friend says they have a good menu.

decided to give this restaurant a try after the menu looked appealing. my boyfriend had a burger and thought it was pretty good. my house margarita was also tasty. however, i ordered the chicken parmesan and was very disappointed. i guess this is what i get for ordering a pasta dish at a burger joint? the sauce was horrible and pasta was not cooked properly. the service was fine, didn't love being sat by the kitchen though.

I don't always write reviews, but when I do, it's because i either had a really good experience, or a really bad one. Doc B's was one of the best dining experiences we had while visiting Orlando and Tampa, INCLUDING Disney world. Me and my family had eaten out for over a week strait, had some mediocre food and terrible service that entire week. Eating out gets old after a while. We were at Dinosaur world with a 6,7 and 8 year old on June 21 and just wanted something more fresh, so we did some googling and came across Doc B's. THANK YOU. Our server was so cute, her name was jasmine, she had glasses and long hair, she was the best. She had a smile on her face the whole time, was super good with the kids and checked on us frequently, which is more than I can say for the servers at most of the restaurants at Disney world. The food was delicious, fresh, bathrooms were clean and it was a nice, quiet place for 2 tired moms to just sit with their kids for a minute and relax and not be treated like we were an inconvenience. The desserts were outstanding and if you like key lime pie, I HIGHLY recommend theirs. If I was a Tampa local, this would be my go to restaurant. Thank you for amazing service and amazing food!

The order was delivered on time. The pizza and the salad came in the same hot Box so the salad was warm and the pizza was not hot. The salad was ordered with no olives, but there were plenty there. The heat made the whole salad smell like olives, so that became a throw-away for me. Then I got to the pizza. Large pizza, 8 slices. But when I grab a slice, it falls apart in little pieces because they are not slices, but little squares. Advertised as slices, photos show slices, but little squares. Like I haven't seen since 5th grade. Then I taste it. Toppings are good, crust is fair, and the sauce is red. I say red, because I could see red. I don't know if it was tomato sauce,  because it had no taste. This may be the most bland sauce I ever had. Two stars because it COULD have been worse.
The food was amazing! & so delicious :) We drove about 50 minutes to try it and it was very worth it! Not only was the food fresh, hot and well prepared but the customer service was amazing as well!

Terrible service. We went on a Sunday afternoon for the first time and noticed one of the guys who works in the truck was smoking right where the customers were waiting. We waited more than 45 minutes for our orders tostones con carne frita y chicharrones de pollo. I asked the lady working there the estimated time for the orders to be done and she said to wait 10 more minutes. After that I asked again and the order was not done and the 3 people working in the truck were arguing about all the orders. Right after Another guy brought back his order and said the meat was frozen.  We left I will never eat there.  I would have given 0 stars but it does not allow me.
Acabamos de comer aqui y nos encanto!!!! Se Los recomiendo. El mofongo con carne frita estaba riquisimo. 10/10!!!
I had mofongo and carne fritas! I had wait over 20 min sue the orders were hectic but it was worth the wait! The chef was very nice. I also tried alcapurria it was awesome!!!
Sid Booker Shrimp at 2/3 the price. Shrimp are big.  Service is a little slow at peak hours, but have  a Red Stripe while you wait.

Excellent sandwiches! Awesome service! This was our first time here and the staff, Victoria and Alexa were very pleasant and helpful. The Cuban was fantastic and the Full Montagu was delicious as well! Highly recommend both!! Enjoy :)

We eat mostly at the one at
Downtown Disney springs. That one is very impersonal.This location ,however does a great job on quality and the staff is very personable. The manager was very friendly.

We visited here on a Thursday, I haven't been here in a few years. Our server was not the most timely, she may have felt a little overwhelmed, but nice lady.. 
The food took a while to come. The chicken wings were really good, I didn't take a picture of them. My friend enjoyed her chicken sandwich,  she said it was juicy and well seasoned. The roasted Brussel sprouts were good, a little to much salt for my taste, but to the point that I couldn't eat them. 

I would visit again.

I've come here twice for brunch so far and both experiences have been solid. They don't take reservations on weekends and both times, the wait wasn't long at all. Also, the brunch hours are really generous given that one of the times I went was at a time of the day that most would consider after lunchtime.

The brunch menu is pretty standard in a nice, predictable way. I split an order of huevos rancheros and creme brulee French toast. The guac on the huevos rancheros was fresh and the creme brulee French toast was as amazing as the description on the menu.

Overall, a solid go-to Manayunk brunch spot with an equally solid looking lunch and dinner menu

Such great food! My family and I ordered the truffle fries and the wings to go. They might be the best wings I've ever had ;) Although the truffle weren't really hot, they were still so very delicious. Would highly recommend and will definitely be back.

I've been to Winnie's in Manayunk a few times. After today. I am left wondering about their practices after I received 3 different explanations about their their gratuity policy after it was automatically added to my check. 

The owner stated that all vendors on the block agreed to add gratuity to all checks above 75, manager said the add was up to the server, the server said it was policy of the owner.  Interesting this did not happen in prior visits with checks above 75 dollars. 

I fully support the service staff particularly pre, during and almost post pandemic. 

Is there an agreement amongst  restaurant owners to automatically add gratuity to checks or is there a criteria for selecting those who receive automatic gratuity?

Tried this on a whim because we wanted to grab something on our way out of the city. Staff was good, not super friendly but we weren't waiting around for much either. Food was good and came out pretty quickly. Nothing earth shattering, just a good spot to grab a quick breakfast if you're in the area.

This restaurant charged our credit card twice.  The first was the actual charge for our food, but the second charge was for a different amount and was made on a day we did not order anything from them. When we called to resolve the issue, we were told that since they had the receipt of the 2nd order (the one we did not place), they stated that they would not refund our money.  After explaining that we could prove that we couldn't have mad the purchase, as we were at an appointment, they still refused to issue a refund.  I would warn anyone against using their credit card at this restaurant.

First time staying at the embassy and definitely will be the last. When you hear that name you hear luxury and there was nothing luxury about. The customer service is horrible , house keeping is horrible, I understand its a pandemic  but the basic necessities were hard to get like tissue and towels. We barely could get bags for trash.  Then there is construction everywhere, the guess should not have been on those floors at all. The bed rooms is freezing cold, we even turned the air off in our room. The ice machines were out , vending machines out and then you want to charge 5 dollars a day for wifi !!!! I was over it, the rooms didn't even look like the picture .

This Embassy Suites in Tampa is currently remodeling.  They are under construction and had I known that before I made my reservation I probably would not have made the reservation.  I am so glad I didn't know, because this was one of the best stays that I have had in a very long time.  To start, my check in was seamless.  I was concerned because they told me when I arrived that all of the rooms they had left were next to construction areas.  As it turns out, I was next to two rooms which were being renovated.  I must have lucked out, because all the time I was there they didn't work on the rooms next to me at all.

Here are all the reason why I loved my stay.  1) Hot breakfast... sometimes the lines were long, but the lines moved quickly and they had bacon almost every day.  2) Manager's reception happy hour... every day they had a happy hour where you could get up to two drinks complementary.  I only took advantage of this once, but it was still a nice touch. 3) The room is was in was recently renovated... new carpet, decorations, a nice sized TV, VERY CLEAN, etc. When it comes to cleanliness my expectations are high and this hotel did not disappoint 4) Front desk staff... they were tentative to my needs and requests.  

So 5 stars for this Embassy Suites.  I travel a great deal and this stay was the most memorable in a good way.

Well customer service has been sub par to say the least. They charged $12 a day for parking and they are doing construction all over the hotel. Breakfast is in a box and the free social hour is a 2 drink minimum and no snacks....... So yeah not the excellent embassy suites that we use to all know and love. And you might say well it's covid. Yeah but covid is over and everyone has gotten there shots. An employee told me that all this changed after they reopened. So you might think that maybe they were hurt during covid and trying to recoup some cash, good point. But if they are hurting so bad why are they spending all the cash to remodel the place. All I can say is that I use to search out embassy suites for three reasons above and beyond service, excellent breakfast with omelets, and free drinks for happy hour. Well if you take that away they really don't stand out anymore. Good luck to them but that is the last dime I will spend at the embassy suites ever!!!

I booked this hotel because I know it's been in the Westshore area for many years. I wasn't aware of the construction they're undergoing but I can imagine it'll be nice once finished. 
I had a slight issue with our room but the staff was super quick to address and provide a solution and for that I was happy and grateful. 
I would stay here again and would urge others to do so as well. It's in a great location and it's close to shopping, dining and the major highways.

My 2 year old found a syringe in our room, the smoke alarm was taped to the wall and fell on my husbands face as we walked through the doorway, and the broken drawer fell on my 2 year olds foot, and our landlines in the room had no service. There was old gum on the doorway and human feces on the back of the bathroom door. I would never recommend this location or any embassy's unless you are ok with your family being in danger just for a hotel. After all this we couldn't even take a hot shower as the drains were clogged. At the hotel the front manager threatened to call the cops on me for being upset and said he had done all he could do by refunding 2/3 nights. It wasn't until we spoke to Jason after leaving that he refunded the rest and gave us 10,000 hilton honors points (what a slap in the face for a ruined vacation). My husband is a  disabled veteran and this is the treatment he received at an embassy's suites. We were told "you can go somewhere else" on a Friday with two toddlers, grandma, and a dog, 9 hours from home. The person doing construction (our room was across from construction with plastic tarps all around them) couldn't understand a single word I asked him when I asked about the smoke alarm. You can see theirs anchors for the screws in the wall but they weren't in the holes and the smoke alarm itself had double tape on it. He couldn't speak the word work or manager, yet embassy says their smoke alarms that are taped to the wall with double sided tape are up to code. Save your money and stay somewhere that cares about the safety of their paying customers. You can't just put a sticker on a door and call it clean, they're super worried about wearing a mask but don't even clean the rooms your staying in.

The best Thai food in the University City area. Dine in or take out. Service is friendly. 

Amazing pad thai, drunken noodle, and basil fried rice. would highly recommend. loved the food here.

My favorite Thai restaurant in Philly. Their food was delicious. Their Thai curry was very popular. My favorite dishes are Pad Thai and basil fried rice.

I recommend this place to everyone who wants to try Thai food.

I've been ordering food from Pattaya since 2012 and the quality has remained the same! Their Pad See Ew is my favorite dish followed by their green, red, and penang curries. Always delicious, packed well for delivery, and made hot & fresh. Pattaya is my go to Thai restaurant in Philly!

Came here for a friend's birthday in December 2019 and food was pretty good. Not super familiar with Thai cuisine or how the food typically tastes, but I thought that everything order (which is more than what is pictured) was fine. Service was a bit slow but was understandable since we were a decently sized party.

Pattaya is our favorite go-to local place for takeout Thai food. Their prices are pretty good, and they regularly send out promotional discount codes to their email list. The fried tofu appetizer is reliably delicious, and our other regular vegetarian picks are drunken noodles, any of the curries, pad se ew, and pineapple or basil fried rice (and they are always happy to omit egg to make things vegan!). I've never been very impressed with their pad thai, but have rarely been disappointed by anything else. Pattaya is definitely the most reliable, yummy, and affordable Thai food I have found in the area!

It's a perfect place to take out-of-town visitors, which is exactly what I did. It's a short walk from home, and reservations are easy to make online. 

For those still easing back into public life after the pandemic, this is a great option. It's well-spaced, and it's outdoors with a nice breeze off the water. My guests loved the pier and the galleries and the garden.

Ordering is easy using the QR code at your table. The menu is simple, but just about anyone can find something to order. There's lemonade if you're not drinking alcohol, and there are decent pretzels if you've got a vegan who wants a snack with their drink. 

Staff are friendly and keep up well. Orders come quickly even on a busy night. I've been twice now, and I'm sure I'll be back again.

They do have to close up when the weather is bad--that happened to us. So keep an eye on the forecast and have a back up plan if there's a chance of bad weather.
Super cool area at the end of cherry street pier. You can't beat the unique location and view. Ordering system is super easy and convenient with QR code.
Had a great breakfast today. Divorced Eggs Carnitas were cooked very well and the tres leches French toast was really good! Good service and outdoor seating. Definitely go if in the area.

Miles Table is our go-to for ordering breakfast and lunch!  They have the fluffiest eggs around. Home fries are great. Divorced eggs is delicious. El Guapo is amazing as well. Service is top notch - they handle multiple customers with kindness and a smile. And they brew La Colombe coffee and lattes!!!!  Vibe is upbeat, good music...I usually leave in a better mood than when I arrive. Thanks for the years of service!

They completely adhered to all COVID restrictions / precautions throughout the pandemic.  They also created a larger outdoor seating area as well.

Delicious! So fast! We have gotten several items...Blueberry Pancakes (Great) The burgers are HUUUUUGE...and so delicious! I got the Divorced eggs...It was also VERY GOOD!!! We will come back time and time again... Love how tasty and interesting the food is and the staff is very friendly.

One of the best prepared breakfasts our family has enjoyed in years.  The omelette was filled with tasty crisp bacon and cheese, the over easy eggs were perfectly cooked, the breakfast potatoes were well seasoned and flavorful, and the French toast was picture perfect and tasted even better.  My husband was tempted by the grilled cheese and was thrilled with the delicious and savory sandwich he received.  The Americanas were smooth and hot.  A wonderful option for a delicious breakfast/brunch.

I came here to meet some friends for brunch and all I'm going to say is this was one of the best Turkey burgers I've had in the city!!! Love the space it's like a farm to table feel. 8/10 would def recommend visiting for Brunch. It's also kid friendly.

Came here on 4th of July and I was really surprised at the lack of turn out and service. There is no table service at this time and it took the bartender a while to acknowledge although the place was empty. And I have been to Fat Tuesday's pre-Covid where we were standing shoulder to shoulder. I hope they bounce back fast from the pandemic because they need it!
The electric lemonade was so good! It definitely helped me cool off on the 99 degree day! Much needed!

Nice selection of flavors available. The drinks aren't weak at all but still taste good. Service was quick and pleasant. Nice spot to pick up some drinks especially during the warmer months to cool off!
Stopped for a drink on May 6th, 2021. The server in the picture had a very nasty attitude. She's in the wrong line of work.

2 stars for customer service onlwhich was seemingly decent. 

I had not 1 but 2 weak drinks! The drinks are to go only so you can't be inside with your drinks.

I want to start off by saying I felt ripped off. A cheap styrofoam cup with a weak drink just makes it even worse. All they had were daiquiris and nothing else from the drink menu was available. I had an entire 16oz drink and didn't even feel the slightest bit of a buzz. My picture of a Fat Tuesday drink was not Instagram worthy. 

Such a disappointment! I won't be coming back here until they fully open.

I would not give this store any rating if I could.
I ordered 2 subs 1 pizza and 1 ham and cheese and they screwed the pizza sub up then I called and the little punk that was working there wanted to argue with me that he did not make the wrong food. As well as his phone skills using words such as yep and uh huh this little bastard needs to learn some manners.
Upon Arrival at the store he still wanted to argue with me after I showed up with both subs to prove he made one incorrectly.

The manager who is a girl at the time was not of any help as she wanted to argue as well
This event happened on Friday February 5th around 9:30 to 10 pm

These 2 should be fired as they both have no people skills and apparently can't even make a sub correctly.

Horrible customer service and just plain rude
I took a video that I will be posting on social media

First time trying it, got the Tom Kha, Thai iced tea, and Love Boat. The love boat was delicious, beef tasted like it was cooked with 5 spice in a nice rich broth with rice noodles. Loved it. Thai iced teas were perfect. But... the Tom kha was inedible. It was by far the most sour Tom kha I've ever had, to the point it made my eyes water. Also it tasted like they used WAY too much fish sauce, it was super salty and the only aftertaste there is... we will try to eat it later with added unsalted broth or coconut milk. 

Still gave 4 stars because the inside was cute and clean, and everything else tasted really good so I'll definitely try them again in the future
Best Thai spot in Philadelphia and it's right near my house.  Offers legit 'Thai hot' option.

Absolutely delicious! I ordered steamed dumplings, Tom Yum Soup (Shrimp), Green Curry (Shrimp), and a Iced Thai Tea!! Got all of it within 20 minutes hot and ready to eat! Fair warning, the spice level is REAL! I ordered my curry medium spice and it was very very spice for someone who's easing her way into spicier foods. So if you're sensitive to spice definitely go on the mild side, or if you're really into spice go for the spicy! The only cons are I only got like 4 pieces of shrimp in my curry, but honestly it would've been fine with absolutely no protein with how flavorful and yummy it was! And personally like the taste of the tea overpowering the coconut mild in a Thai tea and it was a bit more on the milkier side, but still overall a must try place!

The duck tacos were pretty unremarkable, barely any meat and could really only taste the sauce and the flour tortilla. The khao soi was ok but I wouldn't order either of those dishes again. I like that the menu has different options than standard pad thai and would be open to trying more.
delicious, DELICIOUS authentic Thai food!! great customer service!!  A very comfy and sweet environment and experience :)

I wanted to say thank you again for a great lunch and your server was impeccable. I love coming there for lunch or dinner. I feel at home there. My soup and salad lunch was yummy and the potato and bacon soup was soooo good ! I just got back from the  doctor and was not feeling well, and that lunch hit the spot. 
I was just under the weather, then after lunch, I felt better and was ready to take on the day. Please keep being a great restaurant....you guys are my fave spot !
Your servers need a big thank you for always being such good people.

Terrible service! Really useless group of people here - waited so long for the drinks we left before they even showed up... it got too late and it just made sense to give up and go to bed. Def wont waste my time here again, certainly not my money :)

The waitress was a amazing and patient. She took our order and memorized it. She was very helpful and knowledgeable about food allergens. Great atmosphere and fun. This is a must visit for a bite to eat.

This was a great choice. We started with cheese and bacon fries. The appetizer was huge and delicious. Next burgers and salad both were vey fresh large and served appropriately. Our server was quick and accurate.
Great food, slow service. If you order thru Uber Eats or other delivery service, better to add at least 30 minutes to anticipated times, even when ordering hours ahead.
Awesome place. Great breakfast. Got Steak Egg and Cheese with everything and it was so delicious. Friendly owners. Would return and definitely recommend :)

Bagels are fine. However, the service is absolutely abysmal. Ordered 4 bagels, two were outright wrong, and they forgot to make another. When I went to get my correct order, it took 15 minutes and the two new bagels were STILL wrong. I tried a third time, and the order was still wrong, and not even close. Instead of a turkey bacon/egg white/cheese it was egg/cream cheese/onions. How??? After the third time, we gave up. Won't be coming back, a simple order took us over an hour. Extremely frustrating.

They re-opened and were closed at 10 am on a Saturday morning. No sign on their door or anything. Their website says 7am to 3pm or until sold out. If you sell out by 10 am on a Saturday morning you don't know how to run a bagel shop.

I just had a really awful experience at this location of spread. When I visited this location today, the wait was over 30 minutes to get my food and when I finally received my order it was not right and missing a whole sandwich. Clearly this location is mismanaged and unprepared. It is unfair to the staff to have to deal with the stress of not being prepared.
My go-to diner! The food is so good, and there's a nice atmosphere. I order from Pennrose from Uber eats frequently as well and the food is always still hot when I get it.

This place is a classic diner! I don't know how we've been Philly residents for such a long time without visiting this staple! Penrose was packed, full tables, and amazing food! The portions were a nice size and the service was great, even with it being particularly full! Coffees and waters were constantly filled, and we were checked up on frequently. This was the first time we came here, but as I always say about places we enjoy, this won't be the last visit! In the mood for brunch, and some great food, head over to Penrose Diner.

One of the best larger diners in the city: quality food, quick service (once you're seated), and homey, south philly family vibes from all the workers. Very packed on Sundays, so expect a wait or at least 15 if you're a party or under 4, and longer if otherwise. 
I got the steak and eggs- steak was meh, diner quality but for the price (20$) not too shabby. Eggs were cooked perfect, and there was a heaping serving of home fries. Will return for brunch again another day!! But, will probably stick to an omelette.

What a great place!  We showed up for brunch on a Saturday and the parking lot was packed and the line was to the door. However we still were seated within 10 minutes!  There operation was a well oiled machine!  Our waitress was very friendly and accommodating to our picky selections. The food came out quick and it was great!  Would highly recommend.

I ate there twice on my Philadelphia trip and both times it did not disappoint. Get ready to eat because their portions are HUGE. Their omelettes are to die for! I had the greek on letter feta and egg whites and my friend had the Tuscan and both tasted insane and so large that the omelette barely fit on its plate. They came served with a mountain of crispy home potatoes and bread. Get the French fries, just do it. The French onion soup was slurp worthy and was so flavorful and had tons of melty bubbly cheese. Their Greek salad with added chicken was ginormous and honestly one of the best I've sampled in a long time. I'd go back just for that. And my friend's burger...so good that I'm not gonna lie...I was a bit jealous I didn't order it for myself. You must try their gin drink special made with pineapple. It's refreshing and went down way too easily. Come with an appetite because the portions are super duper big. Penrose Diner is an old school dinner dishing out home cooked goodness that just hits the spot! I had took away one star because we asked for separate checks both times but the waitress forgot and it was a cluster  trying to get the cashier to split the check into 4.

This was a really cute chill spot for dessert and bubble tea. I took a few of my out of town friends here on a "walking tour" in the city. I really liked how each seating area is a bit sectioned off so you can have some privacy. 

Once we arrived we were immediately seated and we ordered through their website on our phones. That was pretty convenient since we could browse, select our choices and pay separately. More restaurants need to do this!!

They had a lot of optioned to choose from. I ended up selecting the molten lava cake with vanilla ice cream. It was pretty good but if I come back, I'd definitely choose a crepe cake my my friends did!
I haven't gone to a Price Tea House yet I didn't love! Super cuteee location, the service really good and all very yummy!
Loved it! Good food and great atmosphere  Everything was delicious and the servers are very polite and kind. The strawberry parfait is great!
Beautiful interiors, delicious food and excellent staff. They went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of and our dietary needs were met. Perfect place to share a memorable experience.

I hit the jackpot when I stumbled across this tea house.  For the last few years I've been looking for a teahouse that gives you a high tea experience without all the unnecessary pomp and pageantry. You can make it that way à la cart or you can have a simple enjoyable tea experience. Today I went with the latter. Earlier I had lunch elsewhere but really wanted to wind down with tea and dessert in a different atmosphere. So...... I went to Yelp to search for a 'tea house' there were several however the photos of the interior was the deal maker. Thanks YELPERS!

Of course parking is at a premium but I lucked out. Inside it's a beautiful as I expected. Lovely high backed wall booth seating covered in purple velvet/velour with modern day Louis XVI dining chairs. All very comfortable, clean and in good condition. Throughout practically each seating area has its own chandelier lighting. Because of Covid the booth seating was separated by partitions, the top is made of slate chalkboard with messages written and the bottom wood. Very creative.

On to the experience. I was given a polite greeting, temperature check and seated. The experience of the tea and food was very pleasant. I loved the Lemongrass, Ginger, Carrot tea very refreshing no honey or sugar needed. As for dessert I went with the  Trio Combo; Green Tea Financier was surprisingly very good they were warm and moist, the goma creme brûlée is different not weird but not special and the red bean ice cream had slight freeze burn, but during COVID it's a small matter.

The overall experience was good, I was quite pleased. However the staff could be a little more attentive I googled a lot of unfamiliar items. They lingered at the front counter. Last but serious issue, my tea cup was chipped this is unsightly and somewhat dangerous. Nevertheless I will return and soon!

Ordered the Frizwit for delivery. I am admittedly not a huge cheesesteak person, but the thought of "frizzled ends" intrigued me. I thought they would be the beef equivalent of al pastor tacos - thin and crispy meat. What was actually delivered was more like hot roast beef. The whole sandwich was wet with what seemed like gravy, and the meat was soft. The beer cheese was  overwhelming. Overall I was pretty disappointed and didn't think it was worth the price or the hype. We did get the hummus and laffa though, which was fantastic. I'd consider a pork with hummus platter next time, but would not do the steak again.

I just tried their signature cheesesteak, the Frizwit, which they are currently offering for pickup and delivery. This thing is unlike any other cheesesteak I've had in the city. They advertise it as being a higher quality version of the cheesesteak, and this is 100% accurate! They source their steak from Primal Supply Meats, the hoagie roll is from Merzbacher's bakery, and they make their own beer cheese sauce (since it's a "wit" it's got fried onions too). You can definitely taste the quality. And the beer cheese sauce tastes almost like fondue. It's incredible! It's hard to compare this to the other typical cheesesteak joints, but it's definitely a must-try.

Musi & Frizwit are outstanding and unique in everything they do. Top 3 cheesesteak (and my personal favorite) in the world. Top 3 pork sandwich (and my personal favorite) anywhere in the galaxy. A sourdough biscuit breakfast sandwich that will warm your soul with spicy, savory greens. The team at Musi always brings a fresh take to the foods you already love and elevate the dish to something new, exciting, and absolutely delicious.

This review is specific for Frizwit, which is a popup within Musi. Take out only. They take a spin on the classic Philly staples. I think of their offerings as a gourmet offering of the cheesesteak and roast pork sandwich. Ingredients are local and fresh and you can really taste the difference. It's on the higher side in terms of price, but you are paying for the quality and I think its well worth it.

They obviously make their hours. They zipped tied  the doors. We went to get gas and get something to eat. But lucky us these assholes decided whatever hours they want. Wawa's apparently make their own hours. 

They don't enforce any safety measure nor prevent shop lifting.

Early this morning, experienced some really uncomfortable and racist comments from the girl at the checkout. Was a bystander during altercation between the employee and another customer. The staff member continued to repeat the comment "Black people don't know how to act" "I'd rather serve white people." This employee, we didn't catch her name but she made Wawa look bad last night.
Awesome spot for brunch! Great happy hour and the buffalo cauliflower is bomb!!! Not to mention the amazing bartenders
Love Cask, this is my go to brunch spot. Waiters are always nice and helpful. The chicken and waffles is what I always get. For a few hours on Sunday they have a DJ who place hip hop

I have had my eye on this place for over a year and finally since our vacation plans got postponed due to Tropical Storm Elsa, my husband and I decided to come check this place out. We made a reservation but this is like any popular brunch place where if you show up right before they open or when they're starting to open it's much easier to get a seat. Within about 20 minutes of opening it starts to get packed. I really liked the Ambiance of the restaurant and you can sit indoors or Outdoors which is nice. The restaurant isn't in the prettiest part of Tampa soho but it's still pretty nice neighborhood if you want to sit outside and enjoy the view while you eat. We came here for brunch and luckily they have a good variety in their menu so if you're on the healthy side or on the more adventurous side or on the more simple side this is a great place for pretty much any type of appetite. I have been craving some good, buttermilk pancakes for months now and I decided to get it. Their pancakes made my eyes roll in the back of my head and wrong with happiness. I felt that good flavor but I do wish that they gave the powdered sugar with it as pictured and some more fruit. My husband. They're brunch Burger. I had a bite and it was very well flavored and delicious. We also split the candied bacon jar. It wasn't bad but definitely not something that exceeded my expectations. We also did there mimosa bottles which was nice because you can get two different types of juices and a bottle of champagne. Overall I thought this place was amazing which is why I'm giving it 5 stars and I definitely plan on coming back here for brunch and I would conceive this one of my top brunch spots in Tampa. My husband and I would also like to come back one day to check them out for dinner. Definitely a great restaurant to visit if you're in Tampa Soho.
Food was awesome. The hostess was great. Our waitress was very attentive and friendly. The mimosas was the great. We will be back.

Atmosphere is great. Food was sub par and rather flavorless. For $20 a person for "bottomless mimosas" aka orange juice with a splash of champagne. Offered to sell us additional champagne to make it stronger?

The servers in this this bar are the worst in Tampa. They think their Baywatch material. Not even close! The bartenders under pour to most guest and over pours to the regular misguided Carrollwood crowd that goes there! 

The bartenders do not know how to mix drinks and the turnover rate on the help reflects this. Training 101 is need for their lack of customer service. 

Food is way over priced and comes out cold for sitting in the kitchen too long. On top of no parking and a poor manager who needs to remember who pays for their lights to go on. 

Skip this place and do your self a favor by telling others its another one and done like every bar that's been in that location.

Their pizza brought me back to my childhood eating at the late, great Windy City, and their wings are also excellent. I no longer live in Tampa or I would eat there all the time; as it is it's already a must-visit whenever I'm in town.

If I would make one suggestion it would be to expand their pizza menu and make Windy City's pan pizzas and garlic knots as well! 

Update: still love this place. The pizza is still fantastic and the wings have gotten even better - their new homemade buffalo and green acre sauces are the best I've had from them. Would give them six stars if I could.
Great wings here, best in town in my opinion. But they are a little pricey at more than a dollar per wing. Get them with the Cajun rub and tossed in Buffalo. You can thank me later..

Came in to try the new Lenny's New York pizza. Yum!!! If you are a regular at Thomas P's then you are probably used to their Windy City Pizza which is cut into little squares. This one has a thicker crust and they cut it into slices like a traditional pie. I am so glad they added this option to their lineup. It is not on the menu (yet) so you will need to ask for it. We ordered half Hawaiian and half pepperoni/sausage (see picture). As usual we ordered some sides of wings with some of their new sauces. I totally forgot the names but they were delicious as well. If you like wings, ask them about their new flavors. As always, Thomas P's did not disappoint.

Great atmosphere,  however, service could be much better.  First visit, I went to the outside bar, a few seats were available. I sat down and the two bar tenders looked at me, so I waited, they weren't busy.....then they started chatting to each other.....then both left the bar area....
For some time.....I waited a few more minutes then left.  There are too many other places who do have good service.  Probably won't be back.
First time, had the beef rendang, the app fried potato with corned beef and the vegetable and shrimp rice platter. Food was great, byob is great, service was great. Would visit again!

D'jakarta Cafe is a tasty Indonesian restaurant in south Philly. I only got delivery so can't comment on the dine-in experience. The food was great, though. The beef rendang and the shrimp rollade were delicious - tender and flavorful. The djakarta noodle had a lot of fun variety, though nothing was quite as excellent as those other items. Overall made for a good couple of meals, and I'd consider ordering again.

Came here many times after first review. The food is solid and very tasty. Tried their bubur (porridge), sate ayam, and mie ijo (noodles made from veggie). Highly recommended. Reminded me of my hometown food and with covid we cannot go home
Just ordered for take out. Love their nasi ayam bakar, and Soto betawi. Just the right amount of spice, and their samba sauce is amazing.

I love and visit first watch frequently. Ordering from this new location was actually an accident. It was prepared on time and the lady at the front was nice. However, almost all my potatoes were burnt and my pancake was over cooked. The pancake could have been worse, it tasted pretty good but I can compare to previous experiences that it was left a little too long cooking. The potatoes are just pure disappointment. I don't know who packed this and thought it was actually okay to send it out. I guarantee this wouldn't have occurred if I would have dined in. & Although this location is closer to where I live, I'll continue going to the location by Wiregrass mall. Never had this issue before.

Went this morning and got the trifecta. The atmosphere was very calming. Our server Kristal was prompt at serving and taking our orders, and she stopped by several times to make sure everything was going well. Originally was going to put 4 stars because my food took a bit longer than expected to arrive but Kristal's wonderful service pushed me to give the place all 5 stars it deserves! Will 100% return in the future.

Ecstatic to have a breakfast place in New Tampa with outside seating. Die hard fan of sister location in Wesley Chapel which is a further travel.
Pros: continues the tradition of hot and tasty meals with a rotation of new items. 
Cons: after being a guest here more than half a dozen times, kitchen staff has trouble with menu add on or exceptions... small items like ketchup or a side of dressing are continually missed.  You end up waiting until your server appears again and then waiting again until they slowly return, more often than not half way through your meal. 
Suggestions: ensure staff who deliver your meal verify all is as requested on the ticket. 
Otherwise will go back to Wesley Chapel location who never miss a beat. 
Thanks

I was very upset with the customer service, bot only was she rude she was also very slow. The food was cold and I had to repeatedly asked for things we are 6 people in the family and when I asked for napkins she only brought 3. She brought the coffee without CPS we had to ask for the cups, so disappointed

Food was exceptionally delicious  I had my kids and grandkids with me. They were 1st timers to F.W. And, absolutely loved it!
Avo

Best brunch in Fitler Square - fantastic food, ambiance, and service! Everything we've tried has been great but our favorites are the breakfast sandwich with bacon, egg, and brie on a croissant, Gaulois sandwich, and Duck salad. The iced latte is also delicious and refreshing. Eat here as soon as you have a chance!

Another happy hour pre show at the Straz... wines are now $6 a glass until 6pm... Happy hour menu is the same and you can order off regular menu as well (which where I got my salad from on this visit.)

Here For a family dinner.This place is upscale and top tier.  We always have a great time here. 
The service is excellent.
Best filet in Tampa! I miss the old location but Malios is still delicious. We had the surf and turf and the bananas foster. The filet was perfect and the wedge was very nice.

We had reservations and when we got
there the host didn't even knowledge us and walked away to setup a party table. Acknowledging or saying give her a moment would've been nice. She didn't come back until 7-8mins before we were seated. Need to be more than one host to assist if one is gone for that long. The food wasn't all that great. The best thing was the lobster Mac and Cheese. So on that note I wouldn't recommend this place unless you like subpar food.
Totally recommend this if your looking for fine dining in the downtown Tampa area. I had the NY strip and it was cooked to perfection, the lobster Mac and cheese was also wonderful.
Best taco spot in the city, hands down. This has been my go to spot for a while and everyone I bring by is blown away by how good the food is.

Authentic Mexican food to fill your bellies and hearts. The place is cute and quaint and perfect for a grand Mexican breakfast! We had the huevos a la Mexicana and what a deal! So much food packed with flavor. We also loved the Huevos Rancheros (the green sauce is delicious) and don't pass up on the Quesadilla! We had cheese only and it was fantastic. If you're near Fishtown, give this family owned Mexican spot a try--you won't be disappointed! :)
This place has excellent food. The steak burrito was phenomenal.

Some of the best take out in the area

Always good and no complaints 

Steak tacos and chips and guac are the go to

Stop what you're doing. Yes, you...stop! Pancho's Cafe is IT. It's your go to Mexican joint you've been waiting for. The family owned and operated business is the real deal. Great value too! 

What we snagged;
-Enchiladas in Verde Sauce (Comes with ALL the fixings) 
-Steak Fajitas (Comes with rice, beans, guacamole, and tortilla) 

The meals were LARGE and in charge. We'll have left overs for the next day. Can't be a two for 1 meal! You gotta check this place out and make it your Mexican go to joint. 

No pictures. Was too hungry and it was so good to have to wait for its photo opt.

One of the better Vietnamese restaurants that I've been to in Tampa.  Our server (I didn't catch her name) was really sweet and offered a better lunch option than what I initially ordered which added more on my plate.  She was very attentive and checked on us a few times.  Pretty good portion sized meals.  Both our meals were packed with flavor and delicious.

Friendly atmosphere and interior is modern and clean.  It would've been 5 stars, but we got boba tea and it was the jelly, instead of boba.  Not what we ordered though.  Overall....it's a great place to eat!  We would definitely come back.

Do not go here especially for tourists, the food is not good. Service is horrible. It's noon and they are out of everything. We waited for an hour for our food and they have the guts to take 18% of tips. WILL NOT COME BACK EVER AGAIN.

A Vietnamese friend recommended this place to us and we're so glad she did! The shrimp and pork fresh rolls were outstanding. The mango salad with shrimp came with mounds of matchstick fruit and vegetables, flavorful basil and crunchy fried onions snd scallions. Unique, refreshing and delicious. We ordered the Bo Luc Lac  -- tender beef cubes sautéed with peppers snd onions -- with the fried rice. We were glad to take home leftovers! They gave us a free dessert as we left! We wandered the aisles of the bustling Asian market in the same plaza after lunch. We will definitely go back to Viet Kitchen! There are so many more dishes we want to try!
Loved the green mango salad and the caramelized fish. Ingredients tasted very fresh. I would definitely go back.

Best Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa!!! Highly recommended this place. Super friendly owner and staff and great value too. Very clean decor and the smell when you come in is great and makes you hungry. Will be coming back and telling all my friends and family to come there. Can't wait to come back for more.

Ok, I'm here from out of town, and was in need of some food and brews. I see this place is near my rental. COOL! Pics look like its a fun trendy spot to get some grub...until, I realized that was all FAKE. Place was empty at around 10pm, despite it being listed as open until 2am. Didn't see any of what the reviews and/or photos indicated. FAKE
Such a great bar where I felt at home. Large ken and the manager came out and introduced themselves, where I really felt I got to know the story behind the restaurant.  Thank you guys !

I'm so glad Westy's is back! And it's better than ever. Some of the coldest beers you could ask for and service is always impeccable. Never see staff maskless, always cleaning, washing hands. I noticed they're even using disposable cups and boxes for the food. Let me say the food is out of this world. LK's Kitchen at Westy's has taken that bar to the next level. LK (large Ken) is so passionate about this establishment making it a fun and safe environment for everyone. Ken has stocked the place with some kick ass bands and entertainment. Large Ken knows what the people want and goes above and beyond to please us customers.

Westy's is my FAVORITE bar in Philadelphia!! So happy it opened back up! It's so safe inside, staff wearing masks and tables spread apart for social distancing, overall I was very impressed with their commitment to good service! The bartenders and staff were friendly, the food was PHENOMENAL, I would recommend this place to anyone. Love Westys!!
Super clean and fun bar. They take covid seriously and even have sanitizer stations set up for all patrons to use. Great drinks and amazing food! One of the best bars in the city
The food was so bad , I ordered sandwiches that came out so bad ! I wanted to give this place a try but really bad food .

I was craving some basic comfort food recently and decided to order a grilled cheese and tomato soup from The Foodery. The order came with a pickle slice and bag of chips. Though I did need to reheat the grilled cheese in my air fryer upon arrival, it was still great and the tomato soup was perfect (and topped with a big, cheesy crouton thing!). 

I've always liked this spot and am glad to see they are still offering quality eats!
honestly one of the best cheesesteaks i have ever had. and the onion rings are unreal.

Great food and great alcohol selection. there are lots of alcohols from the philly/eastern pennsylvania region, as well from the west coast of the US. great for trying new drinks. very friendly and helpful staff.

So glad we stumbled upon this place while walking back to the hotel. It was a great way to try all different beers from all over especially PA since we were visiting. Loved it the food was good and fresh. We ended up having Turkey sandwiches with tomato bisque and meatball sliders. Would recommend if you want to try a decent beer selection along with some good food

The food and the service was horrible! My coworkers and I ordered the ribs, Mac and cheese and the candied yams. The Mac and cheese looked dry, and tasted like it was made with vinegar or the cheese was spoiled and the ribs were tough. We ordered a sweet potato cheesecake and when we opened the bag, there was no dessert. My coworker went back to the store and the rude staff said "oh we don't have that ". Instead of saying it up front when she picked up the order so she could substitute it for something else or offering to credit the order that was already paid for. Like a respectable establishment would do, they let her walk out knowing she didn't get what was already paid for. Still waiting on my refund and Will never order from here again!!!

I really wanted to like this place, but the inconsistencies are very disappointing. The fried catfish is still fantastic, but the fried chicken (which on first try was great) had absolutely no flavor, although fried well, it had no seasoning. My broccoli was over cooked with absolutely no seasoning (not even salt), not like my first 2 tries where it was lightly steamed with garlic with a hint of garlic. The string beans are over cooked with large pieces of onions . The fried whiting fish was dry with a hint of seasoning (nothing like the catfish). The rice and gravy tasted of low grade cafeteria style food. I hate to slam this place, but with the inconsistency of the menu, the only item I will buy is the fried catfish, maybe I'll try the cheese steak rolls if they ever have it available. I'm so very sorry to have to leave this review. I gave 2 stars only on the strength of the AMAZING fried catfish.

FANTASTIC FRIED CATFISH!!! My first time visiting on the behest of a neighbor, and she was correct, the fish is unbelievable. I purchased a fried catfish platter with steamed broccoli with garlic and a kiss of lemon, yum! I let my mother, whom is very hard to please, try a piece if the catfish, and all she could say while salivating was " ummmmm this is very good". I gave 4 stars because I wasn't a huge fan of the macaroni and cheese, although I saw a gentleman buy a large container of it. I told a friend of mine's about Soul Kitchen and she said her and her husband go there often. I will definitely be a repeat customer. Just WOW!
After my 3rd time ordering from here , I had to give this place a break. Mac n Cheese was overcooked and lady who was working at the front counter was too busy trying to rush me out the door

Food is good, but the service.. I tried this eatery three different times and ordered a number of their dishes. For the most part the food is pretty good, however the service is lacking. On the second occasion that I ordered, they forgot to give me the collard greens that I substituted for the fries. When I brought it to her attention she denied that they forget them. She then asked what day and time I ordered. I informed her that I knew I had to be the first person that called that day due to the place opening at noon and they took my order at 12.05pm. She then begrudgingly admitted that they forgot the greens but made no effort to reimburse me. That order was roughly $50 and am not a cheapskate but PLEASE GIVE ME WHAT I PAY FOR.

Lastly, I decided to order for my mother, girlfriend  and myself today. I mentioned the greens again before I ordered and was completely ignored (oh well). I placed another order. It came to $55.09. She really gave me back 4 dollars and .91cents in change. I believe that this is  my last time coming here...
Consistently the best for decades. The pan fried dumplings are the best in the world. Neighborhood staple that will always be my fave

Surprisingly good takeout. My usual go to was closed for the holiday, but I was craving some American Chinese. They specialize in Sichuan, so I was a bit nervous since I was mostly skipping that portion of the menu. I got Spring Rolls, Creamy Jumbo Walnut Shrimp, General Tao's Chicken, House Lo Mein, and figured I throw in one Sichuan specialty for good measure, Dan Dan Noodles.

I was quite a fan of how it turned out. 1st- Portions are huge, 2nd - I loved that they separated the creamy walnut sauce and Dan Dan sauce for takeout so everything didn't get soggy. 

Each sauce was so good The Dan Dan Noodles had the right amount of oil and spice, the creamy sauce for the shrimp had the right amount of sweetness, and the general tao's sauce was awesome. My only complaint is the general tao's chicken had a bit too much breading

I've been so tired of lackluster Dan Dan noodles living on the Main Line. These were not just "la" but "mala." The Szechuan peppercorns were numbing allowing the extreme heat from the peppers to easily slide through the lips. Not TOO oily (people need to understand chili oil is essential to this cuisine.) The shredded beef with long peppers was brilliantly "feathered" with cornstarch making the tough but flavorful round tender with the classic texture only the Chinese seem to be able to achieve.  Portions were enormous, especially for the price. Dan Dans would easily serve three as an app. I took 2/3 home, as I'm stuffed. Waitstaff spoke fluent English (which  was lucky, as they didn't understand a word of my less-than-fluent Mandarin. Masks/shields worn by staff (and many Asian customers.) It was quite crowded at 7:30 on this July 4th. They were very nice accommodating me as a single.

We visited this restaurant when we traveled to Philadelphia for a ling weekend. It is a very authentic Szechuan restaurant. As good as some of the best places in Chengdu. I strongly recommend E Mei if you like Szechuan cuisine.

This is a great place!! Food was on point for when you're in a mood something spicy and oily. We got the beef with long horn peppers which had a great kick and flavor - would order again! The beef and tripe in chili oil was pretty good but I think if I had a choice I would just get the tripe and skip the beef. Dan Dan noodles were a little too oily and noodles were soggy... probably won't get again the next time. Be prepared to be drinking a lot of water with your meal as it is definitely spicy!

i love their street style dishes:
o Szechuan smoke belly with garlic shoot (4.8*). this is my must have with rice or beer.
o Fish Fillet with Pepper Corn (4.8*) .  This is healthy and not greasy liked the infamous "water boil fish" and still give you the numb and the kick. :)
o appetizers: sliced pork belly with chill oil. (4.8*) or Beef Tripe, if you are from E Mei.
 
they serve brown rice that is tasty (not too earthy tone) and firm.

the Steamed Sliced Pork Belly with Chinese Pickle is nice.  the texture is nice a buttery.  the taste has a different the soy sauce taste than what I have in Chengdu (3.8*)
Portions were terrible and all the food is old. Refused to let me wait for fresh rice and meat. Especially since they increased the prices. Will not be back to this location.
Worst chipotle I've ever been to.  Employees are awful.  Literally nothing positive to say.  If there were one closer to me, I'd choose Taco Bell over this location every time, and that's just sad.

I will continue to say this about this specific establishment over and over - this is the most incompetent chipotle facility I have ever in my life gone to. Constantly running out of food, have workers left and right playing with their thumbs not knowing wtf to do and now saying no to customers who want a quesadilla because "it's too inconvenient and only offered online" - a bunch of clowns work here

The delivery driver gave us the wrong pizza at first.  Ok, no big deal...I chased his car to the corner and exchanged it for the right one.  Sorry to the next guy for poking around in your pizza.  

The pizza itself was greasy as hell and overall pretty basic.  I would not recommend.

Not a fancy pizza place at all - it's not Angelo's or pitruco BUT it's delicious. 

The crust is very thin with lots of flavor, the sauce is tasty, and ultimately, the pizza is super satisfying and yummy. For me the best part is the ultra thin crust. 

If you're looking for an affordable, classic old school pizza spot, this is it.

Caesar salad was fresh however I must say I was a little disappointed to see they use powder Parmesan cheese instead of real shredded cheese. $10 for lettuce & cucumbers... I added onions & removed the tomatoes- no protein was added.

My husband on the other hand LOVES the Greek salad (they add carrots - not really my twist).
Really good pizza! We had ordered with extra cheese and sauce and they definitely delivered on that. Delivery arrived earlier than expected--good quality pizza! Also the pizzas are HUGE :)
Live the regular and biggie cheesesteaks ( esp wiz Chez, peppers and onions).  We love love getting pickup and delivery from here!!!!
If this MC dont stop giving me pork ima taking them to the court when I always order cheese burgers

Seafood is fresh and high quality with an Asian flair. Crawfish and pork sausage is made in-house and is an absolute MUST. Do not leave this place without ordering at least one. Grouper bites are light and crispy, not heavy and oily like at some other places in the area. This place is a hidden gem.

Oh my gosh this is a hidden gem!! Howie is so kind, and I'm so grateful to have delicious fresh seafood in the neighborhood. Picked up a pound of king crab and half a pound of Key West shrimp for Mother's Day and he steamed it while I waited- with Old Bay! The price was very fair and the food was yummy. I'll for sure be back!

I cannot say enough good things about Heights Seafood. To begin with, we called for takeout near their closing time, but the owner told us come on down anyway - a rarity these days. 

We were planning to grab some Poke, but when we arrived the owner (Howie) mentioned he had scallops Panang on special... yes please. While the scallops were cooking, he showed us the variety of oysters he had in stock, and we decided to have a dozen from Maine.

The scallops were cooked perfectly, and the flavor was sublime.  The oysters were also fantastic, and we downed those in a flash. We took away some conch fritters (reminded me of the islands, they were that good) and fish spread to nosh on at home. 

We sat at the bar while we ate, and chatted with Howie the entire time. Not only was his food on point, but he was a nice gentleman to boot. 

His selection of fish was diverse, i rarely see triple tail in a market.  The fish was clearly very fresh, and the prices were on parity with market. Next time we go I'm planning to buy some snapper to cook at home.

I highly recommend you check out Heights Seafood, whether you're looking for fish to take away, or dining in. Kudos.
First time here and food was just as expected. We had the lobster roll and conch fritters. Next time it will be the grouper!
Best seafood in Seminole Heights!  Howie (owner) is a super rad dude always getting some of the best quality seafood in house. Poke bowls are always on point as well. This place smacks serious ass
So disappointed in the food here! I had high hopes because the concept is cute but the food is trash. I hate to be the one to leave a terrible review but it was not worth it. Don't waste your money.
Don't waste your time, we got there to eat 45 min before they closed and the woman ran to the door to lock it before we could open it.

My husband and I love tacos but they have to be at least close to being authentic; like the ones we get when we spend time in Mexico. 

Most of the time we just get tacos from the places in South Florida close to where we live that cater to the Mexican community (or when we go to Mexico) but in the Tampa Bay area it seems everyone loves or recommends Taco Bus. We've come over the years with friends and remember good times but now we were recently back and to be honest I wasn't loving the tacos. 

All the tacos were really stuffed and my husband and i ordered a variety to share but the main problem was all the grease that came out after we started to eat each one. Tasty at first but that oily grease gets to you and didn't want much but I did enjoy the chips and the bean dip was decent enough. 

I will say I was really liking the people working here though. I remember the guy cleaning up the tables asked to refill our soda.

First of all the food is good... when they remember to put all items on your order.  (Mine clearly said on the order, and receipt,  that I requested sour cream... got  none.  I guess I could live with that.)  

Try contacting them.  Good freaking luck.  

Our order was delivered and the chips were RANCID.  I called 20 times.  Got hung up on and then no answer.  I was only trying to tell them to stop sending these out.  

I will research to find the owner/franchisee and relay this.  And then I would fire whomever felt customer service was last.
4 stars bc the bathroom was locked but the food was bomb. street corn was good and churros  it was bussin

My family and I found this establishment online. and of course, we are all for supporting Black businesses. It was a hot day, thus we requested indoor seating, however, outdoor seating was clean and beautifully decorated. The interior did not disappoint. Clean and tasteful decor! The staff were very personable, and helpful with dish recommendations. The food was DELISH!, with generous portions. And the music was on point. A definite must when in Philly!

We stopped by for brunch before we left and man I wish I could re-eat my meal 1000000x because it was so good. We started off with the Mango Mimosas by the pitcher and an order of the Hot Chicken sliders. These blew my mind! I almost canceled my real order just to order 5 more of these because they were so tasty. But instead we got the breakfast burrito and veggie omelette adding bacon to it. Both were great, delicious choices. Everything was so good!!! The aesthetics, music, food, drinks, service 12/10! And this spot is black owned! Definitely will be coming back to this spot anytime I am in the area. The also sell chicken and waffles and French toast as I know those are popular dishes as well. Indoor and outdoor seating available.

This place is so lovely. I have two gripes so I'll start there. 1. It's often very dark on the side where the kitchen is, 2. It's super loud on the other side. (Though that is a subjective complaint as I just had a baby and am often in quiet environments) Otherwise this place is great and they make awesome food! This is a Black owned establishment which is why I chose to visit in the first place and I have not been disappointed. I've been twice so far. The first time I had the Mango salmon, Thai Chili wings, and the Jawn drink which was yummy. I also had the deviled eggs and my love had the Jerk Oxtails which I didn't believe could be good but I sampled his and it was delicious! The second time we went, the drink special which was a gin cocktail (don't recall the name) and it was awesome, I had two! I also tried the calamari which was smoky but good and the Short ribs which was amazing! I loved the mashed potatoes and haricot beans as well! My love had a Hennessy cocktail which I sampled and didn't like but I don't care for Hennessy anyway so there's that. I have a five month old and each time we've come, they've accommodated him well with a high chair and put us on the quieter side. They also have outside seating. Lovely staff and superb service which was the icing on the cake! Oh the cake!!! Don't let me forget the carrot cake that I can never get a pic of before I devour it. Had it twice, loved it both times!! Can't wait to go back!

Had brunch on a weekday. Sat at the bar. Ordered the fried cheese curds, deviled eggs, Thai wings, hot chicken sliders, and a short stack. This meal was for me and my friend. Every dish was delicious. My favorite was the chicken sliders though don't expect them to knock your socks off heat-wise. Service was excellent. Too bad they're out in west Philly; if they were closer to Fishtown I'd be going there for breakfast often. Guess it's good for my waistline.

What a letdown.

On my neverending quest to try and support black and brown owned businesses, and after hearing constant raves, I decided to finally try Booker's.

Let me start by saying my server, who the receipt indicates was named Shiona but I'm not sure that's correct, was extremely gracious and kind.

That's the only good thing I can say about Booker's.

So it was PACKED on the Sunday afternoon I arrived, and I can understand how that can create a hectic situation. I was seated at a high-rise two top near the bar, where it took just under 20 minutes for someone to come to my table to take my order. A waitress DID, however, come to my table to take away my salt and pepper shakers for another table.

During this time my table had yet to be bussed so it was sticky, with a half-drank cup of water sitting on it.

Eventually my waitress made her way over and I ordered:

Unsweetened iced tea with lemon - $3.00
"Wisconsin Cheese Curds" - $10
"Bookers Burger" - $17
Add Bacon - $6
Beet Salad - $14

So it took 10 minutes for me to get an iced tea. No joke. After maybe 7 minutes my waitress came to tell me they were brewing it fresh. Ok. Whatever. It came shortly thereafter and it was fine. A little bitter, but then maybe after this experience so am I.

About ten minutes later my burger came out. No salad had come. No cheese curds. I said to the woman with my burger, are my appetizer and salad coming out? She seemed bewildered and said she would go check. A moment later she came out with the food that should have come out way before my burger.

I dove into the salad.

It was WARM. It had clearly been sitting in the service window of the kitchen amongst the warm dishes.

But worse than that...THE BEETS WERE RAW. The "roasted beets" as described in the menu might as well have been pulled from the ground. I could not get my fork into them!

So then I'm in the position of being the a**hole who has to send an item back. To be fair, my waitress touched one of the beets and agreed they were literally rock hard and uncooked.

I will say this about the cheese curds: they were good. Nothing spectacular, and an INSANELY SMALL PORTION for $10...but they were good.

The burger was an absolute JOKE. For $17? Are you kidding me? It was a tiny patty on a soggy bun with barely any flavor, with a tiny portion of the most basic McDonald's fries I've ever tasted. This was an $8 burger at best, and coupled with $6 bacon I paid $23 for something I could have gotten at Five Guys for $10. Total rip off in every way.

Now to just take a left turn and address something else: the music they were playing. This is a 2PM Sunday afternoon brunch at a family restaurant.

I heard the N word from that music more times than I could count. That is not my word, and I don't take ownership of it, but I find it unpleasant to listen to even a few times, let along 100 times over the course of an hour.

But it wasn't just that. To quote another song that played: "Don't be surprised boy when I buss it wide, I hypnotize you with this p*ssy, that d*ck make my soul smile."

You draw your own conclusions from here. I'm not a prude, but this is not what I want assaulting my ears at a 2PM Sunday brunch.

If I could I would ask for my money back, and rest assured I won't return. With 20% tip I feel like I threw nearly $50 in the garbage.

Great food, tacos were some of the best I have ever had. Had the Carne Asada tacos and the salsa was the perfect level of spice; very tasty. 

The tacos of Birria were well seasoned and the cheese added a lot. The Jaimica was a nice addition. 

Solid meal!

Great local spot, top notch guacamole ! I got the carne asada tacos and the chicken empanadas as well, and I loved everything . With the chaos of Covid I got take out as did a lot of other people based on the number of orders I noticed coming in, they were clearly very busy and still so friendly and the food was amazing . My new local go-to for sure!

We got takeout here and everything was delicious!  All the tortillas were home-made, the food was all cooked fresh, the sauces were authentic and wonderful!  Everything was cooked to perfection.  Even the guacamole and chips that we ate while waiting for our food was fresh, homemade chips too, and delicious. We will definitely go back.

Super friendly owner who expressed his appreciation of doing business with him. The specialty of this restaurant is the homemade tortilla. So fresh and elevate the meal. 

I had mole tacos. One serving has three tacos. One taco has one layer of tortilla so it's not too heavy, loaded with flavorful chicken mole. It has some kick but not too spicy. Highly recommended

Guacamole and chips is large enough for sharing. Churros are fresh and super crunchy.

I placed a dinner to go order for my family. The food was absolutely delicious! We loved the guacamole, burrito, nachos, tacos, and churros! I would highly recommend and will definitely be returning. Yum!

There have been a stream of Indian restaurants at this location on Krewstown Road, just off Grant, but none of them have stuck until now. Me thinks the Mayura may break that trend and hang around for a long while. The dining room is colorful, the service is friendly, if not quite polished, and the menu is South Indian with an interesting list of vegetarian and non-vegetarian choices. 

We went with appetizers of Veggies Samosas, Onion Bajhi; large bowls of Vegetable Korma and Chicken Masala, and a smaller plate of Indo Chinese Chili Chicken. A basket of Garlic Ginger Naan and supply of Basmati Rice completed the table. Of course, we ordered way too much, but after tasting everything, we were happy to bring the leftovers home. 

The Samosas were golden fried and filled with mashed potatoes and green peas. Very good. The Onion Bajhi were basically dipped and deep fried in a light flour batter, made to be complemented by an excellent sweet/tart tamarind sauce. The Korma was a load of soft veggies in a dark tan cashew mild curry reduction. The Masala was darker and spicier, while the Chili Chicken was a decent rendition of the interaction between Chinese and Indian notions of inbred meals, not as crisp as found in Tibet, but leaning on Szechuan red chili with tumeric bite from south of the border. Each was a carousel of flavor and texture that deserved a trek in the high mountains between the two nations where life is hard , yet a grand adventure. We enjoyed it all. Oh, and the Naan was great with that hint of ginger mixed with garlic. 

The only downside was the Mango Lassi, which was from a mix that was so thick that it could not be pulled through a straw, and required major dilution with water in order to get it down the gullet. 

Otherwise, Mayura was all around a strong showing with only slight fraying around the edges.
Great Indian Restaurant. Very friendly staff, great customer service. Love the food. So much variety and the food is flavorful! Will definitely come here again.

Great tasting South Indian food in NE Philly. We dined inside for lunch on a Friday. There was only one other customer. The restaurant is mostly takeout and only a couple of tables were prepped for inside dining.
We got masala dosa and idli. The food was delicious, not oily and salty like most Indian restaurants. The sambhar was a bit bland and watery for our taste. But, still good!
Prices are fair...we will be back again for sure!
Amazing food and great service. This is such delicious cuisine.....You can not go wrong coming here. The best biryani and samosa chaat in town!

If you want authentic Indian taste! Mayura is the place!!! 
I usually get the dosa's, however their Punjabi food (currys) is amazing as well. Definitely recommend

I hate to be that person to leave bad reviews but here we go... I will say the food is okay, however the management is horrible.  Do not spend your money here, there are many other vegan places in the city.  Owner frequently does not pay employees/gaslights them for wanting to be paid on time and would not be surprised if this business does not last much longer due to poor management.
I have been going here for years. I always enjoy seeing Steve that provides delicious, consistent and cost effective food. His vegan cheesesteak sandwiches are "The Best"!

An amazing local vegan place to go to have a quick bite, lunch, or dinner.

Friendly service and they serve different options for dessert, meal, or beverages.

Wow. Was recently in Philly visiting the Grandkids, and stumbled upon this joint - and although my doctor tells me I should go 'plant-based' (ie Vegan) I'm still on the fence- but this place may turn me.  Food was delicious, plentiful, and affordable.  So much so that I went back the next day, and will go back each time I'm in Philly.
