Going vegan is not my thing or my intention however if you are vegan you must try Vegan Commissary! Again me and the surplus app, I was able to get a very good we can meal at a discount. I would've never given this restaurant a second thought but now I'm reassessing how I view food.  I was quite pleased with the two hearty meals and cinnamon roll I received. 

Like everyone who left a review on Yelp the entrance can be confusing. Luckily I read up before going. As soon as you walk in boom a vestibule-kitchen but it's the waiting area to place your order or pick up your online request. With that said during Covid you may find yourself outside waiting because of the space. But it's clean and organized truly that's all you need!

I received a vegan 'meat/beef' platter (?) unless you're looking to complain, find fault or a cattle rancher you wouldn't really think twice, just eat. There was a 'bowl' of chili that was delicious, bursting with flavor and rich. Vegan or not the chili is a winner. OMG THE CINNAMON ROLL WAS DELECTABLE!

Again Vegan is not me but Vegan Commissary has a new customer. If only for the pastries or something different!
Amazing pho, noodles, and sandwiches for great prices! I have come here several times. 1 star off because I have found hair in my takeout twice.

Update: having just ate at the renowned Pho 75, I thought I would come back here to say the Pho Street is super comparable. Perhaps the noodles at Pho 75 were a little softer/less 'commercial'-feeling but I gotta tell ya, Pho Street is pretty amazing. And much more convenient.

I rarely order from Vietnamese restaurants when not traveling since I typically prefer home cooked Vietnamese food.  I should post pics of my food, lol. That said, it's unfair to my coworkers who love a culinary Adventure and there's only so much Thai or Chinese one can eat sooo went in search of some Vietnamese delivery near the hospital.  There were 2 that caught my eye but we chose this one since there was a much larger selection. Prices are higher than usual south Philly/north Philly prices but seems typical for university city area. Everything from apps, noodle dishes, rice dishes was available. As a group we tried summer rolls (good), lemon grass chicken and noodles (my coworker inhaled this), vegetarian spring rolls (burnt but tasty), vegetarian pho (delicious per coworker) and I had the pork chop rice combo (pork chop was alright, their egg quiche though was amazing!). The iced Vietnamese coffee was also delish! Delivery was super fast! So we found a solid Vietnamese restaurant in the area!
I love Pho Street. As someone who orders from here around once every 2 weeks, I can assure you it is consistently perfect. Both the pho and the summer rolls are excellent.

Can't go wrong with anything on their menu but the Pho and Bahn Mi (grilled pork hoagie) are my favorites with the vermicelli noodles in close third. The portions are so large so if you're not ridiculously hungry prepare for leftovers. We've done takeout a lot and it's always prepared on time and easy to reheat at home (for the pho mainly). Excited to continue coming here for lunch whenever back in the area for work!

The employees say they aren't serving shakes or any special drinks during random parts of the day to avoid doing the small amount of work more than a soft drink. It's never consistent and different employees give different answers, some will and some won't sell it. This isn't McDonald's... it's definitely not because your ice cream machine is broken...

Customer service is horrible waiting in line for 15 mins. You pull up to order your food and don't hear from anyone for 5-10 mins. At least let people know please take a look at your order and I'll be with you shortly instead of having people guess what's going on when they have to be at work soon
Just left food so sloppy not one order right but the nuggets. And I waited 15 mins just to receive my food in the drive through.

Had a special birthday dinner at Cadence, and it was honestly very good... but not fabulous, rockin' my mind, can't wait to go back good. 

Service: Great! Pleasant, attentive (although we did have to ask for more water at one point), courses were well-paced. 5

Atmosphere: Nice. Minimalist. 4.5? 

Food: Ah... everything was... good. At the very least. Let me break it down for you: 

Must gets (5): 
* Cauliflower (Course 1): SO GOOD. Really. Perfect balance of flavors and textures. We ate it all! Made me wish the chef did more vegetarian dishes! 
* Scallops (Course 2): Cooked perfectly, fresh, delicious. Beets with scallops always FEELS like sweet-on-sweet, but it was really well done! 

Good (4): 
* Crudo (Course 1): Fresh. Nice. 
* Head-on prawns (Course 3): A little messy to eat, but they were tasty! And I liked everything else on the plate, very summery. 
* Both the strawberry sorbet and chocolate sesame ice cream (Course 4) were nice, and just a taste was perfect for ending the meal. 

Meh... (3): 
* Dumplings (Course 2): We had been reading the menu for a few weeks and were excited to try these with the seafood sauce/approach! But the dish had been changed to a pork ragu. Which was... fine. 
* Duck leg confit (Course 3): Ah. Also had been hoping to try their famous duck dish, but only duck leg was on the menu. It lacked some flavor, and the texture wasn't quite what we were hoping for. Didn't finish. 

Honestly, it may just be that we were hoping for a few of the dishes we've read about that were removed? The dinner over all was pleasant, but we won't be planning on returning to Cadence soon.

Food mediocre and overpriced. Had to pull bad tomatoes out of my very small sandwich which came with chips, not a side.  Fries came after everyone else was done eating. Friend got an au jus sandwich and had to wait 20 minutes for the au jus.    Sides extra but should be included for the price . Poor service. Place not busy but waitress not attentive.  Water never refilled. The one positive was being outdoors with friends on a beautiful evening.

Seriously one of the best meals I have had in my life, and I have had a lot of wonderful meals in many parts of the world. Look at the menu before you go and bring the appropriate wines. The place is not pretentious, so if you expect to be fawned over because you have a lot of money, go to a different place. But if you appreciate very well executed food served by knowledgeable folk, go there.
We had weekend special stuffed porcheta take out. It's very good. Will go back to try their full menu.

So we went here once before with the Tasting Collective, which was a good time but a few dishes felt off. But as this was big group event this wasn't a fair evaluation. Tonight, however, was fantastic. The prix-fix menu was a great deal, with a very good price for four courses and the perfect portion sizes. We ordered literally everything on the (admittedly limited) menu and everything was fantastic. Plus BYOB! So happy to have this place close to home!
Best Greek food I have ever had! I love this place and the owner is very nice and extremely passionate about food.

Kanella! What on earth happened?!? You used to be THE spot to get authentic Mediterranean food. My dinner tonight was cold by the time I got it home (a 5 min walk.) The lamb was straight up disgusting and dripping in grease (and cold!) It tasted like the food had been sitting out on the counter for a few hours before being served. And totally not worth the amount of money.

Please bring your take out back to the way your dine-in food used to be! Y'all are letting yourselves go!

Don't waste your money.
Super salty.
Dry.
Cant believe I spent the amount of money I did on inedible food.
I never leave reviews but had to for this.

We got the mango salad, chicken satay skewers, pancake, and tom yum soup.

Everything was so good!!! Our favorite was the pancake which was a thin soft and crispy pancake (thinner than crepes) and came with a curry dipping sauce. 

I'll definitely visit this place again the next time Im in Philly. Highly recommend!!

Best Malaysian in Philly and it's BYOB. Service is quick and food comes out fresh, hot and quick. 

Roti canai is perfect and made fresh on the spot to order. The roti relief as an egg omelette rolled up which is great as a heartier appetizer. Fried tofu would be good to skip. Mango salad was good and the wings were crispy and mild. Dumplings were average. 

Indian mee goreng and chicken rendang were standout dishes. Mango tofu was tasty but the pieces could have been cut smaller. Mammas chicken was a huge kid pleaser and sweet and mild.

We had a delicious meal here after exploring Philly! After we sat down, our server brought us glasses of water right away, which was so refreshing after a long day of walking. We tried a variety of items, including the roti, which was light and fluffy and came with a chicken and potato curry dipping sauce. The satay was amazing and the server offered us the option of having both chicken and beef skewers (a lot of restaurants don't allow you to mix and have a combo). I loved that the pad Thai which came with a mix of shrimp, chicken, and tofu (instead of just one choice). The chicken curry was good too and had a nice spicy kick to it, and the Malaysian noodles were delicious as well and had shrimp and squid mixed in. Our dishes came out really promptly and our server refilled our water glasses a number of times. We had a great table by the open windows next to the side walk!

Let me start off by saying everything my friend and I had to eat last night was delicious. The service was also outstanding! The second you take a sip of water, the waitress would come to refill it for you. I love Malaysian food, which is why I am being a bit picky. This restaurant is not my favorite and will not be my go to if I am craving Malaysian, but again, it is not bad at all. We ordered the roti canai, chicken satay, nasi lemak and hainanese chicken rice. The roti Canai was extra crispy and the curry had a nice kick to it. I loved getting bits of potatoes and beef. The chicken satay w/peanut sauce was my favorite. Very juicy and the sauce is addicting. The satay was so tender and cooked to perfection that it also tastes amazing without the peanut sauce. Nasi lemak I was a bit disappointed with. My friend and I could not taste coconut rice at all. The little sides it came with tasted good, but I've had better. I thought the chicken rice tasted way better than the chicken itself. The chicken was extremely soft and juicy. This was a great meal and the prices were just right. Very reasonable and affordable!

We went there for dinner yesterday and left very disappointed. The food was not fresh and extremely salty. The curry and chicken tasted like they were made days ago and reheated. Neither looked nor tasted appetizing. Needless to say we will not be going back.
A HIDDEN GEM!! This place was so good, all the rolls were amazing, as well as the service and our soups.

been waiting 2 hours on a NOT busy night due to this place ONLY doing take our orders for the entire time we've been here, other tables included haven't gotten any food and this place is still prioritizing all take out orders over the people actually sitting waiting to be served.. terrible plan guys

I wasn't a fan of those place, we waitress over a hour for food and kept getting told it was coming. It didn't come for a hour and 20 min. Insane. Shouldn't have to wait this long for a place, anywhere for a Galway decent meal. I wasn't happy with this place. The server could've told us the food was gonna take a while and he never did. Asking him over and over 10 min apart and he said it should be out soon. So if you have the patience to wait here for a hour + then come on in ‍

Ew. Would never return -  even if you paid me!!!!! We went last night, awful food, awful presentation, and the worst service we have had in our entire life. And we get around, haha. Even had a "manager" come over. We explained we hadn't seen our server in 35 minutes and had asked for drinks 40 min ago. When we did see her 35 min prior she told us it takes time for hot sake, ummmmmmm I've had it about 500 sakes in my life and it has never taken 40 min. I let the manager know we never saw her after she dropped our sad sushi off, never got drinks, etc. he then asked if we wanted the little dishes to mix our ginger and soy, and asked me what we wanted?????? Lol. I'm like wellllll SIR, we are letting you know what a pathetic performance of a restaurant we have experienced bc you are a manager and not sure what else to do but pack up and leave, and you ask what do we want? Our check please... She FINALLY comes back now about 45 min later and has the nerve to bring the full bill - $110 and say "so how was everything??" LOL. WHAT????? Who even are you? We haven't seen you in 45 minutes. How about sorry? She goes "I'm only human" i said so are we, when you go out do you expect not to get drinks when you ask 2x or see your server for 45 minutes? She says "I've been training someone". Hilarious. We left and said "hey good luck training, you're doing a great job". This place needs to close and everyone needs to be fired. But hey good luck to anyone that attempts to go!!!! Here's some beautiful pics of this disgrace! 
Hot tip: Go to Bernini, Columbia, BrewCo, Brass Tap, ANYWHERE but here.

We absolutely love Samurai Blue. It is one of our favorite sushi restaurants. The ambiance is great, brick with extended ceilings. Every time we go the sushi is amazing and the staff is always very kind. FYI for reservations you can call, and it has to be at least a day in advance. I recommend reservations, especially for weekends. Tonight we got the crab Rangoons, Spicy Tuna, Tokyo, Mexican, and Spontaneous Combustion rolls. The Spontaneous Combustion roll is BY FAR the best sushi roll we have had there, and we get it every time we go now. Highly recommend this place if you have not been!

Great sandwiches and super friendly staff. Definitely my go-to spot for days when I'm in the office and want a nice sandwich for lunch. The meatball sub is amazing. The bread is soft, and the sandwich always tastes fresh when I order it.

First off this restaurant is a disgrace! The restaurant on 52st in Philly is trash!!! Never again! Service is horrible. Just got our food after being here for 2hrs! Reservations were at 7:00 didn't get our food till 9:00! Food is mediocre! Fish not seasoned! Mac and cheese was nasty! It was a mess! Oh and I waitress was smoking hookah while we waited for our food to come out.The "Brunch Chef" stood in the kitchen and smoked hookah as the smoke blew back on the food being cooked. Not only did we wait 2 hours but then the waitress comes and says "they didn't tell me there is no short ribs." So 2 hours and nobody told. So 1 person didn't even eat! It was so uncouth in there! I will be dragging them on all social media platforms! On the owners as well!

I ordered on Doordash and they adjusted my order because something was out of stock which is fine but they refused to let me get something else disqualifying me for a promo and costing me more than I originally paid! Service could use an adjustment if you ask me.

And then when it got here look what $24 of food looks like! A quarter for size reference

Walk-up windows are so convenient, but they also make it so hard to resist temptation when indulgent food is so easy to get.

After a couple of delicious drinks nearby, we noticed the fried chicken window as we walked home. There was just one person waiting; how could I pass that up?

I got a sandwich, and he got popcorn chicken. My sandwich was the clear winner: tender and juicy. We sat on a bench in the tiny park across the street and enjoyed them.

Don't waste your time with the fast-food chicken sandwich wars. Just go to Redcrest.

I happen to be in Philly for a weekend visiting a friend so when I arrived we were looking for something relatively quick and good. 
Hence Redcrest fried chicken. Do yourself a favor if your looking for fried chicken - just order from here. It is great! I don't remember the last time I had chicken this tasty. It was tasty, crispy and seasoned just right. We tried the regular and spicy and both were superb. Will definitely have it again the next time I'm in town. I wish it was back here in NJ where I live. Great job guys!!!!

Their sandwiches are very good so they are not just limited to fried chicken. I've had the wings a few times and enjoy them as well. I also really like the fries and other sides. It's no-frills and takeout.
The fries chef's kiss , the chicken sandwich crispy and sooo good. I just wish the whole chicken was covered in Buffalo sauce

I don't typically love a fried chicken sandwich but ... I *loved* this fried chicken sandwich. It was our first time and I got the buttermilk sandwich and my partner got the redcrest sandwich. We split a side of Mac n cheese and hot sauce. It was all great! I can't wait to go back and try some more, especially a side of fries and a can of Barq's root beer.
Beat hoagies in Philly!!! Nothing like a old school Philly store with best Italian rolls!

I was trying to make a reservation for this restaurant, for my daughter's college graduation.   I was told to contact the person who handles that  via email, which i did. He emails me back and say i must make the reservation on line. I checked everyday from June to September no reservations. if you are not taking reservations they should have written that in the email instead of wasting my time.   will not be using or recommending this establishment for anything.

Disappointed Mom

Food and drinks we're decent for the price but our server made us feel unwelcome and rushed. He dropped the check as soon as possible and came back and grabbed the bill as soon as we were done signing it. Guess he was in a rush to leave?
Great place for food and drinks.  Met a visiting family member there on Saturday.  Enjoyed the experience.

We were going to eat lunch there today but when we went to open the door we were told they were not serving any more people.  Evidently they did not have enough staff to run the restaurant.  May as well just go bankrupt like the Colorado restaurants did.  Was going to give it another shot.  Not anymore.

Bar Louie is more open connecting to outdoor. But I do not like darker corner when you seat inside. This bar is second stop on our progressive happy hour tour. 

We started with fried calamari. The calamari is a bit tasteless because the coating is not interesting. May be make more floppy and spice with be more attractive. The second item is the chicken quesadilla. This is more interesting. But still this two item are not attractive enough in compare to nearby happy hour restaurant. However I do like the martini. Their signature martini during the happy hour is very good. I have the Diva martini. I like that one. 

I think the drink is better than the food. They really need to work on the food to attract more customers during happy hour.
Everything was cooked perfectly. Salmon was not over cooked and it had great flavor. The bread had that nice toasted bite to it. I'd definitely order this again.

Hidden Gem! The perfect menu does exist! Fresh, Fun, and flavorful. This spot is simply the best hideaway. They have an adorable courtyard dining area that makes Sunday brunch feel like a trip to a botanical garden. Service was kind and attentive. Can't wait to go back!

My usual bfast spot was closed for the week so I decided to try something new. I ordered online which was easy but delivery was Door Dash. I never use Door Dash Bc of the fees which this time included a service charge, a delivery fee, taxes and the tip was another $14 all together. Ordered scrambled eggs 2/10 very dry no flavor. Id give the Biscuits and sausage gravy 6/10 very creamy and greasy. May try again in person def not delivery.

First time eating here. Being vegan , I ordered the tofu scramble, delicious, wish I could make this as good at home! Very accommodating when I ordered a custom green smoothie which was also excellent. I will definitely be returning to this gem in Kensington!

Man, this place was great before but they've gotten much much better.  I always get the breakfast sandwich, and you can taste the quality of ingredients used.  One of the highlights of my week.  I didn't buy them (trying to watch what I eat) but today they had what looked like apple cider donuts and strawberry shortcake and it took all my willpower for the day not to buy, they looked THAT GOOD.  Service is courteous but not overbearing, friendly but not off putting and phony like so many newer businesses in the area.  The people who work there feel genuine.  They also now have a range of groceries and cool stuff like candles and succulents and lip balm and stuff if you like.  Luna is really a wonderful spot, food and service are outstanding.  I hope you like it as much as I do.

I live right by this place and I've been eating here for a while now.  I grabbed a breakfast sandwich today, and unless there was some sort of mistake, the price has gone down to a very reasonable price from what was before a somewhat prohibitive price before.  They've also added some basic groceries, mostly on the organic/local tip.  My sandwich was extraordinary, you could taste how good and fresh the ingredients are.  Outstanding.

Omg it was soo good! I finished my tacos and craved more. Seriously, try this place. A little sketchy looking on the outside but the food is soo good and the staff is really nice. We have taco's, mixed the four, two steak two chicken and a burrito. My husband said it's the best burrito he's ever had. Also, the sauces were amazing! I like the two green ones, especially one with avocado.

I stopped by Los Comparres because of its close proximity to the zoo.  It's be easy to drive by and not notice the location due.  The owner was friendly and does a great job.  I ordered the burrito which is a risk as authentic burritos I usually less tasty than tacos, but I figured it'd be easier to eat on the road.  I was impressed.  This was probably the best authentic Mexican burrito I have had.  It has a great combination of fillings and the meat was excellent.  I highly recommend.

Stranded in Tampa for a couple days and found this little gem just down from our hotel. Very reasonably priced, pleasant staff, and great food. I had the chicken taco lunch special that comes with beans, rice, lettuce, tomatoes, and a couple sauces.

The workers here are so friendly and nice. This is the best burrito I have ever had and it's only $8 for a lot of food! He brought out a variety of sauces for me to try and continued to come back and see if I needed anything and ask how the food was. They are very quick with making the food and great people!

What can we say other than just do it. My boyfriend found this place and convinced me to try it out (I'm a nervous eater - don't want to waste my time lol) BUT I am SOOO glad we did it. We are originally from Texas and this is hands down the best Mexican we have had in two years here in Tampa. We tried the chicken quesadilla (massive!), stake burrito, 4 tacos (pastor&asada) and then went back in!! To try the birria tacos and consume. I have one picture of our food half eaten and only a picture of our consume, LOL. They have great sauces - try them all. The gentleman was super nice and made us feel extremely welcomed. Try it out!

I've been walking / biking past Park Pizza for like a year and finally walked in after a random pizza craving. First thing I noticed was the cool handmade table that came with a little story about it from the owner. I can't quite remember what the story was but I know the table was made from found materials. It still looked very cool. 

 ordered two slices and the wait wasn't long. The pizza had some thick pepperoni on it with a slight charred crust with a dash of pizza grease. Just how I like it. Sometimes I'm in the mood for fancy pizza, and then I just want some quality greasy pizza.

The best part was just hearing the owners story of how he owned another pizza shop in the neighborhood that didn't work out, but he worked hard to recoup and open the current one. The pride he took in his cooking skills even at his older age was just awesome to hear and see. I'll definitely be back for some solid pizza and hopefully to hear more local stories. :-)
Tiny wings for a dollar a piece? Pizza was ok. Fries and garlic knots were not impressive.

A few months ago i left you guys a stellar review...but unfortunately things are going downhill. the last two orders you forgot my salad dressing entirely. and you're definitely not using the same sauce or cheese on the pizza again. I'm from NY and you were the closest thing to a NY pizza in west philly  But now you've switched to that flavorless mozzarellas and barely any sauce with under cooked veggies on ur pizza   You need to get back in the game or you'll lose to dock street. You got it...Bring it back...also the last time I ordered the calamari  was so legit but when I ordered the other day it was 90% banana  peppers in disguise. cold and soggy and you are literally 4 block away. I've lived in this neighborhood for 12 years and seen so many pizza joints pop up and be good for a minute. Don't compromise how you started l...That is what will keep you here.

This has been my go to since I found out about this place , the food is good but guess what I have had it up to here with these people forgetting to give you your whole order ! What is the problem ?! I ask for extra sauce for one order they don't give me any sauce for the other order . Look this is an important issue .I'm so done Park Pizza thank you it's been good but really annoying also .

It started with me having a hankering for pizza. I don't come to philly often, but when I do, I have a hard time finding quality food. We stumbled across this place and it was ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! I ordered three pizzas. Cheese, pepperoni and The Bianca pizza. The bianca pizza hands down is in the top three pizza that I've ever had in life. It was so hot, the crust was moist and the ingredients were quality! I will likely visit this place every time I come to Philly. The inside was clean. Staff were sweet. I wish I had a picture of the Bianca pizza. The pepperoni was literally amazing as well. Please try this place!

Holy moly, my new absolute favorite place for authentic Sichuan food! I tried it for the first time recently and literally called or texted whoever I knew that loved Sichuan food to tell them to stop ordering from anywhere else and try here! Service was super friendly, I told the person taking my order I wouldn't eat it for several hours and she made some great recommendations! I had the ignite noodles (like spicy Chinese spaghetti) and a stir fried pork belly dish. Wowza! Such a great taste profile, there were more complex flavors, not just spice which most other Szechuan places offer. Yes it will be super spicy, I didn't even augment the spice and glad I didn't, I don't think I could have handled it any spicier. And now I see they have a "happy hour" with tea?? I am sooo down for that!

First time here! Please do not order the Chengdu Liangfen Jelly noodles. It was so bad that I threw it out in the trash just after two bites. My friends felt the same. Utter waste of money. I was so upset that I called them to ask whats wrong with the dish to which they said "Sorry you dint like the vinegar taste, order some other flavor next time" as if I'm at fault here. Dissapointed with the lamb dry pot as well, as some of it was either overcooked(too hard) and bit into something gritty(sand like texture). The Chengdu famous ice jelly dint taste good either! Not coming back again. Really spoiled my day!!

Chengdu Famous Foods is one of my favorite Chinese restaurants in Philly, and is definitely my favorite in University City. Everything I have ordered here has been so delicious and authentic, and I am never disappointed when I come here and order something different.

The Dan Dan Noodles is the best one I've had. It was the perfect combination of sweet and savory. The Pork Belly also blew me away, and I just couldn't have enough of it.

One of the best parts of coming here is that the menu is so diverse that I don't think I'll ever be able to try everything, and anything I do try, I know will be amazing. I definitely recommend coming here if you are craving flavorful Sichuan food. 

Side note: bring cash for a 5% discount!

So delicious and authentic! My husband and I came here for dinner after a tiring day and was so pleased with the food that we had. We got the pickled veggies and fish noodle soup which was amazing, as well as a very authentic mapo tofu. We also checked in on Yelp to get a free jelly dessert. Everything was fantastic. We wish we lived in the area so we can try everything on their menu!
I am originally from Chengdu.  This place offers authentic Chengdu food.  Good choices for the entire family. We loved it!

DIG, DIG, DIG!!! All I can say is MAC AND CHEESE!!! I'm not a fan of many Mac and cheese because people will usually through some processed cheese in it like Velveeta or American cheese in it, and I can ALWAYS sniff it out and it's GROSS . Don't argue with me about it, argue with your momma .  But anyways  their Mac is to die for.  They use elbow noodles with a mix of very rich cheddar cheese. The cheese taste like they have the cows in the back, milk them, and make the cheese in house. That's how fresh and rich the cheese tastes. They put a crumb topping on top that only enhances the flavor of the Mac. 

I tried their chicken thighs and string beans. That was okay, nothing to brag about, but the MAC!!! I'm telling y'all to give it a try, especially being a girl who DOES NOT eat Mac and cheese out the house. Ask my friends, they know!!!!

Ate to go dinners here while I was in town on business for a week! Went back 3 nights in a row because the food was so good and the location was right next to my hotel, I could walk there! Food is fresh and the chicken was well seasoned! Loved it!
No frills, healthy and delicious food! But the best part is the people who work here - superior customer service!

This place is good. And good as in delicious and pretty plain. Obviously people eat here to eat healthy, convenient food and that's exactly what it is. I'm a huge fan though, always had a good meal here

Tried out this spot for a take out order that i placed online.  I was pleasantly surprised about the meal.  I went with the classic dig.  It felt healthy, but was also delicious.  It even lasted me for lunch for three days.  Day one I didn't use the garlic aioli that comes with the meal.  That was a mistake.  That stuff in the rice or on the chicken kicked it up a notch.  The broccoli was charred and seasoned well, too.  

I'd definitely recommend checking this place out if you're looking for a healthy, filling, reasonably priced (for center city) meal.

Good food: Meat tasted nice, cuts are slim, yucca fries need some seasoning, rusca potato salad was thick with mayo, paella was very good, sangria was ok.  It was a fun time, service was excellent. We had creme brulee, choch cake and tiramasu for dessert and those were amazing as well as the tequenos.

Worst service ever . !!!!!! Fui con mi familia a almorzar por el día del padre y desde que entramos el muchacho que estaba atendiendo en la puerta cuando le dijimos que no teníamos reserva nos hizo mala cara . Pasado más de 10 minutos después que nos sentamos vino la mesera a atender a la mesa de al lado y le dijo a ese mismo muchacho que trajera cubiertos también para nosotros , a lo que el respondió que la otra mesa tenía reserva y nosotros no . Mi pregunta es . Acaso en su restaurante hay prioridades? Fui mesera por muchos años y donde trabaja todos los clientes eran prioridad !

Went here for the first time to surprise a friend for his bday. And let me tell you, it was understaffed but I have no complaints. The owner/manager himself was in the kitchen throwing down and even found time to check on our table to see how everything was. Again, not a single complaint the food was amazing even after 3rds. Definitely making this place a part of my bday celebrations moving forward

If you like to eat, this is the place to go to! Best Churrasco plate I've ever eaten. It's easy accessible, and when you come in, the service and atmosphere are extremely welcome. Food is absolutely fresh and good quantities. We were a group of four; we had drinks, appetizers, main meal and dessert. So good the food. A must place to come back. You will love it!

This review is for delivery via UberEats. I've eaten at Renzo's, but that was several years ago.

Renzo's is an Argentinean steakhouse. When I last ate there, it was a fairly casual setting, but the quality of the meat was excellent.

I ordered food to be delivered between 8-8:30. The original estimated delivery time was 8:05, but around 7:45, I got a text from the Uber driver that the restaurant was running late. Ultimately, we received the food at 8:20, which was within the original delivery period, but the restaurant did cause the poor driver to sit and wait for 15 minutes, which wasn't cool on the part of the driver.

Being on a diet, we had salad as our sides. The side salad is nothing more than roughly shredded lettuce and chopped tomato. It was fine, but if you aren't on a low carb diet, I'd stick to one of the other sides.

We had the Uruguay-style short ribs and the full-sized (12 oz) picanha. The short ribs were tender and flavorful. They were cooked more rare (we were not given the choice of temperature for the short ribs). I don't mind rare meat, but my husband does, so he gave me all of his center cuts. The picanha was quite good, although pretty fatty even for picanha. I liked their chimichurri, which was oily but well-seasoned.

If I were to order again, I think I'd go with the 6oz picanha, unless I was aiming for leftovers. As it was, we're on Atkins, and the two meals were enough for dinner and then meat for two lunches afterwards.

Not as good as when I had it three years ago. The Wonton Soup was good, and I didn't order the Ribs, which I enjoyed last time. 

I did order the Sesame Chicken and Roast Pork Lo-Mein--both underwhelming. And staff not that friendly. 

China King is a better option (imo).

We love this take out, have been using them for years! Same family has been running it, with same great service and food this whole time -- have literally seen their kids grow up over the years! Highly recommend them!
Really fresh, good American-Chinese takeout. Delivery bags are always very secured and food comes pretty hot. We especially love the coconut shrimp, chicken and broccoli, and egg rolls.

Super friendly. 
Food was good. 
Had the mushroom pizza which was great. Hence the rating. 
Turkey burger. Wouldn't recommend. 
Cannoli. Was ok.
We love Zios, great pizza and entrees and always a very quick delivery. The go-to local pizza place.

Last weekend, my friend and I ordered the San Gennaro pizza, sausage and roasted peppers.   We ordered by phone.   Everything went smoothly and the pizza arrived right on time.  My friend enjoyed the pizza very much.   I unfortunately did not.   The crust was a major disappointment.   It was very soggy and undercooked.   Perhaps there was too much water in the pepper slices, or perhaps not enough time in the oven.   The toping was good, the crust (more like dough)  ruined it for me.  We had the apple salad with blue cheese and raspberry dressing.   My friend enjoyed it very much.

The food tasted pretty good, but every 10 bites or so there would be that feeling as if sand was in my food and that was not very enjoyable. The waitress was new but wasn't able to pronounce any of the menu items correctly.
Amazing! Had takeout from viva and the pizza was delicious. Definitely will order from here again

Been lagging to post a great review here!!  took out of towners ( all 100% NY Italians) to Viva for dinner. Exceeded expectations on my first visit there.....we started with calamari, cooked perfectly...great start...then pizza...impressive authentic, thin crust great sauce and toppings....I go for basic "dinner"   lets give the meatballs a try...spot on AWESOME!!  my friends had chicken marsala and scarpiello...they both enjoyed it...nice bottle of red wine, completed the evening....GO HERE!!!

Good fried calzone

The meatballs are tasty, cool spot. One of the better italianooo spots.

The fried calamari is a delectable treat from the sea gods. 

The owners are super cool and friendly. 

Go there mofos! U will be happy, except when u jump on the scale and realize that you gained some chunk to your wasteline:)

The most amazing, freshest, delicious, homemade Italian food we've ever had. Our meal consisted of calamari, fried mozzarella, coal fire pizza, gnocchi, lasagna, salad and of course the tiramisu, which the single serving was plentiful for our party of 4.

Kind of feel like I'm giving away a secret to review this place. Was searching for chicken fried steak and came up with Cheddars, but their wait was too long. The Dinner was great! Steak was well prepared with homemade gravy, fresh green beans and fine mashed potatoes. And it comes with dessert!
A must try for Tampa family restaurants!! Great service and food. Cleanest restaurant I've seen in years.
Best secret in Tampa. Everything is great every time.  I've taken a dozen people there and everyone has loved it.

This is my new favorite spot! I love it here they have everything you can think of! They make everything from scratch. Maria is the beat I hope you get her as a waitress she is the sweetest. All their staff is attentive and friendly as well. The food is like having a home cooked meal. They have everything from Greek, Spanish, southern. The chicken fried steak and their meat loaf is so yummy! The mashed potatoes are the bomb. I also love their Reuben sandwiches the crunch of the rye bread is everything. They truly are a hidden gem and with most meals the dessert is included and when the bread pudding comes out warm it is to die for! They are very clean the staff wears masks and they have plenty of parking. I highly recommend any day of the week!
The buffet is expensive but the food is not bad need little renovations just everything is out dated

A casual Persian spot that satiates my constant desire for middle eastern food, at least when I am in the University area of Tampa. 

Affordable and good quality. I got a persian tea, salad, and koobiden platter for $20!  A great deal. 

Got my standard order for a Persian place (persian tea, tomato/cucumber/onion salad, and koobiden platter). All was authentic and quite good for $20!  A great deal. Have had better Persian food but this is perfect for the price and considering what is available locally. 

SEE PICS for more detail on the food and current menu. 

The restaurant is attached to a small grocery with folks wearing many hats, so don't come here expecting 5 star service.  Would be a great take-out spot if I lived closer.

What an incredible surprise!  From the outside we didn't know what to expect but when we walked inside it was really inviting. So clean and well lit. The owner is a delightful man and very helpful. I ordered the chicken with Greek salad and shared hummus with my husband. Authentic Arabic bread warmed dipped into hummus that was lightened by olive oil was incredibly delicious. My grilled chicken kebab was like nowhere else. I will definitely return!  Don't miss this place
Amazing. Hard to find Persian food in Tampa but this place is so good. They even have a little market where you can buy GOOD basmati rice and spices

Solid. Kabobs, everything you need and more.
The area of town is lousy and need to be extra careful

Ordered a 8 oz sirloin steak with chopped salad and loaded baked potato. 
Server was friendly and salad was served before the meal with a loaf of their brown bread and butter. 
My spouse ordered the same except his steak was a 6 oz. 
My steak was undercooked slightly and yet tough to cut and eat. See the amount of gristle and stinging mess of my steak. My spouses steak was cooked according to how he ordered and wasn't tough or hard to cut. 
Management offered to bring me another steak, yet I refused because we were going to a movie and couldn't wait.

I think this is one of the nicest locations with the interior design. Recently stopped in and had the new blooming shrimp, wasn't totally a fan, leave the bloomin to the onion. Steaks were both cooked wrong, but we ate them anyways. Luckily they can never mess up the salad right? Oh but they did! Come on outback, since when do you not chop up your cucumbers???? That was a disappointment because obviously it tastes better chopped. But the bread was great!

The atmosphere is still top notch at this Outback, BUT, the food quality has declined...and I mean declined.  We started with the Blooming onion and it was so salty it nearly burnt my tongue!  Terrible!!  We all ordered a meal.  One had the chicken and rib combo.  Well, the chicken was raw, unedited and sent back.  The prime rib sandwich could have been phenomenal, BUT, again so salty...really!  The third meal was a burger and it was pretty good.  It again was way to salty..
What happened??  Just terrible food for well over $75.  We will not be returning.
The best outback I have ever been to! Very modern, friendly staff, & delicious food! What more could you ask for besides another cocktail? 100% will be coming back.

The server Mary was phenomenal-very nice, professional and accommodating.  The food however was a different story.
My husband had the Blooming Onion Chicken which was very tasty.  I ordered the New Strip steak cooked medium.  The first steak came out char broiled.  I nicely returned it.  28 minutes later, after my husband had finished his dinner, the 2nd NY strip came out-still well done and 50% grissle and fat.  I was very disappointed . However, the manager comped my steak and Mary apologized.  Not her fault, but she was wonderful.  I took it home for the dogs.  As a steakhouse, they disappointed on the steak, but service was very good and Mary was phenomenal. I may go back- we'll see.  The salad as a side was delicious.  The wine service was great-just the steak was lacking which for a "steakhouse" is sad.  Sorry to be a negative review, but I call it as I see it.  Thank you, Mary!

Hole in the wall cute Cuban food place. Excellent view. But by far the best Cuban sandwich I have ever had and the coffee gives Starbucks a run for its money. Best coffee I've ever had!!! My boyfriend who isn't a coffee drinker and doesn't like coffee at all even said this coffee was amazing! Also very good prices! 10/10
I take my mom here weekly on Fridays. Fantastic people, delicious food, always leave happy.
Charlie's has never disappointed us. I love the NY style with the puffy, yeasty crust.  The wings are cooked to order and fresh. I love the homemade lemon Italian ice!

I brought a friend who is special needs, the cook was so patient and polite when working with our order. He noticed me saying my friends name (who's non verbal) and made an extra effort to make sure he was good and liked the pizza selection. He checked in throughout the cooking time, again, making a point to acknowledge my friend and letting him know it's cooking and how good he was waiting. Food was amazing! Pizza was delicious. Best pizza I have had in a long long time. 
Due to the hot kitchen and the 100° weather, it was a bit warm inside, but the fans definitely helped. We will definitely be back! 
Thank you Charlie's pizza and wings for being all inclusive and polite to those who are different. I was very satisfied.
The best pizza in the area. HIGHLY recommend!!! I also love the lasagna. The pizza is classic NY style and I love the owners. Support small business!!
A hidden gem in Carrollwood! Family owned and operated pizza and wings are delicious.

Racist Chinese resteraunt has African American  not only pick up his food at the counter but also the food is in plastic to go containers even tho he was eating in the establishment. However,  when it comes to their fellow Chinese customers, they are served at their tablea with  proper plates and metal utensils. This is by far the worst experience that I have ever received at any resteruant.
Love my local butcher, their ground beef brisket makes the best burgers

Came in around 12:45 and they had around a 30 min wait so we grabbed some drinks and waited. About 15 mins they had a table ready for us. I was allllll excited for a nice steak but unfortunately they do not serve steak at the lunch hours. Super bummed so I went ahead with the salmon. After the food came it didn't look like much (amount wise) but it def was! I was impressed. Perfectly cooked and seasoned sooooo perfectly! We also ordered a side of Brussel sprouts. And they were definitely something to brag about! Flavorful and had a nice touch of char on the ends. All in all a good solid 5 star for this place. Just maybe think about adding steak to the lunch menu!!
The steak was delicious!! Best I've had in a while. The sides are huge! The staff was friendly. Not bad at all.
The atmosphere and food were fantastic! I will definitely go back and would recommend it to others.

Amazing customer service! The atmosphere was very positive on a Sunday for brunch. Highly recommend ordering the cucumber lime mimosa with your meal! The buffalo cauliflower and shrimp rolls were very good, but I was a little eh about the brunch plate choices. I expected more. I ordered the grain bowl but sent it back. I shared the steak and eggs with my friend and that was a much better choice. Ask for a side of honey sriracha to go with the steak and potatoes! It's made in house :)

Wow! Such a great restaurant and even better location. Amazing atmosphere and just as amazing service. The drinks are always good, and usually hit the spot. Most of the food is tasty, and most sides are sharable. A few menu items are overpriced for what you get, but overall great spot!

*accessible*
Amazing sandwiches, best pastrami I've ever had. Highly recommend. Great service also. Desserts are huge and delicious. Go now!

What can I say about Famous 4th Street that has not been said?  In my opinion it is the only Real Jewish Deli.  Forget Hymies.  I ordered an Open Faced Brisket Sandwich with Gravy on the side and Latkes.  I had the server bring a box and extra slice of Rye Bread and a container for the Gravy,  I know this bitch was going to last for 3 meals.  The Latkes are not greasy whatsoever and the Brisket is fine getting nuked for round two and three.  Again, I did not take pictures but I think their Brisket is well represented in photos.  My only complaint is the parking or lack thereof.  They bring a nice mini version of there amazing chocolate chip cookies as a parting gift.  I bought a dozen on the way out the door

My hearing impaired husband was yelled at and berated by the older female waitress. I spoke to the other waitress to be seated at a table that old hag wasnt waiting on. I would rather die than give her a tip. The young blonde waitress waited on us. I would not recommend as the staff was incredibly rude, who yells at paying customers! How dare you! And lady if you're so freaking scared of covid STAY HOME.

No better way to kick off the new year with a big brunch! Even though it seems a bit pricy, the quality AND the quantity of the food will justify it. Loved my corn beef sandwich - if you want to add cabbage etc you need to let them know, otherwise it only comes with the meat and bread.

The Culinary Adventures of Tom Coghlan

I Love Jewish Corned Beef Sandwiches. I like them on Rye Bread with Swiss Cheese and Cole Slaw! There are few places left to get House Made Jewish Corned Beef in the City. I used to go to Philadeli, on South Street past Fourth and get a seat near the window to people watch. There was no better place to people watch, back then, than on South Street! They also had a wonderful selection of beers from all over the world! Philadeli abruptly closed down and left me stranded after over twenty-five years of going there! I had tried Famous 4th Street Delicatessen around the corner on Bainbridge Street., but their Corned Beef was different back then. It was a wet Corned Beef that was good, but I liked Philadeli better. After Philadeli closed, my Brother, Kenny asked me if I wanted to go to Famous with him. I explained to him that I wasn't partial to their wet Corned Beef. He assured me that Famous returned to their original recipe, that was much like Philadelis'... It was! It was also obscenely large! Twice the size of Phiadelis', and twice the cost, but god damn it was good! Because of the enormous size of the sandwich, I now order it with double Swiss Cheese, two extra slices of Rye Bread, and a large side of Cole Slaw and make two sandwiches. I don't put the Cole Slaw on the Sandwich, because it makes the Rye Bread soggy. I eat it on the side, bite for bite with the sandwich. It comes with a pickle and a side. I get The Potato Pan Cakes with Sour Cream. They often throw in a couple of their house made cookies with my order.

So I go there to have a good time which I thought I was going to have...this dancer named ASPEN tells me she I going to give me a dance and treats me nice...ASPEN then disappeared and left me waiting for an hour...then dances next to me on the pole and tells me again she will give me a dance but then takes someone else instead right in front of me. Very unprofessional...I will never go there again and never recommend this club to anyone on this experience alone!!!
Be prepared to drop some $ but my God they make it worth it. Nothing gets you out of a bad week like these gorgeous women

Once Again bartenders stealing drinks from customers. I only came here because most places were dead during COVID but at this point I'm done. They steal money from customers so often instead of providing good service and im done with this shit place.  Pay cash and leave. FYI.

Good drinks, great service and amazing massages. I've always had a very pleasant experience. It's a good spot to catch UFC or boxing fights if you don't want to pay for PPV. There's a decent amount of good looking dancers. Unlike some spots though girls constantly walk around asking you to "pay for their dance" . I don't care for that aspect of it that's why I gave 4 stars instead of 5. If you want a fun shot the shot girl is entertaining. Definitely get a massage form Jennifer. Hands down the best of all the gentlemen clubs I've been to in Philly. 

I don't recommend the food unless you're looking for basic bar food. There's plenty of free parking outside in the lot. Entry fee varies depending on the day and if there's a special event.

Horrible DO not go to this restaurant I ordered delivery and they couldn't even get close to what I want it the only thing they actually got the right was my entree and I got no sauces, no drink , incorrect dessert it was horrible
Absolutely cool wonderful experience.   The food service environment was incredible.  Bring your wallet, You are going to need it!!

This place is ritzy as hail. I was really excited to see a bar nearly dedicated to gin. I ordered a last word and it was awesome - service was incredibly fast despite how busy it was with no sitting room on a Friday night. If craft cocktails and a beautiful atmosphere are your thing, you'll like this place. Even had some decent live music.

Went for first time New Years Eve, walking distance from Hilton Downtown. Was looking for a bar seat at a nice place that serves oysters. This is probably the most fun I've had on New Years in a restaurant. The vibe is sexy, somewhat dressy, without being pretentious. The bar is gorgeous. Incredible live music, craft drinks and delicious oysters, steak and coconut  brûlée. I made a great decision to go here, and you should too.

Went for the cocktails and stayed for the food. Every dish we had was absolutely amazing-- the ribeye, sherry chicken, shrimp and grits, short ribs, the bananas foster! Outstanding service provided by staff members joe and Aaron. Don't miss this place!

Amazing cocktails and delicious food!! I love coming here for the food and beverages but also for the atmosphere. I love the live music on weekends. The art selection is brilliant. So classy and elegant!

Was a great place to meet for happy hour. Lots of great sections. Good beers on tap.

Great place for friends.

First of all, with garage parking underneath the place, you can't lose. Across the street from the Liberty Bell, the Independence Beer Garden is in a prime location. There is a smaller, covered "outdoor area" that hosts small fire pits, a bar area and the opportunity to order via cell phone. Limited menu but so good!! ( Strongly recommend the brisket grilled cheese. Omg.) This part requires 21+ and proof of age is checked. 

There is a larger part of the Beer Garden that is covered, has a large screen TV and a host of picnic-type tables. On the tables are Jenga games....so much fun! Also has a shuffle board game where you can sip your beer and roast your friends. This larger part welcomes younger folks in your party and has tall heat lamps to keep you toast.
Personal favorite go to beer garden in the city. The apps are great and the beer selection is really good. It always a good idea to go with big group as they have the seating options.
Cute atmosphere, but service is very slow. Food comes out long before beer does. Plastic drinkware. Beer was served from draft, but was quite flat and tasted stale. Would not recommend to a friend.

Infested!!!! Went here with my sister and was so excited, the ambient lighting and greenery around the patio was great! After getting our drinks I noticed something out of the corner of my eye I noticed some movement. I looked closer and saw it was a mouse jumping around. Kinda freaked out I started to scoot away and the table behind me said oh yeah you invaded their home, we were just looking at your feet cuz they were all around your feet. We moved tables and after sitting around the corner continued to see mice. We moved one more time and continued to see more and more mice come out and scrounging around. We ended up leaving because we were so grossed out. We saw a group of at least 10 mince scurry away as we got up and left. 10/10 do not recommend.
I do not appreciate this unsettling experience at Panda Express. This is extremely poor customer service and the workers during the evening shift on the weekdays do not possess any manners or morals

My husband and I had a little "staycation" and stayed at the JW Marriott. We already had plans for the later evening, but still wanted a nice meal, so we went to Six (in the hotel). The atmosphere was really nice, we ate outside and loved the view.  Service Was attentive and friendly.

To drink we each had the "Rose colored glasses" cocktail, and then Ate shrimp ceviche, snapper crudo, crusted grouper, kale salad with grouper, and then had Sides of mushrooms and french fries. Definitely happy with all of our choices, lots of great flavor and didn't feel heavy.

I will say that we were a little confused with the layout at first, it seemed like the outside dining was more of a courtyard by the pool area and the inside dining was really close to a bar that was super loud. However, by sitting outside it felt like it was totally a different place, great ambience.  We would definitely choose them again in the future.

Pros: pretty view and a good server. The restaurant itself feels more like a courtyard Marriott than a JW but with JW prices. The menu is limited and way overpriced for the actual food. The "ceviche" was just whole shrimp in a sauce lol. Despite an empty restaurant (I understand why now), it was very troublesome to seat our group apparently. Two separate tables when the entire place was empty- which should've been our first red flag. The ambience is weird. Very bright and cafeteria like. The food was okay but certainly not good enough for the price point. Overall, would avoid. Spend your money on better food and a better dining experience. A shame because the location is amazing and could be a great place

More like 3.5 but closer to 4, than 3, so I don't want to cheat them. A group of us came here for a nice holiday dinner recently. The food is good. I had the lamp chops with potatoes, very well seasoned and the potatoes were the right texture. Our service left a bit to be desired tho, I'm not sure if our waiter was also the bartender but he went missing for large periods of time. But overall they were accommodating and didn't kick us out after closing ( please note the website says 11PM closing and they told us it's 10 or 10:30PM.) That definitely should be corrected. Despite the time confusion, they let us stay and take pictures on the patio with the city skyline in the background. The prices are a bit high, more because it's a hotel restaurant than because the atmosphere calls for it. Inside gives me casual but the prices give me higher end. Cute place overall.

We were there last night , 5 of us .made reservations for a table / couch outside . We asked if could move to another couch and they said no cause other people were coming , we were there from 6-9:30 , one of the sofas remained empty . Sad , that they couldn't accommodate us .

First of all, the views are absolutely incredible! I loved the ambience and vibe that was created. I was a little disappointed by the lunch menu, was hoping for a bit more variety. That's fine and dandy as that's owner's choice. I ordered the chicken sandwich and wasn't giving as much flavor as I hoped for. I would have to come back and try more things for a stronger review and maybe even dinner.
The drinks were delicious, they had a nice variety and looked the part.
This place can be a little confusing to get to, but all of the workers near by were super friendly in assisting. The restaurant did offer valet parking which was wonderful, especially since I had my heels on. The restaurant did validate it and I only paid $10.50. All in all, I would give this beautiful place one more shot.
Prett decent bowling alley, good atmosphere and service. If you're looking for a good night to spend  with friends, I recommend checking this place out!
Their hoagies and sandwiches are always the freshest and made to order.  The staff is the sweetest and always go the extra step even at closing time.
the hybrid cuban is the best thing you never knew you needed. takes a traditional cuban to a new level!!

I love the food no matter what location.I had the biggest devil crab in Hillsborough County lol. Man it was good the only thing is it was a little to much salt or whatever seasoning they used.But I still ate it & enjoyed it as well.

Best Cuban in Tampa hands down !!! I have had my share or Cubans lol!! None of them come close this Michelle's long time customer back when they had the food truck  , food and quality remain the same!!!

I absolutely love Chick-fil-A! The staff and food are always spot on. No complaints about that. The line is always long but what chick-Fil-a isn't?! 
I wish this business was closer to my home.

Pros
- it's chick-fil-a...still love their sweet tea
- can order through their app so it's fast and convenient when picking up

Cons
- long line in drive thru no matter what time of day 
- ordered grilled nuggets and they were way over seasoned
- they forgot the fries in our order (!!!!) so we drove back and asked for them and the guy was super skeptical. Instead of apologizing for causing an inconvenience he was so rude and hesitant about giving us the fries
Food was good but seems overpriced compared to other similar places. Shorted me grilled nuggets. Does this look like 8 pieces to you? Nope

Disgusting food, quite possibly the worst Chinese I've ever had in my life and one of the worst meals of any variety I've ever had. Lo mein is flavorless, dumplings taste like the meat is old and near expiration, and the crab rangoons most likely are entirely made of the lowest quality cream cheese money can buy.

The place is fairly bare inside but we were greeted by a gracious under 10 year old welcoming us and asking take out or stay in.
Service was good, very good menu selections and food was served hot fresh and fast.  No issues or complaints.

Ordered Calzone and threw it out. Was delivered by Uber driver with no seal on package. To many freaks out there. Package should have at least been taped shut or sealed so you can see the seal is not broken. Several people was in that Uber car.  I aint eating that not knowing if they was licking that pizza etc.  Also complained to Uber for the subpar delivery service but sealing your boxes unfortunately is a requirement these days

I love this pizza. The dough is perfectly thin yet sturdy but soft on the inside. You can eat your pizza without the crust being hard as a rock by the time you get to it. Definitely the most enjoyable dough I've found so far. I didn't trust it for a long time because a food truck and pizza don't go together in my head, but I'm glad I did. The sauce and cheese are also A1. I usually get pepperoni. As long as they don't burn the bottom this is amazing pizza. I think out of all the times I've been there (10+) I got an almost burnt bottom once.
The restaurant is located in Chinatown, and closes at the arch. The food is very good, and the place is reasonable. We often buy at this restaurant.

I would give this place a zero star if i could. After we ordered the waitress told us there would be an extra 25% extra charge for each menu item because of inflation, we wanted to get up and leave but didn't since we had already ordered. The portions were small. When we received the check, each item had an additional 35-40%! The waitress argued that she did inform us of the surcharge. We told her we will hold on to the check and that we can file a complaint with the better business bureau because they did not display the surcharge anywhere on the menu or in the establishment. When we ask to place the noodle in a to- go container, she said "why couldnt you just finish it" . We paid the full amount without leaving a tip. Now I know I should've read the reviews before coming here.
Charged for prices over what was listed on menu, ended up paying $30 over what was listed. Also didnt get what some of the menu items listed

Being very careful when ordering food from them, they will OVER-CHARGE you!

Last week I was there to order four dish, the total is $34, and they charged $40! While I asked them how they calculated, they seem to be well prepared for giving out excuse! They immediately pointed out they forgot to update the menu, and they took out another menu under table to show me that the prices are higher. 

The food is also terrible. We order Braised Beef Noodle In Chili Soup, there are literally NO BEEF just noodle with soup!

The meal was mediocre at best. The portions were quite small and on the pricey side. The price on the menu is not what was charged. The said they had a recent price increase which is not reflected in the menu. So they basically can charge whatever they want . The worst part of the meal was the customer service as noted in previous reviews. The waitress could've been a robot for all I know. Not friendly and not engaging. Will not be back.

Do not waste your time , money and energy placing an order at this restaurant location . First , if it's delivery your food will arrive cold and they will forget items you ordered and paid for( every time with no cares in the world) . The manager ( which I still hardly believe that can be a real store manager) very nasty , rude and super incompetent. Save your money and go up the street to Marcos . I foresee a store closure at this rate . I will find it very, very hard to believe if that store is still standing in a couple of months from now .
They closed down and now India owns it like they do with customer service internationally. Place is weird and dried pizza nope nope
food is good service is shit. there's this one guy, blue eyes a little too far apart he's an asshole. no people skills. also mozzarella sticks are that worth it tbh $6 for 4 sticks

My friends and I went to Eddie and Sam's pizza across the river in downtown Tampa. We were so excited to see that the sign said true New York pizza. The pizza looked great almost too good to eat. Like it was fake. Well it was. The bread was the whole slice. The cheese looked fake. And there was way too much sauce. Then my friends and I went to Mama rosas pizza and got it by the slice. Basically heaven in my mouth. This pizza is so good it's not even funny. The employees are so sweet I cannot say anything better about this pizza. Keep in mind my roommate is from New York and she doesn't put up with no bs.
i purchased half buffalo and half barbecue pizza and they ended up giving me 6 slices of pizza. don't ever go to this place in your.  .
Although it is crowded the last night, the stuffs were trying to be helpful and friendly..pizza delicious here...I recommend you stopping by and see the differences..

Too expensive. 10.00 for a double burger is insane  no combos offered. ThAts how they, elevation burger. 5 guys get you.... Buy each separately and payyyyyyy crazy money.  Soda and burger came to 13.00.  Do they think average person got it like that?  McDonalds is cheap with poor quality but.....  make your own.

Extremely unprofessional. Very rude. HORRIBLE STAFF with terrible attitudes. If you are an independent contractor (Ubereats, Doordash etc) they will refuse to give you the customer's order. They will require you to confirm your order without actually seeing the order or giving you the order.
Food was fast and hot. The burritos are nuts, especially late night. Highly recommend giving these guys a try!

We stumbled across this listing on a random Monday night when my husband and I had no interest in cooking and made this game time
Decision to order. It was everything you would expect it to be; gluttonous, cheesy and all around instagrammable. I'm not sure we'll ever stoop this low again but it was fun for a one time thing

The Culinary Adventures of Tom Coghlan

I was doing some motorcycle business in Tacony when I realized I was a bit hungry. I googled "Restaurants near me" and one Restaurant caught my attention...It was just a few blocks away...Lorenzo's Cafe Espresso Ristorante Italiano. I arrived at the BYOB Restaurant at 4741 Princeton Ave. and was seated at a small table by my server, Christina... Lorenzos has a family oriented atmosphere and it seemed like everyone who entered knew each other. They all seemed happy to see each other and the Chef and Chistina welcomed them all individually ! The Chef even pulled up a chair to one table to welcome his friends...I felt at home here. A house salad came out with a house dressing and seasoned olive oil and bread that helped prepare me to order. I started with something new to me. Eggplant Caprese, fried eggplant topped with fresh mozzarella, tomato, roasted red pepper and basil. The three slices of eggplant were breaded fried and topped with roasted red pepper, fresh mozzarella and basil. The crispness of the warm eggplant contrasted well with the chilled mozzarella, roasted pepper and tomato...The fresh basil made it wonderful ! For my main course, I chose, The Sinatra... shrimp and lump crab meat tossed with penne and a lobster cream sauce. It was WONDERFUL ! It was loaded with shrimp and the cream sauce had plenty of lobster! When desert was offered, I had to decline... I was stuffed... The next week I was in the neighborhood and I had to stop in again ! Christina remembered my name and welcomed me back ! Lorenzo's is a place I will continue to explore !

Most delicious, friendly BYOB place you could ever find!  You are made to feel like family
Huge portions.. took half home with me!  Neighborhood gemVeal Oscar

MINUS 99 OINKS ON THE WALL!!!
Food is always late, cold and bland. Often missing items. And if you ever call, good luck! Rudest SOB on the phone everytime. Hoping they shut down soon.
I'm surprised that this place only has 2 stars. Solid pizza, well priced, quick service, and one of few late night options in the area.
Blueberry pancake with a side of scrapple was great value. I enjoyed the meal very much. Good service too.

Ate breakfast here. WOW you get a fantastic meal at there best price and food in town. If your looking for great food in the market do not pass this place up. You may have to wait a few minutes to sit down but it is worth it in so many ways. If you leave hungry it odd your fault. Great team here. Everyone eating here Love it.

The blueberry pancakes were the star of our meal here. The batter is delicious and the ladies in the kitchen perfected the way they cook it so that the pancake is crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. They are really generous with the serving size.

Pros
- quick and fast service
- they offer weekday specials
- while you wait for your food they had complimentary cookies out for grabs
- very organized system of getting people seated, getting their orders and cleaning up. Super impressed with how calm and efficient the servers were despite it being very busy 
- amazing food portions and prices
- the food was so so good. Turkey melt sandwich was satisfying and blueberry pancakes did not disappoint 

Cons
- inside the reading terminal market so expect to find street parking 
- can get very crowded on the weekends 
- only offer bar type seating

Second time here-last time missed breakfast since they stopped serving around 10.  Breakfast is served until 12 now and they were busy around 9:30 on Friday.

First visit,  ordered their Homemade Apple Dumpling (featured on Food Network).   Kind of like a slice of old fashioned Apple Pie (although doesn't look like it)-flaky crust and just right cinnamon and apple filling.  Warmed up and topped with their whipped cream and this one is a must try!

Breakfast this time-they have a good amount of options with daily specials.  Ended up getting their Blueberry Pancake Special-fluffy/huge cakes filled with fresh Blueberries and came with choice of meat-bacon was just the way I like it (not crispy.)  Added the Two Egg Platter with Scrapple (also featured on Food Network.)  Although I'm not a Scrapple expert, this one was very tasty.  

Scratch made, simple and delicious food with very reasonable prices and I see why they've  received so much recognition.  From an experience perspective, it  would have been much better to eat-in but all of the counter seats were taken.  I think they stay busy as this was also the case last visit.

A very friendly & service minded lady took my order and food was ready in about 10 minutes despite being super busy.
A Food Network favorite that lives up to the hype!

Before I visited this place, one of the 70+ year old Vietnamese man that I work with told me this was the best place for Vietnamese food in Philly. I thought he was joking, but one of my friends also loved it and decided to take me there for dinner. This placed used to be a Malaysian restaurant called Sate Kampar, which closed during the COVID19 pandemic, though you can still see the old decor near the bathroom. While the menu doesn't seem extensive, they have sufficient variety for everyone. We got the shaken beef, seafood fried rice, and Thai Brussels sprouts because they were what my friend tried and loved. My favorite is definitely the shaken beef. It was so flavorful, juicy, and tender, and the veggies on the side definitely helped add some extra fresh taste to it. I liked the salted egg fried rice, but was definitely craving more ingredients, though I understand the purpose of making it a simple side dish. The Thai Brussels sprouts is also delish. It had so many flavors and textures going on with the cashews and sweet chili sauce (though I was a little upset there wasn't shredded pork jerky in it when I went).

I've been wanting to try Gabriella's ever since they opened, and my out of town friend and I finally made the trip out for dinner!

We opted to sit outside due to the pandemic, and the heat lamps they had were very warm - even on a cold night. We opted for the shrimp porridge for an appetizer and the catfish hotpot for our entree. The catfish hot pot is served with 4 small helpings of noodles, and some veggies, fish sauce, and chiles on the side. Both dishes were so good, felt like a nice homemade meal, very cozy. 

The only thing I would comment on is the price - but I do think it's fair for the area. Sure, I think you can get the same quality of congee/porridge and hot pot in Chinatown area for about 2/3 or half the price  - but the ambiance is different. Plus - Gabriella's is BYOB so you can factor the alcohol cost into the price. Also, I felt like the hot pot that serves 2 is relatively generous! We were stuffed, especially with the noodles. If you came with 4, I would say you could be content with what we ordered + dessert or potentially 2 appetizers + hotpot. Overall, a great cozy home cooked Vietnamese meal & BYOB all in the heart of Passyunk. 

Based on my experience, I'd be happy to return for a date night with my husband! For quick cravings, I would likely still hit Chinatown - but loved this spot for better service, BYO, and ambiance
Enjoyed all the dishes we got here especially the shaken beef and seafood fried rice! Portions were pretty small and slightly on expensive end, but everything was incredibly tasty and unique.

There are so many delicious Vietnamese restaurants in Philly, we are very lucky. Gabriella's menu is a little different, and while it is more expensive, I was happy to find it was well worth it. 

I came excited about the photogenic water fern dumplings, but was more impressed by the airy banh xeo, tender shaken beef, and our absolute favorite the fried winter flounder. Served as a thick chunk, it tastes like sweet crab meat inside fried chicken skin. It comes with the fixings to make summer rolls. We talked about this dish for days. 

Service was accommodating and we ate outside next to a heat lamp.

Prior to visiting, my main experience with Vietnamese food was pho, so I  was excited to expand my palette and try a different cooking style. Our waiter suggested we share a few plates amongst the table, so we ordered the water fern dumplings, crispy salmon belly, Baby back ribs, the shaken beef, and the brussel sprouts. My favorite things were definitely the salmon belly and the brussel sprouts. The salmon literally melted in my mouth and was so flakey and crispy. The brussel sprouts were very well cooked and I  loved the cashews. The baby back ribs were a little disappointing and didn't have much meat on their bones, so there wasn't very much flavor to glean from that. The shaken beef was pretty solid and well cooked. I liked that there was a lot of it to share. Overall a great dining experience with some meh dishes but overall a great environment with good service.

Why have you not been here? Go now! As a Tampa native, I am picky about my Cuban Sandwiches. They really do it justice here. My husband had the Aguilas omelet w/ chorizo. It was also delicious. Huge menu...lots of options. I would recommend ordering online. They make everything to order, so it does take a bit. Totally worth it though.

The place is awesome! A great ma and pa place. The Cubans are really good, fresh and reasonably priced. Also, would recommend for breakfast for all your needs. Definitely recommend if your in the area!

Stick with the Cuban sandwich, forget everything else. They couldn't get an order correct anyway. And 20 minutes is way too long to wait for a sandwich. My side order of devil crab was switched to sweet plantains, check your order before you depart. Extra cash for lettuce/tomato and salami. Tried it once, not going back

I got taken here by a friend who swore up and down how good this place is. I ordered the frita burger which was basically dog food. I am not trying to be harsh but this was really terrible. Like dont even bother serving this option. 

I wasn't surprised when I came here to look reviews and saw that someone had posted that the frita burger was a dog biscuit on a bun. Dry, no flavor and on a really hard bun. I kept trying to give it a chance and finally was just like I give up, this is disgusting.

So I've been wanting to try this place since I recently saw it hilited on TV- I wish I had read thru all the Yelp reviews to see it's a different owner than at the time it was featured on TV.  I also want to make sure everyone knows this is basically pick up only-they have some picnic tables set up outside but they aren't completely covered so if it's raining you will get wet.  Anyway! Cuban was good, I LOVE Cuban bread so even though it maybe isn't the best in Tampa it was well worth the price.  We also got ham and cheese croquettes-I liked them, my sister didn't- I got the ground beef empanada and it was just ok; got sweet plantains-hard to go wrong there!  The parking situation is terrible because you have to back out onto an extremely busy street.  It's very far from where I live-but I was in Tampa-next time I'd try another place just because so many people said there are better & I love trying new places & I definitely would rather sit inside & be waited on.
Great food! I just hope he gets his liquor license so we can have the full experience.

Bower Cafe is by far my favorite stop in the morning on my way to work. Coffee and a warmed cinnamon roll are a perfect start to the day. Every one is incredibly nice. 100% recommend. Definitely my new morning routine!

At first glance it serves a very relaxing aura and that first step insides confirms it. The decor was dope, the walls decorated really cool and the names of both the sandwiches and drinks forces a yearn to read upon you. Everything on the menu is unique to say the least. Patrons ever so peacefully focused and tuned in to their machines. It seemed like a 2 (wo)man ran show and those that were behind the counter that day were the nicest. I love a good cafe, to come here and work? YES, to eat? BIG YEAH, drinks? It's a no for me.
Just came to get a hot drink but was welcomed so nicely! Best hot chocolate I've ever had.

this place had the best breakfast sandwich i have ever had in my life. the ambiance in there was so chill and the customer service was great. do yourself a favor and order the breakfast sandwich!!!!!!
5 star rating for the food.  3 star for service. The service wasn't great but don't let that stop you from visiting.  The salmon toast however was perfectly balanced using super fresh ingredients.

The coconut mojito are too die for. Ladies night are on Thursday nights. House sangria's are $5. They are worth your money. They are so good and are homemade. Our bartender is always attentive and makes sure you are enjoying yourself. Me and the Hubby will be back.

It was fun during lockdown bc they were open, that's about the only positive thing I have to say about this place.  Just went again this weekend bc we were bar hopping and walking by....no one was there, we left after one drink bc it was uncomfortable and an awful time. All the servers had terrible attitudes and do not smile. Hope they go out of business so we can get something good in here! Could be a great spot.
