This is a great place with a friendly staff and pleasant customers. Feels like a neighborhood gathering place whether you live in the Channelside District or not. Highly recommend trying it before or after downtown events or just go there!!

We love this place!  Great vibe and always great service.  We recently met Fred, who works as a bartender part-time.  My husband asked for a spicy margarita.  Fred went out of his way to make sure hubby was happy with it!  (He had three, so I think he enjoyed them!). That's the type of service you get at La La's!  Hoping they adjust their hours.  They open a little later in the day, but it would be a great place to chill on a lazy afternoon!

Really wanted to like this place but it was a "no" from jump. After being seated for 15-20 minutes with no service we finally flagged the host down to get a waitress to take our order. Waited another 5 minutes for the waitress to come, we ordered bottomless mimosas. The mimosas took so long to come out that I wouldn't even call them bottomless. Definitely didn't get our money's worth. The food wasn't brought out at the same time and we were trying to wait to eat together so our food was cold. It took an additional 25 minutes for them to bring out the last plate. The food was decent to good. It coulda been seasoned better. Also the music was way too loud had to yell at my friends to talk to them. I'm fine with the DJ, but I don't wanna lose my voice talking during brunch. The place also had strobe lights during the day... wanted a brunch my feel not a clubby feel Will not be back.

We went to Three12 for a brunch recently and let me say the experience was terrible! The waittress was unattentive and the food was lackluster. They advertise bottomless mimosas but when explained they say you can only get six per person. The waittress was so unattentive we only ended up getting  3 which it took over an hour to even get those. The chef was wearing slides which seemed inappropriate if he was working in the kitchen area and only i know that is because he was also deliverying the food and hookah to tables, which my waitress never bothered to make sure my food came out and i had to ask the chef about it after waiting 30 min for it. When we mentioned our dissatisfaction to the manager he called himself discounting the bill by taking the cheapest items off while still adding in gratuity for a service we told him we were not pleased with. The only positive to our experience is that they had hand sanitizer at every table which we appreciated as alot of restaurants have become laxed in providing during this pandemic. Overall the experience was not good and i would not recommend others to go if asked.

Drove from Baltimore to Philly for supposedly the best pizza: Angelo's pizza. Picked up my pizza there and walked up the street to Nannie Francos for a tomato pie. Well, I found the shining star of the pizza world and it is here! Phenomenal pizza (tomato pie), and I have to disclose that I'm a traditionalist when it comes to pizza... cheese, pepperoni... maybe green pepper/onion if I'm feeling crazy. My mind has been changed forever. Where do I start? The crust? Best I ever had. The tomato topping? Flipping mind blowing delicious! I declined the sprinkling of parmigiana on the pizza (which they graciously ask if you want incase of allergies.) Next time I won't be an idiot.

Visiting the area and was recommended this spot to try its tomato slice (square) and I wasn't disappointed! It's big, square, crispy, and flavorful. After we ordered it was handed right to us and we sat at the tables right next door. Super quick.

My only gripe is that with our order of knots came marinara sauce that was cold. It would have been 10x better if the sauce was hot.

Know before you go: cash and venmo are the only accepted forms of payment.
Wow. Just wow. Best of the best. Really a wow pizza. We got the Barbato square pizza. Seriously amazing. If you're a pizza freak this place is for you!!
Fav slice spot. Satisfying crunch with each bite. Flavorful. Have tried several different slices, all amazing. Been getting at least a slice a week here.
Had a juicy burger with kimchi. The fries were thick cut and delicious, and they offered good portions for happy hour! Pork buns were good too. Excited about this local spot!

The happy hour here is amazing!  The flavors are so unique and the food is delish.  I've ordered here occasionally over the years but slept on their happy hour...until now.  The happy fries have this incredible sauce on them with kind of a spicy Mayo dipping sauce.  Just thinking of the combo is making me crave those fries.  Their bao buns are also so tasty.  They're a little expensive on the regular menu so happy hour the price is perfect.  The beef ones are my favorite.  I've also tries their burgers and rice bowls which are good, but the chicken bites appetizer is also amazing.  Packed with flavor and crispy on the outside despite having a lot of sauce.  The service at happy hour was great too.  We had a kid in tow and they brought a kid cup which was super nice and had a lot of patience for an antsy toddler.  Definitely check this place out and don't miss their happy hour!!

I dined in for a late dinner and got started with some appetizers. Starting with the Southgate fries, I saw numerous reviews saying it's a go-to / must try, but I honestly didn't understand the hype. The fries were soggy from the ingredients that were put on them. It had a garlicky taste but not something I could keep picking at. The spicy pork bao buns were really good definitely will recommend it. Now the Korean wings were an extreme flop. The soy wings tasted like the wings were drenched in soy sauce and were extremely salty. The hot wings were not spicy at all. My sister doesn't have a tolerance for spice, and she tried it and said it tasted identical to the soy wings. The bibimbap was piping hot, and I enjoyed every bite. We also ordered the spicy soju, soju punch, my sassy girl & the bold fashioned; all the drinks were strong and great! 

Now the service here is tremendous. Our waiter was awesome; he was patient with us and kept checking in. Even other staff would double-check to see if we needed anything and so for that an extra star for excellent customer service. I would definitely try this place again and try other items.

Went there for Friday happy hour (4-7pm), the hh burger of the month was a great deal and was amazing! Huge burger and very flavorful. Loved the HH drink  Sapporo + shot of soju for $5! The pork belly ramen was well portioned , and the half boiled egg in the ramen was just right. Will come back again to try out their dolsot bibimbap next time!

Probably the worst Korean food I've ever had. We ordered combo wings. The soy wings were drenched in soy sauce, suuuuuper salty. Like someone took a whole container of soy sauce and dumped the entire thing over it. 

The spicy one wasn't spicy and had almost no flavor.

We followed up with Southgate fries. These fries were so garlicky, I don't think I've ever had this much garlic in my life. It killed the vampire next to us. I love garlic normally, but this was overkill (no pun intended).

The cocktails were a bright spot and so was the beer. The restaurant has a neighborhood vibe and our server was nice, only reason this place isn't a 1-star.

One of my favorite study spots in Tampa! The coffee tastes incredible and there are many options for delicious healthy food! It's an amazing spot for studying with outlets everywhere for those you want to use laptops/ipads.

Your average coffee shop, unfortunately suffering from understaffing at the moment so your mileage may vary when ordering food as for wait times. But the coffee is brewed nice. Great for grab and go beverages.

I was hungry and saw this place as I was driving so decided to grab breakfast. I went through the drive thru and ordered the seasonal spiced vanilla bean latte and banana pb oatmeal. The latte was good, but not flavorful. If I was not told the flavor, I wouldn't have been able to guess what it was. I liked how the oatmeal was packaged for to-go and it was a good amount given. It was just ok for oatmeal. Their breakfast sandwiches looked good and I would've ordered one, but I'm trying to be more health conscious. I would go back and order other items to give them another chance at a better impression.

I hate to have to do this but this coffee shop has taken a deep plunge since it first opened. The coffee used to be top notch and worth the hefty price tag. I don't know the specifics but i believe this place has either changed ownership or management, and it was from that point that the quality of coffee making took a downturn. The baristas used to be so good...all of them. Today I don't think there's a single barista from when i started coming here. And now it's just a bunch of kids who act like they're making gas station coffee. I ordered a cortado the other day and it was just not...i had to dump it. This place started out with a 5 star review from me a few years ago and sadly now it has come to this. I won't be returning. I simply can't "wing it" when it comes to a $4.00 coffee drink.
Great spot to grab a quick brew and catch up with some friends. Plenty seating options and the coffee was delicious. Muffins looked great but I'm trying not to be naughty today

A simple place with a true deli menu.  Sandwiches prepared quickly, well-stuffed (not massively over-stuffed, but they are in the $10 range, not the $30 range).  Corned beef, excellent.  Chopped liver, excellent.  Rye bread, fresh and flavorful.  And Dr. Brown's Cel-Ray soda, the only thing to drink when eating deli.

And they have no issue with going off-menu.  I ordered what I wanted, they didn't blink an eye, and charged a fair price.

Definitely on my go-back-there list.

This place is a deli staple in Rittenhouse. From their breakfast sandwiches to their lunch sandwiches, you can not go wrong with anything you order from here. The inside is very cute and retro, it's a great spot to meet up with a friend for lunch or just to enjoy lunch alone.

Believed the hype in the reviews; was disappointed. Dining area was dirty and rundown. The man taking orders was extremely rude. Food was on par with one of those sandwiches you heat up in a dirty microwave at 711. Bagel had green splotch on it that looked like mold. We ended up throwing away the food when we got home and ate something else.
I stopped in to grab a quick bite on my break. The knish was very good, larger than most, and the staff took the time to heat it up well. Such a hot day and very pleasant staff.

It's good and does the job well. This jewish deli has the largest menu on the planet and has something for everyone. Given the amount of dishes they are expected to make, I can see why their sandwiches are microwaved. The service is quick, efficient, and you can get a meal for cheap. If you don't expect a Michelin meal - this place get's the job done at an affordable price.

I was driving with my windows down and caught the aroma of their cheesesteaks being fried up. 

I went into a trance.

My free will - Gone. 

My protein bar - Ignored. 

Drove by here for years and was always curious how their steaks were. Now I know. 

Some things to point out - The steak was not cooked to order. The meat was pre-cooked and scooped out of a container. (I suppose that's common in fast-paced steak joints, although I do prefer the steak cooked fresh to order)

ketchup wasn't heinz. Their off brand ketchup kinda murdered my steak. (Not their fault) 

The cheesesteak was ok overall
It's about as good as any local pizza joint.

Steak / a bit bland but ok. 
Cheese / mild flavor but ok.
Not a big fan of their fried onions.
Roll was fresh and very good. 

An Ok place to go for a cheesesteak craving. 

* The woman upfront was super cool *
Great food. Love the Mac and cheese bites too. Whenever i call to order for pickup only ever takes 15 minutes. They are all hard workers too, gotta respect that!

Solid local cheesesteak spot to fight the craving while avoiding long lines at D'Alessandros. Priced according to the local spots so didn't break the bank and tasted good enough. Wouldn't scramble to go back but don't regret trying it either. 

I ordered the cheesesteak with whiz and coopers sharp I believe, and the overall flavor of the steak was a 7.5/10. 

Like I said, got the job done but wouldn't scramble to return. They have house made sodas which is cool, though! And the people inside were really nice. I see why they're a neighborhood staple.

Well, all good things come to an end I guess. After supporting this local business for many years, I am astonished at the response to my FIRST TIME EVER call with a problem.  My daughter who is home-bound asked me if I could get her the "Western CHICKEN cheesesteak" from Barry's. I did so and was disappointed to see that it was a different chicken sandwich, when I got it home. No matter, she made the best of it. Couple days ago, she again asked. I ordered it along with another sandwich. My daughter didn't wake up until after 10pm so it wasn't opened right away. About 10:20 she happily opened it and .. no chicken, but beef! She can't eat beef! I was more than disappointed as any little thing I can do to brighten her day is what I aspire to do. This time I decided I'm going to call and let them know because that's two times and the sandwiches keep going up in price so it's a bit of a luxury to order dinner from there. I did make a call but they were closed. So the next morning I called again and Pat who I spoke to was lovely but the sad part was that Barry, the owner, told her to tell me there was nothing he could do for me as the day was over. Said I should have called! We called immediately once discovered. They were closed! He said the tickets were all gone. Told them I had the ticket AND my receipt! And the sandwich!!!! NO GO! So... I will no longer go there nor do I recommend this establishment anymore. To lose a long-term customer ever one sandwich is the worst practice I have ever witnessed. Very very disappointing. Barry just doesn't cate!

Quintessential Philadelphia cheesesteaks made fresh to order for your pleasure. I have been going here for years. I moved from this neighborhood but I always make an attempt to drop by for one of these treasures
 The cheesesteaks are a step above all others which are only judged properly by sampling in person. The prices are reasonable and the adventure is bucket list worthy.
My friend visited this place after doing yoga on a Sunday morning. We both had piña colada smoothie which was very refreshing. Definitely will visit again

Yummy!!! I decided to make my own soul bowl with the plant based charcoal vanilla froyo. The girl was working there was kind enough to offer me samples of their flavors. I tried the charcoal vanilla and was sold. I like that you can customize the bowls. The only thing I'd recommend is turning down the music a couple of notches. It was a bit uncomfortably loud outside near the picnic tables. I could tell the older customers were not about it, lol.

After showing my friend " Dairy is scary " on YouTube and " The game changers " on Netflix, we decided to come here. 

The soft serve is delicious not to mention all toppings are all Vegan expect bee pollen & honey.  
it. 
You can't tell the difference and you don't feel bloated after. The power of Plantbased! 

The place is really cute and insta worthy. And the lady working inside is super sweet . 

The only thing is that the acai portion is small that's why I didnt order it.
Awesome place to grab a power bowl or cool and refreshing treat. A lot of the items on the menu are plant based or entirely vegan. My wife, kid and I all walked away happy.

I was looking for a healthy place to grab a light breakfast and came across this cute spot!

I ordered the Sweet Soul bowl with the oatmeal base, coconut chia seed pudding, mango, strawberries, granola and a honey drizzle. It was SO GOOD that my boyfriend and I came back a second time the next day! 

The workers were helpful and nice. Also, the instructions and toppings options were easy to see and follow! 

Cannot wait to come back!

First time here,  the food was not good the Fries were old and cold the gizzards were fried but too salty, the pop Wasn't even fresh quality or  have good flavor. Will not be retuning, a waste of 10.00 on my lunch break. So disappointed

The fries are old and hard the buffalo wings sauce is different and the chicken is hard and old. I believe they have gone under New Management and the quality of service is very poor. Better watch out because competition is being built across the street. That's where I will be taking my business. This is unacceptable to me

Super fresh! I ordered the veggie bowl and fried okra. Both were made to order and delicious. The veggie bowl was spicy which i loved! Happy this place has a meatless option with the veggie bowl. It packed with veggies

A great little eatery along one of the main stretches of Tampa. They have a pretty extensive menu and provide healthy and affordable American cuisine for the pickiest of eaters. They close pretty early, relatively speaking, focusing on breakfast to lunch time. Make sure to come early and sample some of their delicious eats!

THE BEST BREAKFAST FOOD IN TAMPA. LITERALLLLLYYYYYY FIRE AF. Eggs on point, bacon just crispy enough. The buns were heated to perfection, not only were the tater tots the best I ever had. The way they bolst the flavor of the sandwich is amazing

Was looking forward to this place and came with a friend for brunch. thought it was pretty average. I got the brunch breakfast sandwich but it was just a lot of bread and not a lot of filling. Also felt that the presentation of the dish wasn't the most aesthetic (it made me even forget to take a photo).

This place was delicious. I got the Poblano burger. Omg so go. Love the sweet and heat jam. Prefect combination. Love how light the burger was. Sweet potatoe fried were cooked to Prefection. I typically don't like sweet potato fried but I love them at Graze.

Okay this is amazing place! Super clean, super bright, and the owner takes huge pride in being on site.   They pride themselves on serving the best quality and healthy food ingredients.  The cold brew is really amazing.  They support local brewery's as well.  The food is not oily and the oils they use are olive oil.  I really enjoy a resterant  who prides themselves on clean ingredients!   Such a refreshing change!  My kids loved breakfast there this weekend.

Food Is good, However the woman that Answers the phone is very rude, and Unprofessional...My delivery was I hour late when I called for my food she proceeded to berate me, telling me I called her 500 times...I told her I am a Paying customer...She seem to not care...I will never be ordering from them again...I even Told them I would pick up my own food...They kept saying it was out....She proceeded to curse at me, and told me the delivery guy is not a plane....They need to hire new staff

I've had their pizza many times and it is one of my favorites in South Philly. Always fresh and really tasty. The pepperoni is delicious and the crust is amazing. Their wings are fantastic too. Done to crispy perfection and with amazing sauces. My wife particularly loved their mozzarella sticks. You can't go wrong!

Ordered 2 large pizzas, mozzarella sticks and wings a couple of days ago from Mr. Wings. The crust on the pizza was amazing! I especially love their mozzarella sticks! They were breaded with bread crumbs, which is my favorite. Don't get me wrong, I like the battered mozzarella sticks, but the crunch of bread crumbs is where it's at. My family loved the wings too! Would order from here again.

We had the chicken strips with fries and an order of 10 wings. Both came in melted foam boxes. Thinking that this is a wing place the wings should taste good but nope they are horrible and over priced. Super dry and smallest wing that I ever had. 15.00 for 10 wings. Chicken strips were ok but I'm never going back there again

The eggplant pizza, well done, extra sauce, made me go "Mmm!" with every bite. The pepperoni pizza, well done, extra sauce, is delicious and herbaceous and tangy and also perfect with every bite. The crust is the slightest bit buttery, the perfect amount.

My fiancee says, "Eggplant pies are in my future."

I ordered delivery. I will absolutely do it again.

A delicious surprise gyro place!! Stopped here for lunch on a Saturday and was pleasantly surprised at the amount of lamb and beef on their $7.40 gyro! Bought 3 more to take home to my family as well! Recome

This place is amazing!!! This is my second time eating here and I have no complaints. The chicken is very flavorful with homemade pita and don't even get me started on the garlic sauce and hummus SOOO GOOD.

After my anger subsided, I finally tried this place out. I got the falafel and I get why he was busy the first time I called - it's pretty good. I've been back a few times since and haven't been disappointed with service or food!

The beef shwarma sandwich is our favorite! I've tried the gyros and chicken shwarma which weren't bad just prefer the beef shwarma best. Also, really like their falafels. Overall good-give it a try and satisfies our shwarma cravings

Hands down best Middle Eastern restaurant in Tampa! I was born in Lebanon and grew up on Lebanese food. Recently moved to Tampa from Los Angeles and being sort of a snob when it comes to
Middle Eastern food as LA has probably the best Lebanese food outside of Lebanon I was pleased to find La Pita on UberEats. The kabobs here are always cooked right, super moist and juicy and with the right touch of spices! The Hummus here reminds me of my grandmas homemade hummus....so damn good! Looking forward to try everything else on their menu.
One of our favorite Indian restaurant in the area. Yes they take long to prepare the food but honestly it is worth the wait. We love the butter chicken and chicken 65. A must try

This is a very modernized Indian restaurant. Newly renovated with pale blue booth seating, decorated with various spices and wall art. Place is clean!

The service was good. The waiter was very attentive. The only downside was the food came before the naan, which took a little while. I was the only person at the time dining in so I had the place to myself, so unsure why my food was delayed for a bit... 

Regardless, let's talk about the food! I order their chicken biryani which was delicious! Served in a modern dish topped with lemon slices and onions, it is very flavorful. It's served with their yogurt (so YUM)! Portion sizes are large and could easily feed 3 people. (aka left overs fo dayzz) I also ordered the garlic naan as pictured. It has a little different texture than other naans I'm used to. It's more on the thin crunchy side than a thick fluffy naan. 

Would definitely come back for seconds!

Not great... The food was decent, but the service was slow and inattentive. The server repeated back my boyfriends and my orders- and gave us the wrong orders, and mine came out SUPER spicy, when I requested it to be mild. The server then tried to tell my boyfriend he was wrong and ordered shrimp- not fish. I sent mine back for a mild flavour. Took a long time, and we both got our orders and the waiter accidentally dropped mine. (As you can see in the photo) It was an accident, and I understand that. It happens! The waiter said he just wanted to go home. He then went to the back and never came back to clean up this mess. My boyfriend had to put napkins down for me to walk over. I guess the waiter was having a bad day, as we all have been there. The other worker asked me what happened as the waiter wasn't leaving the back area and "wasn't talking". I told my boyfriend to get the bill as I wanted to go and sampled enough of my boyfriends fish curry, which was really good! They said they could make me a new one, but I said after the first two I couldn't wait anymore. Throughout our time there, I kept going up asking for more water, and felt like we were forgotten about (even though there was only one other booth occupied,) I saw long delays of people  waiting for their orders who were losing their patience. I had high hopes for this place as I live right by it, but I will stick to 'Desi' in Oldsmar in the future. I hope this place figures it out!
Writing this from the bathroom stall......I paid $50 for oil soaked fries, chicken tenders and probable food poisoning. Save your money and your stomach. Go to McDonald's or something .

The food was ok I had wings, cheese steaks eggs roll and a tropical trash can drink which was pretty good. Nice atmosphere. They was playing good music hip hop and R&B. My waitress Maya was very nice. she went above and behind to make sure my service was great.

We were visiting our daughter at Drexel and decided to give it a try.

Well since she has been at school and saying how bad the food was, I jokingly told her I would take her out for a terrible meal not to ruin her getting used to school food. Well I unknowingly managed to do it.

The food was just not good. Everything was so oil soaked that we all left feeling ill. I would never recommend this place, unless I really don't like you, so if I ever tell you to go here you'll know how I feel about you.

I should of read the comments before I ordered. I asked for a medium well burger and my burger was nuked (burnt) to a crisp. For the prices they charge for a burger you would think they could at least cook it properly. Ask for raw, may get well done.

Let me start by saying the food here, in my opinion, only warrants about 2 stars. Not to say that it's terrible. Along the lines of Applebee's or Friday's. Fast food presented well. The extra 2 stars are for our server Maya. Very attentive, pleasant, helpful, ...... and any other positive adjective you can think of. The young lady is from Pittsburgh, but she has the kindness and charm of a southerner. She treated me and my little bayyybayyy very well.

Came here for a meeting, the space was spacious and is decorated like a typical restaurant with the dim lighting.

For appetizers we started off with the fried calamari and clam casino. They were alright, decent nothing too special. Calamari was fried nicely with a slightly sweet marinara sauce. The clam casino decent nothing special to the flavor. Sometimes you hit a bad one that can be a little gritty.

The seafood bisque was decent. Very creamy and gives you a decent flavor profile of "seafood". There was some small bits of soft meat which might be shrimp? Too soft to even tell, more there for a little texture at that point. Having something that wasn't cooked to absolute softness and provide some actual texture would be nice like some nicely cooked  small scallops or baby shrimp.

The crab cakes were well done. Very crisp with a good amount of crab in them. Stays true to that crab flavor. Didn't really use the sauce as it didn't feel like it added anything to the meal. The portions were big and nicely seasoned potatoes and green beans to pair with it.

The Apple crumble, however, was the highlight of the meal. A great dessert to top to off. The vanilla ice cream pairs very well with the hot apple crumble. Delicious!

All in all a decent place to try once in a while with great staff. Your experience might be good or bad depending on the food. My friend got the salmon and didn't like it too much cause it was a too dry.

I have been coming to Gallo's for 40 years at least and this lunch was inedible.  The crab cake sandwich of the lunch menu was served on an ice cold roll with one leaf of limp brown lettuce.  The crab was absolutely tasteless like fried batter and was half the size of what I usually receive.  The soups I took home were thrown away...the chowder was sour, too salty and too spicy...not the chowder I used too love...the bisque was nothing but salt and pepper and also sour.  I hope this was just an off day for the chef...I want to return but am leery that the quality of the food is suffering terribly.

I've been coming here for over ten years, the food is great and always fresh. Shockingly there's alt of unprofessionals here now, the manager didn't make it any better which also shocked me. Never received bad customer service ever up until now. Food is great but you all can keep the bad attitude and bad energy which leads to bad service and lost in customers. WHAT HAPPENED AT GALLO'S

Big shout out to Gallo's for making a night out a great experience for us.  Would give more than 5 stars if I could!!

I'm a physical therapist currently working with a quadriplegic (CB) who uses a power chair.  He and his wife had not been out to dinner since his injury 2 years ago.  I went to Gallo's the day before to make sure they could accommodate them.  The manager, Frank, was great.  He took me around let me measure tables.  Their tables are 30" which is ADA compliant but the power chair requires 33" of clearance.  He tried to problem solve with me where CB and his wife could sit comfortably.

The evening of the dinner, I showed up with 3" blocks to lift one of their tables to 33".  The staff even helped me place the blocks!  When CB and his wife arrived, the were shown to their table like any other guests.  The waitress was fantastic and the staff couldn't have been more supportive, allowing CB and his wife to have a "normal" evening together.

The food was great, the service even better.  Thank you to Gallo's for making this special evening possible.

This is the 5th time in the past few weeks that I've tried to get in touch with someone. I have emailed etc, but no response . I was there about 3 weeks ago with my 91 year old mom and also, my brother . We arrived at approximately 5:30 pm, way before the dinner rush. We were seated immediately and had a great waiter, and then it went downhill . My mom and I were supposed to get green beans with our meal, but we were given broccoli , because they were out of green beans. When it came to dessert, we all ordered apple cobbler . The waiter came back and said they were out of apple cobbler. My mom and brother then ordered vanilla ice cream. The poor waiter was embarrassed to tell us that they were out of vanilla ice cream. Really??? All this happened before 6 pm. The 3 star rating is for the waiter only. He was great, but embarrassed about all of this. Maybe I'll finally get a response from someone from the restaurant ???

Note to Jim!!! First of all we were told that green beans were the vegetable of the day. Where were they? I'm sure my waiter did not know that there was vanilla ice cream in the burger bar or else he would have gone there and this was after we were told you were already out of apple cobbler!!! Remember , we were there before 6 pm and the restaurant was not busy. Don't blame our waiter.

On a tight schedule and had no time to go out for food. Called and placed an order for delivery. Order arrived in half the time I was told. I was hungry so Cool. Delivery Driver was nice and masked up which I appreciate. Pizza was hot and delicious. Nice crust, good sauce. Salad was pretty good and fresh. A little pricey but everything is these days. In my opinion, totally worth it for the quality and fast service. Will definitely order from here again and have already recommended to my neighbors and fam

This was only my second time have Korean fried chicken wings and I must say I'm definitely a fan especially if they'll be this good. (The last place I went to wasn't). Anyway, I got the spicy bbq flavor crispy wings and they were the perfect balance of savory spicy and smokey. The business was obviously newly opened based on the cleanliness. The guy at the register was eager to make recommendations of menu items which was pleasant because the menu was slightly overwhelming with the various options. Overall it was a good experience and I'd go back.

Decided to give a shot at another Korean Fried Chicken wings spot. Decided to try their "Whatever Combo" which includes 20 Wings with a choosing of any sauce you prefer. Fries and Onion Rings. I decided to try the White Snow Cheese flavor. The wings were very crispy and delicious. The flavor was very sweet i didn't expect it to be honest. Can't go wrong with pelicana if you're craving some crispy wings.
Raw chicken and the food is so dirty,  I got a rock in my salad , this place needs to change the manager. Used to be a nice place but now everything sucks

One of the best korean fried chicken in the area! Clean environment, easy online ordering, friendly staff, and the wings are always crispy and crunchy!! Also, love how many varieties you can order - different sauce flavors, bone in/out, wings or whole, crispy or grilled. Highly recommend if you are in the area and want some good korean chicken!

I ordered an iced latte with caramel and their bacon egg and cheese burrito through uber eats - it was absolutely amazing! I always feel nervous/can't justify ordering coffee through uber eats because its so expensive but this was the best coffee I've had in quite some time! And it came 10 minutes earlier than expected! They just got a new, very happy customer!

Favorite coffee shop in the area! Owners are so friendly; you can tell they are passionate about who they are. The coffee is A1 and they always have a seasonal drink that will keep you coming back! They recently introduced breakfast hand food and it couldn't be anymore satisfying. There are days where they have goods made by one of the owners, so definitely keep your eyes peeled for that!

Lovely, little cafe by temple university. It's a great study spot with wonderful music and fantastic baristas. They are attentive, super sweet, and make delicious drinks. I ordered a mystic mint which included the aromatic taste of a lesser known herb showing their knowledge and dedication to not only great coffee but also tea. Additionally, the cheese danish was delicious, warm, and just the right amount of sweet! I will definitely be coming back!!

I work on ridge Avenue so I'm always driving past this little cute coffee shop. I usually go to dunkin but I was running late to work so I decided to try this place out. If I could give this place 10 stars, I would. Chic, clean, and overall great customer service. I got a French vanilla hot coffee with cream and sugar. It was perfect and made in practically 2 minutes. I was in and out in a timely manner. Also, it is black owned which is a plus for me! will definitely be returning back!
Easy to order online with curbside pick up. I ordered a piña colada Matcha latte. It is the most amazing and refreshing Matcha latte I've ever had. 10 out of 10 would recommend!

I live in West Philly, but whenever I can I will walk to Rival Bros for my decaf latte with almond milk. Whether iced or hot Rival knows how to make this drink right. I always complain how I cannot find a good cup of latte across the river in the West Philly side. Don't misunderstand me, there are enough cafes, but somehow a lot of the coffee based drinks are either too strong or too weak. 
Rival Bros seem to get the flavour just right. The service has been good and steady during this pandemic, and the place is always clean. It gets A+ on my cafe list!

This is one of my top 5 coffee places in Philadelphia. Since we are in a pandemic, we've always gotten our coffee to go. The coffee is delicious and they have not burned the milk once. Portions are well-appointed (not too big and not European-small. They also carry the most delicious chocolate croissants. My one note is that the people in the area aren't always accommodating or friendly, especially with parking being what it is, but the staff awesome is so it works out in the end.

Another great coffee shop in the area! I was able to order my drink and get it quickly! I even purchased some beans and they were able to grind them for me. It looks like a great place to hang out *fingers crossed* *one day* make sure to check this place out :)

Situated in the quaint neighborhood of Fitler Square, Rival Bros Coffee is a cozy coffee shop that's great to catch up with friends or read a book. I would not recommend for studying though.

I ordered their Americano and found it quite smooth. My friend on the other hand ordered a hot latte and kept on emphasizing how it was one of the best lattes she's had in a while. The ambience inside is great too -- the couches are super comfy and just the right amount of dimness in a cafe that doesn't make you super sleepy.
Great roast. Wonderful flavor and a great feel inside. Parking is tough but worth the trouble.

I had saved a bunch of restaurants to review later, and it took me forever to remember where this one was from/what I had ordered, which is a testament to how mediocre their food was. It was very busy so the only way to get a table in a reasonable amount of time was to sit at the bar, which was fine. I ordered the shrimp tacos ($15). There wasn't much in the tacos; it was literally just shrimp, a slice of avocado, and a sprinkling of cheese. I expected at least some pico de gallo. Maybe I should've read the menu more closely, but I don't know why this is even a menu option in the first place. The tortillas were cold, tasted awful, and the texture was weird/not soft; they ruined the tacos, not that there was much substance left to ruin. I would've sent them back had I not been so hungry. My friend ordered Nacho Mamma as her meal, which was good and the only reason why this is a 2- instead of a 1-star rating.

Very good food, great server, too crowded during Covid. The squash/pumpkin guacamole, smoky salsa, tuna tostadas, and taco sampler (lamb and pork were best) were great. The shrimp enchiladas were a bit fishy but the green sauce was yummy. Although they checked our Covid vaccine card and ID we felt it was too packed. Should remove some seating during Covid.

I just don't get it. 

I just don't get why this place has the level of popularity that it has. The food is alright. The drinks are fine. The dining room is big and loud. The service is competent but not special. The pricing is mid. I would never recommend El Vez to anyone, but whenever someone suggests going, I shrug my shoulders and say "that's fine," because it's just fine.

The food is great here! The chips and salsas are great and they give you plenty. The only thing I can say about this place is their restrooms are a disgrace! For a popular restaurant in the city you'd think they would have the money to update it. It's only one co-Ed bathroom that's super dirty which turns the whole place off in my opinion. Just keep this in mind when visiting.
El Vez is a great place to grab drinks with a large group of friends. I wouldn't recommend going there just for the food. The chicken talks were a bit salty and not very complex.

Excellent bread, excellent samboosas, decent chicken mandi, but the fahsah was not for me.  

The appetizers and sides here are top notch- got enough bread to feed an army!

The one samboosa I got was crispy, savory and had amazing wrapping.  Similar to samosas but way better!

The chicken mandi was decent- it had a curry spice to it and was cooked well.  Not a home run but not bad.

The fahsah was not for me.  There were crunchy bits in it that bugged me out- tasted like crushed shells.  If they weren't in there, the soup still wasn't for me- had a unique taste to it that I wasn't in to.

Overall it's worth a shot.  Load up on appetizers and bread- skip the main dishes.

The fassolia (white beans in tomato and onion and spices) were hearty, flavorful, and satisfying. It was extra tomato-y and maybe black-pepper-y. Yum. It came with a piece of the house bread, which is chewy and hot and perfect. We also received some tasty hot sauce, seemingly house-made, which was the incredibly hot but also delicious. I chose to eat all of it slowly over the course of the meal.

The lamb haneeth is their most popular dish, so we tried it too. The veggies (potato and carrot) in sauce were soft and irresistible. It came with tender, beautiful rice. the lamb itself was a cut with LOTS of lamb flavor (maybe lamb ribs?).

The soup option was lamb. It is a spiced broth. It is served with lemon; squeeze it in to get the soup to come alive.

Service was prompt and kind.

Yum.
Small place that's easy to miss, but food is amazing. The Fahsah and lamb haneeth have been my go-to.

Their lamb Haneeth (lamb with rice. It's nothing but similar to a pot roast but on an
Upgraded level  ) and chicken mandi (chicken with rice) is out of the world. Took a neighbor of mine here and she's ok to post her reviews as well. She rates this as above any 5 star steakhouses. Ambience is ok but lamb haneeth and lamb Fahsa (lamb stew) is top notch . Juicy succulent lamb with meat just falling of the bone . 5 star plus  for less money

Where do I start....Bland dry food. With No flavor. No seasoning and No sauce. We were very dissatisfied and disappointed. It was a complete waste of money. I don't understand why the ratings are high. The food was horrible. We asked for sauce or something to help give the food some taste. They had nothing! No sauce selections. Not even hot sauce.

Tasty bagels, and very friendly service, this old style bagel emporium sells a nice variety, and they are very nice size, definitely not a boutique bagel.

They are located very close to the 4th. Street Deli, and opened in 1996, they make a true water bagel.

You can get any type of bagel sandwiches, from a lox, and cream cheese bagel to a Rueben, and everything in between.

Give S S P B's a try, you won't be disappointed.

After calling a bunch of bagel shops one morning looking for gluten free bagels I found an awesome option at this spot... It was delicious, and so close to my home. I couldn't wait to go back!

Flash forward a week or two and while walking by I decided to stop in and see if they had any gf bagels left. To my confusion everyone working said not only did they not have any gf bagels that day but they never carried gluten free bagels, despite the fact I was definitely served one a short time before.

Not sure if they just got rid of them in that very short amount of time or what but it was very confusing... and I still don't know if they're a source for gluten free bagels or not.
the BEST customer service. Just got home to my surprise HOT and FRESH everything bagel tucked under the bagel sandwich that I ordered.
Grab a breakfast sandwich or a bagel and a container of their creamed cheese. Prices are really good considering the quality.

After multiple tries for good takeout Mexican we finally found El Taco which not only provided good food but consistency in both quality & service. 
There is a limited menu with tacos, burritos and empanadas but all are well made, tasty and consistant. 
I alternate between carnitas tacos & beef empanadas. Tacos are over stuffed with meat and well seasoned. I like the creamy jalapeno sauce. Luckly they sell by the squirt bottle. 
Recently I discovered the empanadas which are large and stuffed with a spicy beef surrounded by nice flakey crust. I havent tried the dessert apple one yet but will next order.

Had the crispy tacos last night!! This was my first of many more to come visits!! These tacos were the best tacos I've had ever hands down! The shell was deep fried the chipotle cream was EVERYTHING! Great price and tacos were not skimpy! I definitely recommend this spot

A good taco Spot, good portion sizes full of flavor. I personally got the 3 tacos (carne Asada) with creamy chipotle. The creamy chipotle sauce could really be eaten alone it was so good and it brought the entire taco together, the carne was good, nicely cooked. Definitely want to try other menu items. Caramel Churro was also good, and bless the free refills.

Absolutely delicious campus staple. On Tuesdays (and really in general) it's so cheap...3 soft shell chicken tacos with toppings for just over $8. Don't skip the caramel churro at the end, it was amazing! Staff is kind and there's seating inside. It may be a wait because it's usually crowded, but it's worth it.

The serve pretty good tacos. Wait isn't too bad. I ordered the shrimp tacos they charge an extra $5 just for 2 pieces of shrimp per taco which is ridiculous. First and last time ordering those I'll just stick to the chicken tacos which are regular price with no extra charges

I love Nifty Fifty's. A classic, traditional burger with all the fixings you want! They have the best french fries. I can count on the taste and quality to be consistent. This location is take-out only but they're not a fast food joint (I don't think they claim to be). I can agree with others as I've waited 20 minutes. I suggest ordering online ahead of time.
I love them, I'm from California so they remind me of In&Out buuut way better  hands down every time I'm in Philly I stop by  Just reminded myself I need to go back
That was the best customer service I had on the phone in a long time. Let's see how the food is when I head over to pick it up.
Ya get ya moneys woyt...ordered Uber eats,large portions,tastes great. Got the Buffalo blue fries and a cherry chocolate shake...

Waited 20 min for 2 cheeseburgers and 1 small order of fries. The cheeseburger was literally just the burger, cheese and bun. No lettuce, no tomato, no onion, nothing else. What a rip off. I'd rather go to shi*+y McDonalds and order from their Dollar menu.

This place is pretty interesting. I came here one night in October with some friends while I was in Ybor for an event. I was excited to get some fresh sushi. It's a small place, but there are a lot of options for tables outside, and we were able to snag a table immediately without a reservation, even though it was a Friday.

The menu is extensive, with what feels like endless options for rolls. The menu is pretty cream cheese-forward, which is not something I'm used to seeing (at this level) from a sushi place. There is also a ton of cooked sushi options, which again, is odd. Maybe the locals prefer this? Definitely not traditional.

I ordered chicken dumplings, which were fantastic, and the dipping ponzu was so good that I was eating just the sauce once I finished the dumplings. I also got the El Pollito (chicken in sushi?!) and I believe the gypsy (no cream cheese). I enjoyed them both, definitely different experience than I'm used to. My friends got the Firecracker, Rainbow, and Candy Cane, and both said they were good and very filling. For dessert, I had really wanted the tempura cheesecake, but they were out so the three of us split donuts. 

Definitely worth a stop, especially if you are not a sushi purist.

Went on a night that was unfortunately super short staffed but were told upon checking in that it would be a wait so we didn't mind. Karla was excellent in communicating this and so efficient as a server, I honestly wouldn't have known they were short staffed unless she had prefaced it! We were thoroughly impressed by her customer service and skills as a server! The food was also very good. I highly recommend stopping in if you're in the area not on a time crunch.
The best sushi in Ybor ... maybe in all of Tampa! Great service!! Cozy and personable. Love Carla!!

I love this place, prob the best sushi i have ever had. My only problem is they're open about 50% of the time I try to order. Even on days they're supposed to be opened which is super disappointing. Otherwise 5 stars

Cristina is an amazing manager and the customer service is exceptional. The food is SUPERB !  Seriously! The FRESHEST and tastiest sushi I've ever had! The knife work is clean and I appreciate how the chefs put so much care and attention to the artistry of the food. I am gluten free and was delighted to know they have MANY GF options! This was an experience you need to have if you love sushi! The customer service will make you want to never leave. I came her for my birthday and can't wait to come back! Ty for the memorable experience! :) Definitely recommend !
Chris our server was very good, the manager visited our table. The food was great. Fun atmosphere, we sat inside but they did have a live band at the outside seating.
We have no idea why this restaurant doesn't have 5 stars. The wait staff were delightful, the food excellent and the views cannot be beat. Just awesome!

The restaurant has a wonderful atmosphere as well as great food. The staff is very friendly and courteous makes you feel like a value guest. Sarah and Sierra are simply amazing. I would definitely recommend this place to everyone.

The food was truly a nice experience there was
An amazing view to the ocean the staff was nice and friendly the food came fast and had so much flavor imagin if paridise was a restaurant

After a great WIN at the Outback Bowl, we stopped here for dinner. Wanted a Cuban taste. They were spot on!! After being told we would have to wait 30-45 minutes, we lucked up on a couple leaving the bar area. Ashley was our very attentive waitress. She did an amazing job! I ordered the jerked chicken pineapple bowl. It was delicious! The chicken was so tender. Spices were amazing!! My husband ordered the jerk shrimp pasta. It was oh so good!! Pasta, shrimp, asparagus galore! He was very pleased with his dinner and I was too. Mine was jerked chicken, pineapple, sweet peppers, and other veggies served over a bed of rice over half of a pineapple. It was a perfect combo of spices, rice and chicken. We will be back one day soon!!

Country Fried Steak 10/10 eggs 6.5/10 
Great fresh  fruit 
Friendly & attentive service

Hmmm where to start. We were seated very quickly but our food took forever to get to the table. Our waitress was also very inattentive. She forgot to bring us our water until I asked her again. Mind you the place was pretty empty. The food was okay too. My eggs Benedict looked better than what it tasted like. I think the meat was poorly marinated, very bland.  The other plates were just ok. I'd come back just because I had a great experience my first time so I think this time is just a hiccup.
The food was excellent and the service by Traciann was the best we've experienced in a long time , We will definitely becoming back
Good food. Great service. Good gluten free options. Good sized portions. Coffee refills.

This has been probably one of my favorite breakfast places. The staff is so friendly and inviting! I've been coming here for months and always have a good chat with the servers!!! You guys are great! Maybe get better food but other than that!

Love it! Lines may be long during lunch but come back in a few and you won't regret it! The tilapia burrito (also known as captain crunch burrito) ($6) is one of their signature dishes. Make sure to order this with the spicy mayo. Their curry is amazing too when paired with the burrito. A full on food truck meal that will leave you stuffed but craving for more.

Cucina Zapata is one of the best places in University City to grab a meal. Very creative chefs, very tasty fusion cuisine. 

The Cap'n Crunch tilapia fish tacos and fish platter are amazing! Also, their veggie burger is perfect. The actual veggie patty they use has so much flavor. Then there's the sauce. 

Give it a try if you're in the University City area! It's a delicious, filling, and satisfying meal. 

Support a great local business and a creative food concept!

Ricci's Hoagies is an iconic and long established neighborhood institution in the City of Brotherly Love, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Ricci's has been in business since 1920 and any business that can not only survive, but flourish after hitting a century mark, has to be doing something right. 

Hoagies ate a Philadelphia staple and definitely a food of the working man. A hoagie allows someone to eat something substantial in a quick an efficient manner. You don't have to worry about a fork and knife to help you in eating it. I heard somewhere that a sandwich was a favorite amongst truckers because they could eat it while driving. I do not know about the authenticity of the story, but it makes sense. But I think what allowed hoagies (or subs, grinders, whatever you want to call them) to survive is that they also taste great.

I can say that a hoagie is one of my favorite meals. It is a perfect culmination of bread, meats, cheeses, veggies, vinegar, oil and spices and has been embraced worldwide as a lunch (or donner) favorite. Ricci's do hoagies right and as it continues to get handed down through the generations, I hope that they continue to flourish.

So, after over a hundred years, the community still loves Ricci's and after eating here, you will understand why. My go-to hoagie has always been an Italian and they do their Italian right. It is a substantial meal at a fair price and it is something that you will return to Ricci's again and again for.

As Ricci's enters into their second century, they still produce an outstanding product. With them continuing to do so, I can see them making it another century and beyond.

Fantastic hoagies. Can't believe I never knew about this place in all my years living here? Sign outside boasts that it was featured on the Food Network, and I'm always a sucker for anything and everything Flavortown so knew I had to drop in for to-go lunch one day. 

It's typical hectic South Philly ordering and I was a little intimidated when I walked in and saw the line of workers behind the glass shouting orders over the masses, but they couldn't be more pleasant.

Got chicken cutlet hoagies with Cooper sharp and all the fixins' of an Italian sub (shredded lettuce, oil and vinegar, Italian seasoning shake, and pickles to boot.) With two bags of chips and two sodas, it was in the $20 range but WELL worth the price, plus I had leftovers for the next day the sandwich was so huge.

Probably the best sandwiches I've had in a minute and fresh as all hell.

Long line, but short wait! Tried Ricci's Old fashion Italian and it was provably one of the best hoagies I've had. Bread has a little bit of chew to it yet was soft and absolutely stuffed with toppings 10/10 would recommend

Finally got to have a Rocco Hoagie  Yesterday and I have to say , Not Bad , definitely not the best in the City but overall not bad. It was very busy of course it was a Saturday. My real disappointment was with the finishing or condiment stations at the deli. They were so vastly inconsistent  which left me totally disappointed. My 5 hoagies had hardly any lettuce on them and I had to keep telling the guy to put the oil and vinegar on the side. And put the sweet peppers on it. He was just not paying attention and seemed as if he was very new at putting a hoagie together. Mayo on the meats , just a mess. It's a hoagie , it's not rocket science!  Meanwhile the other end where the woman was doing the condiment section was awesome. She just got it right and wasn't afraid to put the condiments on the hoagie. 
Needless to say. These hoagies Just didn't have the right flavor or experience. It was just a meat sandwich with no condiments which is not my style of hoagie at all. 
So, back to Marinucci's I go!!

I'm not usually a fan of Italian hoagies, but my father is, so I agreed to try Ricci's for his birthday. We had the old fashioned Italian hoagie with sharp provolone on a seeded roll. We were both blown away by the quality and taste. The meat was freshly cut, the roll was super soft, and the toppings were equally great. I can now say I'm a true fan of Italian hoagies thanks to Ricci's. Five stars - highly recommend.

After reading about this place and having a free night with friends and a babysitter, we decided to check it out. We relish tasting menus and evenings out so our expectations were high...and the results exceeded them!

Located in Center City in what appeared to be a renovated  apartment and it created an amazing ambiance. The downstairs is a long bar, while upstairs, a thin staircase leads to a thin room, lined with tables and chairs, and with dim lighting that dims further as the evening goes on. The music was eclectic and just loud enough to keep a little attention and quiet enough to not drown out conversation.

The drinks were absolutely delightful! They're creative, flavorful and classically presented. We went through most of the cocktails by the end of the night and all agreed the Assassin's Handbook was the winner. Rum, mulled wine shrub, orange peel and habanero all work together in this boozy, sweet at the edges and with a nice little burn at the end. It was pretty awesome!

Dinner was a total hit as well! Eight course plus a snack at the end...it was phenomenal! Starting with snacks, the chicha morada was a delightful start to the meal with the empanada being one of the more beautifully presented dishes. The corn capelletti was masterfully done, the sweetbreads (my favorite) were rich and earthy, and the BBQ veal cheek was as tender as any meat we've ever had. 

Every course was presented beautifully, but not so much that there was more art than food! The courses started light, went more substantial and finished sweet - each course creative and delicious. We've done a lot of tasting menus and this ranks amongst one of our favorites. It was a perfect spot for a 2.5 hour dinner with a lovely ambience and facilitated conversation with some good friends who we went with. 

If you have a chance, check this place out! It's worth the trip!

The restaurant was well appointed and modern with an open concept. The service was perfectly punctuated Southern hospitality. The piece of heaven I missed and incredibly enjoyed here was the Beef Tartare and Mussel Toast. The taste was over the top. The atmosphere and service were excellent. Excellent menu. Other patrons expressed similar experiences. Knowing what to order here is the difference between a fine meal and a disappointing one.

The tasting menu was phenomenal. My favorite dish was the pasta dish. Even the sweetbreads were good. Dessert was a great salty, sweet, and tart dish. The wait staff was extremely helpful and kind. I do not like the taste of alcohol but their orange Catholic drink was so smooth and delicious. My boyfriend got the assassins creed drink and also could not stop raving about it. The ambiance was also great. Would definitely eat here again. We also do not typically eat these. I also tend to be a picky eater and this place still blew us away

This was a very very good meal. 
We had a great server who did a very good job throughout our tasting menu, he answered our questions and always made sure we had the right utensils and that our water was always full.
We started off with a couple of cocktails that we loved, and then ordered some wine by the glass for the rest of the meal.
The tasting menu was delicious overall, with a few true knockouts (my favorite came early, it was a biscuit bite topped with caviar - my husband loved the corn pasta). Both my husband and I didn't adore one of the courses (he thought the sweetbreads were a little too funky, I thought the bbq veal cheek was a little too rich and sweet and unbalanced), but in a tasting menu there may always be an outlier after all, and the experience of the progression is part of the fun.
I will say that we could have used either one more course or slightly larger servings of some of the courses, because while we didn't leave hungry, we could have been just a little more satisfied by meal's end. And when you're paying $130 per person for the food alone, you want to leave pleasantly full and not wanting for anything more.
That said, it was a very good meal and a cool experience. We came here on a recommendation, and I think many more people would really love the experience as well!

Many fine dining experiences in NY, LA, and abroad, and this one is right near the top. Absolutely exquisite dishes, freshly and elegantly prepared, with high-quality ingredients.  The 8 course tasting menu tonight was a grand tour of flavors, colors, and aromas. Our favorites were the sweetbreads, halibut, and pork cheeks. Cocktails were also on point - we especially enjoyed "Being Frank" and "Assassin's Handbook" - that habanero! Amazing birthday dinner!

Great service, delicious food, and good prices. Staff were friendly and efficient. Multiple waitresses came to our table to ensure we had enough coffee and water. We went there for breakfast and were not disappointed. We'll definitely be back for lunch or dinner!

Fresh, charming, unique!

Im gonna keep this short and sweet: the experience was wholesome, deserving of tips and warmed my heart( and stomach!). Mama's kitchen will be revisited by yours truly and i HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place to anyone within 10 miles. Such a lowkey spot that has major history and knows how to serve

Delicioso!

This locally owned hole in the wall type restaurant. The food was outstanding and I would recommend this restaurant to any of my friends or family. We had breakfast and all three meals were spot on. The establishment had a country vibe... The type you would find up in the mountains of Tennessee or North Carolina. Nothing but positive things to say about this establishment.
Amazing friendly, fast service, the food was all cooked perfectly and delicious. This will be my new go to breakfast spot when in Tampa!
our favorite breakfast spot. We go to eat here at least once a week, its fast friend and affordable. SO awesome to have such a fun little spot right around the corner.

DISGUSTING!!! I usually order from the dollar menu because the burgers are smaller but I decided to order the Quarter pound with cheese and I took one bite and saw the burger was still RAW!!!! They even asked me to pull to the side since my food was taking longer than others..... OBVIOUSLY I WAITED FOR NO REASON

Their bubble bread is great. Their margaritas are great too. Just know that they will add 18% not based on party size but based on tab size. I believe a tab over 50 or 60 dollars will incur this charge. BOGO burgers on Wednesday are a great deal too!. Be sure to come early on weekends because this place does get crowded.
Open late but drinks are a bit overpriced. Food not bad. Could use more vegan options.

As a University employee, and a resident of Philly for more than 20 years, I'm highly disappointed at what happened this evening. We chose Copa to celibrate my promotion. Reservations where made for 3 prior to arrival. I arrived and my manager arrived early and sat at the bar. The other party was running late because her children were sick. The hostess told me that they would hold our table but if the other party wasnt there at the time of seating our table would be given away. We didn't know if our third party was coming or not so we sat at our table with another gentleman who was at the bar we had met. Our third party shows up and the gentleman gave his seat to her and thats when the harassment and disrespect began. The hostess tells us that they cant allow our original third party to sit at our table although the gentlement went back to his seat at the  bar because she was now considered a walk in. I asked what would be the difference if our third party went to the bar and the gentleman remained sitting until he was ready to leave and then our third party came and occupied his seat. The hostess said, shes a walk in and its against the rules. So, we asked for a manager and Nicole the GM came out. We began to explain to her the situation and she was very RUDE and Dismissive and replied, We'll just DROP THE CHECK and walked away. She didnt even gives us enough respect to give us any eye contact. Never in all my years of patronizing COPA, was I ever treated with such disrespect. To add insult to injury, My manager overheard Nicole telling the staff not to serve us. We sat at that table for about a hour in disbelief. The University staff and faculty have been patronizing Copa for a very long time. We order take out all the time. But to endure such harsh treatment and to sit at a table being ignored by their staff was terrible, demeaning and embarassing. They were losing money being RUDE and dismissive and they didnt care under the directive of NICOLE. She's rude and couldve handle this situation better as well as professionally but some people are given these titles with ZERO customer service experience and respect for human beings. The entire time that we were there they lost money not serving us! I could see if we were  disrespectful and disruptive but that wasn't the case at all. Nicole is in the wrong profession, she needs to work in a prison and sign up for intensive Customer senstivity training because with her dismissive rude behavior, Copa will lose big contracts as well as repeat customers. We ended up going to the Landmark and  we spent over $300. I'm displeased at what happened this evening, and as long as Nicole is the GM, I will ensure that my coworkers, friends and family will Never patronize Copa again! As a African American woman we endure disrespect and discrimination on so many levels and tonight was an example of that!

Great little restaurant/bar. Went in on a weekday afternoon and had the Spanish fries and a chimichanga. All the food was great, definitely try the Spanish fries! My boyfriend ordered a cherry coke and it had cherry syrup and maraschino cherries in it, it was delicious. 

Portions were just right and everything tasted fresh. Ambience was what you would expect. Service was great. Note that for a table of two 18% gratuity was included though we didn't see it mentioned anywhere. Not a big deal since we usually tip more than that but I'm sure it catches some people off guard. Will definitely be back, and it's a place I'd bring friends if they were visiting from out of town.

Good value and location. The outdoor seating is excellent after 1 when the sun casts a shadow. There are no umbrellas. The reservation process is not easy, but manageable if you have open table. Kind of annoying to require a walk in customer to download an app and figure out the reservation. I have been told the waitstaff will do it for a customer, but that was not my experience. I like the juevos rancheros. And most of the wait staff. The one I had today was not five star. Hence the four stars.

What an awesome little place my friend and I found while visiting Tampa for the day!!! Not only is it completely clean it's tasty and the staff is great! I had the spaghetti squash pie it was very interesting and light. A sweet customer handed my friend and I these chocolate almond star shaped treats to try (he said he goes there everyday) they were soooooooo good! I also bought some of their chicken, walnut and apple salad to take home. When I got home I ate it for dinner and it was fantastic! The staff is so sweet and the place is adorable must try!
Fantastic dishes, soups and desserts with lots of variety.  Could not ask for a better truly healthy and very tasty gourmet restaurant.  Staff are very good as well.

Literally AMAZING! I cannot recommend this restaurant enough. I am celiac, so finding restaurants that carry gluten free food is hard, but finding an amazing place that has almost an entire menu that is GF that tastes amazing? Crazy! 

We got the lemon raspberry cupcake, lemon bar, two chicken wraps and their in house brewed iced tea. 

Seriously, if you want clean meals that taste wonderful, this is the place to go.

The Greek avocado toast and remedy toast were totally banging. But what tickled me the most was that the guy who was working the front walked me to my car in a rainstorm with an umbrella he pulled off a patio table... what a gem! Will be back!
Delicious homemade vegan pastries! Met the owner who is super friendly. We love the lemon loaf as well as pumpkin bread ( moist and spiced)
Mediocre food.  I ordered online and now I can't get off the mailing list.  I have reached out several times and no response.  No phone number either.

We ordered so much here and everything was delicious!! I'm not able to have dairy and it's so nice to come to an establishment and order without any restrictions. And the staff are awesome! Super nice and helpful :)
When you are here you feel like you are family. My sister took me here to introduce me to vegan treats. The BEST EVER!!!!

Stopped by WeVegan on the way to the beach. Picked up a variety of goodies (cookies, blueberry muffins, cinnamon rolls, and guava turnovers). Everything was so delicious! I can't wait to go back and try more!

I came here with a group of people celebrating a birthday. We Loved the atmosphere and the vibe it had. We were able to order drinks and food. Everything came out in a timely matter. We would definitely come here again. The only down fall we didn't like was have to pay to get into the restaurant.

Asked for a drink 3 times before finally getting the wrong one (over the span of an hour and a half). A hookah was left in the walk way and I ended up burning myself on it, they then charged me $100 plus a 20% tip because they said it was broken. I tried to work it out with them and talk to them about what happened but they were very rude about the whole situation. Also there is a $20 cover charge. Left feeling like I had been majorly scammed.

Visiting Philly for a quick overnight, I was looking for a place with a rooftop and possibly good music and a vibe. We arrived at VANGO, paid a 20$ cover and made our way inside. The security/doorman was nice, which helps. We went upstairs to the main floor but I really wanted to check out the rooftop. Well, the roof left more to be desired. Nothing like the rooftop pics on their site and they had 1,000 card playing tables with hookahs set up so it felt even more claustrophobic outside than inside. The drinks were poorly made and way too strong, but I know some like that. Nonetheless, we danced a bit and left after about an hour,considering it took about 30 minutes to order a drink at the bar, we didn't party much.
This place is a scam, it smells like an ashtray inside and it's not a skybar

Love this spot!
Great service and epic tasting food. Every time. 
Place is always busy and make sure to come expecting a little waiting during the weekends.

Stopped in the get lunch to go. Sat at the bar and had a beer while I waited. Very friendly staff in a very inviting environment! Ordered the Cacio e Pepe and added chicken - so good!! Would highly recommend both the place and the dish. Will be back soon for sure!

Perfect for date night or night out with friends ! Great Happy Hour ! Great service ! Food was even better ! This has been in my collections for a while & I had to sell my husband to get out the house ! Thank you yelpers for reviews & pics ! 

Was able to make it for Happy Hour. I got the frosè & HH Mule. Both are good ! I love to try froses everywhere to compare to Ulele ! My husband loved it bc it had a strawberry vs the normal cherry lol . We also got food off the HH menu .Avocado Roll, Spicy Salmon roll , Chicken Quesadilla , & 1/2 Simple Pizza . ALL delicious . We parked on the street bc we assumed it would be hard to park but to our finding , they had a parking lot ‍.  All in all .... Great Friday night spot & we will be back !

I came for happy hour here on Wednesday around 3:30 pm. I got two classic margaritas and a shrimp tempura roll. My roll was good but my margaritas were just average. It did not taste like there was any tequila in there, just a lot of sour mix. Our server was attentive and sweet!

The namesake is captivating and curious. Two of the main ingredients for a biscuit or maybe with a different spelling two of the main ingredients for a garden, yet the restaurant is also a physical representation of this concept in that they are also missing an ingredient. That ingredient is you, and I highly recommend you add yourself to their recipe. So many have found this place trendy and one dish that all who come cannot leave without is the truffle fries. Gaining almost as much IG popularity as avocado toast, any restaurant that's looking to reach that new demographic has given truffle fries a shot. I am here to tell you to not burden yourself with the other charlatans and just come to water and flour for the real deal. Now of course the menu has much more to explore, but if this review at least gets you in the door I can promise you will keep coming back for more.

Very bad !!! Rude customers , and that's why it empty !!! No one at the kiosk and argued with us . Hopefully we didn't ordered and left and right after us , the employee had a fight with some other customer as well!!!! Don't go please . Employees sucks !!!

This is the worst Taco Bell I advise you to stay away from it the employees are just outright rude first you stand in line to go in the Drive-Thru for about 10-15 minutes then when you finally get to the microphone they tell you to hold on you're holding up for another 5 minutes and then when they finally get to you they're rushing you and then she tells you to hold on so you hold on again for another 2 minutes and then she comes back on and is rushing me and she keeps repeating to for me to repeat the order when I've already given her she had me so confused I didn't know if I was coming or going just outright rude I'll never step foot in that Taco Bell again

This McDonald's and the other one nearby on City Ave are now regularly closing to people and only serving DoorDash and UberEats. Don't waste your time driving here just to be told that they won't serve you. You can read more about their new deal in this article: https://restaurantbusinessonline.com/financing/mcdonalds-announces-new-deals-doordash-uber-eats

Honestly this is LITERALLY THEE WORST MCDONALDS IN HISTORY OF WORST MCDONALDS! At this point why is it open? WHY? I don't even know why I play myself when I go here. There is ALWAYS A PROBLEM like it ALWAYS! I live around the corner so when I say I know OH I KNOW! First off they're always closed. It's literally been a long time coming with this review. I would give this zero stars if possible. The employees have invented every excuse possible to not accept any orders every time I arrive, no matter what time of the day/night. For months. I've complained to corporate but the issue has never improved. It is ridiculous. There basically is no McDonald's at this location.

I was absolutely blown away by the customer service here. The manager was very kind and accommodating when she realized my food hadn't been delivered yet after a short wait. Very happy I chose this location.

Hands down the worst McDonalds I have ever been to. From closing 30 min early to randomly closing for 30 minutes in the middle of a lunch rush, this McDonalds is sure to waste your time. I have never seen a place on Yelp more deserving of a 1-Star rating. Avoid this location if possible.

It's ok food, busy place can be hard to park. Long wait food is mediocre not bad, not good. They require a mask even though there isn't a mandated by law. I won't go back I love good Cuban food this isn't good. Certainly not worth the wait and inconvenience!

I stopped in with a friend because we were craving Cuban food and coffee and happened to drive by. I regret making her turn around to try this place. It looks like your standard hole-in-the-wall Cuban diners that usually have cheap, simple, but delicious food and coffee. This is not one of those places. Both our sandwiches and coffee tasted like they were from McDonalds. It didn't even taste like a Cuban. Just too much ham, a sad wilted pickle or two and too much McDonalds-like 'special sauce'. Some people like that, I guess, but if that's what I wanted I would have just gone to an actual McDonalds instead. Super disappointed.

I LOVED this place. I came in a group of 5 after our afternoon at the art museum. We showed up half an hour early to our reservation, but they were able to seat us right away! All of the food and drinks we ordered were really good. The highlight of the night was our server, Peter. He was probably the best server I've ever had at any restaurant. He was funny, friendly, and attentive. What a great guy. Thank you peter!

I went here with 4 friends last night and had a great experience. We all got different types of tacos, two pitchers of margs, and a bowl of guac and yucca fries to share. Our waiter, Peter, made great suggestions and was a great server all around. I would highly recommend!

Tried this place out for dinner with a friend last week. We were seated upon entrance, which was nice considering we didn't book a reservation. Our waiter was nice, but the service was a bit slow and it took a while to get our orders placed. The food and portions were good. I would recommend trying this place out if you're looking for a place to eat near Fairmount, but I personally wouldn't try it again.

Excellent food - but on the pricey side with smaller portions. Definitely not a typical Mexican restaurant.  Ordered take out - no chips, meals were in good containers - but I was still hungry at the end. 
There are times I wish I was back in Cali-like when I'm trying to find a Mexican restaurant in Philly!

Food was fantastic, but it took longer than we would've liked to have our order taken.

Once the order was placed, it came out fast, and they comped out appetizer for our extended wait.

We enjoyed the enchiladas and the Baja Tacos.

Would definitely stop by again!

The staff all had their masks down. They may as well not even be wearing them. Tables were super close to one another - a foot and a half away from the neighboring restaurant goer during covid. It made the individuals at my table very uncomfortable. In terms of food, the risotto was good. However, it came with just two pieces of shrimp. The rest of the pasta we got was ok, but not amazing. Our waiter was friendly. However, that was not the case for the entire staff.

Friends. I truly don't understand what the 3 and under stars are about. As a frequent reviewer who is not afraid to give a low rating, I am genuinely perplexed by the low ratings here.

Given the ratings and reviews, I was hesitant to come here for a friend's celebration dinner, but I was absolutely wrong. Was it the best Italian food I've ever had? No. Was it the best service I've ever had? No. But overall, I had a wonderful experience without a single complaint (at least not one that would impact a rating.)

Thinking about my experience, my only negative was the bread. Nothing special, dry, and not enough of it - but perfect to mop up the rest of my sauce! My friends enjoyed their appetizers and salads, and my entree pasta (Linguine Alla Pescatore) was incredible. The red sauce was delicious, there was plenty of seafood and the pasta was cooked perfectly. 

On top of the food, our service was fine, nothing special. But we were given complimentary limoncello due to it being a special occasion which was a really nice touch!

In sum, I'm surprised to see such low reviews and I hate that others had negative experiences. While not my favorite restaurant in the city, I would absolutely return to try some other menu items!

My son made a reservation for three for early evening on a cold Sunday in early December, specifying an indoor table. When we arrived, no indoor tables were available and we were offered an outdoor table in a kind of three sided pod, which we accepted. The pod was heated by a small heater sufficient to keep warm only the person seated closest to it. No heat at all reached the other two members of the party. Additionally, not a single employee of the restaurant, whether indoor or out, wore a mask, although our waiter wore one under his chin.
