The food was very good, not quite as wonderful as my wife and I had enjoyed in the past, but maybe my sense of taste was off because I WAS SO COLD. There are too many other fine Italian restaurants in the city. I will not return to this one.

First off, this place is completely overpriced. The food was not great, other Italian spots in the area are much cheaper and better. Portions were very small for the high price. Calamari came with cold marinara sauce and was rubbery. Our food looked re-heated and was nothing impressive. Wouldn't recommend compared to the other local options

I feel that La Fontana Della Citta is a fairly standard Italian restaurant in Philly - it wasn't too special, but the food was decent. We came here because it was BYOB which is definitely a plus. We were seated outside in a booth due to COVID. We ordered the gnocchi sorrentina and the lobster ravioli (a weekly special, don't think it's actually on the regular menu). Both dishes were pretty good, but the lobster ravioli was definitely pricier ($36.95) than I think it should've been for the amount of food. Overall nothing super outstanding, but nothing wrong either.

I got ripped off by Mark today. I bought 2 take out containers which was supposed to be $8 each. Making it $16 bucks. He charged me $19 and I gave him a $2 tip. I didn't realize the price was $8 each until 20 min after I ordered and left. I called multiple times and they never answered. Next time, don't get ripped off by asking the price before you order. It's $5 extra I shouldn't have given him. Hopefully this review will help others.

We visited Little Italy and stopped at the Visitor Center and asked the lady there where the locals go to eat their Philly Cheesesteaks and she mentioned this place as the place to go to. This is not a sit down restaurant, they have a window where you order your food and then you either take it to go or you find a sidewalk table or bench to have you meal. We chose to go around the corner and just sat at a church stairs and have our lunch. My girlfriend ordered the tripe sandwich and I went with the Philly Cheesesteak. Both sandwiches were unbelievably good. My cheesesteak was so flavorful and cheesy with onions, and my girlfriend essentially said the tripe was similar to the way she makes tripe at home. Bottom line, the next time I go back I will hit this spot again!!

Please don't eat here! Me, my wife and my son got food poisoning after eating here on Friday December 3rd, 2021.
Just wanted to treat my family to special on a Friday night and we ended being sick all weekend. Dehydrated, running to the bathroom, no energy. My wife swore we had covid, all rapid tests came back negative and the only thing different was the Wendy's we had.
PLEASE DON'T EAT HERE!!!!

Worst experience ever !!!!! I ordered a Pizza here and the driver couldn't find my address. I proceeded to text only as I'm at work and driver had the nerve to tell me to bring her tip down when I get the pizza , I responded you won't be getting a tip (because really how dare you) so she then told me I could pick up the pizza in the store. I was so angered by this driver we had a heated exchange and the end result was that after the incident I received 5 harassment calls from this driver on the night of and 2 the following morning where she's threatening to hang around my home. Do not order from here.
Permanently Closed. Replaced by Green Parrot, Bar Grill & Tiki - which I do recommend.

This is the issue, hookah stops before 12 am, bartenders and servers have their favorites which are usually gauking men. I spent plenty cash here bc why not give back to my community I live in but here is like a smack in the face almost every time. Do better so u guys can get more community love and support

Tried Chef Thai out and wasn't disappointed. The chicken yellow curry was good flavor and spice. Creamy topping to the rice. Pad Kee Mao had a nice flavorful brown sauce and decent portion size. Pad Thai was classic. With so many Thai places around, there are choices. I'd say this one is worth a visit to try it out. We really liked it.

Before you walk in the door I would call ahead to see how busy they are, I say this in the nicest way possible they are a small restaurant with only one serving tables and another bringing out food so please have patient and hopefully it's not as busy as when we went. 
Alright let's get down to it  after being seated we waited for a good 12minutes before our waitress came back for our order, which wasn't the worst only because it gave us time to look at the menu.
While we were waiting I had noticed this table of ten just started to put there order in so my concern was that it was gonna take long for our order to come to us so me respectfully asking waitress how long the current wait time would be she told it wouldn't take long at all, so we said okay and ordered 
Amazing Chicken( which only says it comes with broccoli on the menu but that is a lie it has cabbage and very little chicken it's mostly vegetables) and 
Combo with Pad Thai ( everything was great for my meal except the salmon on the sashimi had an off texture that made me a little nervous but everything else was good.
Boba teas one thai and one banana(both really good the bobas were soft and perfect texture
and for a sweet treat for my son with got the donuts also good.
The wait time on the drinks weren't bad the food however.... took so long way longer than we wanted to wait. I only wish she would have been more honest with us I understand that maybe they needed the customers but I'm a very reasonable person if you should have given me an honest answer I could have been more understanding but this was not the case.. would I go back? probably but as I said above call ahead

Ordered the egg rolls, 2 sushi rolls, curry with rice & tofu pad se ew. No no no. The worst pad se ew ever! All noodles (the wrong type of noodles I'll add) and a few pieces of tofu. The flavor was terrible too.
Great food, service, and prices. The drunken noodles were amazing! Pad thai was delicious as well. Will be back to try the sushi & Boba!

We went to the St. Petersburg Residential area for a private birthday party at Chef Michaels historic home. We had 8 kids and 10 adults. We were instantly greeted by Chef Michael as we parked our cars. He was joyful and in a pizza hat. He took the kids in right away and had them completely engaged. He showed us his space indoors and out and really made us feel comfortable. The kids (& the adults helped) made pizzas. Chef Michael sat us around a large butcher block island and gave us all dough. The kids rolled it out and then topped them with sauce and more than you can think of toppings! We took a little snack break so he could cleanup and sat outside. The backyard is beautiful and a perfect private setting for a party. We went back in and the kids got an 8" cake to decorate. Chef Michael made it fun and explained colors and sprayed each cake whatever colors the kids wanted. Then he brought out a ton of candy toppings for the cake. The kids were smiling so big! Each kid got to bring home their cake in a cake box. We ate our pizzas and then had some homemade gourmet cupcakes that Chef Michael made for the birthday girl. They even had her name and age on top in chocolate. Chef Michael was very engaging and interesting to the kids. My kids had a great time and said it was the best birthday party ever. The "dog show" at the end with his sweet Golden Retriever was really the cherry on top. I won't spoil it, but it really made the kids giggle and laugh. Thank you Chef!
Great classic diner!  Awesome food with wonderful waitresses!  What more could one ask for from a 24hour diner?
Classic old-school diner,very friendly service, fast and efficient.great food.  Not sure what is up with all the negative reviews...  Recommended!

Came here for a late lunch/brunch on a Sunday. Seemed like your average diner - food was good, it seemed pretty clean & our server was great. Although I didn't get any coffee I was pleased to overhear our server telling another customer that they'd have to check for a fresh pot or brew one - not just serving whatever she found.
No service for 15 minutes.  Who would tolerate that treatment ?  Their food is average   Rob k

Delicious food, standard beer that you'll find most places throughout the ballpark, friendly staff, nice indoor/outdoor atmosphere with big TVs everywhere.  What's not to like?

We especially enjoyed the pepperoni pizza and will certainly go back for more of that in the future.  The tables were full when we walked in about 75 mins before game time on a Friday night, but we found seats at the bar and the bartender was very nice.  The place mostly emptied out once the game started, but we hung around a little while enjoying the air conditioning and crowd-free space.  I am sure we'll return again soon.

So we picked this spot as it was near Busch Gardens after a long day. The name clearly states Tex Mex and it's a counter order type place similar to Qdoba but pricier. We all found various items to order, wings appetizer and cream cheese jalapeño poppers. I opted for the chicken Flautas and they were really good but could've used a bit more of the pico on the side. A handful of chips came with each order and we added on a side of queso. The queso is not traditional but is smooth and heavy on the chili powder flavoring. Others ordered steak tacos lacking in steak and minimal cheese included, disappointing, especially for the pricing. My teen son ordered a burrito which was large but had more cilantro lime rice than meat. My daughter ordered the chicken chimichanga and said it was good. 

   Overpriced, limited sides, no free chips n salsa besides the small handful that comes with certain entrees. Friendly enough counter service. Nothing really memorable we'd return for.

Can you say salt? The chips are so salty that you will need a gallon of water to wash it down

The salsa is terrible

The taco was marginal

Even the chicken tortilla soup tasted like a salt lick

The music was also terrible

This place was a WASTE of time and mone

Just moved to the Tampa area wanted to try this place out. It was pretty alright. We got steak nachos and chicken quesadilla, Chips could be better quality they were a bit stale and the cheese for the nachos wasn't good to us. I thought it would be more traditional. It's good food for cheap. Definitely a cool place to go. The cashier girl was super nice and helpful excellent customer service. Just because me and my friend didn't like it doesn't mean you won't. Give it a try

The food was so good. We ordered from here for work and had it delivered to us. The pad thai was amazing. I love that they have more egg and a lot of food. My friend is eating down the kung pao chicken. I got a summer roll of course and it's really good. The only thing is the stuff keeps busting out like stuff was already coming out. I love egg drop soup so. All in all 10/10 no complaints :)

The food is great with excellent portion size. The service is always great and the prices, for what you get are very reasonable. I've been going there for 30 years and now that the buffett is gone and they make everything to order the food is better than ever. Hey, I'm a very very tough critic and to get a rating like this is quite an accomplishment. For what it is, it is an excellent experience. I would never order takeout only dine in. The food is best when hot and  right from the stove.

Hao wah is the go to spot for Chinese, Vietnamese, and sushi! Even though they don't have buffet anymore, their prices are still better than most places around that area. I ordered the rainbow roll and eel roll and the presentation was so colorful and pretty. They have a wide selection of sushi options which is great because I'm allergic to shrimp but I didn't feel limited. The taste was fresh and light, it's definitely my favorite spot for sushi in south Tampa. The service was great and the waitress makes you feel like family. I can't wait to come back for more!

Located in the plaza by the Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza, Hao Wah is a classic Chinese & Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa! They have plenty of parking in their lot and inside the restaurant is spacious, decorated with hanging dragons and delicate Asian decor throughout. It really completes the Asian food experience. We went here for a Saturday night dinner and wasn't disappointed! We were quickly sat and opted to try their new boba menu. Super affordable options for $4.50! I ordered the lychee tea with boba and it was the right amount of sweetness (not too sweet) and super refreshing. 

We started with the soft shell crab which was soo flavorful, crispy and juicy on the inside! It was seasoned well and didn't require any dipping sauce. I could probably eat 10 of these by myself. For my entree I ordered the general tso combination which came with fried rice and an egg roll -- all for $10.95! There was so much food I brought more than half of it home. The chicken was extra crispy, the sauce was the right flavor (I feel like a lot of spots make the general tso too vinegary but this one was perfect) and the fried rice was delicious (had the usual veggies mixed in!). The egg roll was juicy and packed with veggies on the inside and was crispy! Paired very well with duck sauce. 

My friends ordered 3 sushi rolls and a poke bowl which also came out quickly and were presented beautifully on a wooden tray! Their sushi is one of the best. They never skimp on the roe or anything. I'd highly recommend trying it out! You wouldn't expect them to have so many sushi options but they do. I'll definitely be back to give more boba flavors a try and more of the other Viet dishes!
Big portions, great service and only $11 for a dinner entree, fried rice and egg roll! Will definitely be back!
My go to order is the chicken shish-kabob loaded fries. Legit best fries ever!! Great service

New middle eastern restaurant that actually has flavor. Many of the restaurants in the area have the look and processes but lack flavor. This is now my go to instead of my usual place which is 20 miles away. I will work my way through this clean eating menu--thanks!

How does Fox Chase have such a kick ass restaurant? Awesome!  Had a variety of items via take out and loved it all. Food was all fresh made and tasted like I imagine it would if I had a middle eastern grandmother. The staff was super friendly and even called me when the order was ready. The falafel wrap was the stand out and I highly recommend the garlic sauce. Put that sauce on a cardboard box and it'd be delicious.

What a treasure of a little restaurant in NE Philadelphia! Food is delicious and staff is friendly. Dine in or take out, you get nice sized portions of food. The lemonana slushy is so delicious and refreshing! I'm a repeat customer. Trying to eat healthy and at a decent price has been a challenge during the pandemic, but Bisho's makes it easy with their great menu!

This was an amazing!! My husband and I ordered online for dinner - website was super simple and easy to use! We ordered a mini appetizer sampler. The falafels were definitely my favorite. They were crispy and light-not dry at all. The baba gannouj & fava bean spread were also very tasty. We also ordered 2 rice bowls, 1 chicken, 1 beef kabab. We have enough left overs for both of us tomorrow. I highly recommend this place. I'm ready to order again and try more!!

My friends and I dined at Modo Mio Taverna on a Saturday evening. The experience was just okay. We made a reservation on google. When we arrived we learned we accidentally chose an outdoor dining table. It was 40 degrees, obviously it was an accident. The host advised she still will be able to sit us but she needs to confirm with the manager. The manger comes to the host stand and in my opinion he was rude. Please keep in mind there was 3 open tables. He came over and was like "oh well they can seat at the bar or outside". He didn't greet us at all. We ended up sitting at the bar. The bartender was very nice. 

Now to the food. We ordered the menu touristo. This included appetizer, pasta entree, and desert. The appetizers were great. We had the calamari, mussels, and rice ball. All were delicious, but the entrees were just okay. All of us felt the food was too salty. I ordered the lasagna and I can definitely say I've had better. Lastly, the dessert. The olive oil cake was dense and I didn't like it. The tiramisu was delicious. All in all, not enough to return but the appetizers were good and the male bartender was pleasant!
Hands down my favorite Italian restaurant.  Very happy it has come back after closing the Girard Ave location.  Can't wait to go back.

....still in Philly, yet reminded once again of the city....and it all started with the meatballs. The menu reflects them with a basil pesto; I politely asked for the marinara, my favorite. The decision was a good one, as the classic meatballs were outstanding. Next, the pasta and fish; which I always get at the same time. The description of the Pappardelle had my mouth watering, and it was no different after  I tasted the perfectly cooked wide egg pasta, with a truffle cream mushroom sauce. It went so well with the papillote Branzino. The fish, cooked in parchment paper, was as moist and delectable as any I've had.  
I had the pleasure of meeting the owner-chef, Peter McAndrew, and was able to express my delight from a spectacular meal. He was very gracious, and somehow knew it was I who had asked for marinara instead of basil!

My husband and I have been customers at both incarnations of Modo Mio as well as the now-closed Monsu. The new Modo Mio Taverna has exceptional food served in a charming, rustic space (with a full bar!) The staff is wonderful and we have yet to have a dining experience with Chef and his staff that hasn't been fantastic. He puts out some truly transcendent dishes in an unpretentious and laid back space. I have traveled and eaten all over Italy and consider myself somewhat knowledgeable- Modo Mio does not disappoint. 

People should be running to this place to spend a special night out (or just because they want to eat some damn good Italian food that is equal parts creative and sumptuous.) Restaurants need our support right now while recovering from the damage that covid inflicted upon the industry- and no one deserves it more than Chef Peter McAndrews.

This restaurant is one of the best restaurants in the city. Philly native, chef Peter studied in Rome and has definitely brought his Italian craft along with his Philly charm to make the experience like you're going to your Grandpa's for Sunday night dinner. We've been coming here for the past 2 years and we haven't had bad service or food yet. Their cacio e pepe is one of the best I've ever had!

Let's just be straight up: there are much better taco places in Philly. There are much better taco places in Fishtown. Hell, there might be someone who lives on the same block as Loco Pez who might be willing to make you a taco, and it will probably be as good or better. 

This is not meant (I think) to be authentic Mexican food. Instead, it's kinda "food in the theme of Mexican." But it's cheesy and hearty and comforting, so it does the thing that takeout is supposed to do. 

And, even though it's a chain, it's still a real neighborhood restaurant. They really held this area down during the pandemic, and I appreciate them for it.

Stopped in here a few weeks ago and definitely a spot on my taco rotation now :-) 

It's a divey looking bar with great drinks, good food, and good service! We sat at the bar and started with some margaritas and had the Chevelle which is a spicy passion fruit marg. Honestly one of the best margaritas I've ever tried! Although it didn't have a super noticeable kick I think it still added a lot of flavor to balance the sweetness of the passion fruit. Had the Fairlane next which is the pineapple and guava and didn't taste much of either flavor so I'd probably pass on this one next time. 

Ordered the chips and queso, Al pastor and pez tacos, and a side of guacamole. The queso came out later than the tacos actually but the bartender was attentive and kept checking on it for us! Definitely worth the wait because this was also one of the best queso's I've had. It had the perfect consistency with a good spice to it! Al pastor taco was super juicy and pez was great as well - great flavors and nothing negative to say about either! The side of guac was bigger than a side so I was able to eat some chips with it and not just use it for my tacos. Perfect portion for one person. 

Also a really great price for the quality in my opinion! I like tan at you're able to mix and match the tacos and 2 was enough for me with the appetizers. Drinks are lower than typical taco/marg places as well and they even do pitchers of 2 of the margs! 

I'll be back to try more :-)

Every time I have something from Loco Pez, I think about my meal for days. The Spanish rice is exactly how I would want it to be made and the tacos are fantastic. (We've sampled every single taco offering. The conclusion: All delicious!) The only thing I've had there that is so-so is the flan, but that said, it's not bad, just not the freshest, and I still think about getting it every time!

Went here a few weeks ago and I love it . We chose to eat outside and the booth area was really nice and private . We ordered a few drinks , nachos for the table for happy hour . They were crispy and well covered . I got a few vegetarian tacos , I tried one of each the mushroom, seitan and soy chorizo . The soy chorizo was my favorite , they could probably use something better to hold it up but it was delicious anyway . My friend got a few meat tacos and a burrito . We also ordered green rice and waffle fries. I also like how a bucket of different hot sauces were available. Our service was fast and friendly . I enjoyed all the food and ate a lot . I look forward to going back
Shrimp burrito is inconsistent at times but when they are good, they are great. Brunch is solid here though.

This one was my second time ordering from this restaurant and I am actually loving the food they prepare. The samurai party tray consists of 46 pieces of sushi that you can share or eat all by yourself. It was perfect for the 2 of us. We ordered the house special lo mian too. I thought it was a bit salty and oily towards the bottle of the bowl but the first bite was actually amazing. The noodles weren't too dry and had soaked up some flavor from the sauce The shrimps and chicken were flavorful as well. I would definitely order another party try. I wish they would have a build your own party tray though, that would be pretty awesome.

I initially found the woman at the front counter to be a little pushy and off putting. She asked if I was ready to order in quite a gruff tone. After I did so, she then directed me to sit down on a stool. When I wasn't moving fast enough she said, "you, please, sit here". 

I wouldn't say by the set up that I would ever dine in here. What would be the dining room is filled with boxes and other miscellaneous items that don't exude the kind of atmosphere that it should.

All of this aside, let's talk about my order. I got my regular go to rolls, eel and cucumber and spicy tuna. I also tried the hidden dragon roll which consisted of crab and avocado and topped with salmon, tobiko, scallion and a special sauce. The roll was good but there was a sweet element in the sauce that seemed out of place. Speaking of sauces, I've never had a spicy tuna roll that didn't include one of some kind usually a spicy mayo. I was kind of disappointed in that. 

 That being said I would definitely be willing to try more rolls from them. The fish was fresh and the prices were reasonable.

Not bad!
I ordered from here just to try something new & I'm glad I tried it! 
Food: I ordered a Alaska roll (4) a fresh green roll (3.5) & the chow mei fun with shrimp (4). The Alaska roll was fine, but the green roll lessened on me as I ate it - I'm not sure why that was. The mei fun was a little bland to me but still pretty good and a generous portion. Food wise, it's nothing fancy or superb. I'm going to keep it in mind as the Chinese place I keep in mind for a quick fix! 
Other notes: The service/employee greeting me was so kind. I think their prices were exceptionally fair. Two rolls and a big portion of mei fun was less than $20. Lastly, as of now, they are still take out only. I planned to do pick up, but I wanted to mention that for others. My order was ready pretty quick - 20 minutes on a Friday night around 6. 
Overall, it's not the best for sushi, but I'll keep it in mind for Chinese food. The service and prices are the reason it's a 4, opposed to a 3.

I sat down at the restaurant, not to eat but to watch some of the game. But before I could sit down I got kicked out of the bar/restaurant. I told the guy I was ordering anything and that I only wanted to watch the game. He said he was turning off the TV's. There were two white gentlemen sitting at the bar and I never heard the employee tell them that they had to leave. And I watched from a distance and notice that they were allowed to stay and sit at the bar to watch the game. One of the disturbing things is I'm an employee at the airport and I have heard them tell other people that there were leaving but they could remain and finish watching TV. And I've noticed on several occasions that the TV's were left on. Coincidence

If you're in Terminal C and want a nice glass of local beer to help your flight time "arrive" sooner, you can't go wrong with Cigar City Brewing. We didn't have a chance to try their food menu while passing through Tampa, but the food that came out looked good and on a different trip we were so horribly disappointed by the Burger 21 next door to Cigar City that they literally *could not* possibly do worse on the food front, and the beer is good so I'll take it on good faith that they have some nice offerings.
We popped in after landing as we waited for our ride and my brother ordered the Maduro Brown, while I went with the Fancy Papers Hazy IPA at our bartender's recommendation. Both were very good, and I've also had their Jai Alai IPA (if I've misspelled that, please forgive me, I didn't even pronounce it right the first time) and would recommend it as well. They also offer half-off shots when you buy a beer, so we had a pair of Knob Creek Ryes to get our time in Tampa started off right.
All the beer was good, the shot prices were good for airport prices (realizing that they're half off), and the service was friendly and prompt. We had a good time relaxing there and I bet you will, too. Looking forward to trying the food next time I'm through Tampa; Cigar City Brewing is definitely on my list of places to visit again.

While I get that post pandemic has issues sounding staff, I would stay away  from the Tampa Airport location. 

The online ordering system barely works. It would not work on my phone and for the folks with me it took about multiple submission for the request to process correctly. Took one guy 2 tries. Another guy 10 tries and for 2 of us did not work at all so that had to be taken manually. 

All of our orders were submitted within 3 minutes of each other.  The first order came out in about 10 minutes. 

About 15 minutes later we asked where our food was and was told it would be right out. However that didn't happen. We asked about 10 minutes later and was told it was at the window. We did see orders come out of people who sat down about 10 minutes after us. 

At this point, I didn't want mine. However it did come to the table in a matter of minutes. They offered it to go, but I'm not a fan of eating on a plane.

The Cigar City in the airport is my go-to stop in airside C before a flight. It's a short walk all the way to your left when you clear security. It's the first (and I think still only) functioning brewery in an airport.  They have 8 - 10 beers. However most of them are pretty mainstream. If you are used to the fancy stuff at the regular location in the back room, you won't find it here. I've eaten here once or twice and it wasn't memorable but it was ok. 

They do have an online ordering system but it's a bit confusing. You have to get someone to "open your table" first and then scan the barcode at the table. This is convenient though because you can pay your tab online if you are in a hurry.

Guacamole served with plantain chips... my friend and I knew we were in for a good meal when we started with these. Mixto has kind staff, beautiful interior, tasty drinks, and delicious food. It was a Friday night and we didn't have a reservation, but we were seated in 5 minutes (October 2021). Next I want to try out their brunch, but I can't wait to bring my parents next time they visit me in the city too!

They accepted a  reservation for us at 930pm on new years eve. Apparently they close at 10. 

No one told us until the kitchen was already closed and it was "impossible" to open again. They called to confirm the reservation and all. 

Barely had time for an appetizer. No one communicated they closed in 30 minutes on NYE. 

Very bad service, communication, and internal processes. Will never come back.

And gratuity was included in the check lmao
Not the same!! Service suck, food did not taste like before, might have gotten new cook

First and foremost I am so happy that they are still open even after the shut downs. Are used to go to the spot quite often before the pandemic and I decided to pop in for dinner and I can confidently say the food is still just as delicious. The portion sizes still look the same and I'm so thankful. I really love this place I think the food is just so comforting and it's just amazing. Obviously this isn't true Spanish food but the half paella is definitely enough for two people. They are so generous with the seafood. There's half of a lobster, there are clams, muscles, calamari, scallops, chicken, and sausage. There's just so much food in there. If you don't get any appetizers you'll just leave feeling comfortable. The bread is just as delicious because your bread is definitely buttered on both sides haha. The guacamole comes with plantain chips and it's just as delicious the muscles I've had in the past and it's also good. The thing about this restaurant is you can honestly come here and order anything and it will be absolutely delicious. For drinks I had a mango margarita and there was a pineapple Mojito that was absolutely delicious as well. I stand by what I said in my other reviews, come here and eat. Please.

Mixto has really fallen off. It used to be my bf's and I favorite place for date night. The last few times we had it, it was terrible. I don't know if they changed cooks or something but it's not good at all.

According to an article in the Philadelphia Inquirer, one of the owners is a spoken advocate of the anti-vax movement, even went as far to say that there needs to be a separation of food and state???  Just like republicans refusing to mask up in some places, I will also follow my belief system and not eat in a place with such convictions.  I would feel unsafe if many of the workers there follow this owners beliefs.

they were out of all the ingredients for their vegetarian sandwich, and offered to make a grilled cheese instead. They still end up charging me the price of the veggie sandwich (14 dollars for the most basic grilled cheese??). Got there 4 minutes before happy hour and stayed for over an hour, and didn't end up getting any happy hour prices ??? 
I gotta say the best part of it all was the waitress who is apart of the pyramid scheme and tried to sell me on it, big yikes.

This review is for the kielbasi cheesesteak (Wit or Witowski) only: Meh ... Roll was too soft and the meat tasted like lunchmeat. 
I was expecting a cheesesteak with small pieces of kielbasi on it.  

For $14.50, it's way too expensive. And the stools were uncomfortable.  

Cute idea, though.

Little corner bar in Port Richmond section of the city. Triple D joint.  Had the roast pork sandwich and it was killer.  Wife had the roast beef and she enjoyed that very much.  Nice corner tap room atmosphere.  Only part I didn't care for was the excessively loud music being played during the football game.  Too loud to hear my wife even.

Every time I visit Philly, I find a new restaurant that I fall in love with! Gaul and Co is no exception! The Wit or Witowski was flat out delicious and the bartender was a cool guy! You're missing out if you don't check this place out!

Sadly, we were so disappointed in the food tonight.  We haven't eaten here in some time & really wanted Chinese tonight.  We spent nearly $60 for plain, bland food.  Most entrees tasted the same.  All the chicken was heavily (thickly) breaded.  The orange chicken used to be spicy, but no more.  There were plenty of red spicy peppers but they were all without any taste or heat.  I'll include pictures of the globby meat and how much actual meat you receive.  Pitifull.
PS) Can't get pics to post.
5 stars all the way. From service to taste. Food presentation is phenomenal. And they give you a lot. You will have left overs. P.s call and order ahead of time for pick up.
This is hands down the best Asian food in the area. Chicken with broccoli. General Tso's chicken. Lo Mein. Thai fried rice. Each dish was amazing. Very nice staff too

We were meeting someone who was driving through the area and they found this gem close to an exit on I-75 - now I wish it was closer to home! 

The menu had a good variety of Asian food without being overwhelming - something to please just a about everyone. Everything we ordered was fresh and delicious, and the dinner entree portions were huge! 

For appetizers we tried the Thai Coconut Shrimp and the Dumplings (pan fried), and enjoyed both. Unfortunately we were so hungry we ate them before taking any photos! I am not a fan of coconut, but even I liked the Thai Coconut Shrimp - and the pieces of shrimp were large. The pan fried dumplings were good, although a few pieces seemed to be a little over cooked (but still yummy). I would recommend both and not hesitate to order them again. 

Now, on to the entrees... first, as I mentioned above, the serving sizes are huge, so you get a good value for your money. Next time we will likely order one meal for my husband and I to share (especially if we have appetizers). We all ended up with at least half of our plate left to take home, and I'll probably get two more meals out of the pad thai - three meals for $15, not a bad deal! All the veggies looked fresh, not over cooked and mushy like at some restaurants- they were just what you want from healthy and delicious Asian food! 

My first choice was seared ahi tuna, but unfortunately they were out. This was disappointing, but understandable since it was New Year's Day and likely a busy weekend for them. 

I had the Shrimp Pad Thai (minus the scallions, bean sprouts and tofu it normally comes with), and it tasted amazing! Although there was a flame by the item on the menu it didn't taste spicy to me (and I have a low spice tolerance). There were at least 7 or 8 large piece of shrimp mixed in the large pile of noodles, leaving me plenty to take home. 

My husband had the Orange Chicken and loved it! It looked like there was about 2 lbs of chicken piled on his plate - which was a bit overwhelming! It came with quite a few chilis and a side of rice too.

Our daughter ordered the Double Pan Fried Noodles and enjoyed the dish. The portions were large for her entree too. The noodles weren't quite what she was expecting (some seemed a little burnt), but she liked it. I tried a piece of the shrimp and it was tasty. Her dish had lots of veggies which looked as if they were cooked perfectly. It also had a good proportion of meat to veggies and noodles (while the pad thai seemed to be predominantly noodles). 

Overall, this visit to Liang's Bistro was a pleasant surprise! The only downside is that it is quite far from our home and we won't be able to visit frequently.

One thing to look out for is that the floor is very slippery, and it did even rain the evening we came in. I think they are using a wax or floor cleaner that is not made for the type of flooring they have and it is leaving a slippery film on the flooring.

This Restaurant is exactly what I think of when I think of a Chinese Restaurant. They are the same ownership as my other favorite Win Win but where that is a good Quick Service Restaurant, Liangs is a great full service restaurant. The pork fried rice is delicious the barbque ribs fall off the bone without that fake sweetness. The sesame chicken is exceptional. We love it all here. Reminds me of great NY Chinese Restaurants.
Incredible deep dish pizza and friendly staff. A true taste of Chicago in Tampa. Our new go-to pizza spot!
A true taste of Chicago! We are big Chicago deep dish fans and Cappy's version did not disappoint! We have found our new go to pizza place in south Tampa!

I came here once a few months ago with my family, and it was great! Service was fast and friendly, and everyone enjoyed their food. I am vegan, so I was very pleased with their vegan cheese option. I can't wait to go back sometime soon!

Cappys pizza has amazing pizza and Greek salad. The Chicago deep dish and calzone are my favorite things in the menu, but really everything they serve is my favorite lol. Greek salad is crisp and flavorful and a great way to start your meal! They make their dough and sauce and the veggies are always fresh. This is a fun, no frills, dining experience that's main focus is serving you kick butt pizza and tasty sides to accompany it. If you're in town visiting, it is worth a visit! Us locals love Cappys! The one on Bay to Bay is the original and the one I go to.

THE BEST Chicago style pizza in Tampa. Bar none. I've tried both the NY Style and the deep dish. NY Style is more of a medium crust than a thin (I prefer that) and the deep dish reminds me of my previous home, Chicago. Only knock on this place is that during peak ordering times, it's tough to reach them and due to the high call volume, they miss things. For example, I like the deep dish pre cut and basil on the margarita pizza. Both were missed, IMO due to volume of pizzas being made. I'm glad it's busy, but those things shouldn't be difficult to do. Also, word to the wise, their parking lot is SMALL so I usually park a street away and walk. Could get lucky with a spot, but usually not worth the effort. Overall, great pizza, will continue to be a customer no questions asked.

This place is prettyyyyyy good. There are taco stands all over tampa that are essentially the same thing, these guys offer a slightly bigger menu, but it's essentially a basic taco shop, basic tacos, for slightly elevated prices. Food is pretty good don't get me wrong, tacos cmon, can't mess this up, but just not a GREAT spot,
The best. Great portion sizes and fast cooking. The quality was insane, as someone who is from Texas and grew up eating Tex-Mex, this place is legit.

Super fast service, guy at the front was very kind and helpful to me deciding on what i wanted, very low price for the quantity. The steak quesadillas were 9/10, only thing i would say is some of the meat is very thick, and hard to bite into, but overall, amazing restaurant!

Great casual Mexican! This place may not look like much driving by but owners and staff are very friendly and not afraid to get their hands dirty in the kitchen cooking. I tried a variety of items all made fresh down to the chips and guacamole. Tacos and burritos are filled to the brim with fresh ingredients. They make their own in-house hot sauces as well. Nachos were piled high and enough for about 3-4 adults! My favorite dish has to be the quesabirra tacos! They were not skimpy at all filling the tortillas with tender meat paired to dip in the hot consommé! Just may be the best in Tampa!

Very poor business etiquette to post hours in multiple different places and on multiple different platforms if you're not actually going to be open during them. Also poor business etiquette to charge considerably more than what is listed on both Uber and the menu in the restaurant. Shame that they've been having so many issues and discrepancies.

This was my first time at Topgolf and it was very fun! I have played golf since I was 11 years old. My wife is also an experienced golfer. We invited two friends to join us, who have never so much as swung a club. They enjoyed the experience as much as we. 

The check in process was efficient and the staff was friendly and helpful. The clubs are in great condition (although I brought my own). The system that tracks the shots and awards points based on accuracy in hitting positions set at different distances. 

I am not crazy about hitting the ball off of artificial turf and a rubber tee, but I understand that this is the practical way to set things up. 

We were assigned a tee box area that had a low table and couch seating and it was comfortable. 

We did not dine there, but plan to return and have lunch after (or while) we are playing.

First time visitor and I have to say I walked away wanting to come back again soon.   I had made a reservation on-line and check-in was easy.   When we got to our station, our server/golf guide explained how everything worked and took our drink order.   It was a bit chilly, but there were nice overhead heaters which kept us cozy warm.   There was a seating area and plenty of room for us to relax.  There is a variety of clubs from which to choose, which was great.  

We totally enjoyed hitting balls, although many times not so well.  .  Our server came by often to make sure we were ok and that we didn't need anything.   When there were 15 minutes left of our time, our screen asked if we wanted to extend our time.  What a great option!    We chose another half hour which was plenty of time for the four of us.  Our server promptly brought our bill, which included our play time and the drinks.   It was all run very efficiently.

We had wanted to stay for lunch, but the outside eating area was not open and none of us are eating inside restaurants right now, so we had to go and eat elsewhere.    Next time I would get a stall that had a high table, which could easily be used for lunch and drinks.

There is more to Top Golf than golfing believe it or not.... The food is exceptional, service is awesome and the ambiance exudes fun and high energy. 

Great place to host any event, business meeting or even to just grab a drink. Pool tables downstairs. 

Should you want to reserve a bay, you can do that online for a small fee. I prefer the 2nd level near the bar and if lucky, to catch the sunset. :-) 

Check out happy hours, Sunday Funday brunch or go work on your swing. 

This location has it all.

Top Golf is a great place to have a function or a group of people go. IT IS SIMPLY FUN.  The food is not that great and they could use more focus on the food but it is really fun.  I guess you are not really going to Top Golf for the food anyway.

I've been here a handful of times but most recently top golf seems to be more organized. Came here on a Friday night to kick off a birthday weekend. Service was prompt friendly and attentive. You can reserve a bay online prior to your visit which I recommend 1 to 2 days prior for availability. Otherwise they always accept walkins as only a certain amount of bays are reserved. The process is straightforward and everything is done via text including check in to bay assignment number. You can wait in your car or there is a bar area upon entry. 
The wait varied from 15 minutes to 45 minutes upon arrival both times we have done the bay reservation. It simply means you get bumped up to the top of the waitlist upon arrival. Pricing is reasonable given 6 to 8 people per bay per hour. Noteworthy is Tuesdays are half off. There is a five dollar charge for any member who is not currently registered. If you are tech savvy all of that is done at your bay as well. It can be as self serve as you want it or you may ask for help from one of many employees walking by. Overall a pretty chill place to hang out and fun for everyone . My only complaint is when the machine froze we lost some playtime and they were not able to extend it for us. Instead they offered a $10 gift card for the next visit. Which means we will have to spend more coming back of course. If you are paying per minute -I think any time frozen should be extended during your visit. hopefully management will review that policy, 
Or move us to another bay if our location is reserved for the next party .

When my husband and I were making decisions about our wedding day, we instantly knew that we wanted Publix to somehow be a part of it. We had about 80% out of town guests and our biggest desire was to showcase all of the things about "our home" that we love. 

The minute after we booked our venue, they gave me a list of cake bakers. Publix Catering was on there! BINGO! When I first set up a meeting with the women at Publix, they were SO kind and attentive to all of my questions and concerns. They were quick to provide me a list of cake fillings and offer a sample session (which would be done at home due to Covid). I would highly recommend bringing your in-laws or parents to your house and making a night out of it, because we had a blast! We chose the strawberry/banana cream cake and to no surprise, they knocked it out of the park. Our guests literally raved about it all night long. The price of our cake was SO reasonable compared to other bakeries.

The next thing we wanted was food for our bridal party to eat while getting ready. Of course, we had to go with the traditional and well-known pub subs, which did not go to waste. They were fresh, healthy, and absolutely delicious. They were a huge hit. We ordered chicken tenders and fruit as well to ensure all pallets were taken care of. 

Lastly, we wanted to incorporate food as our favors. While picking the catering departments brain, what better option than to do COOKIES! The cookies we chose were heath bar and chocolate chip. Again, another thing our guests raved about.

Do not hesitate to book Publix as your event catering supplier. You will not be disappointed.

Wanted to try a new steakhouse besides Picanha and Taste of Brazil and maybe I should have stuck with what I'm used to. 
Nothing really stood out as there was a small variety of sides and meat selection. There was at least 7 different types of meat and wasn't very appetizing except for the individual steak that they provided and the chorizo. 
The hostess/waitress was very nice but terrible service. At least the worker handling the meat kept on coming around. 

**For 2 AYCE meat, the bill came to around $84!! Why was it so expensive?? I wasn't sure if tip was included as it didn't show on the receipt but I did leave a tip just in case although paying anymore money was a waste.**

Overall, really nice people, but service could be better and for the price you're paying for AYCE, definitely should have more options.
Super good food friendly service very nice people. Many options to choose from clean and quick . Kid's friendly as well .
Very, very good 'za by the slice, Roman style which is thin and airy. I prefer the white slices to the red sauce based ones, but everything is good. Hard to walk by and not get a slice.
After reading all the great reviews, decided to try the Prosciutto and Mozzarella sandwich for $9.50. See photo.

This pizza is actually amazing. I never had Roman inspired pizza but this is so unique in flavor offerings and always cooked at the perfect temperature level.  Crispy, delicious, and quick. My favorite.

Small taco shop with a good sized private parking lot.

I'm always looking for a good taco place in Tampa. Taqueria Gonzalez serves up tasty tacos to order in a small sit-down restaurant. Service was fast when I was there.

I went for lunch. The restaurant was less than half full. There's table service if you're dining in, otherwise, order at the counter for takeout.

I tried the quesobirria, a taco barbacoa, and a pastor taco. They were all pretty good with homemade tortillas. They were on the small side and lighter on the meat than other local places, but 4 tacos definitely left me more than stuffed. The quesobirria tacos were full of melted cheese. I did not receive consomme with them, and maybe that was what felt missing. The green hot sauce was very mild, the red hot sauce was not as hot as at other local taquerias.

I also had a cucumber and limon agua fresca. It was a little too sweet. There's only one size, and it rivals a Big Gulp in size.

Right now, they only take cash.

My mom had some school related workshop on Howard Avenue. She wasn't familiar with the area so she went with some other folks to get lunch at this place.

She ordered Fajitas Mix and brought some home for my Dad and I. It was a mixture of grilled steak/shrimp/chicken/bell peppers/onions and some small tortillas. ($16)

I was nonplussed initially, but when I ate them just now, it was like Zangief did a FINAL ATOMIC BUSTER on my taste buds! (Note to women:  Imagine a 7 ft 400 lb bearded Russian guy doing two suplexes, and then a spinning pile driver on you)

The shrimp pieces were big and juicy. The flavor was still there on the beef/onions/chicken 6 hrs later. There was also rice and beans and pico included. This is even better than Chuy's which is the best I've had so far.

I'm kinda surprised all the white girls havent bombarded this place with reviews. 

GO GO GO!

Great authentic Mexican food for a great price!! Found this gem and they have great prices for their portions size!! Wonderful staff small family owned restaurant great atmosphere! I defiantly recommend bringing in cash for tip they do take card payment but are unable to add tip the ladies defiantly deserve it !

This is my updated review. I have not gone back and I originally have given them 3 stars, but I feel that was a bit too generous given the circumstances. It's been a few months and I can't even think about fish tacos without feeling sick. I simply can not recommend a place if the food has gotten me so sick, which in fact made it hard that night to eat anything else. I really wish I could give them another chance but I won't and I don't recommend them either
We sat at the bar for some drinks and apps prior to a reservation we had elsewhere. The service was spectacular and the bartender was very personable and kind.

El Camino Real is the definition of attention to detail. The pickles that come with certain meals are more than an afterthought and the side of ketchup is deliciously smoky. I enjoyed the Texas Phillycheesesteak but the real winner was my friends steak tacos. You could taste the care this place put into marinading the steak. I am excited to go back, the intersection of Mexican food and bbq is a delicious and hearty place to be. The menu abounds with many different dishes from each cuisine and options to cross over the two.
i ordered thru uber eats. what the entire fuh is this fish taco? the fish is so dried up its like beef jerky. i am so pissed.
Really good food and awesome service. I saw the bad reviews about service, but I had a different experience. The drinks are also very strong 10/10 recommend & will definitely be back again!

I had to convince my wife to try this place just to get everything unseasoned. I had a fried fish sandwich that tasted like nothing, my wife had a deviled crab with the same no seasoning. For a black operated business very disappointing !!!

They always say the best food comes from the places not expected. The interior and exterior is completely run down. I wouldn't come here on a date night but the food is top notch. Best in town really. I have tried many seafood places and most people do not know the flavor of how to make shrimp and pasta taste good. Best place.

We have visited this restaurant many times. Today's take out was incredibly disappointing. 

First of all, I ordered fish and shrimp. There was no whiting so I tried grouper. Once I arrive to pay, I see there is an upcharge for grouper. The menu said +$3. My receipt indicated +$4. I don't question the decision to charge more for grouper, my issue is this nugget of info should have been shared when I placed my order. 

Second, we asked for medium seasoning. The fries were naked and corn was, too. 

Typically I visit on Friday. I didn't see any of the usual faces on the Saturday that I visited. Regardless of the day, I won't be back for awhile. 

What's pictured came to $33. 

Grouper and shrimp dinner
Tilapia dinner
This place was great. It's family owned and operated. Grouper sub with yellow was delicious. Clam strips great. Perch excellent. Crab cakes yummy. Just the place we needed to find.
Second time coming to RSM, they never disappoint! The fish, shrimp is good! The place is very clean and the staff were friendly.
While the food is generally pretty decent, the service is absolutely horrible at the bar. Awful. How insulting coming from a service background, and being treated the way we were today.
Very cute restaurant! Tasty food options at a good price. They have great brunch and lunch options. A fun spot to visit in Fishtown.

Everything we had here was so freaking good!! I ordered the eggs Benedict and you would never know that the hollandaise is vegan!! The ambience was great and our server was super nice! This place had been on my list for so long and I wish I had gone sooner
Great food and even better service. Forget the rest and come to Front Street for the best.

Oh the drinks start you off just right. If you get there around 1130a you will have both breakfast and lunch options available. Servers are COVID compliant, and they have a whole outdoor area. Setting up for a party! Parking is tight and it's right under the El. I had the chicken sandwich topped with bacon and the fries were perfect. I ate everyone else's fries too! I was starving. My cuz got the frittata and she loved it. Her first time having one. She said it was light and fluffy. Chicken tenders also consumed by our party. Big, juicy and crispy. Then there is the chicken breakfast skillet (?) well seasoned and definitely something you made as a kid when bits of this and that were in the fridge. I would return again

Slowest Wendy's I've ever been to. There always a long slow line here. The only time I've never seen a line is when this Wendy's is closed. Avoid this Wendy's unless you like waiting 20-30 minutes plus for your order.

I don't understand why every time I try to get coffee from this particular Dunkin Donuts I never can. The line either takes to long or they have some excuse for why you can't go inside to get coffee. But even it you try to go inside the parking lot is so small you end up getting stuck trying to get out. All I ever want is just some coffee

I had ordered a mobile order and it took over twenty minutes to get it. They were slow and forgot my order. Plus, I saw the lady behind the counter lick her elbow over the food right at the counter! This place is disgusting, slow, and I will never be going here again.

I ordered a Signature Pumpkin Spiced Latte & they gave me a Pumpkin Latte - its def. NOT the same drink because Signature includes whipped cream and a caramel drizzle. I'd avoid this Dunkin if possible except it's the closest one to me so I test it out once a month. I will go to other ones if possible!

Also, the person taking my order was rude. She basically kicked me out of the drive through because they got the drink & price wrong. I was really polite because I know how hard this job is but no excuse to treat a paying customer with disrespect when it was their fault.

Vegan burnt ends sandwich 
Sweet iced tea 
Mac n cheese 
Crispy creme bread pudding

Honestly, every single thing (yes, even the vegan burn ends sandwich) was delicious here! And the fact a BBQ spot also has good vegan options is insane in itself.
Everything was delicious and even though my stomach was not happy with me, I finished it all in one sitting.
Sweet iced tea wasn't overly sweet. Mac n cheese was creamy and a perfect portion of pasta to cheese. The vegan burnt ends - I couldn't even tell the difference between OG burnt ends and the vegan option. The crispy creme bread pudding is a winner and worth all the hype (I'm not a bread pudding fan, and this place hit it).
So go and enjoy! You are welcome.

Worst service ever! Food not worth the price. Fried okra came out burnt to a crisp with my wife's cold brisket. Took back for more they forgot to bring to table. After waiting 20 minutes for my order went to counter they had forgot to even start cooking it. Had them refund my money didn't have time to wait longer! Won't be back!

Let just start off by saying that this place has the best bbq o have found in Tampa so far! Also they are the only place I have seen burnt ends at as well that are so delicious! 
We stopped in because my son saw the sign out his window and wanted the kids hotdog from 4 Rivers which was great because my husband & 8 had no idea what we wanted to eat. We walked in and the place wasn't a busy as I was expecting which was nice because their was no line. I had never been to this location but it is Way bigger than south Tampa that they even have a bakery separate from the bbq section.
We started to order right away I always get the 2x2 but this time I did it with burnt ends and chicken my son got the famous hotdog he had wanted and oh yeah for sides baked beans are a must and the Mac and cheese is all the right cheese and Mac combined.
We picked a table and grabbed our drinks and I sat the whole experience was great the food was and still is amazing every time we eat it 
Now for the best topic of the night Desserts!! No I'm kidding it's the service!! Max who helped us at the bakery won kids hearts over, such amazing service and Thank you so much for the great hospitality!

This restaurant has the potential to be 5 star all the time I believe but my 1st and only visit there I just wasn't happy when I walked out.

I will say 1st it looks very clean and that was welcoming.

Is the staff that interacted with me at the counter  ordering my food  was also very welcoming.

I got the messy pig sandwich and their food is served on kind of a classic barbecue house metal tray.. The name of the sandwich is messy pig however I really did not want to see the food especially the meat fall off to sandwich On to the tray.  I'm not sure why the food is served like this who wants to eat food off of a dirty tray.

Eating the sandwich is where I was really disappointed the flavors were there but is there but the meat was just above cold. I was thinking maybe it's supposed to be served cold old then why would I have a little bit of heat on it. I don't know I just don't have the willpower to send food back unless it's really bad anymore. This is a restaurant that also makes remarks about great service, so they should be on point. 

 The quesadilla was good and their sauce was just as flavorful. 

 It's like I said the flavors were there but with the little notes posted about quality of service that they do around the restaurant it needs to be spot on everytime, take care best wishes.

I don't know who took this place over..... but JUST DON'T.  Clearly a fast food chain employee took this place over,  because I've had better McDonald's food.  JUST DON'T DO IT.  garbage at a high price... in styrofoam!!!!

If I could give negative reviews and I would. I ordered a chicken salad. Not even 5 minutes later, I cancel it as something popped up. I get a call 30 seconds later demanding that I pick up the salad and going forward I have to prepay.  I have never even experienced that. Ii was told an hour then 25 minutes. I gave ample time based on the time I was given. 

So I go in the store to pick up my salad. The young girl who called me- is giving me the rudest smirks and horrible attitude. I talk to the owner and he's like what do you want me to do. How about apologize for what she did or have the girl apologize. How hard is it for someone to say I'm sorry for providing false information. Instead- he tells me there are other pizza shops. Damn straight there is- that's why I go there and not here. I only came because it's across the street from me: 

My salad is decent. If it wasn't for the rude staff- I'd get it again. But moral of the story- treat your customers with respect.  A simple apology goes a long way.   

Now I get the bad reviews even though the owner claims new ownership.

We ordered food for a work meeting - just over $200 worth of food including tip. When the food arrived, it was unlabeled, so we had to open each individual box and sandwich to figure out whose food was whose. It's not that hard to write "chicken" or "steak" on the outside of a box/sandwich. In addition, several of the items were not what we ordered - including buffalo wings with no buffalo sauce, and a fried flounder sandwich that came with no sandwich. I called the restaurant to inform them about these errors, spoke to a manager, and the manager refused to apologize and did not offer any refund or credit. We will not be ordering from them again.

We have ordered from this place since they first opened at the location across the street from where they are now. Against my better judgement since the place has changed hands and changed quality  I ordered a salad and wings tonight and  an hour later I am still waiting . I called to check on the order and the person who answered could give me no information. The service is the awful since they changed hands . Say what you want about the women that used to work the counter under the old owner , they knew what was going on with your order . If they had to call a driver they did. I stopped ordering pizza from here  but thought I could do a small order but I guess not . I'm done.
Ordered a Stromboli through GH, this particular restaurant delivers in house, so GH doesn't contract a driver. My food never showed up, was over an hour of my time wasted. I do not recommend.

Definitely the worst food I've ever had :/
Spaghetti with sausage was just mushy noodles basic sauce and HOT DOGS LOL
fries were bland 
Even the ketchup tastes cheap
Great soul food.  Oxtails, chicken, greens, pudding, rice and gravy, macaroni and cake!  Very clean on the inside!  The cooks are hilarious!

I'm from outta state and came down here looking for good places to eat at.  I love soul food like who doesn't?!? I ordered the fried chicken combo with fries and a key lime cake. I should've known something was up when I tried a fry and it was soggy and hot tasted like it was made in a microwave. Now the chicken‍. I'm very disappointed. I opened the box and seen 6 pieces of fried chicken I bit into one and it was tasteless literally tasteless. Just horrible! The cake was the best part and it still wasn't that good. I've never had soulless food before until now!
This restaurant has the best food.... omg!!!!! I would eat there everyday of I could , the green, yams, cornbread you name it everything is just fantastic.

If I could give 0's then I would!! I keep giving this place chances but this is my last and final time. First of all, you can never get through when you call and when you do succeed they place you on hold and forget about you. Gave them another chance on 9/10/21 when I placed/paid for an online order took the 20 minute commute to get there and they had a sign posted stating they were closed for a few days. Needless to say they never updated nor shutdown there online ordering status which is through a third party vendor and I paid $38.67. I contacted the company Menufy whom I placed the order through and after there investigation was complete I was then refunded my money within a few days. The foods not great, it's a hit and miss anyway and the level of professionalism, courtesy lacks. Totally done with this place, I tried!!

Is this place even ever open? They state that they take phone orders and delivery. They never answer the phone during their posted "open hours". Some menu items they just don't make. Their hours are weird. How is a soul food place not open on a SUNDAY? Like, what? Their hours online, on their website and what's on their front physical door does not match up either. Drive there with the fam during posted open hours and they were closed. Do better
Worst Popeyes I've ever been to. Read the reviews DO NOT GO HERE. Staff is even worst, since the moment you walk in. No source of customs service. RUN IF YOU CAN

My first time. Here 645 pm aftwr looking at all the bad reviews I almost did not want to come walk in and the service was good the food was hot And fresh that's all that matters. To me  but the women  the was taking the orders was calling ppl hun and sweetie. Other then that 5

I wish I could leave a 0 on this review. This is the worst place I have been. They are disrespectful and rude. I am paying customer and at the bare minimum they should treat their customer with respect. If you can somewhere else go they are plenty of restaurants around. Biggest mistake ever to come here
Nasty attitude even over the intercom in drive thru. Poor service poor personalities it's employees like this that ruin a business

This place is absolutely awful. It's overpriced and the burgers are totally inedible. My stomach hurt instantly!! The pictures online are so deceiving, when they give you a burger that looks like a thin slice of cardboard and a plastic bun. I will never eat here again.

This place was pretty decent . I had the Philly cheesesteak and two different salads . The salads are so big and so yummy . I wish the Philly cheesesteak bread was toasted but all and in it was delicious . It also was pretty quick when it came . And still nice and warm . I also got the brownie , it was extremely fudgy and needed a little salt but it was decent
The place to go for vegan junk food. I feel extremely guilty but happy at the same time.

I've heard so much about HipCityVeg and I'm glad I was able to finally check out their food. For those that do not know, everything here is Vegan!! The store is location right in the heart of University City by UPenn's campus  and when I went in, it was packed with college students. As for the menu, I wanted to try as many things as I possibly could. So here's a list of the things that I've tried. 

Chicken nuggets
Smokehouse Burger
Vanilla milk shake

For vegan/health conscience eaters out there I highly recommend. It so refreshing to be able to eat bomb vegan food with flavor. I would most certainly recommend the smokehouse burger, I truly could taste the different. 10/10!

Happy eating

Not always the fastest, but damn it's tasty!!!! Crispy Hip City chicken sandwich (sauce on the side or it's just too much and sandwich falls apart) is amazing and so filling. Sunny side Sausage breakfast is awesome too. Just can't go wrong here!
Heaven!  Best cheesesteak in Philly!  Tried all the hype but Sorrentinos is the real deal. And real Philly soft pretzels!  I'm planning on proposing to the lovely lady who made my sandwich!  So good.

Absolutely terrible quality of food. I've been here a couple of times per covid and it was fine and not sure what happened but it's absolutely a place to avoid now. We got 5 dishes the wait took a long time, the quality was so bad and the portion size was so small compared to the price that we paid. For reference I am Cantonese and know what these dishes taste like if they were made properly. 

The first was the pineapple fried rice and it was so sad. They used canned pineapples but they didn't even look diced like they straight up poured it out the can, strained it, and threw it in fried rice. It didn't come in a pineapple (which I supposed makes sense if they don't use real pineapple but comon the picture had a pineapple isn't it false advertising at this point). The flavor was also really unimpressive. 

The garlic pea leaves we got were supposed to be stir fried but they BOILED it. There was no flavor at all. I can't believe they boiled it.. either they are super short staffed in the kitchen or they absolutely don't care anymore. Nothing on the pictures look like that came on the table. 

The Dan Dan noodle portion was so small. The flavor was okay but overall not good and wouldn't get again. 

The dry pot chicken was also sad. The coating And the chicken didn't mix well at all. And the texture was all wrong. I'm not sure how they messed this up but they really did. It was also really really salty. 

The chongqin noodles were okay. Not a super huge fan but the portion size was also really small. 

Over all we paid over 80 dollars and not everyone was full there was 4 of us. What and epic waste of time, money, and rental space. Honestly I am so upset I don't think I will ever come back this experience was absolutely abysmal.
Very good ramen & duck. But a veggie dish included little tofu and dry noodles. It seems items are inconsistent.

Great food for the price!

The shrimp rolls were packed with shrimp - we were shocked at how full they were.

The Dan Dan noodles were just okay. I probably wouldn't order those again. 

The chicken with broccoli was good. Classic/traditional taste. 

We will definitely keep Sang Kee Noodle House in mind for a rainy day lazy meal.
Love this place, I have no ideas why the reviews are mediocre. I've been coming here for lunch for ages.
Great food and very cheap for how good the food is. We had green beans, pork belly, fried spicy chicken, and boiled fish. Every part was delicious!

As long as I can remember being in West Philly Makkah has been a go to place for anything Middle Eastern. It always has been a bit intimidating being an Asian woman to go in here; usually the place is filled with men, few women, and narrow aisles. When Al-Rayyan market opened up around the corner I started going there because it was more sanitized and more women shoppers were there. 
However, let me tell you, Makkah is a gem. I have been looking for Aleppo peppers everywhere and could not find any. I took a chance and went today, and voilà! Found one! I even bought the bean pie! Wow! 

As intimidating as it is, I have always found Makkah employees to be helpful, and kind. It is also open 24 hours, with all sorts of homemade prepared Middle Eastern food, and desserts. They have a barbershop upstairs, and also kitchenware, clothes, etc upstairs as well. Thank you for making my day!

I love this cool little grocer in west philly. There's two levels consisting of your grocery staples along with a clothing and gift shop of the second level amongst other things. My fave part by far is the food bar. It's small, but you really get that homegrown feel of food without having to travel too far. It's essential to take your time the first time here just to see everything  from the unique spice options to the international food selections.

This market is truly a gem! I came here just on a whim and was so delighted by all their options. It's a pretty small place but they have so much stuff and you could really take your time to check everything out. I got a bunch of goodies. Really love their baklava. I'm a little obsessed actually because I went three times in the last week lol. They also have hot food that looks really yummy but I have not tried it yet but I plan to

The best halal food truck in University City. The halal mix veggie and falafel over rice are just out of this world. Perfect flavor. Sauces are good. Sometimes the red can be a little too intense for me, but the white sauce is perfect. 

Always friendly service with a smile. Obviously, a great price point for all of the food that you receive. Highly recommend this place!
Ordered 4 dishes for take out New Year's Eve. When we got home realized only 2 of 4 were in bag. Hungry and unhappy.

Lovely restaurant and staff. I've ordered close to a dozen times in the past year and yesterday was my first trip dining in. Their shrimp pad Thai is my go to dish! Wish I was a bit more adventurous with their menu but maybe in due time. Pickup times are very accurate when ordering out and their site is convenient and simple. I also like that you can customize the spice level and even though I eat every part of their dish, I never leave feeling uncomfortably stuffed. You can tell they use quality ingredients and not a lot of oils or additives and my body really appreciates that lol
A revelation. True virtuoso sushi!  Relaxed, intimate and oh so delectable!  Best in the city! A

Dasiwa hits the spot when you're craving Asian and udon, gyoza, sushi or just need some white rice for take out because you're me and you're lazy to cook rice. It's a neat spot in the neighborhood. I've been here a few times and ordered take out numerous of times. The service has always been good.

The coffee is fine, the food is great. I gave four stars because the friendliness of the staff is hit or miss. I tend to go to the monkey and the elephant which is a short walk away because they're just as good, the establishment is beautiful and the staff is always on point.

IMunch Cafe offered everything I desire in a neighborhood establishment.  

1) Friendly staff
2) Food prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients 
3) WiFi
4) Strong a$$ Lattes!

Just visiting Philly for the first time and was looking for a quick bite to eat while visiting Fairmont Park. I was blown away by the food here. Got the bean burger and a smoothie. They used top quality ingredients on both and they tasted amazing. Not only that, it was a great portion size at an amazing price. Would most definitely be back if I'm ever back in Philly. Great spot!
We went here for breakfast. The food was OK, but none of us liked their coffee. So if you crave a good coffee, don't come here for it.

I love this place. Everything is always fresh, deliciously flavorful, and well portioned. I've tried a bunch of stuff on their menu from breakfast, lunch sandwiches, salads, and smoothies. I'm never disappointed. Favs include French toast, herby chicken salad sandwich, crab cake sandwich, and their Greek salad. The guys who work here are always super nice too.

I am new to the area and a
Starting my quest to find a decent Chinese food place that is not a buffet.  I ordered the lunch combo with General Two's chicken.  The pork fried rice was bland, the chicken tasted like rancid oil, and the to go bag did not include soy sauce, napkins, or chop sticks.  There was not an option to self-serve those items either.  

I checked with a local business person who confirmed that my experience was common for this establishment.

Very expensive for poor quality food. The orange chicken was soggy and the rangoons were extremely over fried and practically empty, it was just crispy folded dough. Really disappointing.. smh. Honestly the worst in the area..

This is my hidden Dominican spot. Prime time is lunch-early dinner. Food is fresh and sells quickly before late evening. Once they are out of a dish, it's over, so get there early or call and ask for it to be put to the side. They now have more English speaking employees, so good for non Spanish speaking customers. Can't go wrong with anything here to be honest.

I don't leave many reviews but this place is a gem! I haven't been inside l, but I've been using Uber eats for a couple years and this is by far the best soul food spot I've eaten. The menu is small and simple. But every item is consistently well prepared and served with huge portions. Well seasoned, perfectly prepared. Thomasena puts her foot in this for real. Every item is what you would expect but more in portion. The only thing I can say negative is there is no beverages to order from Uber eats. Not sure if they have a sweet-tea or lemonade on site but that's the only thing I can say bad. I highly recommend Thomasena's to anyone craving some excellent soul food with sharable size dishes. Keep it up guys!

Wow! The people on the neighborhood app "NextDoor" were raving about this place, so I had to try it. Hands down, the BEST fried Fish Platter I have EVER had. It was so light and fluffy but flavorful. The Baked Macaroni & Cheese was amazing. The Candied Yams were a little dry, because all the sauce settled at the bottom but man, they were so well done, and not slippery/slimy lol. They were out of potato salad, so they refunded my card for the cost. Thoroughly enjoyed my meal. Soooo good. Great sized portions!

Ordered delivery from Buk Chon and it was absolutely DELICIOUS. The army stew was incredibly tasty and authentic, and the spicy pork was out of this world. Cannot wait to try more dishes, so far this is my favorite Korean spot in Philly. Great price as well for everything!

My partner and I decided to try a new restaurant tonight and she chose Buk Chon. Great decision. The restaurant is modern, cozy, and has a very chill ambience. Great service. We tried the Korean fried chicken, bibimbap w/shrimp , spicy pork bowl, and hibiscus tea. Everything was fresh and delicious. The spice of the pork bowl was perfect. This was for sure some of the best food I've had since I've lived in Philly.
Amazing!!! Loved all the food and great service!  We loved the sizzling plates and bowls, definitely a new favorite spot

First time here in old city and loved the food. Soft tofu stew was the exact thing I wanted in the cold weather. Piping hot, super soft fresh tofu and veggies and Super delicious ...slurp slurp! Also tried the Shrimp Kimchi Paella that was really flavorful too. Korean Pear Punch was so refreshing. Great place and good service. Lovely ambiance. I will come back again to try their green onion pancakes as they looked really good in pics.
The food here is wonderful. It's BYOB but a nice liquor store is around the corner. The service was really nice and polite. I loved the menu (the actual design of the menu) every bite was delicious.

By far they have the best pizza I've ever had. Can't attest to anything else because (nom nom nom) I get fixated on the amazing pizza and garlic bread they have. 

As we were leaving I saw the server bring out tacos and something else that looked amazing. I will expand my pallet and try something different next time we come. But I swear if you're looking for some bomb ass pizza, definitely coke here. 

Parking isn't the greatest but I've lucked up each time I've come to find parking in front, up the street a bit or around the corner.

Food: 
Mac n cheese (shells and cheese) was way too salty- like it came straight out of the Pacific Ocean.
Philly chicken: dry, plain, bread was straight out of the bag- not even warmed up. No toppings.
Caesar salad was the saving grace which we used to top the Philly chicken sandwiches, especially since the salad was slathered in ranch. 

Service: 
Waiter was rude and did not seem like she wanted to be there. Turns out 20% gratuity is already included so I guess what's the point in being polite? 

Probably should have only gotten drinks for this kind of place/service.

Decided to try this place based off the reviews and advertisement of bottomless mimosas. Forgot that parking in this area is pretty none existent and that I should've used a car service but I lucked up and found a spot about a block away.
