Upon entry, we were greeted and seated and our server (Cara) immediately came and took our drink orders. I wasn't able to drink the bottomless mimosa alone so we ordered a tropical and pineapple mimosa and the tropical one was really good and sweet. 
During brunch hours (11am-3pm) they don't have the chicken parmigiana but they do have the chicken parm pizza which was amazing. OMG, I will certainly come back for another pizza. 
We also ordered the garlic cheesy bread which I couldn't stop eating and hours later was still burping garlic...I loved it. We also ordered the chicken wings and chicken tenders which were also good but just come close to the pizza and cheesy bread. 
 
Definitely worth trying again, will take advantage of the bottomless mimosas, and will use a car service to get here.

Excellent brunch! Ordered the chicken tenders and they came out piping hot! They do have bottomless mimosas for $35 and it's worth it! My glass has not gone empty. Please ask for Cara, she it the best!

It was awesome finding a great bottomless brunch in the city. I love the location of this place in Old City. It's super walkable and accessible via SEPTA. There's indoor and outdoor seating, but we decided to sit inside and enjoy the speakeasy feel and Halloween decorations. I got the two style eggs scrambled with cheese, bacon, and a biscuit. My friend got something similar except hers came with a brown gravy. For the most part, the eggs were cooked well, the bacon was a bit too crispy for our liking and the biscuit was super dry and not flavorful. The mimosas were really good and for the price I will definitely be coming back to enjoy them. Overall Bourbon and Branch has decent food especially if you're trying to get food quick. If anything, I'd recommend if you go to definitely get the bottomless mimosas.

Ever just stop and say I'll grab a slice to curb my hunger ?  Yeah that's how we walked into John's.   

This was absolutely delicious and I will admit hear "how can I help you baby" from a woman older then I totally made my day.

Ming Gardens is a solid spot for Chinese take out in Tampa. My orders have always been delivered super quickly and everything tastes fresh. They have some of the best egg drop soup that I've ever had, and have some funky fusion options on the menu, like cheesesteak egg rolls. Their broccoli dishes are wonderful too. Despite the low price point, portions are massive, so keep that in mind when ordering!

Best chinese take out in Tampa
Don't let the location or appearance fool you
The food is awesome, the portions are huge and the price is unbelievably reasonable.

Is anyone aware of this place changing ownership recently? They were my go to for Chinese, always hot, fresh, and awesome! About a month or so ago, the food quality dropped substantially. Lo Mein noodle over cooked and stuck together, almost zero tofu in what was once a delicious hot & sour soup. Also eggs in the soup which used to be vegetarian.

If they did change hands, the new folks are nowhere near the old ones

This is my favorite Chinese food place I've ever had outside of New York City! All the food I have gotten from there is so good especially the sesame chicken and general tso! 10/10 recommend I have told all of my friends about this place and every single one of them also becomes obsessed with it!
Was really good.  Ordered through Uber Eats and delivered hot.  House Special Lo mein and fried wings were great!

We recently had a retirement dinner party for a co-worker at the Plough and the Stars, and the event turned out fantastic. Prior to our decision for a location, we researched a couple of venues, but after dealing with the Plough's owner, Marion Ryder, along with her husband-business partner Jerome and their business partner Austin it was a simple decision. We had the second-floor balcony area to ourselves with a fully stocked bar for our beverages of choice.

Erin, the manager, coordinated the set-up for the dinner party and was very accommodating to our needs. Our server, Katrina, and the bartender, Ruairi, provided exceptional personable service the entire evening.

A special thanks to the Chef and the kitchen staff. Our menu selection was a Caesar Salad, Guinness Casserole (Angus Beef slowly braised with Guinness, Carrots & Onions), Roasted Spring Chicken Breast with a Red Wine Mushroom Sauce, and Atlantic Salmon in a lemon caper white wine sauce. Coupled with Plough's famous homemade brown bread and other condiments, the dinner buffet was spectacular.

At the conclusion of our event, a view of us stopped for a nightcap at Plough's main bar on the 1st floor, and had the pleasure of being served by bartender John-Joe, who always has a good story and funny joke to tell all.
Thank you Plough and the Stars for a remarkable evening!

Adorable and so nicely decorated for the holidays. Good selection of beers and cider. Food was just barely OK. Burger was very thin, overcooked and fries were extra. Omelette was also overcooked and came with an exceedingly small portion of roasted potatoes. Definitely go to drink, and maybe snack, but not for a meal.

This bar is great. Really cool space and the food is delicious. I usually get the fish and chips or an order of wings. But I've been known to dabble in the shepherd's pie, it's also in a really great part of town. And I've noticed the people there are a pleasure to talk to. Put it on your list.

The only spot open for breakfast, and what a great find! Staff was so kind and welcoming. Yes I had a burger for breakfast as I am definitely not a breakfast person but all in all this place was delicious.  Cozy looking pub with a beautiful set up and fire place. Great selection on beer and other spirit's.

Didn't eat here, but partied here for Halloween. I love the architecture inside and would love to come back for food. DJ was good and kept the party going. There's a bar on the main level and upper level so plenty of options. Thanks for a fun night: I will be back for any holiday party they have!

Cheese steak bao buns and the Dan Dan noodles for the win. Bao buns are crispy and happy a perfect cheesy, spicy, slightly salty taste. Dan Dan noodles are creamy and delicious -- suggest adding chili oil
This is NOT your typical Dim Sum. This is great, hip, modernized Asian tapas. Really excellent all around. Favorites were the pork ribs and caterpillar bread, but honestly it was all good.

Sat at the bar. Great atmosphere. Bartender was really nice. Food was on the expensive side for what it was. You can get just as good dumplings for half the price in chinatown. That being said, the food was delicious and the beer I had was tasty. So not much bad to say, just that it was pricy for what it was. I'll probably just go to Chinatown next time.

We stopped in for a very quick bite late at night just before they closed and ordered the shrimp dumplings, the soup dumplings, and the Dan Dan noodles. The food was good. I'm sure this is one of those places where you can order anything on the menu and it will taste good. BUT I definitely think it's a bit overpriced considering how much food you get relative to going to a real dim sum place. The neighborhood is pretty far from Chinatown and if you need a quick fix then this is a good spot however, if you can make the trip to Chinatown you can get more bang for your buck.

Bing Bing is always clutch! Honestly it is my favorite place to go after a rough week. It's my favorite place to go to celebrate. It has an amazing happy hour, good food, staff that is overly accommodating, and it is always a good time.
The beer selection is fantastic! Probably one of the best bars for beer in the city. The food is not great. I come here strictly for the beer.

Ate lunch here and had a great experience. 3/3 on meals with beef brisket sandwich, beef stew and corn chowder. Good beer selection as well. 

Our bartender (maybe the owner as well?) was very pleasant and made our experience positive. 

We would recommend!

Such a great spot! I believe this is where Mad River used to be and such a great use of this space. Excellent apps -- their stuffed mushrooms are the best I ever had and the wings are hearty and delicious. Great atmosphere and excellent happy hour. Staff is super friendly and engaging.

Stumbled upon this place accidentally and was not disappointed! I've never been to a bar that serves so many different kinds of beers AND has amazing food.

Everything from their beer selection, to the menu, the atmosphere, and their hospitality, is amazing! I was here for brunch and had the octopus, some type of ceviche dish, and the vegan pumpkin cake. BUT the best part (and I'm sorry if I butcher the description but it's not on their menu anymore) was these raw tuna bites which were one of the best things I've tasted in a long time. Like I said earlier, I was so surprised at how good their food tasted. All while they had old records playing and the Liverpool game on tv (such a vibe). 

Our waiter/barman seemed very knowledgeable and was very hopeful with the menu. Later found out from their website that he is the owner!

I would definitively come back here again and recommend this place to any of my friends who go to Philly. Wish it was closer to there I lived because I would come here all the time with my friends.

Robust, diverse beer selection 
Friendly, outgoing staff
Outrageously tasty food

A friend and I stopped in here on a Sunday afternoon as the Eagles game was wrapping up, hoping for a quality beer selection and decent food, given the good ratings. Instead, we were treated to a beer menu we were thrilled with, and meals we couldn't believe were so mouthwatering. 

The bottle/can listing is really strong, with offerings from local and national micro/nano-brewers, plus Belgians that would be at home on Monk's menu. Meanwhile, draft lines represent fresh offerings primarily from intriguing craft brewers around the nation. I love ordering beers that are harder to find due to their limited distribution, vintage, or similar (I'm an unabashed Untappd dork), and I was completely thrilled with what I found. 

Food - I had a vegan Banh Mi and my buddy had a burger. I needed to keep slowing myself down to savor the food, so strong was my inclination to just house it as fast as I could. My buddy also said the braised brisket sandwich was delectable. Even each of the sauces, the cole slaw, and fries were a treat. 

The environment was open, welcoming, and accommodating to conversation while also taking in the game (emphasis more on enjoying the company you keep versus an overly-loud TV).   All of the staff was attentive, knowledgeable, friendly, funny, and seemingly enthused to be there. 

I'm only in Philadelphia about five times a year, but after such a smashingly successful first try, Glory is now firmly on my repeat-visit list. Outstanding!

Hawkeyes pizza is the best independent pizza restaurant in the Tampa Bay area, especially their 24-inch pizza. Looking to feed a big party then order that Big Boy pizza. Can't for their new store to open.
Great place with incredible genuine food and a hard working man running the place. I highly recommend coming here for the best Korean food and supporting this family.
Love this place. Great food, exceptional service, clean little restaurant. I can't recommend it highly enough

Not great, not bad.  I ordered the beef dolsot bimbimbap.  Skip the dolsot if you are expecting the rice to get crispy - it doesn't.  Small portion, light on the meat, but it tasted okay.  We ate in, but I think due to this damn covid thing, we didn't get any banchan.
If I came back here, I would probably go for just the veggie bimbimbap - a better value for the money.

Was in the area and checked Yelp for some good eats. Came across this place. I didn't even know there was a bibimbap specialty place nearby.

I kind of like the concept of a stand alone bibimbap place. The dining area of the restaurant isn't currently open, so you can call in an order or walk up. I walked up and ordered and received my food relatively quickly.

I ordered the dolsot bibimbap with beef. I didn't know how the dolsot bibimbap was made without the stone bowl, which usually cooks the rice while your eating, so you can a nice crust around your rice towards the end of your meal. Basically the dolsot bibimbap to go was mimicking that experience with frying the ingredients before serving. At first, I thought the portion size was a bit small, but after eating it, I was surprised how filling it was. The gochujang or hot sauce was mixed in. The food was cooked well and it tasted great. It had a good amount of spice.

The only compaint I had about this place was that it's a bit pricey for my specific order. It was close to $14 for a relatively small rice dish. Maybe next time I may order a dish without the dolsot ($1) and beef ($3) upgrade and see how it is. The vegetable bibimbap seems decently priced at $8.95.

BOTTOM LINE: eat here! Short menu with reliable reliable tasty Korean staple dishes. The owner is so nice and thoughtful and I'm so glad we are close enough to eat here at least once a week! A total understated find for south street area Asian food!

We were waiting in an empty restaurant for 45 minutes after being told it will be a 20 minute wait. When asked what was going on they said to go orders were a priority and couldn't serve us until the to go orders where done.  They said it could be another half an hour

I had a great experience at Psomi this weekend. It was my second time visiting and it did not disappoint. You can tell the wait staff is working hard and they keep everything moving. The food came out very quick and was to die for. I got the Keftede sub and the hummus appetizer. Both were insanely good and I took some home to finish only an hour later, it was that good. We sat in the front where you don't need a reservation. A table took a little bit to empty and then clear but by the time we got there and sat down it was only about 10 minutes. It's such a lovely place and atmosphere and I can't stop thinking about that food. I'll absolutely be back.

A hip Greek lunch/brunch establishment with a beautiful ambiance and indoor outdoor seating. Came here on a Saturday for brunch with a larger party but made a reservation well in advance. Psomi had an extensive menu with lots of bakery items, alcoholic drinks, coffee/tea, and food. 

From the bakery, we got the baklava and bougatsa. Would highly recommend the baklava as it's one of the best I've had. Comes in a small piece, but well worth it. Baklava can sometimes get mushy but this one stayed firm together with lots of layers. 

For coffee, got the latte which you can customize wi the special flavoring. Tried the baklava syrup which was great and came with a cute little pastry on the side. 

For appetizers, we got the octopus ceviche and treis which was great for the table. The pita bread is light and fluffy and also one of the best I've had. 

For food, highly recommend the lamb burger, the grilled octopus horiatiki, pork gyro and lamb burger. Fries are also amazing that come with the burger. 

Overall a cute, hip place to come for a girls brunch or date on a nice day!
The food was amazing! My husband and I went to Greece a few years ago and the food here reminds me of the incredible menus we experienced. Definitely a favorite of mine.

I really enjoyed my meal here. I fell in love with loukoumades after spending a lot of time in Greece and any place that offers them earns my "they must know their Greek food" trust. I enjoyed them with a cup of coffee, but they were more like funnel cake pieces. Delicious, but not round and doughy. I'll happily eat here again and can't wait to bring friends and family.

A super modern and fun place to visit for some greek food. Parking is pretty annoying here because it's so popular and it be difficult to park. The decor is super modern and nice here. Service is pretty good and attentive. The food is a modern take on some classic Greek and Mediterranean dishes, not always the best remakes but overall still tasty.

First let me say that I was really excited to try this place....
Ordered steamed chicken dumplings and they came out frozen in the center.  I mean completely frozen...
Then we ordered the ribs as another appetizer and they seemed to be microwaved.   Not appetizing at all.

For our main course we ordered the chicken chow fun and the shrimp fried rice.  While better than the appetizers, fell way below some of the noodle bars in Vegas.  

All in all, if you're starving and have enough comp to cover it, it's decent.  If you are paying, go to the bakery or someplace nearby.  Hope this helps

Love this place. Have to eat here every time I come or stay at Hard Rock.  Definitely pricey but  what can u say... your at the Hard Rock. Everything is pricey. 

They give really good portions and very consistent food. 

Haven't had anything here I didn't like.  My favorite is the spicy cucumber salad which I eat as a side w meal for an extra kick. 

Only down side is they don't do take-out. But it is probably what keeps it consistent so kitchen doesn't get overwhelmed mass producing food. 

I just take time to sit in and make sure to order enough to go. :)

This place is probably the busiest restaurant in the Seminole Hard Rock Casino. As many times as I've been to casino I've never eaten here. Mainly because the line is always so long but thankfully I finally had the opportunity to see what the hype was all about. All my friends go here consistently and brag about how good the food is. This place did not disappoint at all. I had a Jubao rice bowl which was chicken , shrimp and pork with fried rice. Everything was perfect. Next time I'll definitely have to try the pho which I mainly here the most about . I will be back very soon to give the rest of the menu a try. Make sure you go hungry because the servings are pretty big as well. I definitely recommend checking this place out when at the casino
Doesn't matter what you order from the menu, it's ALL great! I believe if they had a dirt sandwich on the menu, it would be delicious.

After my last mammogram i was bumb out n decided to go to Hard rock casino n find some joy. I totally forgot this place was here. As i rode the escalator downstairs I remembered there was a ramen place i wanted to visit! You have to go towards the right n it's hidden in the back nearby the asian slots machines. It's always packed n has huge lines! My luck i just walked right in! You can see the roasted ducks hanging in the kitchen, chefs ate all focused on the freshly cook meals n the staff outside are friendly. Got walked in to a wall bar table, sharing The company to another gentleman. For those worried about the rona? You may want to ask for a table. I was comfortable with whatever they offer me as long as i feel safe. It was nice n comfortable hidden spot for me to do my rating in privacy. The minute i sat, a waitress showed up out if nowhere. Delightful n kind. I went with the Kirin beer one of my favorites on asian beers. Not to sweet nor bitter. Kinda taste like a corona with a zang. I stared at the menu and wambam! I saw it! Duck Ramen! I went with udon noodles, i never had them fresh made. A couple minutes in she delivered my meal n i lost my composure! I joyfully shouted; "oh my god! This is just sooo BEAUTIFUL!!" The waitress laughed with me. I praised the dish for the presentation n how amazing it smells! She thanked me, warned me the plate was hot! i just sat there full of joy n curiosity. The dish is massive! I wasn't expecting it to be this big! It had 1/4 duck on top but it was huge! The broth simmered, the heat was there alluring my tastes buds. It was maddening, so well done! The smells were so orgasmic! No lie! My body quivered from joy. I took the ladle spoon and sunk it down. picking up some my first sip just brought so much joy! I blushed n danced on my chair. Great food hits me like that! The gentleman next to me, smiled witnessing my overjoy with my meal! The broth was so tasty! Gentle but then picked up in flavor the longer i held it in my mouth. It was well balanced! No matter where i picked it from. It was perfect l! I could tell the broth was 100% made from duck meat! It had the gamy taste i love from roast duck n the lovely spices they add to curing it with. The Duck? It was phenomenal! They give u a side dish fir the bones. I was really impressed. I usually buy roast duck from the asian market in brandon n its always to greasy. This one? No way comparable to this! Very meaty, tender n the grease nowhere to be found! The skin was nice n thin. I even crushed the bones in my mouth! The Udon was so fresh! Gummy n elastic, not soggy. The was all well balanced plate. I found lettuce in the bottom of the plate. Crunchy n very green. I saw the plate of the gentleman next to me. He ordered a combination plater. That man was about 6'3" athletic build n he couldn't finish his massive meal! I can definitely say this with confidence! For the price vs the size of these meals? This is a very amazing business! Prices aren't high either! U can bring the whole family n not break your bank! I was so blessed to come here. I will definitely come back with my family. I seriously recommend this restaurant. They may not have desserts but noooo problem! Theres the main confectionery in the lobby and on top of amazing desserts? They are affordable to. Do yourself a favor n come on down!  Make sure to come right before lunch cuz by dinner? There's always a huge line outside!

The Szechuan Beef is really good, and has not made me sick yet. The restaurant smells like an open sewer. I keep going back, I just try to get in and out as fast as possible. The children that seem to run the place are not very friendly, it seems like they would have noticed the horrible smell. Maybe they have gone "nose blind."

We got our food delivered to our hotel. Very fast delivery and they brought it all the way up to our room. All the food tasted great and was still warm. Staff were friendly. Good prices. I'm usually leery about Chinese take-out because it is very hit-n-miss....but this place was awesome. If you're ever staying at a nearby hotel and need to order in, give it a try!

Came here for a quick bite while out and about. Nothing quick about this visit. Waited over 10 minutes just to be acknowledged and another 15 to get simple drinks. I stopped counting waiting for the food. Ordered fish and chips and they where delicious. Husband ordered Sheppard's pie and since he was starving, he ate it. The flavor was definitely not traditional. He said it tasted like taco meat seasoning. I decided to taste it and indeed tasted like chili. Lots of cumin... in a sheppard's' pie? Won't return even though fish and chips where good. There are other places that are much better overall for service and food, i.e., The Wild Rover Brewery.
Wings were better than the chains! Meaty and lots of flavor options! We chose Habanero Chili(mellow sweet) and hot for a 20 piece. Magners cider and Murphy's red. Will be back!

Go somewhere else. We waited 20 minutes for our draft beers and our food never arrived. When we asked our server after waiting over half an hour, she admitted she forgot to put in our food order. I used the bathroom before we left - filthy and no toilet paper.
We've been coming here for many years, almost since it opened. Fantastic food, friendly staff, and great atmosphere!

Maybe it's just best to come here during the day, lol. Loved this place when I first tried it and came back. On my second visit though it wasn't good. Ordered the dark and stormy and it tasted like a extra sweet flat soda so wack and the manager refused to take it back, so either I force myself to drink it or it's a waste. Which is bad business ethics. My wings were soggy. I ordered hot wings and they tasted like they were below mild. It was over all just a wack experience. I liked them the first time but after going to 2 locations and being disappointed in the same night I'm good. Its basically robbery. I explained I didn't like the drink I wasn't intending on drinking the drink and I still have to pay for it and they didn't care that my wings were soggy. Like if you're just broke and need the money just say that. I've never been to a restaurant where customers were really unsatisfied and they didn't do anything to try to fix it. What a loser. Now I get why their reviews are so bad. This place ain't gonna make it much longer with these business ethics and I don't care attitude. Unless this place is in a area where quality doesn't matter and they are use to being treated this way. Enjoy the $63!!

Best hot chocolate!!!! It is super addictive and didn't taste too sweet (I feel like every hot chocolate I get usually is too sweet). The deep fried cannoli was so heavy (granted that should have been expected since it was deep fried).

Came here at 8 PM on a Sunday and had the loveliest experience since moving to Philadelphia last November! Ordered a Blonde Expresso after asking what the lady serving liked the most, let me tell you... THE BEST EXPRESSO I HAVE EVER HAD. And coming from someone who's been deployed to countries such as France, Spain, and Singapore I've really acquired a taste for different coffees so it was nice to have something with this quality just a hop skip from my own dwelling. A chocolate shelled cannoli and scoop of cheesecake gelato, which was also so so yummy! Just sitting in the store and looking at all the miscellaneous articles and decorations themselves was fun! One thing I enjoy the most about places like this is the tight knit environment, ended up talking to the lady about their antique coffee grinder, roaster, and their amazing futuristic expresso machine (For real ask them, it's amazing). In summary, just go. You won't regret it!

This is one of thee best espresso places I've ever been to! The cannoli was to die for and I've had cannolis in other places and these are the real deal! The nutty latte is a peanut butter lovers dream!!! The owners of the cafe are so sweet and welcoming ! Make time to go to this place !!!

First time getting a pizza from this place, & honestly, it beats some of the old standbys in the neighborhood when it comes to flavor.

Ordered the largest size with sausage & basil & it was the spiciest tasting pizza I've had in the longest time. The golden browned cheese & thin crusts were plusses in my book. 

Individual slices were out. So a pie it was at $15. It did not take too long to make. And a short walk home guaranteed that it was still fresh & warm when I got it inside. 

The guy behind the counter was friendly taking my order.

The interior looked clean & well kept.

One star deducted because there didn't appear to be any mask wearing on the premises.

I ordered a personal size pepperoni pizza, some sticky wings, and a beer to wash it down with.

My dining companion and I sat at an outside table. What I liked about the tables was that they are night right at the street but in view for people watching.

I enjoyed the food. The pizza is made to order and very greasy but I love greasy pizza as long as it's flavorful and it was. I think they brush a butter or butter garlic on the crust which adds to the flavor.

This place lost two stars because my food was brought out to miss with an empty pizza box. I had to go back in to get my pizza which was still in the oven. The guy that took our order is the same guy that sliced up my pizza. He was doing fine until he picked up my pizza to put it in the box, scratches his head and with the same hand used to scratch his head, he provided my pizza a nudge into the box.

I was hungry and didn't want to request a new pizza so I cut off the crust of the slide is touched and the two neighboring slices.

I would have given this place 4 stars with one star to go but two things just weren't right.

First my dining companion and I sat at an outside table and the ma that took our food order said he would bring out our food. Awesome, thank you. but then I open my small pizza box and it was empty. My pizza was still sitting in oven.

I got a good chuckle out of that but then as the same guy that took my order took my pizza to slice it up and put it in the box, he scratched his head and as he was putting my pizza in the box, he helped it along with the same hand used to scratch his head.

I didn't want to wait for a new pizza to be done so I cut the crust from that slice and the two neighboring slices and enjoyed the rest of the pizza.

We were so happy when this pizza spot opened near to us in Center city. Great tasting pizza, friendly service, the option to sit outside and a hood selection of well priced beers. A nice addition to the neighborhood.

First of all, the host didn't even bother making sure that our table was clean. He knew it was dirty and yet placed the menus and napkins over the leftover food. He even flicked one of the crumbs with his finger. Now, there were several times when we had to correct our server. We asked for a sprite and sheerly temple. He brings two sprites,( which took ten minutes) I then asked him for my temple and he said they ran out of an ingredient to make it. Which was a lie because he then brought out what I had ordered. Anyways, he brought out the wrong order and brought me shrimp instead of chicken which I am allergic too. It took us again another ten minutes for someone to come and tell us what went wrong with our order. Like the server the manager was unprofessional. The server blamed it on our miscommunication when everything was communicated several times since he had already messed up with our drinks. And when I kept asking about our food and our drinks he paused me to go work on another table. 
I am just so annoyed. That staff needs to be trained correctly and not blame the customers for their mistakes.

Service at the bar was top notch. We should have just eaten there. We gave our name and number at the host stand ("10 to 15 minutes") and received an automated text confirmation. We sat at the bar and waited. 

We went back to the host stand 15 minutes later, and our name was gone. They had no record of us. They offered us a table right then, even though no text ever came saying one was ready. Then we sat at the table and had no service until we flagged someone down who had no idea no one had greeted us or taken our orders. He said "I'll just take care of you myself," which is nice, but surely someone was assigned to our table. 

Last time we were here, our trainee waiter brought soups and salads after the entrees; when told those should come before, he said "you should have told me." Apparently he'd never been to a restaurant before. We never come during busy hours, usually around 5:30. Overall, we'd never come here if not for the bonus gift cards.
I will preface this by saying I normally love outback. But how do you not have any broccoli at this location?

So we went there for dinner and sat at the bar. First words out of the bar tenders mouth. " I was left a messed I have to clean it up and then I'll take your order". 20 minutes later we left. They didn't want our business. If they did the bar tender would  have said what do you want I'll get it for you and then I'll clean up. No tips!!!

COOKIES ARE AMAZING HERE!! Yes, insomnia have good ones- but these are larger and just beats them!

Chocolate Chip Macademia Nut & Peanutbutter choco chip were the ones I tried and both were out of this world. Sadly, they became a little cold once i reached home, but I'm sure couple seconds in the  microwave would make them good as new again! $2 per cookie.

Will probably get a cookie each time I visit!

Yummy cookie! I got the Chocolate Chip Macadamia after seeing it crowded by a bunch of people. After reading the Yelp reviews, I saw that the nut choices had good reviews. It was a lukewarm cookie, though still good.

We love these cookies, I tell people all the time about them! I drive over from jersey just to hit up a couple spots, 4th street cookies being one. We are nut lovers, the ones with nuts used to have more so hopefully they add more nuts  but these cookies are nearly perfection. So worth it if you haven't tried them yet

It's hard to walk past their cookie display and not want to try one! I enjoyed their chocolate chip cookie. I popped it in the microwave when I got home and it had my favorite type of cookie texture: slightly crispy on the edges and soft and gooey in the middle. These would probably also be even better fresh out of the oven at the shop. The cookies are a pretty good size. Definitely shareable, but easy to eat one all by yourself. They have lots of flavor options; something for everyone.

Best cookies I've had in years! Everything is always freshly baked and every cookie on their website is always available. I particularly like the snickerdoodle and chocolate chip, but I've tried just about every flavor and they're all consistent. I go to Reading Terminal Market JUST to get these cookies. Highly recommend!

This has to go in the list for worst service restaurants in all of Florida.  Popeyes food is so good, but I try this place like once every six months and they never cease to disappoint to the point where it is now a joke amount friends around here.  Todays trip.  I wanted a regular meal thats it.  I order and she tells me they are out of fries.  Of course they are.  So I ask what other choices and she pauses, I can literally feel her rolling her eyes, then she very bitterly tells me what they are.  I say, none of those sound good, I'll just do the nuggets and the tea.  She angrily says "pull around", so I do and pay and there is no nasty exchange or anything said, but she wouldn't really talk to me and stared at me as if we were longstanding enemies.  No sauce in the box, so I ask for two.  She is so upset with me now, she can barely take it.  I pull away wondering why she hated me so much.  This place is a crazy example of how good Popeyes food is that a restaurant ran about as poorly as you can run one can turn a profit month over month with inept and often hostile service.

If I could give this thing a -5 I'm stars I would. I mean there's not that many good Popeyes around the area but this place is far worse than all of them put together. I mean they always get my order wrong and the drive-through would be open but no one is ever there. To top it off the damn drive-through smells like someone took a fat dump right there in front of the area where you speak into the mic. Establishments like this Popeyes is why people look at Black people crazy as hell and I'm a proud black man and I'm thoroughly disappointed.
Great customer service & fresh food. Restaurant was clean and we had no issues with our order. Manager was very friendly!!!!!!!
Had a great lunch at Popeyes today, staff offered amazing hospitality! Definitely recommend this location for a quick and delicious lunch!

I don't do fast food often but when I go it's usually a craving for their original chicken sandwich. Every time I've come they've been friendly and efficient and I'm always greeted with a smile at the window. Not sure what is happening with others but I've never had an issue and have been coming occasionally for the last two years.

Only if you are from way up north would you think this was good bbq. My husband thinks at least it's better than Sonny's but that's not saying much. My brisket had no flavor, the baked beans were canned and not even decent canned and cold when we got them. The pulled pork was done well or they would have got a one star

Excellent food! Love the local feel of the place and the fact that we could order alligator from a drive thru (we are from NYC)! You have to push the button on the intercom because there's no sensor or camera like at big chain fast food restaurants. The guy who took our order was very friendly and gave us recommendations. I didn't catch his name but he seemed to be a manager because he was balancing the drive thru, phone calls, and talking to staff in side. Regardless, he was extremely kind, helpful, and attentive to us.
The food was so fresh we had to wait a few minutes to eat It because It was hot but It was worth It! We ordered the gator cheesesteak, chicken tender sandwich, and fries. It doesn't come with any sauce so if you like ketchup/Mayo/mustard/etc be sure to ask for It 
Overall we had a great experience and we will recommend this place to anyone who lives here or is visiting the area!

I gave them one star because zero was not an option.  There food is average at best, service is terrible.  The topper is having their political views on their sign.  This county is divided enough!  No one needs their hatered spread around Tampa.  "Let's go Brandon " has no place on their sign.  I will drive an extra 20 minutes and give 1st Choice BBQ my money.  They have great food and great service and I have no idea what their political views are.
The worst food and customer service. Went for lunch with several co-workers before Christmas.  I will never return.
after seeing the lets go brandon insult to our President on there sign i will never stop there
Mediocre food...have given it a few chances now and everything I ordered has been average.  Ordered pad Thai last night and it seemed like it was just spaghetti noodles in peanut sauce. Disappointed.

For thanksgiving 2021, I visited the Ft Lauderdale/Hollywood, FL location. It was first time visiting any of the or properties.  I prefer the Tampa location, the North Tower was nice, valet was nice, checking-in was welcoming and the rooms were beautiful & clean, the restrooms on the floor were clean and the staff was overall pleasant. They said hello, asked you where you were from & if you were enjoying your stay.  Due to COVID there's no bed service. I would suggest bringing wipes and hand sanitizer to do a quick over in your room & to wipe the slots & tables and I'm not saying this because of COVID, some people are straight up nasty and to protect yourself from getting sick & ruining your time...it's worth taking a little extra precautions. The smoking is thick; however, they do have a non-smoking zone I stumbled across (the place is big) and a non-smoking zone on the 2nd floor which was great (tables close down, not sure what time). About 3am the smoke dissipates...when it clears out a little. I tried my had at Black Jack and they were patient when others were NOT!  My trip was even better cause I didn't loose any money
Just to let you know how awful this place really is when it comes to their slot machines at this casino in Tampa if I could give it a - 0. I would do so.

i made and paid for my hotel reservation in late November. first of all, the central reservation personnel, though polite, are not very qualified. they will rarely transfer you to the hotel, even when you have an issue. i wanted to speak with hotel management and they told me they were not allowed to transfer me to hotel management. i made reservations at Council Oaks for a dinner birthday celebration for my moms 85th birthday. it was to be a party of 10. i specifically asked if seperate checks were ok and was told they were. when i called back and spoke to Council Oak directly closer to my arrival, they told me only 2 tickets were allowed for large parties and they did not even show the cake i had ordered months prior for $75 dollars. so when i got to the hotel on Jan. 5th i called and spoke to front desk manager Chris, very nice person, to advise him we decided not to eat at Council Oaks but at the HardRock Cafe instead. Chris could not even find a reservation for my party of 10.  just imagine if we had showed up for dinner at Council Oaks and there was no reservation, how embarrassing would that have been. Chris apologized and said he would look into what happened and thought perhaps the reservation was make at the Council Oaks at Seminole Hard 
Rock in Ft Lauderdale. another slip up of the central reservation personnel. so we had dinner at HardRock Cafe which was adequate. our server LD was not very good. we had 2 filet mignon dinners ordered one meduim and one medium rare. well the food runner gave the wrong plates to the wrong people and before we determined the problem it was too late and one of the people had begun eating the food. LD should have had them cut into the steaks to make sure they received the proper steaks, but half the time we couldnt even find LD our server. other than these issues, everyone and everything was fine. but you expect a 4 star hotel to be more polished. i certainly would review the central reservation personnel and get them all on the same page.

I was there for a planned 2 night complimentary stay on 1/09/22 &1/10/22.  I gave them about 9 hours of play on Sun & again on Mon.  On Monday afternoon, the dealer & then the supervisor threatened me with expulsion from the pai gow poker table because I made some mistakes setting my hand.  I pointed out that the mistakes were mine & I did not ask them to return my lost money, I accepted my losses without any complaint.  But I continued to be threatened that I would be asked to leave the table.  So after about the 5th threat from the dealer, she accomplished her apparent goal, I voluntarily left the table (& the casino), then checked out of the hotel a day early (with a free room).  Having made hundreds of casino visits over the years in several states, I have never before been treated rudely by a dealer or a supervisor.  This was the second rude dealer I have encountered at HR Tampa.  I returned to the table after cashing my chips to point out to the dealer that I was far more polite to her than she was to me.  I said nothing when she made 5 or 6 dealing mistakes over the course of 6 hours, including neglecting to pay a bonus hand for a full house, and for neglecting to deal all 7 hands another time. Perhaps I should have recommended to the supervisor that she be expelled from the table & replaced with a more competent dealer.

My suggestion is rather than spend any money for their hotel (over $500 per night), you would be better off using that money to purchase a plane ticket & hotel room at a Vegas casino.  It will likely be less expensive & you will be in an atmosphere where your patronage is appreciated.  This was far & away the worst casino experience I have ever seen.

If it wasn't for the great service I received in the hotel & the restaurant, my 1 star rating would have been lower.  My rating for the casino is below zero stars; the place owes me 3 stars.

Bottom line, church bingo is a better option.

My fiancé went there Saturday night for his bachelor party. While there, he was playing the table games and drinking a few beers but not showing signs of over served in the least. He and one of his buddies went to the bar where his buddy bought them both a drink. The female bartender served my fiancé's friend, but not my fiancé. When he asked where his beer was, she said its coming then walked away. After waiting at the bar for about 10 minutes without getting his drink, I approached him at the bar asking what's taking so long. He reiterated what the bartender told him earlier that is was coming soon. He kept having to wave his hands to get the bartender's attention and she would just look at him and help someone else. He then asked the male bartender what's going on? He ignored him as the female bartender was explaining the situation. He approached us and said the bar staff got word to not sell my fiancé anymore alcohol and to talk to the manager for further info. Then a man in a suit walked up to us, asked for my fiancé's ID, wrote out his license number and explained that they are refusing to sell him alcohol. But he did not have a reason why. My fiancé has a Myotonic Muscular Dystrophy so he already stumbles and slurs when he is stone-cold sober. He only had at most 3-4 beers in the course of 3 hours. So he was not by any means, overly intoxicated. We explained the situation to the manger that he has a disease that makes him that way. He just looked at all of us and acted like his disease meant nothing. That my fiancé was over his drinking limit. All he wanted was a nice night out with his friends and family to celebrate our upcoming wedding! This is discrimination! We will be filing a formal complaint!

Okay this is some of best pizza I have ever had.  The dough is so fresh, ingredients are top notch!  I finally found the perfect pizza place in South Tampa!    The venue has live music as well, it was Friday at 6pm when they were setting up!    

I highly recommend this place!  Nice owners as well, super kind and clearly family operated!
Best pizza. Fresh ingredients cooked perfectly. So many options including vegan and gluten free.

First time going was the other day was in the area for business & I must say that pizza was very amazing an the customer service was unmatched. The food was Piping hot and fresh also very flavorful The buffalo chicken pizza was beyond expectations. Also the Server Jae was just so pleasent & sweet. She is very attentive, and makes sure your comfortable and well taken care of. Great place to grab a bite to eat!
First time and it was really good. Garlic Parmesan wings and the chicken bacon pizza delicious.

Average rooftop bar experience. I personally seek establishments with more diverse clientele and menu options. Bok Bar did offer a spectacular view of the city. 

The art studios within Bok are pretty cool though.. will describe in a separate review.

Back in my day, Bok was a school, not a bar #thisprobablymakesmeold . But the building's reimagining transformed this space into a great spot for groups or date nights, as the rooftop bar offers one of the best southern views of the Philly skyline. Make sure to check the rotating menu if you plan on eating there though.

It is pretty awesome that they converted an old school into a rooftop bar, but it just fail to deliver anything other than provide a pretty great view of the city. The drinks are overpriced and the space is overly crowded. The few times we have come and ordered food, we have always left disappointed. Pay for the view, but don't expect a food meal.

Very chill vibe to being locals and guests alike. The views are breathtaking and remind me of why I still choose to live this east coast city life. The menu rotates so you wing get bored with the lite bits. The cocktails are refreshing. But let's be honest, this space is all about the vibe and the company. In an old high school, the income here is used to subsidize the rent for the small business owner tenants in the building. That alone makes me want to return over and over again.

Loved Bok Bar - it's in the Bok building in South Philly and is the only rooftop bar in the area with beautiful views of the city. Drinks were good and they have a rotating menu! Would definitely recommend visiting.
Nice, small and quaint establishment.  Family owned.  The staff are very friendly and attentive.  The food is awesome.  Authentic Cuban/Spanish food at affordable prices.  Five stars all around.

Stopped in for a quick bite after a hot afternoon at the zoo. My knowledge and experience of cuban food is certainly limited but everything was delicious!!

We ordered roasted pork, fried pork chunks, and a palomino steak with mashed potatoes and yellow rice. We also got an empanada and croquettas. So, we loved all of it. The empanada was delicious with a great crunch on the outside and the yellow rice was so good. My husband loved the steak which is very heavily seasoned and I loved the pork chunks. My kids enjoyed the roasted pork (shredded) which was tender and juicy as well as the white rice.

There's plenty of spaces to sit down and eat. No frills and delicious place to eat with some outdoor covered tables also. Check it out!

This place is the BOMB!! Been going to this place for years and sadly haven't been in a while due to my moving away from Tampa to Hernando but every now and then I drive the route to pick something up there because it's just that good. Don't miss out! Give them a try! You won't regret it!

This food is fresh and delicious. I've eaten here at least 5-7 times now and it is always satisfying. I tend to stick to chicken so I have tried both the shredded chicken and the roast chicken. I enjoyed both. The shredded chicken is very flavorful so it might be my favorite. The rice and beans are always tasty too. The flan here is also very good. If you are in the mood for some home cooking but too lazy to cook, this is the place for you. It doesn't feel like I'm eating "restaurant food" but that I'm enjoying someone's mom's delicious home cooking. This place is a Tampa staple!
Best Cuban spot I had in town.  I will frequent when I'm on this side of town.  It's a cafe style restaurant with nice staff and grassroots environment.
Yummy!!!! We happened to find this great gem on our way South.  All 8 of us loved our food. I had the green omelet and it was super tastey! We will definitely return!

I won't be returning the feel of the place or the vibe was off to me. They put sugar in their grits gross. The grits didn't taste right. I am a grits man.. if you mess up the grits the whole breakfast is messed up to me. The grits were watery and nasty. Like they took left over or yesterday's grits and tried to doctor them up... Yuck..
Shared a great breakfast with my husband this morning! The smoked salmon bagel plate with poached eggs. Also a side of onion & cheese hash browns! Yum!!

We came for a late breakfast. We were immediately greeted and told to seat ourselves. Cute little diner atmosphere. Full breakfast/lunch menu. My husband had the smoked salmon and eggs and I had Popeye's Revenge omelette. Everyone was very friendly the service was quick, the food came out fast and they keep your coffee cup filled. Reasonable serving size and priced to match.

We love having breakfast at Nickis!  I had a veggie eggs Benedict PLUS biscuits & homemade sausage gravy; boyfriend had a country skillet .  Both were yummy!!   Our server, LISA, was attentive & she spent time with us to brighten our day.  Such a sweetheart--we left with a smile on our faces. Reasonable prices too! 
 
We we will be back soon!

This is the single worst McDonalds and restaurant I've ever been to. The employees are super rude and the wait time will always be 30+ minutes regardless of how full the restaurant is. I cannot stress how terrible of an experience getting food at this MCDonalds is. This is one of my rare Yelp reviews purely because of how awful the service is. Please change management.

I should be able to give zero stars on here! And I usually Yelp before I order but it's McDonald's right? Again I was wrong for not following my instincts! Like you guys have one job! That's it! And I get it it's hard sometimes but when someone orders a damn burger and asked for no ketchup?!?! What's the hard part of this especially when I just ordered that and nuggets and I didn't even get a damn bbq sauce! I threw my food in the trash because not only did it have ketchup it was ice cold! And not only did I say no ketchup but it was all over the box! My gears have been grind and I'm over it but next time no ketchup please.........

Probably the worst McDonald's I've been to. They make all their stuff at once and don't make your order fresh. The nuggets and fries weren't hot and were stale and the sandwich was soggy. Avoid this heap of trash and save your money.

Constantly botching online orders.
For example, bought the Big Mac bundle box today only to be missing both sets of large fries, watered down drinks, unfresh chicken nuggets, plain hamburgers instead of cheeseburgers, BBQ sauce instead of honey mustard and overcooked meat crumbs on the outside of the bun of one burger.
They do this all the time regardless of what the service is (UberEATS, DoorDash, etc). How hard is it to read an order from a screen and place said items out for delivery. They are the absolute worst. Do not order online from here at all

Came to this bar to watch the Army Navy game. From the moment I walked in the place was playing absolute bangers on the radio and the drinks were cold! Great atmosphere and great place! 10/10 will be coming back!!

Neighboring Paddy Whacks is fun for when you want to get rowdy, but most of the time, I'd rather head to Cavanaugh's for darts, beers, wings and pierogies, and fantastic, laid back servers and bartenders. Come watch a game outside or at the upstairs inside bar.
The food is excellent every time. Only order takeout but I imagine the food is just as good dining in.

We were craving for pizza and decided to try Cicis Restaurant for the pizza. It is a unique restaurant which offers pizza buffet as well as pasta buffet. There are many small video games too which children can enjoy. We went during the afternoon and the restaurant was full with family enjoying with their children. I ordered Veggie pizza over the counter. The service was good and i got the pizza in 15  minutes. The pizza was hot as well as delicious. It had all the veggies which i love. The only issue was with the onion on pizza. I believe onion was not properly cooked due to which we had to remove onions from the pizza regularly. All in all we loved the pizza. It was amazing and delicious.

Checked this place put while visiting Philly. It was good but they messed up my sandwich. I was hungry and in a hurry so I ate in anyway. The girl at the register appeared to be new and they were busy so I just let it go. If I ever visited Philly again I'd give them another chance since the food tasted good.

Terrible service. They staff with young kids who do not know what they are doing. I had to go back twice and they still got it wrong. Can you imagine, they made a hoagie without lettuce, tomato, onion, seasoning, oil/vinegar on it. That was my Audiablo, which I found out about after going back for a second time to get my other sandwich, which they forgot. They placed me on hold for 10 minutes and never came back to the phone when I tried to call and then they stopped answering the phone. The sandwiches are decent but the service is awful. Can't believe I was charged for this fiasco. 
There is no leadership there, which is why this store is run so poorly. They have no common sense, no customer service skills, and no understanding of how their mistakes make a terrible impression on the business. If the people can't handle it, the manager should be onsite. This is why other restaurants, which were only a few stores away, went out of business. If they didn't have the Primos name, they would be in the same boat.

I order my hoagie online and for pickup to make sure they got it right at the market street location because of past order mistakes.  I drove there and paid to park. Picked up my Mild Italian hoagie and drive home.  BIG MISTAKE TASTE YOUR ORDER WHILE IN THE STORE.  THEY PUT HOT MEAT NOT MILD. I cannot eat it so I called.  They never offered a refund, or to send a delivery out which they claim they don't have. Told m to drive back, pay to park, bring this hoagie back and they would make me another hoagie.  I don't have time to do that. So there is a hoagie out beside my trash.  And I'm out money and time.

Ordered three pies plus one order of meatballs.  Also requested plates, napkins, silverware, crushed red pepper and grated Parmesan.  Got none of those things which generally wouldn't be that big of deal.  BUT since everything is packed up....my husband had to go to the store and buy items in order for us to eat comfortably.  Dissatisfaction makes me look closer...carnivore pizza didn't include cheese or sauce for that matter, all the way to the edge.  I don't mind spending money AT ALL when the food is good.  Since this isn't the first time pizza has been inconsistent (set aside plate etc issue) think I'm done with Anthony's.  It's just not that good.  Will spend $100+ at another and more deserving pizza restaurant.

Very good pizza and wings that is consistently that way. Friendly staff and a great rewards program and happy hour. They used to have amazing ribs that are no longer on the menu and I do miss those and if you don't like pizza, wings or salad the menu is limited.

My wife and I really enjoyed our experience at Anthony's in south Tampa.  The pizza was great and the service was super.  We totally enjoyed our time at this establishment.  We were met at the door, got our drinks right away and pizza came hot, who could ask for more.  The place was clean and the manager came by and checked on us, which indicated attention to detail that is lacking in my other establishments.  Would highly recommend and will be returning.

This is a tale of really good pizza paired with sub-par service (and not because there wasn't sufficient staff).

We created our own 12" pizza.  Only addition was sausage.  Once ordered the pizza was delivered quickly since they use a high temp pizza oven.  The pizza was perfect and had just the perfect level of sauce, crust and melty cheese.  It even had TWO bubbles on two slices, one for each of us.

We ordered soda and water.  Both went empty for all too long, including right in the middle of the meal when this can't happen.  When I buy a soda for $3.25 and they only provide a single refill because they aren't focusing on drinks....we were not happy here.  At the end of the meal we chatted for a little bit and no one came to ask if we wanted refills on both glasses. They also brought the check out before we finished the pizza. Might need some training.

There are several TVs turned to sporting events.  Place was about 50% full on a Sunday night.  Plenty of parking.

Next time we'll skip the soda and bring our own water cups.  Problem solved!

Can't really rate their pizza yet since I've been sitting outside for 45 minutes. I got here at the "30" minute pick up recommendation and have since been sitting. I've been asked a few times my name even though I saw inside they have my car description and name on the receipt. It's been an hour and 5 minutes since I placed a simple order for a pizza and salad. It's Sunday night and restaurant is less than half full.

Haven't been to a Boston Market in years. Decided to go in today to grab a quick meal and had a very disappointing experience. I ordered the meatloaf, and it was dry. They didn't have any ketchup, no laser potatoes, no fountain drinks, and while they had a few bottled drinks, there was no regular Coke (just diet - unless I wanted an entire 2L). I know things have been hard throughout the pandemic, but you can't expect to get returning customers if you can't even keep your basic items on hand.
Hood asf overcooked chicken nuggets they say fuggit you want fresh fries they say yeah that's a lie. Make you wanna fight
Get the Cuban sandwich. The only regret you'll have is that all other Cuban sandwiches will pale by comparison.

We haven't ordered from here since June and prior
to today we loved it! I'm not sue if they have changed owners or chefs, but their menu and recipes have definitely changed. I always get the lobster bisque and today it was completely different than usual. While it did have more lobster chunks, you cannot taste the sherry, so it tastes flat, it has a ton of herbs in it now and it is VERY salty. The potato salad on the Greek salad is night and day from the previous recipe and while I like potato skins, this salad had a ton of dry potato skins mixed in, it was not appetizing at all. I originally thought it was gyro meat. They also used to use a unique seasoning on the potato salad and it was great! Now it is tasteless and again, flat. My husband always gets the fish and chips and he said they have changed the batter and it is not flavorful like it used to be. He also said it is VERY "fishy". They also removed the Cuban empanada from the menu, which was our favorite. I guess if you have not been before you won't have anything to compare it to, but we miss the flavor!

The waiter was very polite but the food OMG all we ordered come spice and to be honest I don't recommend this restaurant. I ordered a tomato soup and believe it was not good and I let came with a slice of bread lol my husband ordered a sandwich and it was really small and the taste not good, for my mom a gyro sandwich the sauce was thick, very strange, the fries were absolutely over fried and the beef empanada was so greasy and the tasty idk how to describe. For my daughter rice and beans not good as well.

A great menu and delicious food but horrendous service. Servers are very slow and super inattentive. Food came out cold and took us 15 minutes to even be greeted at the door. Silverware was unclean and they were out of a lot of the menu items.
Food was excellent. I love the onion soup  . And they were very helpful. Will definitely try again soon

Mushy shrimps the consistency of mashed potatoes were in my pho.
I told  the people about the shrimps thar worked there, they said they were probably over cooked. That is all!! They offered nothing no apology nothing!! I had to throw all of them away. Really disappointed this spot is in the hood I guess they think they can give you any type of service.

Got an order here through UberEats and was disappointed. The shrimp summer roll only had noodles, rice and shrimp. Other places usually add bean sprouts or other things to give it more substance. The deluxe pho was very fatty with a thick layer of oil on the top. There were 4 pieces of meat, a slice of meatball and the hugest chunk of tendon. There was also a small hair intertwined in the tendon. The broth was salty too. It would be better if they didn't combine the hoisin and sriracha in the same sauce container. I was also surprised to see the meat cooked in the same container as the broth. I thought the beef would be raw and separated.
A must try.. always friendly... good always delicious.. and the quantity is very good for the price.. yummy

Food is absolutely delicious and the customer service over the phone is excellent.. I ordered the shrimp pho and asked for it to be spicy.. job well done.. the flavor of the broth is amazing. Very good value of food.. my new favorite Vietnamese place to eat.
Literally my favorite spot for Pho I always get the steak flank pho and grilled pork vermicelli. The pho has such depth of flavor and the grilled pork is cooked to perfection so delish!

I absolutely LOVE Daiva's! First time here and will be back again soon! Everyone is so nice and it really does have the quaint diner experience you're looking for. People of all ages were there for the great atmosphere and the good food! They also have brunch and lunch specials that come with a free adult beverage?? (It's a great deal!) Their prices are great and it's worth every cent! I hope they stay open for years to come! I definitely found my local go-to diner :)

Always a good time. Food is always fresh and prepared very well. Good sized portions at decent prices. Servers and hostess always looking to make sure everything is good. Menu is diverse. If you know you coming with a large party call a day or two ahead they will accommodate you. They have two large booths that can hold up to 10 people. Easy listening music while you eat. Dining area isn't too loud, you can actually hold a conversation. The owner is not removed from day to day operations. She is involved in every aspect (Hostess, Server, Cook, Dish washer, janitor, etc.,), very down to earth person. Full of positive energy which you feel while your in the restaurant. Hours at the moment are 8a-6p everyday.

I would never recommend this place. Although the cook was  entertaining the food was just not it. Upon entering this place it had a very strange smell. Almost like being in a very old building with a moldy smell. It was like a cloud just following you with this smell that it made my stomach very uneasy. They sit me and my spouse down with another party of 4, cool. I order my food then decided I needed to use the bathroom. While using this semi dirty bathroom another walks into the stall next to me and start vomiting. Her friend is telling her "maybe it's just cause you haven't ate today and the food is heavy". In my mind I'm thinking dang I hope she's alright. I go sit down start having the soup, steamed dumplings and the plum wine. The plum wine was gross and asked the waiter he can take it back. He kind of hesitated like I should just drink but no it started making my stomach feel VERY Uneasy. I go to the bathroom cause my stomach is just hurting out of no where. Sure enough now I am vomiting. My spouse is like not feeling it either. The cook did not season none of the food. I couldn't eat the rest of the time because the food was just making me sick every bite I had. I couldn't even eat my leftovers smh.
I have recently turned vegan, so I skeptically asked if I could have the udon noodles with tofu substitute. It was amazing, it'll be my go to dish for any Asian cravings!
Great service. We sat at the bar for sushi. Which came out fast. We order the Godzilla Roll, volcano roll and the Mango Lobster roll. Really delicious. Will definitely be back.

This was the very first sushi place I ate at here in Florida/Tampa area. I found it on yelp. Reviews were great so I decided to try it. I didn't realize that they closed for a bit between lunch and dinner. Fortunately I arrived only a couple of minutes prior to them opening for dinner (5pm). They also have Hibachi but I specifically went for sushi. Despite it getting crowded quickly, service was prompt and the servers were very kind. I ordered the sashimi dinner which had an assortment of sashimi and also included a salad and soup. Prices are very reasonable as well. Everything was delicious and the presentation was great! I was later notified on yelp that they used my photo for their profile which made me smile. I'm glad this place is very close to where I live and I can and will be coming to eat here often. I will definitely be trying their hibachi as well. 

The parking is ample btw! Definitely recommend Kuchi Sushi if you're in the area! :)
Great sushi and hibachi! Nice atmosphere as well, perfect date spot before or after a movie (AMC right nearby!)

this was our first time at don julio's and it was amazing. Our server Natalia was so sweet, the restaurant is adorable, the service was fast and amazing, and the food was to die for. couldn't write enough good things about this place!!! highly recommend.

The online system accepted reservations for Christmas Day. We were contacted Christmas Eve to confirm our time. When our party arrived, the restaurant was closed. Why accept reservations when you will not be opened?

Ordered delivery via Uber and was really happy with how they pack everything. Only reason I gave it a 4 was bc the salsa. We ordered two orders of salsa bc we love our salsa and the Two containers we got were halfway filled up. Salsa was good but not our favorite. The entries we got though were delicious. I think next time we go we will eat in to enjoy it more.

My first visit was all over the place with emotions.  Both good and bad.

Start with the goods.  Was excited to try this after reading about it in the local Neighborhood News publication.  The food was mostly fresh (complementary chips were the only exception-not warm).  Great flavors in the meals.  The salsa was good.  Overall above average service.  Plenty of parking.

Things that could be better: I ordered the chicken fajitas.  As you can see in the pic they bring you the standard large amount of food to create your masterpieces.  The problem lies with the size shells they provide.  Regardless of whether you select corn or flour you get these mini postage stamp sized tortillas that only hold one strip of meat plus peppers, beans, etc.  I asked about this and was told there is no alternative.  This is like giving artist Michaelangelo a 6 inch section of ceiling and told to squeeze the art in.  It was so frustrating to carefully load all the ingredients in, then try to massage it closed only for everything to fall out all over the table.  

Second issue: they bring out THREE of these tortillas.  I laughed and asked the lady if I was supposed to cram all the food in these.  She ended up bringing three more out a few minutes later, but after the first two rounds she didn't ask if I needed more so I gave up the fight and just ate the ingredients off the plate.  This isn't how fajitas should be enjoyed in my opinion.

Third issue: besides the small thimble of salsa there is no sauce to add to the mix.  Salsa would be nice.

Last issue is accessibility to this restaurant.  It is super difficult and dangerous to exit headed east on Bearrs Ave.  During rush hour traffic it is next to impossible due to traffic flow.  They recently closed the ability to exit the lot out onto Bruce B Downs.  Be careful!

Ambiance is just okay.  Numerous TVs playing all different things.  Wallpaper boarder starting to separate from wall.  Can be loud aince tables next to you are so close.  There are not very many tables inside.  Also have some outside seating at the front.

Overall would give this place 3.5 stars overall if Yelp allowed.

The best Mexican food I have ever had.

From start to finish it was superb! 

Sampler 
Burrito 
Charros

My belly is so happy. We had a lamb, beef and chicken dish and every side option for the vegetables. Everything was amazing. I don't live here but my two friends who were with me do and they said they will definitely be back.

Amazing food, coffee, service, and overall vibe. 

Highly recommend whether looking for a meal, a place to get some work done, or a quick snack. Favorite spot in Rittenhouse by far.

Very generous portions, but I was sad to say the food was just okay. I had the Doro Wat and an order of Kik Alicha. The chicken was good enough, but the injera tasted really off to me. Also, the Kik Alicha had a somewhat rotten taste to it that I couldn't put my finger on. 

I've had Ethiopian food from numerous places and was really craving it. I've made Kik Alicha at home before and it's turned out even better than what I was given. I'll try the Beef Stew next time and update my order if it's better, but from what I ordered, I will not be going back.

Never had this kind of food before. Told the owner my table and I had no idea what we were doing. He recommended we try the Doro Tibs and  the Yebege Tibs. He brought it out on a big plate and we shared it. OMG it was so good! The meat was so flavorful and the pancake bread was yummy. Now we know we like Ethiopian food. Thank you for a memorable meal!

Just happened to park next to this place and noticed it. Ethiopian food has been a recent discovery of mine. I had to try it. 

Simply put it was excellent. The doro (chicken) tibs were tender with a great flavor without being overpowering. Everything else from the injera bread to the sides were of good quality as well. 

I'm a big fan of Ethiopian coffee now and the iced coffee here is very worthy of its reputation. 

I've been to a few Ethiopian restaurants in the city now. This is probably my second favorite. But it's a very high second. Maybe 1.5. I'd recommend it to anyone wanting to try this food. 

And the people running it were very nice. Support the small businesses in Rittenhouse. It's more fun for me to get a meal at a place like this than it is to go to the trendy spots.
This place combines great food, great entertainment and great ambiance.  Highly recommend!

We came here for dinner this weekend. The ambiance is cute and the singers are so talented, but the food is really average. We ordered a bottle of wine, calamari to start, and then I had the house made brichole as an entrée which was not great. I dont think the pasta is made fresh in house. My husband got a ravioli special and it was a much better pick. We closed out the night with espresso martinis and some gelato, and by gelato, I mean, it really could have been breyers vanilla ice cream and I wouldnt have been able to tell you otherwise. 

We were in the back room and were on our way out at the end of our meal when one of the singers was about to do a performance, so we had to wait a few minutes for the performance to conclude, so we had to SPRINT to make our train. Not the performers fault for the timing, but it was a frustrating end to an average meal.

10/10 ! 
This is probably one of the best restaurant/ cafe that I have been too. This cafe is quite and quaint but it bold in the experience it presents. Our waiter Alexis explained how the restaurant went and was super attentive with our orders. While I was order I heard someone tap their glass calling for attention I was so confused then she started telling a story and began to sing guess.... Drumroll OPERA! My mouth dropped all of the waiter are classically trained opera professionals. This legit took this place for 10 to 20 immediately. I was so in awe when all the singers were harmonizing together while still serving us! The food was nothing short of great as well. I order ravioli, penne and a shrimp dish and had more than enough left overs. A true Italian would love this place it is extremely authentic, pleasant waiter and amazing food! Will 1000% come back here!

I always walk past the Victor Cafe, occasionally passing by when a singer comes out on the Juliet balcony. Victor Cafe has really transformed their outdoor space during COVID, and I think it is one of the best in the city when the weather is nice out. They make the most of their sidewalk space (solid deck and love the string lights).

Had a great experience when I finally got to try it. Food was good, prices fair for a fancy dinner. They even made my husband a cocktail that was no longer on their menu (he wanted to try something with chartreuse) since they still had the liquor.

Mad props to the waiters and waitresses. They take turns to sing every 15-20 mins, and they're all pretty impressive. Must try if opera is your thing but still very enjoyable even if it's not. It's great live entertainment during dinner!
Poor service , mean  very condensing , new again go to this Resturant . The most demeaning unprofessional people

The food is pretty good. The young lady working the front desk isn't polite or helpful at all, that's one of the reason they lost a star along with some updating of the look. You can tell a lot of people visit and aren't from Tampa or the area. Several people walked in with questions and wanting to discuss the food she was very short and rude. Also my I didn't receive my macaroni and had to remind her she got it and it was really hot, to the point the plastic was melting into the Mac n cheese. I told her it shouldn't be in the container if it's that hot, because of the chemicals from plastic transferring into the food. She said with an attitude "we always do that "! I said it isn't safe and poor it into the box with my other food. When I sat 5 months pregnant to do that, she said we don't have dine in. So if y'all don't have dine in, why do y'all have booths? I  said okay, I'm waiting on my Uber. For them to have a girl on the front with a poor attitude and that isn't socialable can be a bit frustrating. I found this location on Instagram and I looked at Yelp reviews.

I got the seafood plate boiled Cajun butter style. The snow crabs were cooked perfectly. The flavors blended well with the snow crabs and corn. The sausage were salty so I didn't eat many. Overall, I would go again. Next time I'll try their soul food.

I ordered via phone on a Friday night & had a short wait upon arrival. I ordered the oxtail over rice & peas, mac & cheese, yams, collard greens, & cornbread. The oxtails were $2 more than listed online. However, they were good as were the yams & cornbread. The food was good overall. Not enough rice with the oxtail. The greens were a little spicy for my palate. Also, the location could be better lit at night. Other than that it was a good food experience.

The cajun butter shrimp & potatoes was really good! The collard greens were seasoned great. They  didn't have meat in them. I liked the basa fish, but one piece over bread  was $8 no sides.  The  strawberry lemonade was so good I had to go back for  another  cup. Customer service was lack luster but the food was good!
I tried this  black family owned soulfood/seafood spot off  MLK in Tampa Florida yesterday!  It was  #smacktastic.  The strawberry lemonade  was so bomb that I  got 2 cups & one to go! It taste better than chessecake factory strawberry lemonade!
 Just not $5 a glass 
Mini shrimp boil
Collard greens 
Basa fried fish  (light &crispy & overpriced)
The two Con's were the lack luster customer service 
Secondly one piece of fried fish shouldn't  cost $8.99 over white bread.  But I'm a serious foodie who will pay!

This is one review I had no problem writing. After searching for a good resturant in the area and nothing that's apart of a chain. We came across Ladies of the Sea on Yelp and decided to take a 15min drive to see what it was about and other than finding out due to the small store front location we couldn't sit inside to eat due to Covid WE WERE NOT DISAPPOINTED. We ordered our meals and asked question after question and NECIE did not get mad one bit. She explained everything to the "T" and everything came out just as she mentioned! We were able to enjoy the sounds of the community and sit outside at the picnic tables and enjoy our meals. This BLACK OWNED business is one that we will be sure to visit everytime we leave South Carolina and visit Tampa! Awesome customer service and great SeaSoulfood!

1 star is way more than I would give them. Ordered from DoorDash tonight, a 60 dollar order for my family, we did not receive ONE thing that we ordered. They gave us a bunch of old chicken strips, popcorn nuggets & chicken littles. Probably not even half the worth of what we ordered. Everything was cold & gross. I don't understand how you can possibly get every single thing wrong. I work in food service, that's almost HARD to do.

Simply the best. You will not find better Chinese food in Tampa. I am from NYC and frequented Chinatown. When I got to Florida I was so disappointed and thought I would never get authentic Chinese food again.. until I found Chicken Yummy! The food is amazing and the owners are so friendly. Thank you Grace!! We will see you soon.
best authentic chinese food everrr. family owned which makes it better. my go to spot for me and my boyfriend! we love the orange chicken and one order feeds both of us!

Generous portions, food tastes freshly made and yummy as the name would suggest.  My family favorites are the crab Rangoon, dumplings, chicken rice noodles and real orange chicken! I could go on, but those are consistently faves

The only thing to regret about this Chinese food is that you didn't know about it sooner. Everything is delicious and the portions are large!

Every dish that I order from them becomes three meals. I enjoy the cumin beef/lamb, and shrimp lo mein. Throw out any perceptions that you had of Chinese food prior to this place. Unlike other Chinese take-out, this food is not greasy and doesn't leave you in a food coma afterwards. 

This is my new go-to take out.

Not going to support this place anymore. I've been coming here for years, so this is not an impression after my first visit. 

I walked in today and must have been a ghost because no one actually SAW me. I am a grown Black man.
