The three people at the register helping no one after one customer left, the person standing right in front of me across the glass counter who eventually chose to serve the customer behind me first, or the customer who entered after me and chose not to defer to me. No one said hello, acknowledged me, or apologized after I was forced to ask, "is anyone going to serve me" in order to generate any tangible response from anyone. 

They ruined my morning, and I hope the manager that I spoke with relayed my message to those providing service the morning of 11/21. This is not about customer service - this is about decency and being good people. I didn't feel like I mattered there, and I shouldn't feel that way. I'm not going there again.

Omg best bread in the world. Friendly and quick staff. Good sandwiches, breakfasts, and coffee. And did I mention, the best bread in the world. Don't believe me? Order the Artisan toast (just their bread and butter) and you will be transported!! One drawback, they don't have WiFi and it is a great location to sit and get work done.
Great coffee, baked goods, and sandwiches.  In fact, everything on the menu is fabulous.  The staff is especially friendly.  A must stop if your in Chestnut Hill.

Consistently poor customer service, poor goods, and overpriced items. 

I bought a slice of cold quiche that was labeled 6.99 in the fridge. Attendant rang me up for $11 saying it was mislabeled/gave me attitude for mentioning the discrepancy. 

I've asked for a sandwich to be toasted to go only to be told they "don't toast bread" anymore. 

I once ordered a new menu breakfast item to which none of the employees were familiar with despite it being posted on the menu board in plain sight. Was given attitude for ordering this!

I've tried to order 1 dozen rolls only to be told "you can't order that many because then there won't be much left for others to buy" 

I've waited over 30-45 minutes for a toasted bagel with cream cheese and coffee on at least 4 separate occasions. 

Because I've lived close to this place for years I've gone here out of necessity to "give it another chance/support a small biz" only to hate myself afterwards. Never again. 

I've also been treated differently based on how I am dressed (gym clothes vs put together) here on several occasions over the years. 

I see another reviewer saying she had an experience with racism in this establishment and I can honestly say I'm not surprised at all. 

If you want good coffee on the ave RUN to poppy's or chestnut hill coffee co. If you want a good/fast bfast RUN to Starbucks, skip this place and save yourself time and money!

I got the multigrain loaf and it was amazing. Too amazing to not know what is in it though. I'm concerned that there were no ingredients listed on the bag, nor on the website. How do people still get away with that? What if there was something I was allergic to? Staff seemed angry that I came in to make a purchase, so despite the great tasting bread, the over all experience was not very pleasant.

Customer service is very poor. Wendy's does not close until 3am and I got there at two. I went to go place my order and nobody greeted me or told me to wait a couple seconds. I waited a total of 10 minutes before a worker said something to me. They told me they were only taking cash and at that point I drove away because of how upset I was. Mind you I was also upset because I was not greeted at all. This is the Wendy's I usually go to, but after tonight I will not be coming back. The workers are very rude.
great time and the games can be paid for through an app so you don't need change which was nice
Cheap drinks and tons of classic games! The atmosphere is superb! So retro and the tacos are delicious!!

No masks on employees or patrons. No hand sanitizer placed around for games, expensive gaming and mediocre beer selection. They gave me pitcher water from the bar that'd been sitting 4 inches from people talking all night. Not worth the 9 dollars in tokens I spent in 15 minutes.

I'm from New Jersey and I been here with my friends and brother after I turned 21 and there is security checking ID's at the door and you MUST be 21 and over to enter there and I guess the bar laws are the same as New Jersey is Pennsylvania. Anyway, this is a GREAT bar and arcade to go when you want to visit Philadelphia for a little 'Philadelphia Freedom' and it's cool there!

I've been to another bar similar to this in Las Vegas. I was invited here by a friend, and I'm glad I was. Really cool bar. 

Lots of old school video games and pinball to play. Games like Punchout, Daytona USA, and lots of pinball options. 

They have an excellent selection of craft beer as well. I had the Brewmasters Union IPA, the Boardwalk Blackberry Saltwater Taffy IPA, and the Pumpking. The bartender even gave me a free taster of the Operation Breakfast coffee stout. 

Food options were limited. I had the mac & cheese, which was great. 

I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted because I had to go to a concert, but if I'm ever back in Philly, I'll be sure to return.

My absolute favorite sushi place !!  They are much cheaper compared to everywhere else, sushi is fresh and great quality. They are always timely and considerate. The service goes absolutely above and beyond to accomodate you as a guest.  I love this place and keep going to it every week!

I decided to return to Sake House because my last visit was very interesting. As I stated in my last review, there is  a lot of potential here -- which is why I returned. They are still looking for help in the dining room and when I entered the staff was eating dinner. As soon as I came in they immediately all got up and we're ready to serve me. Tonight's dinner was an Alaskan roll and some salmon teriyaki. I also let my server know that I could not eat any egg and he assured me that they would take care of that. The Alaskan roll was absolutely excellent. 
I also ordered some green tea and this time it did not disappoint. Hot, fresh and my own little pot.  Mmmm. 

Initial service times were good for my roll and sides. The salad is simple , it's basically just lettuce and dressing.   The soup is standard miso, very good.   
The salmon teriyaki was served super hot, sizzling!  Very good, sashimi grade salmon no doubt. 
All in all I was very happy with my meal and I do intend to return soon.

2 rolls and chicken friend rice cost me $42. And when I tell you this is the last time I'll eat here. None of the food had flavor. I've had better sushi at Publix on $5 Wednesday. I ordered online and then came 20 min later and they didn't even have my order and when I say didn't have it, like they literally had no idea what I was talking about. When I ordered my food online it just had me do Apple Pay with no email for the recipe so thank goodness I didn't close out of the web page I ordered on or I wouldn't have been able to get my $42 food(I'll even post the receipt b/c I can't believe I paid for this). And they kept asking me to see the email of what I ordered and I kept telling them I didn't have the email I just have the webpage open showing what I ordered and how much I paid. I'm just so disappointed and hungry b/c I couldn't finish this.

This was my first visit to dining at sake house. I came at about 7:30 PM on a Wednesday night. It took almost 7 minutes for someone to greet me outside. After I was greeted by one server another server came to take my order and asked me if I would like a drink. However I had already ordered green tea from the first server so I told her about that. I then told her about my food allergies we worked over the menu together and the decision was a bagel roll and some scallop teriyaki which was supposed to come with white rice soup salad and teriyaki with vegetables. 
About 10 minutes later my green tea arrived in a very nice looking pot and a tea cup. The water really wasn't all that hot. I don't know if that's because it sat or if they don't serve hot green tea for safety reasons. As a result it didn't really brew correctly and was very weak even for green tea. I think if the water were hot it would've been much much better.
The server went inside and after approximately 20 minutes the other server came out and told me that she was sorry for the delay but the other server had to leave. Then she wanted to know what I ordered and brought it out to me 10 minutes later.    I have to say the teriyaki is extremely good here! However it was not served hot and I suspect that is because the other server left the first server to do all of her work because of the emergency. The bagel roll was one of the best I've had in Tampa hands down. The rice was fresh smoked salmon was very fresh and the cream cheese was just the right amount not too much not too little. I did not get soup and I did not get salad -- as a result I won't be able to review those items here.  . So I have to say that if I return I will know what to expect. I think I just caught them on a bad night. Why four stars?  Because the quality of everything they serve is extremely high -- ! I think if they worked out their service issues this could be one of the best sushi restaurants in the area.

This is by far my favorite Japanese take out restaurant! I have tried other Japanese restaurants but nothing can compare to Sake House. We have never eaten at the restaurant, we have only ordered from Uber Eats but the food is hot and has consistently been correct every time we order. We order atleast every other week, if not more. The portions are more than enough for one serving. I cannot recommend this place enough and I would not order anywhere else for Japanese food!!
Horrible service. I thought this was fast food. We have been in line for at lease 15 mins. All we ordered a 3 sausage biscuits, sausage McMuffin & 2 hash browns this unacceptable
Service was really slow. Staff was not friendly at all. I've been there a number of times and I've had the same poor pullout of service
I ordered yesterday and let me tell You, the food was hot, chicken was delicious, like it had just come out the grease.
I'm not givin any stars because I didn't get the food I ordered n it took too long to get here. I love Popeyes but this was just horrible. If I order something I want what I order smh.

Hands down the best Chinese food delivery in Philly. There isn't much on the menu we haven't tried, but some faves are the sesame chicken, mei fun, chicken wings, any of their soups, pork fried rice, cashew chicken...and on and on. Fast delivery by them--NOT door dash! So skip all those extra fees. So friendly when they drop off. Amazing customer service. They remember your orders, even if you did some substitutions or customizations on a previous order. Order from them regularly and never had a bad experience.
I think this place is going to go out of business.  It's gone so far downhill from what it was.  Very sad because it used to be my go-to.

They're Food is so good  , i got the bacon cheese burger and Canjun fries 
Staff was friendly , everything was a great experience over all , I'll be back!

I don't what is going on with the food. They used to have the best wings in town. But we went there last Monday and they were burnt to a crisp and dry. It has been bad the last few times we ordered food from there.. Sad to say we won't be going back.

Wish that I could give them 0 stars. This is a neighborhood dive bar located in Carrollwood. Ordered 10 wings mild/honey bbq and requested them to be crispy. Needless to say the wings were big and reminded me of Brontosaurus wings, weren't crispy, were a little underdone, and they barely had sauce on them. Ended up wasting them and my $ due to being underdone and not wanting to get sick. Have been to this place several times in the past and never had an issue with the wings until now since it's been a while thought I'd give them another chance but didn't win me over so officially done with this place.
Decent wings, good beer selection, food menu seemed tasty and LOVED the pool tables without smoke. Not super busy but totally ok with that.

Zara has really improved over the last few years. It's become my go to spot when I want quality sushi.  I love that they are open for lunch as well. I typically will do a sushi combo, and they offer the option to upgrade to the better cut of fish for these combos as well. 

Their desserts are unique. It's $12 and you get. A choice of 3 mini desserts. I love this for the variety. The beignets are fantastic!

Really want to like this place, but the sushi is boring, bland, and overpriced. Skimpy portion sizes too.

Atmosphere inside is nice, service is good, but the sushi is nothing special.

Zama, is definitely is the place to go for sushi! I went for a date night. The food was amazing!! I didn't get any drinks because I left my ID at home but it definitely was a vibe. The greeter/ manager was amazing the waitresses worked as a team no complaints from them. The food came out quickly. Only down side is it's very loud. I think it might be the way it's structured. They had some really loud guest but the greeter/manager  handle it elegantly and professional. I would return for sure!!

Lived in Tokyo for 4 years. My bride of 21 years was born & raised in Japan. Bar none the best sushi in the greater Philadelphia area (her opinion, mine doesn't matter).  All credit goes to Zama-San who runs a tight ship but treats his employees & customers with the utmost respect & kindness.  I recommend the omakaze chirashi.  kampai!

This is one of my favorite little spots in Philly.  Why?
1-Great sushi. I mean really good.  It is Creative, fresh, quality, just damn good.... Try the Philly cheesesteak sushi roll.  I have never had anything like it.  All sorts of traditional stuff too, but that one is just fun and amazing.  
2-Great sake selection.  Drunken Whale is a big favorite of mine. 
3-You can eat at the counter. 
4-they always have mochi (a dessert). You are missing out if you have not had it yet...!
5-the staff really is good and care about what they do.  

Things to know:
1- it is not a big place.  Make a reservation
2- You are going to pay for this meal. Good food has a price, but it is worth it. 
3-it is not a big place.  Make a reservation.  

If you are looking for a nice date night, then this is the place.

WOW! The king of burgers here in tampa, you will not find a better burger place in this city, guaranteed. Eaten here many times, and every time it is literal perfection. They have a great culture, staff, everyone is friendly and it's just a outstanding atmosphere! Try the hotdog sometime or take it home with you, don't sleep on the hotdog!

Just wow!!! TNT is one of my top recommended spots for burgers! 

Massive in size and flavor, these burgers are so incredible! The creativity in their menu is also what sets TNT apart. My favorite was the Cheesy Beast which is a patty topped with sausages, lettuce, tomato, and then CLOAKED in cheese. It is a sight to behold!  

Although the burgers themselves are the main attraction, don't miss out on the Salchipapas which are their fries loaded with an unbelievable amount of toppings like hotdogs, onion rings, chicken tenders, a variety of sauces etc.

Overall, these are some amazing burgers. The Colombian burger was so complex and tasty and cooked perfectly. It was my bf's favorite burger in his life, and I'd say it would be in my top 5 for sure. I ordered the Bella Ciao. The word that comes to mind is "fresh". The pesto and soft cheese give it a very light flavor even though you're eating a huge burger. The two employees said it was their favorite. For me, I prefer richer flavors so I wasn't awe-struck. The fries as a side are only $1.50 and taste really great. You can ask for dipping sauces and they'll include them; all three flavors were good.

Burger Culture is literally down the street and for me they're a tie as for burgers. The main difference is that Burger Culture can take an hour to get your food while it only took 4 minutes for TNT to make our food! Great service. We are absolutely coming back.
1st time at the TNT Burger.  Amazing food and good atmosphere!  Glad we stumbled upon this place.

This place never fails! It's always open when I am looking for late night food , quality is 100%. Many options, many sauces. Everything is cooked so well! Chill outside seating or just take to go, it's still good when you get home

great place to hang out and grab a latte and read a book. the ambiance is very homie - and they have pages from old books cascading from the ceiling. there isn't a whole lot in terms of seating, but it is an intimate coffee shop with books that you can purchase. i love the wooden center bar in the middle of the store, it definitely adds to the environment. i got one of their seasonal latte's, and it was perfect. Milky, frothy, and not too sweet. I'll definitely come back, and it feels like the perfect place to go on a snow day

Coffee was amazing, and the pizza croissants were really good. I also absolutely loved the selection of diverse children's picture books, and the barista was efficient, helpful and applied the Covid safety precautions firmly but in a friendly way. Absolutely recommend this place highly.

Love the local coffee shops and community spaces!  Uncle Bobbies is just that! A local gem  in the community not only to get good coffee  but a good read as well.


#supportblackshit
Cause as if it being a black owned bookstore isn't enough. The atmosphere is is great. The fare is tasty & its always clean & inviting.
Some real good coffee, nice folks, and a pretty great selection of books that you're not gonna find in other places. Make a point to visit
The best tacos in Tampa ,yea everyone says that but legit just go here and try it out .
This place is fire. I was staying up here for a class and this was in the neighborhood. Glad I walked in. Queso fundido and quesobirria are pretty great.

We love Catrina's.  Karol, an owner, makes sure your experience is 5 star every time.  The food is outstanding, we keep coming back again and again.  You can taste the skill and love in every fresh and delicious bite.  The atmosphere is very warm, inviting, relaxed and very comfortable.  Check this place out for sure.  You will not be disappointed.

After having tacos in Houston from a food truck that was all in Spanish...I have been searching for that taste in Tampa. I have not found it. However-Catrinas was the closest I have come to having that authentic taste but with all the flavor.

I went for lunch during the day and let me tell you. The aesthetic of the place is absolutely gorgeous. They incorporated so many of the Mexican themes in the decor. I am not sure if it was the restaurant owner or if she was just the cook...but she was so attentive to my coworker and I. We were the only ones in the restaurant and she took care of us so much Cooked all of our food to order. 

The esquites-mexican corn was so delicious. Just how I like it with plenty of cotija cheese. My tacos were so delicious and I was full for hoursss. 

I would have never known that there was this jewel just in the middle of West Tampa. Unfortunately with the demands of my job it is very rare that I cam take time to go away for lunch or even take a lunch but it was a very memorable and delicious experience.

Been here on three different occasions and everything has been phenomenal. The service was great but the food is absolutely delicious. I still can't believe one person can do so well at multitasking the kitchen, front and dining all at once. Absolutely breathtaking. Margaritas are right on the money! Not for weak folks. One of my favorite things to eat here are the chicken nachos and the sopes. Highly recommend this hidden gem. Have some grace and do not go rushing here! There are only two people working and doing everything. Not everyone has surpassed the pandemic and it's workforce decline. My go to Mexican food joint.

Great place for working as they have a lot of seating upstairs and downstairs and it is pretty quiet. If you come on a Saturday during December, they have drink specials where all drinks any size are only $1.

Inconsistent on COVID rules. I was there for less than 30 minutes when employees interrupted my meeting several times to tell me to wear a mask when I was actively eating or drinking. One of the times, I was in middle of a sip. Straw in mouth. The other time, I was chewing my pastry. I looked around and saw five other people without masks. There was two who didn't have any drink or food on their table space. Rather frustrating that I am following the rules and being punished and others aren't. When I brought it to the managers attention, he said they are new at implementing this policy. He couldn't or wouldn't  explain why I was being singled out. I left quickly after.

Very nice location, inside and out, come check it out!They have financial advisors to help you figure what you need financially and grab a bite while you're at it. Card holders get 50% off craft drinks. They recommend no photos inside if possible.

Now they're advertising on Capitol One X, annual fee is slightly higher but with sign up you get 100,000 points when after meeting the minimum requirements. 

CO is easy to use app, book your flights by using your points or convert them to paying down on your bills, PayPal it. They also partner up with H&M and other businesses to get you bonuses back on your purchases.

Second floor and first floor offer spaced apart tables and areas to do work. Great for students. Keep your mask on and distance if possible.

The best place for freelancers and remote workers! I have been there many times when I am tired of working at my home office.

A huge, open, sunny space in the middle of Rittenhouse Square and plenty of areas to work. You can find some nooks if you need a private space, though they get occupied pretty quickly during busy times.

The cafe is open 7 am - 7 pm and you have more than 8-hours of work time to spend there. Staffs don't seem to care too much about staying for a long period of time.

A huge plus if you have a Capital One card- all drinks and food for half the price. They don't taste the greatest, but decent.

They'd have daily events where people can come and get financial education if you are a Capital One member. They also have some fun community events as well as Popup shops from a local business. I have to say I was excited to find a local ice cream shop come for a tasting one day :)

Overall, it is a great place if you are looking for a place in the middle of the town to get some work done. Will love to come back someday + I wish there were Capital One Cafe like this in my town!

The restaurant was clean, the food was freshly prepared (we had to wait a few minutes, but so worth it) and although we picked it up practically around midnight, everything was spot on - our order was correct and the food tasted FANTASTIC!!! Any time I'm in Philadelphia, this halal joint is going to be my go to!!!!
First time trying this place, their General Tso's chicken is amazing! On top of that its halal, def one of the best chinese food spots I've ever tried and i will be recommending it.
Chicken was excellent. Everyone likes their meal. Fried pickles were wonderful as well. Highly recommended

When visiting Philly was looking for a quick easy lunch for the family. This place looked like it was worth a try. Food was great and service EXCELLENT. Definitely worth a visit if u are in the independence hall area

Great fried chicken at The Bourse!

I don't know what the other vendors are like at The Bourse, but if you have to choose one to eat from, you cannot go wrong with Freebyrd Chicken!

Recently, my wife, my son and I visited The Bourse on Independence Day weekend and, to our disappointment, almost every vendor was closed ... on Independence Day weekend?! In Philadelphia?! We were quite shocked that nothing was open here considering it was a holiday weekend in the city where the nation was born. However, in came Freebyrd Chicken to the rescue! And, thankfully, they did because not only were they the only vendor that was operating, but their food was damn good too!

Their menu wasn't very long, but my wife and I ordered The Freebyrd Chicken Sandwich and Chick-in-a-Box. The Freebyrd Chicken Sandwich was described as a buttermilk brined fried chicken, Alabama white BBQ sauce, homemade pickles on a soft roll. The Chick-in-a-Box consisted of buttermilk brined fried chicken strips, coleslaw, Alabama white bbq and Appalachian moonshine bbq sauces.

Food ..... absolutely blew us away. Just as shocked as we were that no vendor was operating at The Bourse, we were just as stunned at how delicious the fried chicken was. The Freebyrd Chicken Sandwich with the Alabama white BBQ sauce was, as Guy Fieri would say, out of bounds! The chicken was perfectly fried and really thick. The sandwich was a mess, but a delicious mess at that.

As for the Chick-in-a-Box, the strips were huge. I was so stuffed after eating as much of the strips as I could, but they were all extremely tasty. The only knock is that we wished that there was more of the Alabama white bbq and Appalachian moonshine bbq sauces for dipping. The fried chicken was excellent, but the sauces put them over the top.

Like I said, thank goodness that Freebyrd Chicken was open to save our dinner plans on Independence Day weekend. With no other vendors open at The Bourse and the rest of the area around Independence Hall pretty silent, we were truly glad that we ate at Freebyrd and, honestly, have no regrets about eating at The Bourse.

I took a star off this time because some of the meat on my ribs was a little tough instead of fall off the bone. This place is still great! I've been here probably about 20 times but this was the first takeaway I've had and earlier in the afternoon. We ordered the pig out meal for 4- comes with 1 slab of ribs, 1/2 chicken and a lb of meat- we chose sliced beef brisket which was $4 more but so worth it. The beef brisket is so good. It also comes with 4 sides and cornbread. We chose 2 Mac n cheese, baked beans d and no sweet potatoes. We also ordered a lb of bbq pulled pork and a side of the cucumber tomato salad. I know it's just cucumber tomato salad but I love it. Perfect amount of sour and sweetness. I didn't get the kielbasa this time and kind of regret it because I know how good it is. If you haven't been here yet, go!!
Love love love Sweet Lucy's!! The food is excellent! The staff is very nice and helpful. Truly enjoyable.
Not how it use to be they need some real cooks in there.stop going there since it fell off

Great service at the counter, even better food, good space for large parties as well. I like the variety of sides and desserts too! You can have table service or order and seat yourself which is nice. I always forget about this little gem but when I remember to go it's amazing!

I was very disappointed when I went here I heard such great things about this place, and when I went their I was sitting outside in my Uber. The Uber waited 30 mins for my food to even come out after they brought the wrong food because someone was parked in my designated parking spot. So not only did I have to pay $50 for a ride their and to wait but the food was so gross. The ribs were disgusting, and rubbery. I ended up throwing the whole thing out. Will not be returning.
Flavorful, kind staff & nice portions proud to finally find flavorful (not oversalted  rabo )
Great food, reasonable prices. Lots of variety of dishes. If you're not sure what to order just ask, the staff was amazing! Very large portions.

When you walk in you realize how much food they have. It's two sides and a meat. When I picked my sides they gave me enough food for two people. The avocado salads was an extra charge but worth every cent. 

Both our meals were 30$ which seems pricey for two people but I'm not complaining because it was delicious and I had some for left overs the next day and it was just as good. I'm not a huge fan of Spicy food but I love flavor and they managed to bake some of the juiciest chicken that packs flavor in every bite. 

Cooking rice in large quantities usually can be a hit or miss but the rice was soft and perfectly cooked. 

This place definitely knows how to cook and would recommend just for all the flavor.

Ahhhhh-mazing service and food! As first time customers (my mom and I), they were not only very patient but took time to answer questions and explain everything. You get A LOT for your $- I couldn't finish my food in one setting and I was upset about that :(. The food is extremely flavorful and overall mouth watering. We went back 2 nights in a row and plan to visit every time we are in town. If you haven't tried this place you need to. Thank me later! #freedom

The options were overwhelming. The staff let me sample an item I'd never heard of. It was a plaintain mash and it was incredible. The tostones were very delicious. I topped them with the beef and bell pepper option. 
The setup shows what all options are available and you choose one meat and two sides. My comrade chose the oxtail option and it was very well made. They have varies meats, soups, veggies. Vegetarian friendly in my option due to option selection. But also carnivore friendly lol.
Hours posted on doors and online say open till 10, but workers were locked up and said they're closed at 8:40 on a Friday night. Unacceptable.

If I could give them 0 stars then I would! Been here twice in the last week to pick up food for others and the drive thru is the only way possible to order/pickup food due to the inside being closed at all times. After sitting for 30 minutes in the drive thru when I finally got to the speaker/window the lady taking orders was very rude and I was told that they're doing the best that they can and short staffed. Having to wait for atleast 30 minutes on both occasions with about 6 cars ahead of you is ridiculous and hoping that with enough reviews/complaints they'll get better with there etiquette, wait times or maybe even open the inside of the restaurant back up because honestly they should feel honored that people still want to frequent there business due to the food not always being it's best.

Ordered online and waited 40 mins in the drive thru because the inside was closed. Called multiple times to see how to skip the line but no one answered. Then we I get home we open our food to see rotten potatoes and chicken missing. You could clearly see the potatoes were black and rotten when you put them in. But you don't answer the phone when I call then by the time I try to go back and return it, the restaurant closed. Disgusting. I know things happen and places are short staffed and stressed right now, but there's no excuse to serve this.

I have been a customer at this store since day one.  But, no more.  May last two experiences have been horrible.  I place my orders on line expecting to go for pick-up at the time promised to be ready and I also pay immediately as I place my order.  When I arrive I am notified I have to make a 1hour wait in line with all other customer who are purchasing at the drive-thru.  The first time it happened I called the store and said NO.  I will be in front of the store parked in the disable parking for them to deliver as promised my purchase.  They where not too happy but they did.  Yesterday I place a new and very large order two hours before pick-up time for 6 family members and paid immediately and was promised my order at 6:15PM.  I get there a few minutes ahead of time and there is a line at the drive-thru of 30 cars.  I tried calling the store and line was busy.  I knocked on the door and told I had to stay in line with those who are just purchasing at the window.  After more than one hour wait my food was not ready and they did not even look at my online order.  Of course when given my order number they didn't bother to look and took a verbal order.  Finally I get home and they had given the wrong meal and not enough food for my family.  I was so upset I actually felt I was getting sick for their lack of interest of getting it wright.  So I proceed to the store with my printed order and demanded to speak to the manager.  She came out and I explained my disappointment and was told she had some new employees.  I said that is not my problem and if you would answer the stores phone this could have been corrected on the spot.  She said that she had not been able to charge the stores phone for that day and that is why I received a busy tone.  I said that is not my problem.  This
manager is a disgrace for this business and should me fired.  Today it still bothers me the lack of interest to serve their customers.  We are not doing them a favor.  We are helping this business to stay open and prosper.  I will never visit this store and all that I know I will let them know about my experience.

Never Go Back.

Mrs. Rivera

I came from Vegas today and went to this place just before closing time      Was way better than i expected it to be!    Burger was really good....   Sweet potato fries were spot on and the mango habanero ketchup was awesome. Service was good too!

Late lunch, our first time... 6 of us and the burger were AMAZING!!! you have to stop for burgers- skirted cheese burger is great.  Fries. Onion rings, milk shakes and the staff were on point!  Night recommend you check this joint out!

Great food all around!!  We had a group of 6 and tried almost everything...burgers, chicken, salad, fries, sweet potato fries, onion rings, cookies and a shake!!!  Everything was fantastic, hot and fresh.  We will definitely be back!!
Quick friendly service, and an awesome burger. Good crust on the patty. Chips with monger seasoning hit the spot as a side. I will definitely eat here again.
The best burgers and fries.  Highly recommend the Burger Monger burger with black peppers and an onion ring.  Yum!!

This place is a joke!!!! Ordered 3 items that they were out of...Ruben Rolls, Santa Fe Rolls, & Shepherds Pie. This was at 8:30 on a Saturday night! It's apparently a golf club bar so the regulars think they come first & are loud & rude! Service was very slow as well! I gave 3 stars because the staff was friendly! I'm Irish so over all I was VERY DISAPPOINTED!!!!
the lady at the front was extremely rude . She practically through my order at me Sesame Chicken

This place is a hidden gem for sure! It's located in a weirdly hidden shopping plaza next to a hotel. The parking lot is weirdly shaped but there's a lot of parking. There's a ton of options to chose from on the menu. 

My go to here is the shrimp with broccoli but I ask for a white sauce since the brown sauce is too soy saucey tasting for me (I'm not a big fan of soy sauce). The egg rolls are AMAZING! And I say that with honesty cause I hate egg rolls elsewhere. I like both their egg rolls plain and with shrimp in them. The portion isn't huge like I've gotten elsewhere but for me it's a good amount. They make amazing wanton soup and be careful! It's hot like it came from the seven levels of the underworld! But it's almost guaranteed to be hot when you get home! The krab Rangoon are super delicious and come with the standard sweet and sour sauce. 

The inside is clean and well maintained. Utensils are to the right on the counter along with sauce packets. The service is always prompt and you have the option to order online too. Overall it's one of my go to picks for quick service and delicious food!

This "Philly Pretzel Factory" has a drive thru window and which is nice if you have kids.  The staff is always quick to fill your order.  
If you place an order early it's always ready when you arrive (even on football games when there are trays piled up). 
The store is very clean.  The owner must be very generous with making donations because you always see gift baskets at church events and local fundraiser.
No matter how many years go by, this sushi has remained amazing! Prompt service and delicious rolls!

This place is 30 minutes from me without traffic. However, I decided to take the 45 minute drive to pick up lunch from there because I tasted my sister's sushi and LOVED IT. I was not a fan of sushi before. I had my boyfriend drive me all the up to Oxford Ave just to get me two rolls of ex-girlfriends and 1 shrimp tempura roll. I'm not proud to say I almost ate all three rolls. That means something coming from a person whom wouldn't touch sushi a year ago.

Best sushi and shrimp tempura I've tried in this vicinity. I took one star off because the last time I ordered the sushi rolls were smaller than usual but I understand costs have increased. They always get the order right and they are super fast without jeopardizing quality. I usually get ex girlfriend, lobster wasabi, and a few other rolls. Also, if you like tempura, try it here because it's VERY GOOD: The shrimp/veggies should be battered lightly (not too thick) and Mr Sushi gets this right!!! The crunch when you bite into it is amazing. My dad craves it like once a month and the dinner portion size is more than enough for 2-3 people.
Friendly staff, fresh food, efficient service. Never had anything bad from this place. My family's favorite go-to spot.
Great food and fast service. I go for the California Rolls and the Rock Shrimp. Everything is always super fresh. Also, the Shrimp Tempura is a must!
Bargain breakfast on weekdays is great, especially because it includes some delicious coffee. Perfect spot cash only.

Wonderful location within the city and tucked away nicely on a quiet street. The menu is quite typical of a standard pro-brunch spot but the food is lovely. I have frequented this restaurant and enjoy every trip more than the last. Taking 1 star off because some managers tend to rush patrons in order to accomodate the next group on busy days. Not the restaurants fault but management leaves a little to be desired. 

Cheers.

Came here last minute on Valentine's Day. The nachos, margaritas, and veggie enchiladas were so good. Wasn't crazy about the ambiance or service but understandable due to covid and it being valentines day. Our table was next to the open window and it was FREEZING. We asked if we could move to a booth on the inside and they obliged. Had a very strict time limit of one hour which I thought was too tight. With that being said, I do want to go again for the food - just hoping they keep it warmer during the winter this time.

This place is fine! I appreciate masked servers. They say they check vax cards at the door, but they just ask people to put masks on. Lots of outdoor dining options. Their tacos and spicy margs were good as well as their chips. Their guac def left a lot to be desired however. I think it came out of a package, and it's the smallest portion ever for like $11. One thing is that they're using takeout stuff for dine in, which I think is very strange. While the packaging is mostly cardboard, it feels very weird going out to eat and eating off of that. Oh well. If I'm ever feeling local Tex mex, I'll come here again but maybe for takeout like I did the first time. Note: no hh specials anymore!
Solid! Good drinks. Atmosphere is nice. Loved the spicy jalapeño marg. Food is solid as well. Came on a Thursday and it wasn't too busy
Really terrible margaritas but very nice bartenders. Seriously though, really weak margaritas that just taste like watered down sour mix. Real bummer.

This restaurant was a fun ambiance but these were some of the most bland "tacos" I've ever had. Honestly the appetizers were better than the meal. I ordered the beef gringo which was insanely under seasoned. I'd recommend coming here for just drinks and maybe some desert or the fried corn was very tasty. They charged me $2.50 for salsa verde which wasn't even told to myself to be an extra charge. I'd beware the overcharges and bland food.

220 East is as close to good home style cooking with just enough flair to keep you interested. The portions are enormous and can easily be split for a small charge. Service is friendly and attentive. Great cocktails and soups
Out door dining is available if the weather is good and there is always something happening in the neighborhood. Very fair pricing.

This is a staple on Davis islands! All the locals love it and so do I! The grouper is always fresh! The specials are also great. I got the grouper blackened and my mom got the prime rib/ shrimp scampi special. Great place and great atmosphere!

Server was not very friendly. Ordered extra protein (chicken) with my entree. Friend did not in his. We had the same amount of protien. Server seemed inconvenienced when we ordered desert. Food was good.

Best curries in the Tampa Bay region! Order them Thai style & you will never be satisfied with any other curry. The flavors absolutely "popped" in your mouth with freshness & flavor! We have a plethora of  Thai places in the areas around St Pete  but nothing like this!
Best Thai/value in downtown Tampa. Everything was really good, and the mango sticky rice brought memories from Bangkok Thailand. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed

I got the Lunch Pad Thai Noodle for $9.95. It came out as $12.31 after taxes and fees. The small roll it came with was a bit stale and didn't taste fresh and crispy as I expected it would. The amount of food wasn't much but it was enough to satisfy me. The Pad Thai was a little dry and lacked flavor...kind of like having leftover noodles the next day.

I ordered online around 1 pm and my meal was ready in about 12 minutes. The restaurant itself looks very nice on the inside. 

Overall, I give it a 3. The food was average but I'd be willing to give it a second chance to see if maybe a dine-in experience would be better.

Went back and dined in on Saturday night. Ordered a bunch of food; everything was very tasty, on point! I'd say the only thing was the portion size (kind of pricey relative to the amount of food given).

This little breakfast spot is the PERFECT place for a nice brunch, breakfast, or even grabbing coffee with an old friend. My best friend told me that this had become her new favorite breakfast place in Fishtown and I couldn't wait to try it! 

The place is smaller in size, but do not let that scare you if you need to wait 20 minutes to be seated because they are FAST! We got seated right away luckily arriving before 9 am, by the time we left a little after 10 it was completely crowded with every table filled. 

I ordered a coffee, tofu scramble with latke and biscuit, and my friend ordered a mac and cheese pancake, yes you read that right, and eggs. The tofu scramble was ok, not the best one I've ever had, but it did the job and the latkes/biscuits were perfect! I tried a little piece of the mac and cheese pancake and wow! Who would of known? With everything and tip we only ended up paying around $30, which is amazing. I'd recommend and looking forward to going back myself to try other options

I visited honey's last Friday for breakfast with a friend. We got there when they first opened and sat down right away. We both had the lox platter and I also had a Matcha latte with oat milk. The bagel tasted super fresh and everything that the lox plate came with was fresh as well. The menu is huge and there's so much to choose from. I also got a potato latke because I just had to try it and it was delicious. I will definitely visit again next time I'm in town.
Great food with a diner feel. I got the breakfast sandwich and my partner got the breakfast bomb, which is really enjoyed! Those home fries was great!
always good choice for a hung over brunch ! it's like a glorified diner. i can't just suggest one item because this is a spot i never pick the same item !

It suck that I have to do this, but this location has completely fallen off... I have been going here for more than 10 years, since see the Chicken Fried Steak featured on Triple D (since that first visit, my trips have all been for breakfast at around 7am). I went on Sunday for my birthday breakfast and was provided with a plate that did not match my order, which did include pancakes but these were close to raw. Moreover, the formerly perfect coffee was bleh and fired up heartburn. Expectantly, the formerly best Turkey sausage that had a hint of maple was replaced my small discs as hard as a frisbee. The latke was still amazing and the eggs were cooked great, but for the the price and friendliness; when we were the only ones there it was a monumental disappointment and I am done for a long time.
If you're in Ybor city and enjoy a cigar, check out this shop.  Has many cigar selections with a bar to pair the smoke.  You can hang inside or outside because they have plenty of space.

Brian makes the best Old Fashioned I've ever had, with Angel's Envy. I've been coming here for over a decade and it's still my favorite bar or restaurant in Ybor. When Ybor is crazy, KC is the calm eye of the storm.
I have family members who live out in other Stares that Love cigars from them. So now I know what to five as gifts.

Probably the best cigar shop I stopped in during my vacation run. First of all, it's perfect darkness level inside. Kinda like how the cigars are displayed behind sliding glass doors where you just serve yourself. Good selection of name brand cigars, with a few house cigars.

Long bar top, plenty of stools, some local craft on tap with full bar. Good sized room, some chairs, tables, a row of tables up at the front window and some tables and chairs outside as well. Nice that you can sit outside and smoke around here. Like it, but sat at the nice air conditioned, dark, bar and had a few drinks.

Staff really friendly. Answer your questions, service was good. I understand they have a kitchen and serve food but I didn't eat anything. Very relaxing, low music, several TV's going on different channels, volume down. Nice place, will be one of my places to return when I find myself in Tampa again.

First time here! 

Stopped by for some Haitian food on their Independence Day. Kreyol Delight wasn't open for their normal hours so I went with what I thought was the next best option. 

I wanted the oxtail but they didn't have it so I opted for the griot and rice. It was overall a solid meal but I feel like the griot was fried a little hard and was kind of missing that crispy outside but soft in that the dish is known for. The rice was very good. I was a little sad that the dish wasn't served with plantains for the price. 

All in all, I'd definitely return in a pinch. The staff was nice and the place was clean. I wish the menu had a few more options available but what I got was decent. I'd call ahead if you're deciding to go.

Saddens me to write this cause I want my people to win, but at this point, Alez is embarrassing Haitian cuisine to be selling this mess.

I bought a large diri kole pwa rouge ak koden (rice and peas with fried turkey) and the rice was soooo dry and tasteless. The turkey was ok but it wasn't the most flavorful as it usually is. My red flag was the sauce! Before paying I held it and asked them if this is the sauce they make and they said yes- but it was just the broth from the meat they cooked. They either poured it directly into the cup or attempted to make a sauce with it and tomato paste but failed miserably. Haitian cuisine is like no other and this restaurant continues to get more terrible overtime. I've been eating here since 2015 and the food taste is currently at its worst. I wasted $14 because I could only eat like 4 bites of it- I lost my appetite for the whole day and gotta reset my taste palette. Im gonna have to either re-cook/re-vamp it or just take my L and throw it out.

The last management made tolerable food to eat when you crave Haitian food but Kreyol Delight is closed or something, this new management is just terrible. I should've drove the extra mile to KD-- never am ever eating here again.

Dirty, all u can smell is old burnt fryer oil...had to go outside as eyes were burning and my clothes and hair were permeated with greasy smoke. People laying on booths, girl at front scratching her weave.... No more pick ups there ‍

One of the best Haitian restaurants, although customer service need some improvement, the food is always delicious and they give you plenty. I spent a good deal of time looking for a good Haitian restaurant, once I stumbled to this place it instantly became my spot. Definitely recommended
I don't know how the food is, because it was closed when I got there at 11pm on a Friday. Apparently the hours are wrong and not open till 12....
Super exclusive. I always stay at the hotel near this area but can rarely get in. Great lamb!

Wow, just wow. On a recent trip to Philadelphia I was shocked at how amazing the food is at Zahav. So many courses and flavors. I can't even pick my favorite because all of them were so good, however the sweet potato cooked like BBQ was over the top! Can't wait to be back.

A work of ingenuity. Came in for my husbands birthday and loved that the entire menu was already taken care of. Whenever I go to a restaurant I always ask- what would you recommend? What does the chef create that is good? The Zatar flatbread bread  smothered with zatar was a miracle and the myriad of 6 dips like  a tart eggplant  ( I need to reread the menu)) perfect tender crunchy carrots, beet salad, best   hummus I have had with this spicy aoli, and my favorite was the crunchy tangy cabbage...reminded me of Indian thali with chutneys.  

I can go on and on with the wine pairings flavors and write an entire novel about the layers flavors ambiance superior hospitality of this restaurant and meal. The chef came to the table- I was thinking how do you do it? Wish I took a picture with him.

Just another thing- my daughter said she was dreaming of the chicken- she is very picky and has eaten in many restaurants around the world ( we all have)-

Came here for my bday dinner and it was such a great experience. The staff were so friendly and accommodating. The food was amazing - lots of food with good size portions. The hummus was spectacular.
Highly recommend!

Went to Zahav in October and had a wonderful sit down dinner with this feast of a spread. The food and service here was amazing - for a world class restaurant there wasn't a shred of false pretense. We were welcomed in like family and dined like royalty.

A couple of tips for the uninitiated - pace yourself. There is a LOT of food that comes with the tasting menu and you will want to eat every single plate and clear it all before the next plate is set down. Don't do that. You'll just end up setting yourself for speed eating and losing out on all the nuanced flavors and appreciation for the technique.

Without question the star of the meal was the lamb shoulder and the rice... I'm really glad I left some room for that. Imagine being stuffed before that shows up at your table? Other personal favorites were the grilled haloumi - ours was served with these insanely umami bomb-like tomatoes that just sends shockwaves into your brain. The veggie salads to start were also a lot of fun, having a little variety to whet your appetite is a great way to start off an epic meal.

Enjoy!

Love this place!  Just moved to Tampa and yell reviews steered me here.  Samantha greeted me right away and was exceptional at refilling my drink.  I opted for the Rib eye and it was surprisingly not fatty and cooked to perfection.  Broccoli and salad were fresh - huge for me!
Fun lace to watch games and the atmosphere is friendly.  I'm glad to have a new hang out!

Great place to have lunch or dinner, relaxing atmosphere, with excellent service. We are not from this area but we've made North 30 into a regular stop when in town. Great hamburgers btw! Eat in or pick up. Thanks guys
Awesome place with a great environment. Fast service with great food! Arrived with two young children and tbh I was hesitant to going because of it being close to USF but I was throughly impressed

This place is awesome...lots of t.v.s and music and great atmosphere. Nice hangout  and have great food and great service. The servers here are cute and sweet and try very hard to make sure you are taken care of.the food is delicious and hot and served promptly. It has great outside seating and they do have bands playing out there too once in a while. This place is one of my Hangouts. I like it here. Bring the whole family !!
This place is a gem !!! Thank you north 30th for being such a awesome spot. Go to Facebook to keep up with bands playing there, gives time and info !!!
Good food. sweet tea was delicious!  friendly staff,  good and comfortable atmosphere. even kid friendly. Indoor outdoor seating with great views of televisions.
Bun Bo Hue is the best!!! Always order extra spicy and substitute with pho noodles!!!

Highly recommend this spot, definitely a hole in the wall mom and pop shop. The space is small, so I'd recommend coming in smaller groups or during less busy times. Their specialty BBH doesn't come with blood and has the option to be without pig feet as well if that's not your thing! 

Parking might be a little difficult, but there are two parking lots nearby, each with 2 hour free parking - street parking too, if you get lucky!

The soup was so flavorful and the flavors of salty, umami, and spicy were so balanced. I thought it would just taste like spicy pho but it was so much better than I expected! I also loved that they used thick noodles (thinner than udon but thicker than regular pho noodles). 

[food insta: @strwbrrryboba for more food :)]

I love bun Bo hue and this place really does it the best. It's a small, but very cozy restaurant. Get the special BBH. I got a small, but I would get the large next time. There's a lot of meat in it and it's just so flavorful. Come check this place out!

Authentic, flavorful food with great service in a quiet family atmosphere. The portions are very generous with plenty to take home for another meal. The pho is especially tasty and filled with lots of sumptuous ingredients.
I love this place, the menu is vast and friendly service. I enjoy the Bun Bo Hue and Banh Cuon Cha, the food was good and really delicious. The prices are fair and the services are fast! I also recommend the Pho as well. They let you make your own if you are unsure what to get

Don't bother going if you don't have a reservation.   Walk up is like Black Friday and despite lining up at 4:15 to try and get a table, folks rushed past us and into the restaurant and when they opened the doors.  Terrible crowd management.  So much for a special dinner for our anniversary.   Even if we'd have stayed the experience was souring.

Not sure who gives this place less than 5 stars right? I drank a bottle of wine from 1984 for $60, which was delicious and I still find amazing. Where else can you do that? The food is 10/10, ALWAYS, everything on the menu, French onion soup is a must have. Also make sure you eat some dessert and have a drink in their upstairs room after the meal, it's a unique experience for sure.

I wanted so bad for this to be an amazing experience. We had put in a reservation months in advance, then changed it near the date and they were great about it, even getting us in earlier. Service was impeccable throughout the night from everyone we dealt with. Now comes the BUT. But the food was just good. All of the meat was good and well cooked (save one entree) but it was just good. Not spectacular like the hype says it should be. And, quite frankly, not anywhere worth the premium we paid. It is a good steakhouse and the service is great, but the meal just does not meet up to the hype. Maybe that's just not possible.

The hype is real here. I've been told by many people I know this has to be one of the places you stop by if you're ever in Tampa, and it's true. This restaurant is an old school steak house that books up real fast so make sure to make a reservation way ahead of time. Service is stellar. All entrees come with their signature salad, soup, and sides. They can even book you a table at the dessert room when you sit down for your dinner. 
Highly recommended!

I will say this, I've never given a 5 star review and then have something I don't like, but I'll get to that in a bit.

 First, service was outstanding and very pleasant. Very attentive with refills. Kevin always made sure we were take. Care of.

 Appetizers and salads were tasty. My wife got a house salad and I got the crab cakes. If you like seafood, you would like the cakes.
 
 Entrees were also amazing. Wife had a 10oz sirloin and I had the flounder. Both of which cut like butter.

 I am still going to give this place five stars but I will say the dessert room was super disappointing. We were better off just stopping at Dairy Queen. Everything we tried was just dry and flavorless. Just a personal opinion, I wouldn't recommend visiting. Everything else is off the five star scale.
The strawberry smoothie was ELITE. I'd make sweet passionate love to it. I'd start a family with it and build it a home with my bare hands. Highly recommend

Tried their hot chocolate and coconut milk tea with boba yesterday. Didn't particularly like either of those especially the hot chocolate. It was extremely watery and cloyingly sweet. Might update this review after trying some of their other lattes (like matcha or red bean) but only once they start serving in proper ceramic mugs (they are currently serving in to-go cups because of covid). I hate drinking anything out of to-go cups, they not only ruin the whole experience but I feel like they affect the taste of the drink as well - for the worse.

Honestly, I'm surprised by the quality of food and drinks here. I wasn't expecting much coming in. I had an avocado smoothie  made with fresh avocado and condensed milk. The green tea Millie crepe was very good. I was craving for some, but A La Mousse always run out. So I'm glad they have it here and was tasty. I wonder who made it. I will totally come here more often.

First time ever giving a one star review. We ordered taro milk tea, mocha frappe, and chocolate pyramid dessert. Total $18. Very disappointed with each one. Sadly, could not really enjoy at all or even finish any of them since none tasted good. And all of them tasting kinda bad is the unfortunate reason for the one star (sorry). Just to warn that based on this, we don't feel comfortable coming back or trying anything else and to tell you that it may not be worth your time and money to try it either. Maybe some of their items are actually good (I doubt it?), check other reviews to see what others recommend if you still want to try it out.  Other notes are: Very cute interior of the restaurant. Nice but slow service, but only one person taking orders and making orders. 
For milk teas I highly recommend Mr. Deer the Camp's brown sugar deerioca series in Philly's China Town.

I have been going to Deke's for years and not only is the closest bbq spot to me but, I really enjoy almost everything on the menu I have ever had. From big family meals to a meal with a friend I always suggest this spot when I'm in the mood for bbq and don't feel like lighting up my smoker.


The fat boy sandwich, ribs, pulled pork, brisket, wings etc etc are all very good. The only reason I give it 4 stars out of 5 is every now and then I have found the noodles in the macaroni and cheese to be under cooked and personally I have never liked the cole slaw. I have had the food enough to know when it's really good and when it's below it's average and I would say maybe 1 out of the 4 or 5 times I order food every year I have this issue. Otherwise this spot is great and I suggest giving it a try.
Food is delicious! Went twice and both times the ribs were awesome! Definitely go there if you want good bbq!!
Amazing BBQ! Got the food truck at the Citylight Fall Fest at Gorgas park. Was perfect BBQ for a fall day.

First time trying  Deke's. We got the Baby Back ribs and they were a bit on the dry side but I still enjoyed them. We ordered online so we weren't familiar with the sauce flavors and there wasn't a description of what Q, XX, and etc were so I just chose the first one I saw. I think if they could update the descriptions on their apps that would be helpful for the customers. We also got the fritters and pickles. I regret not ordering more pickles! They were so good especially if you like bread and butter pickles. My sister got the chicken and pork sliders. Chicken was a bit dry but the pork was great! Overall good first experience. 
Price wise for the food preparation, is slightly higher than I would have wanted to pay, but you do get a reasonable portion.
They are still OPEN! Go to the website to grab their number for orders because the number listed in Yelp doesn't work. Highly recommend the oxtail meal on Sundays!
They are efficient and very friendly. Food is great and a refresher from the normal. Very clean and never a long wait.
The food used to be good but it seems like the staff doesn't care about quality anymore. Last 3 times I went it was just bad attitudes and the food looked like slop.

This Caribbean food restaurant is tucked away amongst a slew of other storefronts on FF ave.  It's easy to miss if you're not paying attention. 

They do not have a dining area and are open for take out only.

The cashier was very friendly and food was very good.  I ordered the curry chicken platter which came with cabbage slaw and rice for around $12. The serving was huge and could be split into 2 meals. I also ordered the beef patty which had a nice kick and was also very tasty.

Folks, I've thrown out the bad money at this place, don't use your good money to chase something that won't be there.  Save your time and money, you're worth it.  This soon to be shuttered joint isn't.

I really try not to give out a lot of five stars or one stars.  One star is reserved for establishments that should not be in the food and beverage business.

Normally, I'd give this place two stars.  Except they committed one inexcusable sin (details to follow).

In theory, an interesting concept, Cajun Seafood boil.  In execution, a VERY poorly re-purposed "Famous Dave's" remodeled on a shoe string budget.  In fact, the entire operation is on a miser's stipend and it shows at every facet.

Food:  Very low quality, clearly all of this was institutionally sourced, seafood previously frozen (you don't freeze, thaw and serve raw oysters).  Chowder was quite probably generic Campbells.  Razor clams also clearly previously frozen, placed in a bag with "broth", potatoes, and an ear of corn and lovingly nuked in a plastic bag.

Service was extra ordinally slow, 2:30 on a Friday afternoon in January, in attentive, in-experienced, and all in all a poor unprofessional episode.

WHAT EARNED ONE STAR:

My cocktail.  I ordered a Bombay martini.  Admittedly I can be very specific, but witnessing how bumbling our server was, I'd be glad to settle for a chilled glass of Bombay, no vermouth, no "stirred", no garnish, that's how low my expectations were.  I literally asked for a Bombay Martini, nothing else.  Even a rocks glass with Bombay on ice would have passed that incredibly low bar.  Impossible to screw that up, right?
When it arrived, I realized that I should have asked for "a clean glass".  The rim of the glass was caked in what appeared to be dirt.  Since my cocktail arrived at the same time as our entrees, (which makes it SO much easier for the server, and that's what dining out is all about), it was never checked up on and we didn't see our server again.  
At the end of the meal, I pointed out that I wasn't served Bombay, and that the glass was filthy, I was told that this was sugar and salt?!?!?!  (Possibly true, but would you taste check something that looked like filth?)  I told the server I was certain I hadn't ordered that (I'd never even dreamt of it in my worst nightmare) and was responded to with a shrug of the server's shoulders.
I was charged $13.00 for a glass of Bombay Sapphire (not Bombay) in a filthy glass that made it undrinkable.

The only way I'd consider re-visiting this joint was if they'd throw a paper bag with my $70 through my car window as I slowly drove by the front of their "restaurant".  Not just a bad experience, a shameful one.

First off, let me say: THIS PLACE IS THE BEST PLACE FOR A CAJUN SEAFOOD BOIL! My aunt and I decided to come here today. We were greeted by 3 young men, who kindly asked us, if we had masks, due to it being mandatory in Philly. We did. We were seated and given menus and within 2 minutes, we were greeted by an AMAZING waiter named Benny. (We will be back to see him) We started off with the lobster bisque, hush puppies and lobster claws and arms for appetizers. The lobster claws and arms were SUPER fresh and sitting in a Lovely garlic butter sauce! So yummy! The hush puppies were GREAT! They also got dunked in the garlic butter! The lobster bisque was a little too thick for my liking and reminded me of baby food mixed with the baby cereal... But... My Aunt loved it! We created our own boils which consisted of the following: My Aunt had 2 snow crab clusters, 1/2 pound of shrimp with the head off, a lobster tail, broccoli, corn and potatoes in the hook and real sauce mild. I had 1 cluster of dungeness, 1/2 pound of crawfish, 1/2 pound of head on shrimp, a lobster tail, boiled eggs, broccoli, and corn and potatoes. We both got extra sides of the garlic butter for dipping and dunking! It was AMAZING!! The crab was JUICY!! The lobster was tender and moist!! You could taste the freshness of the shrimp! The corn was sweet! The broccoli was clearly fresh with the perfect amount of crunch! The sauce was absolutely DELICIOUS! The portions are huge!!! In fact, not only did we leave with more than half our food, we ordered 2 additional lobster tails, because they were THAT good!!! Then, the manager Rob, was kind enough to walk us out to our car! They've earned a life long couple of customers! Thank you hook and reel!

Great food and atmosphere. I love a restaurant that is extremely clean especially during this time of pandemic.I live that they have added me items to the menu this keeping things new and deliciously interesting. Like the new lobster claw appetizer and entree. The presentation was beautiful and so was the taste. Not many places offer just lobster Claws as an option so I thought this was especially nice for the menu upgrade. The veggies were delicious too and didn't taste like an after thought but rather complimented the dish. The broccoli wasn't over cooked but cooked just right so as to maintain its nutrients. And the corn didn't taste freezer burned like at some places that throw it on the dish as an after thought. I love that they use garlic that actually taste like garlic. There mussels are HUGE in comparison to most seafood restaurants and you get a lot of them. The only con is that they need better fries. Their fries don't taste like real potatoes. The fries are rather a loveless after thought. Bland and reminiscant of card board. Our waitor was friendly and courteous. Even when he accidentally put my appetizer in as an entree. He attentively took care of removing it from the bill and apologized for the misunderstanding. Overall I'm satisfied and will continue returning.
This was my first time at Hook and Reel. The food was Delicious and our server Leon was great. He was very attentive to us. Everything was served fresh and will come again!

Haven't been here in a long time so, I decided to come in for dinner. There was no wait (arrived around 9 pm) and mask were not mandatory nor did they ask vaccination status of patrons. 
Ordered 2 clusters of snow crab legs with old bay and a side of garlic butter as well as crabmeat fries. 
I was disappointed with this meal.  The crabmeat fries were good minus the white sauce that was on them. I did NOT care for that sauce and am unsure of what it was but to me it didn't seem to go. 
Our clusters had no flavor at all and the garlic butter was just regular butter NO garlic.

I'm so thrilled to discover this wonderful French  pastry!!!! As a dessert lover, I'm craving for a delicate pastry shop in Philly (where it is hard to find except the Korean Paris Baguette...). I'm soooooooo glad to discover this little place! The croissants are both crispy and soft at the same time. You can taste the delicate thoughts put into these bakery. Definitely will come more often!!

Super awesome and cute little shop. I appreciate they checked vaccinated status. The staff was extremely attentive and nice. They helped me pick out the right pastries for me. Would recommend and going back

I stopped by this lovely little bakery in Center City on my way to a friends house. I ordered an orange olive oil cake, chocolate pretzel croissant, and regular chocolate croissant. All were superb!! The olive oil cake was out of this world and I'm determined to try and recreate it in the near future. The pretzel croissant had an interesting crunchy topping and great texture in general. This place also serves La Colombe coffee which is my favorite coffee, as an avid tea drinker & occasional coffee drinker.

Cute store that is small dog friendly! Very chic interior with very friendly staff. They missed my sandwich order which was a bummer but other pastries were satisfying. The lemon tart was too sweet for me but the pastry on the Napoleon was super flaky and lovely and the blueberry galette was the perfect amount of sweet.

This has been my favorite place to get coffee and pastry's in Philly since it opened 4 years ago. The staff is kind and welcoming (They go above and beyond). The owner is a brilliant pastry chief. The shop is beautiful, clean, and has wifi!

The pastry's are always fresh and the coffee is always hot. I cannot recommend J'aime enough!

Friendly people and awesome sangria. Second weekend we have been here. Sundays are happy hour on sangria. Few flavors to choose from. Have had the red, rose and mango. All good. Still a couple more flavors to try.

The customer service was amazing. The cashier was very attentive. I really enjoyed the yuca fries and the pork cuban was cooked to perfection. They said it would be a 15 minute wait but I got my food way before then. However I also didn't mind the wait because I had a tasty mango sangria that was recommended by a gentleman in front if me in line.

A basic Cuban. Nothing I would rush back for, the bread was fresh but the meat was barely seasoned. There's nothing I can really say besides it's a basic Cuban. On the other hand do you see those tostones? I thought this was a joke. I've never seen tostones look this bad and they tasted even worst. It's like they have them made and then just refry them in oil once you order them. They were cold and burnt at the same time(shocking). Hard as a rock 0/10.

This was my favorite stop at the food hall! I was interested in a bunch of their appetizers, but since we were trying lots of spots, we only got one thing. 

We decided to get the Cuban Salchipapa. They were loaded Yuca fries. The chicharrónes on them were so good. The combination of flavors was great. 

I'd definitely come back to try more!
The place was crowded and the menu is expensive. The staff were rude and it's not real Cuban food. Will never visit this establishment again

We stopped here for drinks and Michelle B. was a very sweet and fun bartender. 

The house whiskey that they use in their Old Fashioned is Old Forester; Well balanced in taste and presented sensibly. 

The Last Word is a dry gin cocktail made with Nolet's Silver, Filthy Cherry, and Chartreuse. Tastes sour and tart. A cute feminine cocktail for sipping on.

The ambience of this bar was business casual and comfortable.
I haven't been here in years but the offerings have changed tremendously.  They offer less wine choices.

I would knock this up to a 3 1/2 if I could...this really is a fun place to spend some time.  Usually solid service...just a couple things that you need to be ready for.  First off, the bar is tucked away in a far corner and not big at all.  Be ready to stand a few people deep to get your drink if you aren't already seated somewhere.  Secondly, the outdoor area has some comfy seating, but you are right on the street, and at an intersection to boot.  It can get quite loud.
Overall though, really a pretty solid place that is a little off the beaten path.
I would recommend it for a drink or two, and then hit one of the myriad of restaurants just a block or two away.

The food is better than 3 stars. They have no idea who they want to be. MMA, poker and pro wrestling on half the channels. Art Deco nude prints on the walls. Seat yourself in the restaurant, and a lottery system as to who serves you if anyone.  Mismanaged.

I didn't take pictures of the food, because it took so long to arrive we had to shovel it down in order to make our show across the street at the Straz.  It took between 35-45 minutes after we ordered to have food in front of us. Every time we asked our server about it, we were told it was 'just about out' or 'they're plating it now', both of which were falsehoods.  If you are trying to have dinner before a show, I would definitely find another establishment to eat at.

I understand most businesses are short staffed, but after reading previous reviews, it looks like slow service and slow food preparation are pretty much the norm.

The food, once it arrived, was decent, with my favorite being the chopped salad.  The pretzel was good, as was the meatball appetizer, which came with two huge meatballs.  The tuna, while the presentation was nice, had literally zero flavor.  I probably would have enjoyed the food more if I had more than 5 minutes to eat it, but I will pass on this place in the future.

Soooo fresh,delicious,and flavorful! Would highly recommend!
Also,the best cheesesteak wrap I ever did have!!
Terrible. We ordered chicken shwarma and beef shwarma platters, and they bore no resemblance to shwarma. The meat was just boiled and dry, with no  seasonings and clearly not roasted.

This place is incredible. We had ordered delivery, and the grubhub driver left the food on the porch without notifying us. We dog owners did not foresee the foods arrival without notice, and let the pups outside. You can guess what happened next. Two four legged creatures happy as can be, belly's full of Smiley's, and some less than happy humans. After contacting the great people here, not only did they offer to drive the replacement eats to our door themselves past closing, but we were refunded for the whole thing. Not only did our scavengers eat for free, but so did we!!! Please give your patronage to this wonderful establishment. We now understand the name is as such because they will make you smile no matter what. Beautiful people!!!

Dreadful meal.  We ordered chicken shawarma platters.  The shawarma bore zero resemblance to the dish by that name.  It was a lightly seasoned, very dry, overcooked chicken breast on top of rice.  The pita bread was arguably even worse:  thin to the point of matzo crackers and about as tasty.  The beef shawarma was reported to be equally bad.  It's as if this restaurant had never tasted or been exposed to real Mediterranean food.
Super good food at really good prices! Their smoothies are awesome as well. Everyone is always very nice.
Fresh food. Each dish is freshly made. You can taste it it fresh. Great for lunch. A few tables to sit but small place.
It was OK at best.   I wanted the real 'Philly cheesesteaks' experience and this was average.   Meat wasn't flavored that well.  Wiz and onions were good.  Better flavor at jersey mikes.

We ate here yesterday and chose this spot because it had over 4 stars with over 9k reviews. My husband, myself, and two kids did not get the hype. Super bland sandwiches. Don't even think they added salt and pepper to it. I ordered just a cheesesteak with onions (American cheese), the kids shared a cheesesteak (American cheese), and my husband got a cheesesteak with peppers and onions (American cheese). Had to lift the meat up to confirm there was even cheese on it because of the lack of flavor. For our first "Philly cheesesteak" we were not impressed. Cash only. Parking is limited (we parked in a lot close by). Masks are required.

Very fast and definitely know what you want. I was visiting Philly so I really didn't know what I wanted and the line was going super fast. The cheesesteak was good though, I'll try a different place with more of a calming presence. Overall, it's always popping business over there, you won't be disappointed. Try the Philly taco out, I messed up and going to Jim's first, go to Lorenzo's Pizza and then Jim's to roll up the cheesesteak into the pizza! Also only cash! So beware, it's lacking in the meat with no flavor so get onions!

Everytime I think  of this place. Yummmmmmmmmmmm. Just went here for lunch with the boo and the line was quick and service is always attentive. Cant go wrong with a yummy whiz cheesesteak with mushrooms and onions. A forever favorite!

Jim's Steak was one of my favorite places for a quality cheesesteak for years. Their sandwiches used to be packed just like Pat's. They'd have chunks of steak, onions and cheese falling out after each juicy bite. By the time you've eaten a little more than half of a sandwich, you'd be stuffed - There was enough leftover to save for later! The crazy ass line that wraps around the building was worth the experience. Nowadays, neither Pat's nor Jim's stuff their sandwiches with a lot of meat anymore; the most recent visit has changed my perception my go-to-location for cheesesteak. 
The price DOES NOT justify the time you have to wait in line for a skimpy sandwich - I repeat, the quality of Jim's Steak is not worth 45-60 mins queue for a $14 (CASH ONLY) cheesesteak! 

If you don't believe me, check for yourself.

First time trying this place. Wanted to try a New Mexican restaurant and this place didn't disappoint. The tinga quesadilla was huge I was unaware of this and ordered two. The pastor tacos were really good. The sauces were pretty good I'm usually a green sauce type of girl but the red sauce was definitely my go to here!

I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place considering how many times I've been here. This is my brothers favorite cheesesteak in Philly. I'd say it's up there but not my fave. Don't make fun of me for my cheese whiz choice today. It's not my usual option but I was craving salty goodness. My usual is American wit. This place definitely gets the roll right, it's nice and soft. This is whole steak not chopped. They used to have the peppers and pickles on the counter but due to Covid, you now have to ask but they're still free of charge. I personally dislike the two different lines for steaks then sides/fries and drinks. No one wants to wait in line twice but they do it that way for when the lines are long to pump the steaks out fast. This was my first and probably last time getting the pizza fries, I'll stick to the regular cheese fries for now on.
Quit your job if you hate it...stop playing with your life playing with people food.sloppy and service sucks butthole.

I hate leaving negative reviews but I am trying to help anyone looking for honesty about where to eat.  I will keep it short.  I will come back and re-evaluate at some point but this trip was not good.

- It took 45 minutes for 3 steaks and only 4 people in line ahead of me.
- The fries are a separate cook so my fries with whiz were cold and mushy by the time I got the steaks.
