- This was not a staffing issue, there were 5 people working.
- 2 grill cooks and they were working ticket to ticket.  Didn't put the meat on the grill for one order until the entire last order was complete.
- Not a cheap steak, and not a ton of meat.  

I am a chef of 20 years.  Not only do I know what i'm talking about, but it kills me to leave a negative review.  Get your act together Steve's.  I was told this place was excellent, I was lied to.

Love Steve's my brother knows his for school I think anyway î don't like iif 
U go in and I don't remember if it was 10 pm or 11 but u can only get regular fries not criss cut and some of the cheese on the steak i was in there not that long ago and for 3  cheesest  onions and one of those had sauce and mushrooms it was $39 and change sorry Steve steak are good but $39 good I don't think so
Pricey!!!! They need to help you order if you're new or senior citizen.  Taste good though...

Food was alright, somewhat flavorless  andvery expensive for such little portions I don't mind paying 14$ for a pasta dish wish no protein if I can have some leftovers the next day but 14$ no protein and still being hungry after finishing doesn't make me want to order ever again.

We had some friends over a few weeks ago and had some pies delivered from Original's. I meant to write  review back then but just didn't. So here I am writing a review for a pizza delivery that was weeks ago. First off the pies were outstanding. But our delivery man was probably the nicest delivery person we've ever had. Very personable and just nice. I will be asking for Mike M. every time I order from there.

The new outside bar is sooo nice!! They have mist-ers which was such a nice touch on a hot day! It is like a little oasis back there! Lots of Tvs, and games like table jenna. Our server was so nice! It was a hot day so I got a turkey Club and calamari appetizer, The dip that went with the calamari was addicting. We'll be back!

I only came here because I had a Garces gift card to use up, but I came away thinking that this might be my favorite restaurant in Philly. I've been here five years, going on six now, and I'm really sad I didn't find this happy hour spot earlier. To preface, I love Spanish tapas, so it's only natural I would love this restaurant. We came for the late night happy hour.

We ordered everything on the happy hour menu. Every single item was a hit, although the grilled mushroom + guindilla was probably the worst item out of the six (although it wasn't bad, just think the pepper wasn't really to my taste).

The montadito with tuna and montadito with eggplant were absolutely amazing. The shrimp was probably one of the best shrimps I've had, and the chicken was also extremely juicy. The serrano y queso was also quite excellent. We ordered sangria to top it off, which was good but nothing super special.

We will definitely be coming back for the tapas again. So, so good.
This was a very nice meal in a very intimate space. The food was delicious and would highly recommend the seafood paella with my favorite part being the squid ink rice.

Some of the best red Sangria I've ever had. Bartenders made some nice recommendations for tapas.  Duck octopus n lamb.  I could have those three everyday.  The sauces on each plate were delicious.  Everything grilled perfectly and $9 a shot was priced nicely for the quality you received.  Take a seat at the bar and slow play that hour of righteousness.  Then go next door and grab 5 whiskeys.

Nice ambiance but disappointing service - last night, the waiter treated me very disrespectfully, saying very loudly and disrespectfully in front of my Wharton colleagues that he won't serve me because I did not have a physical copy of my passport (presented a valid form of foreign ID with visible birth dates as well as digital copy of passport). When I forgot to wear a mask as I stood up from the table, he again announced loudly in front of other guests that I needed to wear a mask whenever not seated. 

These are reasonable policies that I was 100% willing to I abide with, but did not expect to be spoken to in that tone, and "lectured" in a rude manner in front of my colleagues and other guests during my first visit.

I frequent many wine bars and restaurants in Philly and am yet to experience terrible treatment of this level.
Paella was ok, not as much seafood as I was expecting in other paella's I've had. Wine was a good selection. Pricey per glass, just buy a bottle and have them cork it if you can't finish

Worst service ever. Long long lines and I sat at my table forever before anyone even asked to take order. And when the food showed it was horrible. Saffron or Indian Gate in New Tampa are much much much better!  Avoid this place.
Excellent this place is always so good. Has a wide selection and the customer service is wonderful. We always look forward to the food here and bringing our family. Is also very reasonably priced

Unfortunately deteriorated this time.  Our full family has COVID and really wanted some food :(

The dahi wada is not ground!  So raw dal!

Too sick to put all details but everything had some issues, I tried them again today after a while, didn't expect it to get worse.  Raw dal is really going too far.

Very good food. I had gotten the buffet and it was very good. I am happy I discovered this place. 5 out of 5 stars I would recommend this to anybody wanting to try authentic Indian food. The customer service was great!!You won't be disappointed.

I called a few weeks earlier to make sure they were open and the buffet was running.  No answer and I did not leave a message.  Five minutes later I got a return call and that's why we came today!
Excellent food, nice service, a good variety of different foods to try.  Restaurant is clean and well lit.  We will be back.
This place is amazing!!! Love the food here. They have amazing oxtail. If you are looking for a great place to eat. Check it out! You'll love it!
They went up on the ox tails but there still the best I've had from a Caribbean restaurant. The food is usually good I staff it's rude. Just wish the line would move faster.

Very satisfying! The rice&peas are some of the best I've had. I think the sides could be a bit better (I wasn't a huge fan of the yams or cabbage). Overall this place isn't bad, but there are a few Jamaican restaurants in the area that I'd suggest over this place.
The best Caribbean food that I've had in Philly. The portions are huge. The food is always hot. Service is fast  the oxtail is hands down THE BEST.

Horrible experience!!!! A piece of a plastic latex glove was in my food(pepper steak, rice and beans and cabbage. Once I returned back to the restaurant the owner and food server was beyond ignorant. They barely wanted to give me a refund.

One of my happy places. From friendly staff to delicious bowls. I especially love their seaweed salad topping and the complimentary dole whip sample at the end of the meal. A perfect finish that takes the edge off of anything spicy.

Always have an awesome experience. Ordered via Uber for bogo and then when I came in to pick up saw their buy 50 gift card get a free bowl and dole whip and decided to get that as well. Their food never disappoints and their staff is always the nicest.

Went to island fin poke in new port Richey today all I can say is great food great service and a wonderful atmosphere , the staff was well versed and the management very friendly it is a must try and is on my revisit list

I ordered pickup for a "build-your-own" poke bowl. I included ahi tuna, salmon, shrimp ceviche, mango pineapple salsa, jalapenos, edamame, onion crisps, corn, sesame seeds, nori strips, seaweed, sweet onion,  on a bed of spring mix with ponzu and avocado cream.

The bowl was delicious! It was fresh and exactly what I had in mind. Nothing I would change except maybe pull back on the ponzu portion. At the end, the flavor took over too much. Or maybe offer the option to have it on the side. I would have much preferred that.

Otherwise, great poke. Speedy too. It was a 2-for-1 special, so I am definitely looking forward to it again!
One of my favorite spots hands down. Try to get your hands on the vanilla swirl dole whip (pineapple/strawberry depending on what they're offering).

Just the name alone made me love it. I went this past weekend for a birthday brunch and this place is a gem! It was so good and so close to home that it may just become my new neighborhood bar! It gets a solid 4.5/5 from me. I went with a group of five and the group consensus was a very well-deserved five stars. 

Suttons is small, cozy, and delightful! The BOTTOMLESS mimosas were the most noteworthy part of the experience - made to perfection with a 70/30 alcohol to OJ ratio and continuously replenished. Five pitchers later we were feeling pleased and very buzzed. The 2nd best part were the Brussel Sprouts...I can firmly say that I've never tasted better brussels sprouts in my life. The recipe is super simple (crispy brussels just tossed in honey with a hint of lemon) but the taste is exceptional and unique! These brussels sprouts were superior to the fries which is very very rare. Most of us got the Crispy Chicken Sandwich which gets a 3.5/5 from me but everyone else in my party gave it a 4. The spicy dijon sauce fails to amplify the taste of the sandwich and its on the pricier side (adding a side is $2 extra). I can say the chicken patty was very tasty and came on a brioche bun for the win! I went with a side of fries which were good though nothing special but what complimented my sandwich best were the brussels sprouts. We loved everything and we will definitely be coming back to explore the rest of the menu! 

The outside seating is superb and its actually a closed-off backyard instead of being the usual sidewalk seating that's so common nowadays. Best part of outdoor seating is the decent size TV they have that's perfect for sport lovers! We went on a quiet Sunday with few people at the bar and even less outside so it felt like we had the entire backyard to our party which made us enjoy out time even more. 

It's a quaint and promising bar with excellent service that I cannot recommend enough! .

A Kensington gem with a relaxed vibe and a simple menu inclusive of varied salad, app and entree selections.  There is something for everyone.  All  food is prepared to perfection.  The beer provisions are noteworthy as well as the wines and spirits.  If you're fortunate to reside near this locale or decide pop in for a visit this place brings it on with great drinks, food and fun.  Aside from indoor seating, there are outdoor seating areas in the front and rear of the establishment - I recommend the cozy rear patio.  My family and I find time to return as often as possible - wish we lived closer.

We stopped by on the way back from a Fringe Festival event at the Icebox Project Space in the Crane Arts building.  What a find!  Wonderful cocktail list, great on-tap list (especially for a space this size), well stocked bar, good and wonderfully prepared dinner selections.

Quick summary -- We sat outside on the back patio (there are also on-street tables and indoor seating, but I recommend the quiet and industrial chic of the patio).  Cocktails -- well balanced, interesting flavor combinations, well made.  Coconut shrimp with three sauces.  Crunchy chicken platter with a well-made salad as well as the Chicken Tingo Tortillas.  I had the tingo, and they (three four-inch tortillas each with a massive mound of tingo, vegetables, etc.) were fantastic.

Niall Murphy (owner) joined us for a bit as we finished.  A fascinating person who knows how to run a great establishment.  Good knowledge of the locale's history.  Showed us a picture book he made of the complete rebuilding of the space -- an amazing transition from a shell to a beautiful neighborhood space.

We'll be attending more events at the Maas Building and Sutton's is so well placed between Maas and the Temple Regional Rail station.  We'll definitely be back!

My go-to spot for food and drinks. Amazing pub-style menu, awesome atmosphere and top notch service. The owner, Niall is super cool and always very warm and welcoming. My favorites are the wings, the fries and the fried chicken sandwich.
Went to drive thru today at 2:30 pm. no staff to be seen , restaurant was empty , drive thru cashier was unresponsive ,cars were backing up and leaving unattended.  Not good business..

I live in East Falls very near this place. Its always great to find a place that is walking distance on where I live. For me, I've had several things, the fish and chips. Fish not bad, but fries are only OK (the only thing that keeps it from giving 5 stars) and the tandoori wings are an original take on chicken wings. Baked with curry sauce on it as opposed to buffalo wings that are usually fried and soaked in hot sauce.

But what I really really LOVE and what will make me a regular is the roast beef sandwich. I am the type that like the roast beef sandwich with au jus sauce and beef that came from the oven, not a cold cut from the deli. A lot of my friends like Arby's for roast beef sandwich, but me I've been spoiled by  roast beef sandwiches that are far better than Arby's and this sandwich meets it my strict needs for roast beef sandwich. I use to have to travel to Center City and go to Nick's to have a roast beef sandwich. Today, don't need to go to Center City, got  the Black Squirrel.

Before it became the Black Squirrel, this place was several other bar and restaurants, but I hope the Black Squirrel doesn't suffer the fate as the previous tenants did with the location, because I want to keep enjoying the roast beef sandwich.

Black Squirrel in East Falls.  So I had a birthday lunch with hubby at the Black Squirrel, contemporary British Pub Fare that feels more elevated than most other places in this category.  I got the Onion Soup with a piece of toast with rarebit on top (a dijon mustard and cheese combo)... this was just outstanding.. the sherry in the soup really took it to the next level.  Hubby got the cheese board which seems a bit small portion-wise ( aren't cheese boards pretty big usually)  We got the fish and chips and the tandoori wings... wings must have been made from jumbo birds since they were HUGE.... and quite delicious.  We agreed that the expertly crafted cocktails were the highlight though. They were just stellar!  They did require proof of vaccination, which they had been doing since June, although the staff was unmasked.  They did have outside seating and I did see heaters.  I loved feeling transported with the decor, food and furnishings though!

Beautiful and comfortable decor.  Felt like you were in someone's dining room. All the staff were very friendly.  They have nice background music, and a overall good vibe. 
Very nice menu with quite a few British dishes, like cottage pie, fish n chips,  and bubble n squeak! 
I ordered the delicious British cheese tray, tandoori wings, triple cooked chips, and the bubble n squeak. All very tasty, well presented and satisfying to my palate. They also have a nice selection of cocktails, wines and beer.  I ordered the Hallady, it consisted of Dickel Rye, maple, cardamon and chai. It was so good!!  
Overall, it was a pleasant experience.  I can't wait to visit again.

Awesome, Awesome, Awesome... Ambiance, food, staff! It's one of my favorite places to go ...The servers are awesome & it's also a great bar scene! I have eaten the salads, soup, branzino, last night we shar d the gnocchi ( delish! ) & warm shrimp salad!  & a glass of bubbly! YUMMY! 
Keep up the good work you guys at Black Squirrel!

After being seated at our table, we were greeted by our server, Gordon.  He was so friendly and enthusiastic about taking care of us for the evening!  He was just a pure delight!  We shared a bunch of apps and our entees, as well.  Standouts:  scrumpets (recommended by Gordon), cottage pie, fish and chips (oh, and those chips! Delicious)!  Our burger was good, just a tad over-cooked.  Great evening!  Thanks again to Gordon!!
Sandwiches are smaller than I expected, but excellent.  Someone else said their Pastrami is god's sandwich, but I'd designate the Penn Special for that.

I've been searching for a place that not only had fresh ingredients,but listened intently to what I ordered. You know that you've been heard, when you receive your order and it's made to your specifications! I found good food and attentive service, I'm gonna make repeat appearances here !
I stopped by 2 weeks ago. The door was open but the place was gutted.  Is it closed? Does anyone have any information on the status of the place?

Stopped by from out of town twice in the last month. Once it was closed with a message scrawled on a piece of paper - maybe about being closed for a couple weeks, but impossible to read and no dates given. The second time the door was open and I went to enter only to hear a voice from somewhere shout out, simply, "closed!"  The place was gutted - no deli case or counter remained. Yet, all online sources claim it's still open.

Does anyone know what's going on? Is it just a renovation or is it closing for good? The fact that they provide zero information anywhere and don't answer the phone is really not cool. I don't live in W. Philly anymore and came from way out of town, twice. Please, have a little respect your customers and provide updated information.
10/10 every time. Wonderful staff, food and prices.

their food service, prices and delivery have declined drastically. i feel bad for mel because he is nice. i know he needs to make an income but he should just close rather than provide subpar quality.
The food here is amazing. Service is great.  Gabriela & Kelly were so awesome! I could come here once a week, easily...but I live in south county

Used to love going here on a Friday night and sitting in bar area listening to music. Usually have to get there early but even that doesn't matter anymore bc bar and table reserved . We've been told a number of times bar area is first come. My daughter met some friends a few months ago and it was a full band. They couldn't even talk to each other. Unfortunately, Sacred Peoper is going from nice dining to a club. ‍ Don't know if we'll be back.
Their nasty food got my entire family food poisoning, and I was up all night puking my soul out. Im pretty sure they were serving expired food. DO NOT GO HERE

A bit of a drive for us, but when we are close to this place we try to go. It's owned by the DebarTolo's, so being owned by billionaires never hurts... beautifully decorated and one of few establishments that has a proper sized bar area. We frequently eat at the bar, so we love their layout. Decent selection of drafts and bourbon, and a very good wine selection (reserve list). Also one of few higher end places that offers a happy hour too.

As for the food, the fried Brie app is killer, the short rib cavatelli and filet are standout mains for us. Great side selections with the tilamook creamed corn with bacon being my favorite (add japs to kick it up). Have not made it to dessert, so can't comment on that just yet.

Nice to find a great dining option that's not a chain...

If you want great tasting food and cocktails this is your place! There is a good variety of cocktails and entrees on the menu. The service was excellent (shoutout to Tony!). We had the chicken parmesan and the Hawaiian Delmonico. I definitely need to come back and try the other dishes!

For Friday night dinner we were looking for a spot to have sandwich and fries. Since we had already tried Burger 21 before we decided to go to the restaurant to get the togo order. By browsing through the menu we ordered Crispy Chicken Sandwich and Sweet Potato Fries. The restaurant took 10-15 minutes to get our order ready. The food was hot and freshly made. We loved both our sandwich and fries. We loved our food and it was delicious.

Have heard good things and finally figured we'd try it out. Not impressed at all. Wife was happy with her burger, no complaints. She may have been trying to spare my feelings as it was her choice to go. My burger, I asked for medium. What I got was a patty burnt on one side browned on the other. Burnt to the point I was bitting into crunchy bits throughout. The lettuce was old and soggy. Not blackened yet but definitely dark and on its way. I got the lettuce heart as well, not good. The bun was soaked in grease for about three bites or so, I did not eat it. French fries were good, the thinner fries which was a nice change. Milkshake was thicker than most. Probably the highlight of my lunch. Tasted like they added whipped cream. So if you would rather not have, mention it when ordering. Staff were very friendly and ready to help if needed. Place was clean and looked nicer than most burger joints, although we do not go to the typical cheap burger places. I don't mind paying a bit more for a burger but when I do I expect a lot more than we received here. The prices are way high compared to what you get. There are about a half dozen or so places to get nicer burgers in the area  and this place I would rate last in that group. They do have other sandwiches like chicken and such. Wife wants to give it another go but we'll see.

We were looking for quick bite and we decided to order Sweet Potato Fries and Black Bean Burger from Burger 21 through Uber Eats. We got our order in 20-30 minutes. First we tried Sweet Potato Fries then Black Bean Burger. Both the foods were tasty and delicious. Loved its taste. Whenever we will get an opportunity we will go to Burger 21 to try other menu options.

I think I may have been to this location when it first opened. But it's definitely been a while. Yesterday my son and I stopped by there for a quick dinner option. I ordered the bacon cheeseburger with a side of fries as well as cheese sauce for my fries and a new s'mores milkshake. Overall all of the food and a milkshake or excellent! The only thing I would knock down a little bit was the overall price. The staff was super friendly and overall the wait was not too bad! I will definitely return :-)

I got the bbq bacon burger but i got it with just bacon burger and onion straws. They messed it up the first time then brought me a new burger. When looking at the burger i realized the bun had mold. The food is not fresh at all!

Great neighborhood spot with a solid beer selection and great food. Really good price for a city too. If you're vegan/vegetarian this place had plenty of great options/substitutions for you. The non-vegan options looked awesome too. Highly recommend!
Great food and friendly employees.   Decent beer selection.  Everything looked clean and orderly.  Would def come back for lunch.
Great paninis, great selection of craft beverages, and they also don't play around with their chip selection. Staff was real cool on top of it all!!
Just had the roast beef sandwich and it was amazing. Large menu, delicious snacks including cupcakes and an even larger sandwich and salad selection. I will be back.
Hands down the best panini I've had this far, everything was delicious and fresh! Highly recommend, my mouth is just watering thinking of eating here again

So we are here now and the black girl behind the bar looks at us more then once and didn't even bother to ask if we need anything do we want a drink or did anyone talk to us yet. I've been here many times and it's not like this she only talked to the white people that came in and not the black. They are not like that but I guess now they are. I will not come back

I've never been to this establishment, but I called in advance to see what event was going on that evening. Also to verify if there was a cover charge since I would driving a long way if I came.  The person who answered the phone was rude, unwilling to assist, and didn't have any information.  Furthermore didn't even try to find someone else who could answer my questions.  I don't want to support an establishment where the Customer service is bad before I even arrive.  No thank you!  Do better!

Interesting little spot for Ethiopian food.  We ate outdoors in the backyard.   Very laid back an comfortable.  You had to go in and place your order at the bar, but that wasn't bad.  Had the veggie combo plate, which filled us up.

We got two delivery meals from this place and it was extremely disappointing. Possibly the worst Ethiopian I've ever had. First and worst, the portions were criminal. Each plate was nearly $20 and there was barely enough food to finish one piece of injera. They were child-sized portions. The lentils appeared to have been mixed in a blender. All of the dishes were bland and flavorless. Did the restaurant run out of seasoning and spices? This food is made for people who've never tasted Ethiopian food or who've lost their sense of taste altogether. Will not eat here again.

I don't know what happened!  I love this restaurant but I got takeout today and there was hardly any food. I ordered the lentils in Berber sauce and collard greens in the vegetable mesob and they were very small portions and usually there's a salad. Nope no salad and very small portions and the lentils were not fully cooked. It was not a great $18 spent. I don't know what happened because normally they give a lot of food and it's cooked perfectly. I'm very disappointed.

Trendy and vibrant small breakfast place in fishtown. Standout on the menu was easily the breakfast potatoes, which for a person who normally treats them as a customary accompaniment, was a pleasant surprise to fully enjoy them. The fried chicken sandwich with shallots was a flavorful experience that I look forward to having again. The Coffee was refilled frequently refilled by friendly staff and tasted freshly dripped. I would have liked more than Tabasco at the table to add some spice to meal. All in all, a great start to the day eating here.

I was genuinely surprised there wasn't a bigger wait for this place. The food was really good, especially their home fries. We got the Dinosaur Egg, Eggs Benedict with fried chicken, and Biscuits and Gravy. The Dino Egg was okay. It was more like a new take on avocado toast where they give you the entire avocado and tell you to deal with it. The eggs from the benedict was a bit disappointing since the yolk was a bit overcooked. But the biscuits and gravy with homefries is the reason why I'm writing this review. It's a must-try for sure. Enjoyed the food, atmosphere, and the friendly service by the employees.
Awesome atmosphere and awesome food !! You'll love it here. The hash browns were delicious and I ate way to many but it was worth it !!

Had generally a tasty experience here. I really wanted to try the lox but they sold out 6 of them to one person RIGHT before I ordered which was really unlucky. Luckily I also wanted to try the breakfast pierogis.

Breakfast pierogis were awesome - but I may be biased because I loved potato-based anything and sour cream, and pierogis in general are just the best. Our table had chicken and waffles which were also tasty, some regular dish with homefries and meat, and a vegan breakfast burrito.

I will say when I tried the breakfast burrito I did not like it at all. It tasted burned, but the person who was eating it didn't have any complaints so maybe it was just me.

Overall would still recommend trying this place for being cute,  and having some unique breakfast choices.

Tried breakfast, but our two plates took a full hour to come out with zero communication 

Food was decent 3/5 (Dino egg and the breakfast burrito), but not worth the hour wait. 

Server comp'd our tea, but it's not enough for us to return. 

given the several other local options, I can't recommend spot to neighbors.

good luck!

Good happy hour, a great space, and tasty, tasty food. I'm a fan.

Obviously with the current plague ongoing, I haven't had many opportunities to stop by anywhere in Center City/Rittenhouse in the last year. But I've been to Butcher Bar maybe three times, and every time the service is on point, the drinks are stiff, and the snacks are satisfying.

Prices outside of happy hour are about typical for pandemic+Rittenhouse. So definitely not an everyday spot for this salaryman. But it's worth it for a sorely needed catch up with friends. Remember friends? And in person? Yeah, that feeling.

Can't wait til it's warm enough again to hang out in the back patio area. Assuming that's a possibility given the ongoing slowpocalypse. Here's hoping.
I love this place so much. Atmosphere is great. Food is amazing. Staff is always friendly and attentive. Highly recommend!!!!!!

I've been here a few times this review will summarize happy hour and brunch. Happy hour is reasonable with their portions and not super busy the times I've been there. Service is on point and staff very attentive. Brunch is delicious and generous portions - had the French toast and had a hard time finishing it. Will definitely be back to try more of their food.

If you have a big party coming up I would 1000% recommend this place! The trough is perfect for any group between 6-8 people. There is so much meat on this board it's not even funny. Our favorites were the short ribs and the burgers the french fries were also delicious and surprisingly the pita was fire too. Bison BurgerWild Boar Ribs
Not worth the price. Staff was extremely friendly, but the food on the trough wasn't worth it.

I regret going to this location every time. It's on my way home from school and I love Einstein bagels but this location is the worst. It can be dead and you will still wait 20 for a sandwich. I've tried the app but this location just never seems to get it together. I've worked at Starbucks and I know how hectic it can get. But here they just don't care, they mess up orders, they have no line system, they're pretty rude. It just sucks. I recommend their sandwiches but please just go to a different location.

I just moved to the area and this was on my carefully researched list of food places to try. 

I got the breaded fish tacos, a carne taco, and the pork taco. The ingredients seemed fresh and they certainly looked pretty. However the flavor was just missing that punch of goodness I'm used to. Perhaps I'm spoiled from having lived in California. There was no spice, no lime flavor, no....anything special.

I don't think I'll try this place again. I've heard this coast doesn't do tacos well? Not sure yet, but this was a big disappointment.

The place was clean, the staff was attentive and kind, and everything had a beautiful presentation.

Love the atmosphere.. fun, festive, great margs, and superb baja fish tacos.   My fav thing i tried might have been the nachos though.  So good and they actually spread the toppings out, so you aren't left with a pile of tortilla chips after 5 good bites!  Def will be back!

I gave a 2 star review because I have had good eats here before. However today I ordered in store. There was no easily accessible menu so I asked for a chicken bowl and walked through specific ingredients. They charged me $10+ for the worst chicken bowl I have ever had. They didn't include half of the ingredients like veggies etc. it was just chicken and rice slabbed in a bowl. Worst part: they even left the avocado skin in the bowl! Highly disappointed, feel a bit disrespected, may not come back.

If you're looking for a great place to enjoy a casual meal or takeout an awesome Sunday football spread, Burma Onda is your place. From a variety of delicious tacos, to chips and guac and our favorite...the NACHOS.  The price point is good, the food is delicious and their to go packaging makes take out tacos a breeze.

Loved trying out this taco place! The staff were really friendly and service was rather quick! I got 4 tacos and I was definitely very satisfied given how loaded they were. Special shoutout to their fried fish tacos which gave you a hefty piece of fish which was light and crispy. Their flavor profile is solid as well. Looking forward to coming back for some casual tacos!

Good food, lightning fast.  Excellent customer service.  Recommended to all.

I'll be back!

Delivery is good but food not good @ all. Shrimp lo mein was so salty. I also order pork fried rice but it came without meat in there‍. It looks so disgusting. We couldn't eat anything. So everything in trash. Never order again.

I don't know what to say. But I will start with the positives. Their food is excellent and I look forward to it every time I try to order a delivery. The problem is the delivery! They are only two blocks from where I work (Methodist hospital), yet they've cancelled at least 2 of my orders without telling me. Once they thought it was a mistake, because my zip code was from Northeast Philly, where I live. Yesterday they cancelled because they don't have lunch specials on Sundays. All they could have done was call and tell me, but they did not communicate. I had to re-order and it took another hour before I received my order and I was beyond starving. I finally ate my lunch at 3:45 pm. Why is it so hard to get good service down here? I work alone in my office so I can't walk over and pick it up.
This place is fire!!!! One of my go-to spots when I'm craving some good eating. Very consistent with a pretty diverse menu. Highly recommend!

Good food but the pork rib sandwich is not that big. Mine had 4 ribs, and not that big either.  You fare better getting the platter. Turkey wings were good but different both times I ordered. One was wet and one was not. Great sides tho. I will order again.
Good comfort food. Got me some turkey wings mac and cheese and string beans. Veggie taste like out a can but other than that everything was nice. You can't sit down. Everything is togo
Everything was good except my chicken was very pink in the middle(I ordered the bbq chicken wing platter)

Disappointing from the first bite.
Very little meat on the bone. So much sauce you couldn't taste the meat. Two of the ribs couldn't eat because of the gristle. Cole slaw, store bought and the peach cobbler is nasty. Crust dry, way to much cinnamon. That's the only thing you can taste.

Paid to much to give food to the 
They were tender. 

Won't ever order again from this place.

I don't get here much since I'm no longer in the area, but it used come here frequently and I've been known to still make special trips to Fink's.  Hoagies are inexpensive and some of the specialty sandwiches are excellent.   Only problem is the hours:  Closed most Sundays (except during Eagles season, even then it's order ahead).  Also closed Monday-Tuesdays.

There's a reason Fink's is the King! Hoagies are excellent and so is the potato salad and Mac salad. Extremely affordable and always friendly. We got a party tray to feed 10 and it was more than enough. Choice of 4 hoagies and 3 pounds each of potato and Mac salad plus all the condiments you could ever need. All for 62 bucks! Highly recommend them for your catering needs and even just for a great sandwich!! Thanks Fink's!!
Fink's is amazing clean and friendly. A closedown is BS. Likely an overpaid bureaucrat looking for an Annie Oakley. This inspector probably lives in filthy squalor. Go figure.
Visited this restaurant yesterday such quick service and great food!! Will definitely be back
Great chill spot nestled in the heart of Bay Street. Everything made fresh in house. Open kitchen is great for a full view of the operation

Where to start?! This place has a great atmosphere and even better food! My boyfriend and I came in for lunch and I got the Knife and Fork Cobb and he had a signature Wok Out Bowl - both items where amazing (I tried his!) 

The service was impeccable, attentive and friendly. This place is a hidden gem in Tampa. We definitely will be back!

This is a fantastic spot for lunch or dinner . Always a great vibe. The food is phenomenal and the service is consistently great. If you want to have an above and beyond experience, Doc B's is the place to go!

I've been a Doc B's fan for years. Their food is consistently delicious and I never have to worry about being taken care of.  The bartenders and servers are polite and helpful. My favorite dishes are the Brussels Sprout salad and the Dinah BBQ ribs!

So we normally order pizza from Marcos on Gsndy/Westshore in South Tampa once a week. Never had any issues and staff there seem friendly. So we have a coupon stating 1/2 off on Full Moon on your pizza for pickup so today is December 18 2021 and it's the last full moon of the year and a special one according to google. I call and order a pizza and they guy tells me it's not for today but tomorrow! I'm like No, today is the full moon and he tells me according to there company calendar it's tomorrow the 19th! I explained to Giovanni no it's today and I verified it. I ask him if I could speak with a manager he said he was the manager!! So I said you're not going to honor your coupon for today? He said no he has to follow the company's calendar! Lol some manager he is!!so you guys run false advertising maybe I'll contact the BBB. Or better yet maybe I'll buy you a calendar with the CORRECT moon phases? How about that?

I wish there was a negative stars. Not only did the food take 98 minutes it was not good. I called three times to be put on hold 3 times. When I asked to cancel the kid said ok cool and hung up. The only positive was the drive was super nice and apologetic. I still took the pizza but he did not make me pay for it as I wouldn't. I didn't catch his name but thank you for being the only positive part of the experience of ordering from Marcos. 
 The pizza was gross and hollow in the middle and ice cold! This was the last time ordering from here. I wish them luck.

Stumbled upon this place after searching for a Mofongo spot. Found Mofongo Steakhouse but thought it too pricey. Decided to try En Mi Viejo San Juan. Absolutely delicious! We ordered and tried various dishes. They didn't disappoint. Great service with a smile! Try the juices too. I loved the Parcha!!

I was really craving authentic Puerto Rican fritura and a jugo de parcha. I paid $3 for a jugo de parcha then I see I'm getting served Welch's Passion Fruit, I was so disappointed! I ordered two empanadillas; one de pollo and the other de pizza. The empanadillas were less than halfway filled and definitely came from a store bought box, another disappointment.
Este lugar es muy acogedor y buena musica , buen servicio y la comida es excelente , mi Tocallo el Chef Ariel cocina muy rico , les recomiendo este food truck boricua !!!
La comida aquí estaba sabrosa. El mofongo, los tostones, las alcapurrias y relleno de papa. Exquisito!! If you're near by you must try. De-lish. De una Bori de Nueva York. Chef's Kiss
The jerk wings/sauce and chicken foot soup are great when they have it.  They never keep it regularly.

I can't get enough of their Original 1862 Roast Beef Sandwich! When I moved to LA I had to swing by Vegas to eat at The Earl knowing it was the last one in the west. Now that I'm back in Tampa I can't get enough.

Inside the Food Court of International Plaza and Bay Street (Mall), this sandwich shop delivers a great sandwich worthy of the name. What more can you say other than if you like sandwiches (like Joey from Friends), then definitely try this place.  I tried the LTO "The Feast" which had a mix of meats and toppings and was just delicious.  The guy taking my order answered my question on what was a better choice and he didn't make a mistake.

Promote the Earl of Sandwich to Duchess/Duke, Princess/Prince, or even Queen/King of sandwich.  It's worthy of the new title.

Earl of Sandwich at International Plaza and Bay Street in Tampa is a great place to get quality sandwiches when you are on the move and need something good. I really like the selection of different items that they have here and how they make everything here. Cool place to eat at.
I thought it'd be better because it's always packed and ppl rave about the brunch. Food was underwhelming and the bill was ridiculous.

Not it for me. It was highly overpriced for a small amount of food. I think people mostly go for the name. I would prefer a larger portion at a smaller price. I am really sick of these fancy named restaurants getting away with subpar food and overpriced menus.

I had to wait an hour and a half for my food. My waitress gave me water and then never came back. Eventually I had to pull her aside and ask when our food will be ready and she didn't even bring it out. I am never coming back

We came here for lunch during the week and there were quite a bit of people in there. We were able to get seating indoors because it was very cold. I ordered the honey chipotle wings. I received 9 of them and they were pretty good. They were very very saucy and flavorful. I also ordered a side of shoestring fries. The other person ordered a chicken Parmesan. She said it was only ok. Not photographed here were our holiday drinks. They were definitely very very good. I think overall this was a decent lunch spot. I did enjoy my meal and we really enjoyed our drinks.

My mother and I get along best when shopping and going out to eat. Yesterday, she visited me in Philadelphia and we went to a boutique called Lila in Manayunk (which I'll also review). We loved the guy who worked there, whose taste was so fine it was second only to his warmth.

This is relevant because he's the one who recommended Winnie's when we asked for his "go-to" place to eat. When someone's personality makes you feel cared for, elevated, and indulged, I recommend asking them for a restaurant recommendation!

Winnie's felt just like we thought it would based on his description. It was busy but not packed in. We waited 20 minutes for a table and it was worth it. I do wish they had text alerts so we would have been able to walk around outside more while waiting, but it was cozy inside with beautiful and bright artwork on the walls and lots to look at and chat about as we waited comfortably on a bench.

Our table was perfect- right by the window, with a view of passers-by. 8 feet or so away from our table was a large party including several children, and we noted that all their food came out at the same time (and looked amazing- especially the French toast!). The kids were coloring happily and enjoying themselves without any snide glances from judgmental co-patrons or "ughhh not today" staff members like at some other "family-friendly" places. Winnie's took care of them and made them feel welcome, which made us feel good, too.

I don't like dining in places that make anyone feel excluded. Winnie's was warm, elevated-casual, with generous portions of delicious food, and a truly diverse crowd of patrons.

If I were to design a personal family holiday party, it would be my goal to model it after the vibe at Winnie's.

I had the cheddar burger and my Mom had the veggie burger. We both swapped chips for house salad for just a few dollars more and we were stunned to see how much salad we got- and it was a real, beautiful salad! Not a few leaves of lettuce and a slice of tomato. Both burgers were good, but the food star of our meal, in our opinion, was the mixed berry jam that started our meal in a bread basket and ended up becoming an obsession!

I'd share photos except we were focused on shared time together and enjoying the food, but everything was well-presented and delicious. Next time I'm trying a Bloody Mary, which looked great- and also generously poured- on someone else's table.

While the food was definitely delicious enough to merit its own focused review, the star for my mother and me was truly the vibe. And there is no better propagator of this vibe than our beautiful waitress, Janelle. We had some simple special requests, like ice in my water and not in my Mom's, and lemon on the side. Nothing crazy, but not nothing. My Mom is like Meg Ryan's character from When Harry Met Sally- lots of questions and most of it "on the side."

Janelle couldn't have been more accommodating, without a single indication of impatience. When she learned of our love of the cornbread with jam, she replenished our stock and even sent us home with extra containers for our leftover bread!

With so many hospitality and food and beverage businesses suffering the last few years, and having a hard time finding good staff willing to work on the front lines, it is especially worth noting that Winnie's really has it covered. It is my profound wish that they know how appreciative my Mom and I are for all they do to make sure patrons leave feeling embraced, seen, and well-fed. Extra thanks and warm holiday wishes to Janelle.

We will see you again!

So I ordered from this restaurant via Grubhub. They had an amazing five star rating with over 1600 reviews. However here if I'm correct they have a 2 1/2 star rating. Guess I should've checked.

Received a call from the driver asking me to come out of my building to get the food. I made him aware that for two years I've had the same instructions to my account which give a gate code and exactly where to place the order inside the building. He refused to come in the building. So I called the restaurant and they lied and said the GrubHub's policy regarding COVID-19 as a drivers cannot enter and make indoor deliveries.

I chatted with GrubHub customer service and they issued me a $10 credit and the credit for the seven dollar tip which was 25% off my bill. However, they refused to return the funds for the actual order itself. Considering that the restaurant lied about policy immediately by GrubHub and the driver did not follow GrubHub's guidelines, why in the world would they not return my money. I will absolutely never order from this restaurant. This was my first order by the way. Do you not get yourself involved with this restaurant.

Hello my name is Nargiss Haleem I stayed two nights at this hotel checked out 12/30/21 and forgot a black pair of pants and a green shirt in the closet. I have been calling since than asking for my items it's been almost two weeks! This is how management is handling my issue, I call I'm out on hold till after I'm tired and hang up 38 minutes last time. I ask to speak to the manager Alberto Ramos I get his voicemail left 6 messages no response! I get housekeeping left 4 messages no response! I just left the manager another message! I will post every time I call till I get my clothes! Worst customer service I have in countered in the 18 years I have been traveling!  Give a star only because I had to click on it but this customer service deserves Zero!

Two stars may be a little harsh, but three would be a little much. I may have rated it three stars until this morning. When I turned on the shower, I discovered the drain was clogged. I don't like showering in a hotel where water is backing up in the tub. Doesn't seem very comfortable, if you know what I mean. Overall the room was clean, but definitely aged. One chair had two cuts in fabric, as you can see in the pic. Overall, it certainly didn't feel like an Embassy Suites. Really felt more like an extended stay hotel. Not what I expected. The bartenders at the evening reception were very good and nice, as was the staff at breakfast. The good news is they are working at upgrading the rooms slowly. One tip though, I would not recommend one of the corner rooms. The design is very uncomfortable. For a suite, the only place to sit is either the bed, or a sofa in a very small section when you first enter the room. To summarize: overall disappointing but clean. Not what is expected from an Embassy Suites.

I'm giving them four stars because the potential to be great is there.  As we all know the only reason to ever stay at an Embassy Suites is the evening social where you get free drinks and that eggs cooked to order breakfast. We came in for the Bucs v. Giants football game. Perks were the shuttle to the game, $5 per person. The room appeared to be recently renovated but some of the furnishings were stained (not cool.) The bar matron asked me an odd question when I went up for my second drink, "is this one or two?" I'm not sure why she asked because in all my years of staying at an Embassy Suites and frequenting the social, I have never known there to be a two drink minimum. So why ask??!?? Nonetheless, if you are in town for a game this hotel fits the bill but know they are currently a work in progress.

I'm not surprised that I'm disappointed.
Good thing I only ordered 2 dishes . 2 stars because it was basically fail proof dishes, but not inedible.
Salmon red curry  was basically soup, it was so watery it ran right through my rice, the fish was abit smelly  I can taste it in the curry, imagine that. Drunken noodles were shredded noodles and the sauce was super red with a gritty texture , definitely not your traditional sauce.
Good selection. More than just the classics.  Liked the Pork Belly dishes.  Apps were a bit small.  Crab and Shrimp fried rice - no crab.  BYOB now.  Good price point for a large group.

A decent Thai-ish restaurant near Penn's campus!

Recently, my friends visited Pattaya after they moved to the Locust Street location. Here we ordered the basic noodle dishes: Pad Thai, Drunken Noodles, and Pad See Ew. 

The dishes were great but they weren't 100% reminiscent of Thai food, more so just other noodle dishes. The Pad Thai had more of a soy sauce base- I didn't taste the sweet/sour of the tamarind as much as I would have hoped. The Pad See Ew was decent with a sweeter soy sauce taste. Lastly, the drunken noodles were ok, but again, skimped on the strong veggie and Thai basil flavor (if you don't like spice too much, get the 1/5 spice!- Thai spice doesn't play around). The orange slice topping was interesting and my friend said she liked it over the Pad Thai! 

Overall, it was a good experience but seemed a little underwhelming if you're expecting authentic Thai food. The service was extremely friendly and quick though, so I commend the workers for that! Would come back to branch out and perhaps try their other dishes!

Cool place. Tons of seating. Nice beer options in cans and some on draft. Would return as you get epic views of the riverfront and nice place to hang out in an open air venue. Not too crowded when I went.

What a wonderful spot to have a drink under the stars. This place is right on the water with views of the river. They have a variety of beer on tap and canned. Server was wonderful and tons of seating in there outdoor garden. Its open roof and breezy.

We walked out to the Piers and stumbled up on this place Which doubles an art Gallery.   Huge place.  We came early and got a SEAT by the water.  Its sorr of food truck style, and although It isnt crazy priced - you are paying a little extra for the location.  There is a "service fee" stealthily added to every tab (the tip).  A little tricky. 

We had wines and ate the watermelon $4, the orzo salad $10 and the pretzel $5.  All were good.  

Great views of the water and perfect at sunset.  A quick walk from old city.

Nice place with a great atmosphere.  The food was terrific  and they had some great drinks as well. We sat by the waterfront and the music was also good.  We live in Texas so it was a one time deal unless we go back to Philly, otherwise we would be regulars.  One odd thing is they asked for my phone number. Not sure why they needed it since it wasn't like they were going to text me when my table was ready because they sat us right away.

Spent a beautiful day in the city. Started here for lunch- too gorgeous outside not to sit and feel the breeze by the river. We enjoyed beers and ciders, plus a killer hotdog and turkey panini. QR codes at the tables, where you order and pay. After this, we strolled the vintage market in the Pier. Worth a visit.

I'm sad to re-review this restaurant and have had such a different experience than my previous visit. This time I tried the takeout option, since it was too cold to sit at their outdoor seating. We tried the make your own omelettes, which came with potatoes and toast. The eggs were over cooked and did not have any seasoning on them. There were also large onion slices in the eggs that were not only challenging to eat, they were hard to want to eat. The bread was also over cooked and so hard to bite into. Lastly, the potatoes tasted reheated and had no seasoning. I don't know if my experience was only bad since it was takeout, but it does not make me want to return soon.
This is one of my favorite local spots for breakfast or lunch. I usually order online and pick up. Love the chocolate chip pancakes and the avocado BLT.
Cute little spot - didn't get to try much but the short rib omelette was to die for. I'm a sucker for a short rib
Miles table is always a treat. Their avocado BLT is my go to. Indoor seating is back!

Great neighbor place.  Went there on labor day weekend when few other places were opened and I'm glad I went! It has a great menu; a little something for everyone. The coffee was delicious. I had a burrito and it was good and plentiful.   The seasoning was perfect.  I will definitely be back to try some other menu items.

Bar tender/Cashier was rude for no reason. I came in excited because it was my first time at a Fat Tuesday. I didn't know how to order & it not sure if that upset the employee (she is Caucasian with short hair). She made my drinks & I paid. I asked her if I could sit at any table & she nodded looking the other way. I still said thank you & gave her a tip. I just didn't need to be welcomed like that, she ruined my experience. Maybe I caught her on a bad day? I see there's a sign that says "help wanted" on the outside & maybe she's the only one working? (The bar was almost empty) Not sure but I hope she isn't like that with all customers. Not friendly whatsoever.

All the years that I've been visiting south st & I never actually stopped in this place lol My friends and I finally decided to pay a visit. The only regret I have was the brain freeze for chugging my drink to hard LOL.

As part of our bike pedaling tour, this spot was actually recommended by our guides. When we first walked in (which took a bit because we were confused with the layout of the bar and how the entry/exit doors were labeled) we thought that our guides had made a mistake. It was completely empty, the bar had super low energy, and so we went to Reef, a couple doors down. 

After we got drinks from Reef, we decided to give Fat Tuesday another try since we had some time to kill (5 minutes) before returning to our bike. It was still empty,  so my group of 6 sat at the bar and ordered shots. They weren't bad, but also weren't out-of-this-world. A 3-star "OK" review is pretty much exactly how I'd describe our experience.

Highly disappointed in the customer service experienced yesterday night as well as tonight Aug 19th & 20th 2021 to be exact. We traveled out about two hours just to get turned away because either the workers decide when they want to close. Or the business just needs to update the closing time. The website as well as yelp mentions that this location closes at 1 am but arrived at 12 yesterday and got turned away and again today around the same time we went through it even worse. The worker not sure her name red head was so nasty to us. We walked in and I went to the bathroom, she was inside sweeping and looked at me with an attitude and said were closed with an attitude. I asked could I use the bathroom and she still declined. She walked us out and I said it's not fair to close early especially not knowing if people are traveling from a far distance. Fat Tuesdays is pretty well known and hard to find. I would work on this ASAP because this is a huge inconvenience. Driving from Brooklyn to Philly we could have honestly just went to AC & went to wet willies. I hope this problem is fixed soon so know one else experiences this, it's not a good feeling at all.

This place has fire wings, ask for Cajun butter, the manger I presume (a young female) makes the best wings. This place is a must when you're on the road for a hot fresh pizza. 10/10 and great service as well

Great spot! Delicious food, cute ambiance, and most importantly, Tui, who runs the place is fantastic! Ended up having the best time. Support this local, authentic business. Great menu and it's all cooked by a real Thai person. Oh and I almost forgot: It's BYOB (no fee!) which I love.

I made an order through Yelp thinking I could
Depend on delivery and 15 Minutes after the delivery was supposed to be made I got a call
Saying that Grubhub who I did not order through, said the order was complete. Don't use grub hub, just go straight to the restaurant. The manager did his best to get me the delivery, when that didn't happen, he arranged with grub hub who I couldn't reach to return my payment and for that I am grateful.

Hit and Miss.  I dined inside with my family and I wasn't too thrilled with the unprofessionalism of some of the servers.  I attempted to walk out of the bathroom and one server was chatting with her boyfriend, blocking my way to the table.  I said excuse me and they continued their conversation.  Total turn off from dinner in general.  
I attempted another night at the outside bar.  I was craving prime rib and knew about the Thursday special.  The bartender was AWESOME!  Total fun vibe all around and the food was spectacular.  A big fat seasoned prime rib with mashed potatoes and gravy.  I did order it with vegetables, but the bartender was so cool, I didn't mind.  Now I know to only dine outside - friendly staff and patrons!
Consistently delicious hot food, excellent service, and a full bar. Melanie was our server. She was efficient and upbeat. Definitely recommend this place!!! We are regular offenders.

Tom Terrific here with another honest restaurant review.

BOOGER ALERT!    BOOGER ALERT!!     BOOGER ALERT!!!!

Since these reviews are my mine, i believe in letting the readers decide
what they want to do after i state some facts.

I cannot eat at this restaurant. why?

The manager has decided to hire servers with boogers hanging out of their noses.

When i walked in i noticed two servers with those horrid septum rings hanging down to their upper lip. They make me nauseous. I will not be served by someone who feels this is a proper facial decoration to bring my food to me. They look like a booger.

The manager at Clearwater's Buffalo Wild Wings did the same thing and she seems to have lost some business. They make me sick and i will not look at them.

You can hire who you want but i will not eat here.

For a sports bar type place this really surprised me. We sat out on the indoor/outdoor patio and it was very pleasant. It was 2 of us so we opted for the $11.95 pitcher of margaritas(?!). I was obviously thinking it was just going to be sour mix at that price, but they were quite good and definitely tasted the tequila. We got about 2 1/2 margaritas each. My friend is gluten free and we always love to try appetizers so luckily she could eat tortilla chips so we ordered the spinach & artichoke dip and the large Tex Mex nachos and everything was good. The chicken on the nachos was very tasty and all the toppings were very good. The chips with the dip were thin and crispy. Overall everything was good!

In town for the weekend to attend a soccer game; very glad that a place like Miller's is open late at night; we were quite hungry after the game; ordered for pickup; waited for nearly twenty minutes before it was realized that our order was ready; no one bothered to let us know/bring the order to us, even though we called to let them know that we had arrived to pick up the order. Had to ask a couple of servers about the order. Though the place was busy, still quite frustrating that we had to wait that long for an order that was obviously ready. In any case, we ordered nachos, wings, mozzarella sticks. Typical bar-type food, satisfying, but nothing to write home about so to speak.

I love Happ's!! I come in or send my fiancé weekly to get my favorite breakfast sandwich, the croissant sausage egg and cheese. The owners are so kind and welcoming every time I come in. The food is amazing. Consistently too good.

I placed and order for Side Pistachio Honey Spread, Balboa (Italian style) Bagel, and Carnegie Reuben Bagel. Ordered on-line paid $30.14. Received a call 15 minutes later stating they didn't have what I wanted and they would REFUND my money. Well I never received my refund from something I NEVER received. Call twice left TWO messages to call me back and still NO CALL and NO money Refunded. They were advertised on 6abc. What a bust!!!!!!!!!!
Great diner food and the most friendliest staff, can't beat it. All day breakfast is definitely the way to go!

This is a classic south Philly dinner
That does a good job of preparing classic breakfast platters. Service was swift
However, be prepared to have deep pockets. Brunch for 4 came in close to $90. I am not talking mimosas or any of the Jumbo pastries that grab you the minute you walk in. I have to admit they are tempting 
But my goodness, it's still a diner
I know, I know food costs more and the 
Pandemics made things worse for all of us
Nuff said, be prepared, you could do worse

Wanted a breakfast and wanted a spot for hat was going to serve alcohol and found this place. Initially I wasn't to thrilled about going to a diner but OMG was I pleasantly surprised. 
We arrived and there was plenty of parking available and was greeted and seated immediately. We could tell that they have plenty of regulars as we heard the servers talking to people by name and remembering different things that they typically order. 
Our server was great, took our drink orders (mimosas) and came back with our drinks in regular size glasses (no complaints here). 
Ordered the French toast deluxe (French toast, sausage, ham and bacon) as well as the steak and eggs.  Boy was I amazed at the food. Everything came out hot and perfect. The steak was cooked perfectly and was seasoned so well that steak sauce wasn't needed. The French toast was perfect; just the right amount of crunch to it and it wasn't soggy. Diner food is typically good at most places but this actually surprised me, I wasn't expecting the food to be this good.
They screwed up your mobile orders badly waited 30 min and was told they forgot to put in the system   You have sarcastic Emily and confused Colleen who would messed up your orders badly.

What a joke. Poor value.
I've been to Penrose Diner before, and have never been crazy about the food. Last night I Was starving, so I stopped in for a bite. Big disappointment. 
Not that the food was terrible, it was just way overpriced and a bare bones platter.
I got a Cheesesteak Panini. When it came out, it was by itself on the plate with French fries. No coleslaw. No pickle. Nothing but the sandwich and fries. 
The sandwich was OK, but nothing special. Like most diners, they load you up on fries (to fill the plate up), and they're more than you can eat. 

Now let's Get to the price. For the sandwich and fries with no soft drink or sides, just tap water, the price was over $14. So with the $3 tip I left, you're talking almost $18 bucks for a mediocre sandwich and a glass of water.

Also, my server at the counter had such a detached, icy-mechanical demeanor, I thought about leaving her less than $3. 

Never again. Too many better options around.

Interesting experience! Good option if you want to get dessert and a drink with good company. The desserts aren't as sweet as I thought which is essentially on purpose and the culture of how the desserts are made. Some people like this! 

The bubble tea only comes with brown sugar boba, no options for lychee jelly, etc. Would rather get my same order at a chain like Kung Fu Tea.

There's a location in NY that I frequent so I wanted to check out the location out here in Philadelphia. Service was prompt, the ladies greeting guests were sweet. Some of the selections (sandwiches) on the high tea were okay. Otherwise, the atmosphere was accommodating.

Prince Tea House is the epitome of charm, class, and elegance. 

While fairly casual, the vibe is elevated without the stuffiness in all the best ways. The aesthetics are cute and dainty with lots of European charm, but with a menu with Asian-inspired flavors. They have a wealth of hot, loose-leaf teas, speciality teas/bobas in individual servings, some food options, and a wide variety of desserts. 

I've been to the location in Flushing, NY, but finally found time to try out the Philly location. I came with family (there were 7 of us), and were quickly seated at their larger, round table. A little cramped, but they didn't have any larger options. We ordered a Purple Yam Mille Crepe Cake, Tiramisu, Du Hammam Green Tea, Jasmine Green Milk Tea, and a Signature Milk Foam Black Tea with Boba. Everything was delicious and well presented. We had so many people that our tea pots didn't last very long on the tea light stands LOL. 

Our servers were kind and presented everything beautifully. No complaints. 

Prince Tea House is a great place to catch up & spend time with loved ones. Can't wait to return to this location in the future. It's a great addition to Philly Chinatown!

Such a cute dainty spot in Chinatown. Really appreciate how it's away from the hustle and bustle of the other restaurants so I can walk without feeling like I'll get hit by a car, lol.

I've been here twice. The first time to sample some food for my best friend's tea party and the second time for her actual tea party event for her birthday. I enjoyed each time! The workers are very sweet, and I love their ordering method. You order by using a QR code on the table that directs you to their website to order online. It's a live ordering tab where you can actively see what other people at your table ordered. 

They have a good selection of sweets, sandwiches, salads, appetizers and drinks. Don't expect "entrees", though some of their food can definitely fill you up. And for a very affordable price! Everything is under $10. 

For my bffs birthday/tea party event, they were prompt in bringing our stuff out and were helpful. It didn't feel like we had to wait for our food and drinks although we had a party of 7, and the restaurant was busy. 
 
Not my last time at Prince Tea House, and I recommend this place for a lunch date or tea party for sure!

Tucked away in the back of Chinatown, this place looks amazing inside. Aesthetically pleasing and welcoming atmosphere. The staff was nice and efficient. 

Since my friend and I was a little hungry we went with the Chicken Katsu Sandwich was delicious. The chicken was fried nicely and still juicy inside. Nicely seasoned as well. The flavoring was on point and the sauce on the chicken was delicious. Everything is held together by a delicious butter brioche bun.

The salad on the side was well a simple salad nothing special. Not too sure what kind of dressing they used, a little similar to honey mustard taste but very mild.

Onwards to the dessert. The Purple Yam Mille Crepe Cake was pretty good. This type of flavor is usually very mild, but I felt like this one was a bit too mild in flavor. The layers itself are very nicely done and soft, piled high, and easily cut through. Still a very delicious cake.

Trio Combo Mix and Match is a great sampler platter. Very aesthetically pleasing to the eyes and pictures. The green tea financier has a hint of green tea on a soft and warm cake. Very light and slightly moist. It definitely goes well with the tea they have.

The Pate a Choux Chocolate Ice Cream was just as delicious. Very crunch pastry on top that complements the rich chocolate ice cream.

Lastly the Goma Brûlée. It might not look the most appealing, but it was delicious. It still has the nice hard caramelization on top and underneath is the black sesame filling. Delicious and smooth as it enters your mouth and coats your tongue with the flavor of black sesame. The filling is a little thick but it isn't a big deal.

In conclusion an amazing place to try different desserts. Great place for a date and a must try. Definitely can't wait to go back again.

I first learned of them through the Too Good to Go app. I was running errands nearby and picked up some bargain priced hummus and pita chips. I looked them up online and was intrigued. 

I was also impressed that they seem to care about reducing waste. Hummus comes in reusable containers. Chips were in paper bags that I can compost. They asked if I needed a bag; I'd brought my own reusable one. They even make hot sauce from kitchen scraps and compost the rest. 

We returned to pay full price on a weekend when the spot runs as Frizwit, a sandwich shop. Their take on a cheesesteak, with more upscale ingredients, was unique and delicious. The vegetarian mushroom "cheesesteak" was equally flavorful and delicious, just as satisfying as the beef version. 

We tried pickles (I love pickles) but we're underwhelmed. Perhaps they just weren't as impressive as the sandwiches. 

But I keep thinking about those sandwiches and am planning my next visit so I can try the rest of them. 

As for Musi, they are finally back with a tasting menu,  it seems. When I'm ready to eat indoors again (not yet, though), Musi is on my to-try list.
This rating is for your beautiful article in food and wine. Hope you realize how many positive responses you received. I hope this is noticed by all restaurant owners. Oh, thank you.

I love this place. Conscientious, caring business looking out for customers and employees. Now that my husband & I are beginning to venture out for dining, this is exactly what we're looking for. Tasty, creative dishes prepared with love, immaculately clean, with concern for everyone's safety, and unparalleled service.

This review is ONLY for the frizwit cheesesteak. I didn't eat at Musi but picked up their cheesesteak and shared with my group. Not one of us liked it. The beer cheese felt grainy, and meat was so sparse and there were just too many onions.  Out of four people who tried this sandwich, no one liked it. The meat was actually delicious but it didn't fill the sandwich and the whole thing just tasted like onions. It was a huge disappointment. If you're doing a cheesesteak tour of Philly, you can do wayyy better than this steak.

10:40PM on a Friday and denied service due to "staff shortage"... poor management, period. Sad excuse for a company after speaking with corporate and them basically saying "there's nothing we can do." Uhhh hire people?? Maybe that location can't retain employees due to such poor management, get it together. I'm sure it's not their fault but if other convenience stores function fine with 2 employees I will just take my business there honestly just close that location down if you can't "staff it" properly. Avoid this location at all costs other reviews are not wrong!

This is the most disgusting, filthy, unkept Wawa I have ever been into in my life and I'm from PA.  Where to begin: everything is covered with dirt, the gas pumps. The trash and. The concrete pads are disgusting.  Vomit and urine are a nice touch outside.  I guess Wawa overlooks this location because it makes money being across from the casino.  The bathrooms aren't just dirty they are run down with rust on the hand dryers and faucet.  The faucet sensor was so dirty the faucet won't run, can't wash your hands.  Who cares about the water when the hand soap dispenser is open and empty.  The floor in the mens room had so much urine, my shoes slipped out constantly when I tried to use the urinal.  How can Wawa have a location like this? I guess their brand standard being trashed isn't their concern because the location is busy?  The washer fluid in the windshield washer buckets was empty and the window washer was broken. 

Trash all over In the parking lot.  Cigarette Butts on the carpet with leaves in the vestibule. 

I wish I'd taken photos because it's so gross honesty.  We won't be back. 

And I'll bet they blame it all on lack of staff, LOL

Do yourself a favor and just go somewhere else.
Waited 15+ minutes for my order to be completed and when I got it, it stunk so badly of cigarettes I could barely eat it.

Loved the atmosphere here! It's in a nice location to people watch and the DJ is great. He plays a variety of music, which livens up the atmosphere. Very yummy drinks and very yummy chicken and waffles . The food service is fast and the staff members are really nice.

Finally made my way to Cask today. Brunch was pretty good! I had the deep fried french toast with a side of bacon and potatoes. The french toast definitely grew on me, but I definitely enjoyed it. I like how Cask gives you a pitcher for bottomless mimosas because we only saw our server every so often. Definitely would recommend for a Saturday or Sunday brunch. Definitely will be back.
Omg My brother recommended this place to me and my sister to try while we are out here visiting food is delicious and let's not Forget about the live Dj perfect music perfect vibes I love it here
Not the best place, but not the worst.  Really oily food, not much flavor. Could be must better with a fresher menu.

Worst experience ever!!!!!!!! Discrimination because we had kids and sat us outside even though they where not busy and we had a reservation. Tried to sit out party of 8 at a table for 6 people. We never saw our server took 27 minutes to get a drink. From the time we sat down to 2 hours later we finally got our dinner. The manager isn't really a manager as he was just as bad as the  serving staff if not worse. The food was mediocre the deviled eggs could have been used as bouncy balls. All of our food was warm at best. Overall not a place I would recommend to anyone. Worst dinning experience in a really long time. When I spoke to the manager he could have cared less about my concerns and could not walk away from me fast enough.

This was the Best customer service by far I have ever received in the food industry!!!

 We came in after a late night of hanging out at a friends house and grabbed a couple burgers we asked for the medium rare and we also ended up ordering a grilled cheese for my son and some mozzarella sticks to share with the table.

Maybe 10 minutes go by in our food was already out I'm ready to eat we started off with the mozzarella sticks which were a little over cooked but still good, we were onto the burgers in after two bites and we started to realize something our burgers were definitely raw on the inside like I said we ordered a medium rare when we told our server she came over and looked at it got the manager right away and realize that the kitchen staff had messed up. I'm 

The manager and our server were both amazing, came over talk to us in the sweetest way make sure to take care of us and also apologize for the situation that she was very disappointed because they have really great burgers, we understood completely and told her it wouldn't be the last time we come because everything else was still really good even the bites of the burger that were safe to eat. I'm still giving this place five stars for the outstanding service I have ever received for an issue! We will definitely be back in the future

This place was awesome! Great atmosphere, great food, great service!!! I highly recommend it! The owner even came over and introduced himself and made sure we were taken care of. We will definitely be back!!!!

Best Buffalo shrimp I've had in a while!!! Went here twice in one weekend because we couldn't stop thinking about our first experience! Very happy we found this place!! One of our new favorite go-to spots for sure!!

First time here and we got the boardwalk fries (which are made fresh here) and grilled wings in a couple different flavors. All were amazing 10/10. I've personally worked at Hooters & Winghouse in the past and I can tell you hands down the wings here are 100 times better especially the sauces! We will definitely be coming back no doubt.

The best in Sports Bar Quality Spots: Thomas P's Sports Bar & Patio we had the Chicago thin crust Skyline Pizza with Johnny Garlic Sauce as an appetizer to share. I had the Buffalo grilled shrimp, Atlas & Lisa both ordered the fish n chips planks & Glen got the baked wings! 
All the sauces, dressings are housemade & incredible! Have you been? 
The owner, Thomas McHale is always gracious & welcoming!

We got the hekeng udang, soto betawi, and super meatball! I liked the crispness and flavor of the hekeng. The soto betawi came with a good amount of meat, and the soup was souper tasty! The super meatball was not as flavorful as I expected, but the smaller meatballs in the soup were good. Portion sizes were decent, normal.

Overall, good meal in a cute restaurant. I liked the wall decorations. Also, they take card now :)

This was a very cute spot that we went to while we were in Philadelphia. The restaurant is very quaint and is good for a small group. It became very bustling around lunchtime. 

I was excited to try the many delicous dishes on the menu and decided to grab Chicken Satay and Chicken Liver as apps followed by Nasi Goreng Special, Nasi Babi Kecap, and Bakmi Goreng Djakarta. This was followed by a yummy dessert/drink, Es Cendol. We also grabbed a box of Peyek to munch on. 

Overall, everything was delicious! I'm not a huge fan of liver but the liver wasn't too bad and was around a 7/10. 

The satay was tasty although I wished it was a bit crispier. It was around an 8/10. 

Nasi Goreng is one of my favorite dishes and this did not disappoint. It was flavorful, full of chicken, sausage, and shrimp and I enjoyed it a lot. A 9/10 for me. 

The Nasi Babi Kecap was hands down my favorite and a solid 10/10. I loved how tasty the pork was and the sauce was perfect! 

The Bakmi Goreng Djakarta was also very tasty, with the perfect consistency for the noodles. This was also a 9/10. 

I enjoyed the Es Cendol and felt it was an 8/10.

Lastly was the peyek, which was also very tasty. Another 8/10.

This is a great spot that seems to be a go-to for the Indonesian community in the area. I recommended popping by for some delicious food if you're in the area!

The food here is amazing, this place is such a gem! 

I came here with a rather large group and the staff was super friendly and accommodating about our reservation which I really appreciated. 

We ordered a mix of rice, noodles, curry, soup, and other things. I wish I took a picture, but you're just going to have to take my word for it that everything was delicious. The chicken satay skewer was full of flavor and tender, it slid right off the stick. The fried rice was very tasty and even though it was such a simple dish, it was very memorable. The curries and noodles we tried were also incredible, you truly can't go wrong with anything on the menu. The Happy Soda was less sweet than I thought it would be but I really liked the jelly in it. 

Everything so good, we were all still talking about it the next day and making plans to come back. You need to come here!

There's a reason this place is so busy. Friendly staff, great food. Got the hekeng udang appetizer, which was really tasty and fried super crisp. Had the nasi ayam goreng, which has a little bit of everything on it. Really enjoyed the various sauces, which had great flavor in addition to some heat.

Dined in today for the first time after eyeballing this place from the previous Yelp Reviews... so happy I finally did! Scrumptious, interesting food and various flavors very modestly priced.
