I got the chicken liver as an app - two hefty skewers worth, nice and crispy and flavored on the outside, makes eating healthy easy! Additionally got the veggies and chicken w fried rice- veggies and chicken were served in a flavorful broth, and I added the sriracha and sweet& spicy red sauce on the table which made it perfect. Finally, the worker there was so sweet and welcoming. Definitely gonna come back again and try something new!

Simple breakfast, two eggs, home fries, bacon, toast, coffee.  Home fries not cooked, but warm; eggs cold, but cooked. Waitress never came by to ask how food was.  Newly opened but not ready for prime time.

I've had good experiences at First Watch in the past and will go back and hope they tighten up their business.
 I was with a group. My order didn't show up with the others. "Oops, your order was crossed off" They brought mine when everyone else was almost finished. The frittata came with a side of a few leaves of lettuce. It might have had a bit of vinaigrette dressing on it, hard to tell.  The frittata itself was smaller than I expected.  The toast was missing. I asked two wait persons about my toast. Finally it was brought to me, just as I had finished the meal. "Here's your toast." I guess that was dessert. It was good toast. 
 We had to ask for everything but salt and pepper to be brought to the table, ketchup, jam, etc. No "Do you need anything else?"
  I can understand a busy Sunday brunch time. I can understand missing someone's order. I can understand missing part of the order. But not a single word of apology the whole time.  I can understand shortage of good help nowadays, but  many businesses have realized that if you pay better wages, you can hire more (and better) people. How much are you paying your staff?

Good morning everyone Sunday for me is breakfast and I like to make a big deal of it LOL period growing up in New York City with no money my mom would always make a huge breakfast for the family . I decided I wanted something rich and decadent and I've been to this first watch many times I know the menu inside and out, but today I tried this thing they have called chickenchanga. It hits the spot . Perfect size the sauce they have I believe is called Veracruz sauce delicious with a little bit of spice if you can deal with it. With some rustic potatoes which were okay but the main focus was the wrap and a side of fruits. The acid of the fruit helped. Make sure to ask for a sharper knife as you would need to cut through the wrap makes it easier to eat it. Again very live surroundings kinda loud if you're okay with that. Let me know what you guys think?

Love first watcha because of the freshness and quality of their food. I always get the breakfast tacos because of the flavor it gives, really like how flexible they are in regards to order customization. Can order the tacos with no chorizo and add extra chicken no problem. All in all great breakfast place here in Wesley chapel

Not one to do this kinda feedback but hopefully they may change something for a better service experience. This is meant to impact future customers who read the reviews and decide to eat here or not eat here; 
I have spent the last 5 years in the customer service, specifically event experience and engagement realm. I have observed, experimented and implemented the' white glove', 'feel good'- experience for a few different businesses, so when writing this review, I really hope to encourage the leadership at this establishment to up-train their staff on creating the atmosphere to match First Watch's company culture and values. 

First and foremost; the food was great as usual, quite filling and hot, thankfully they were not swamped today. On that note with the dining room not overrun and the servers not unbearably overwhelmed I would like to note a few things:
-sitting down was simple enough. Getting to our table and sitting down was fine and our server was there within two to three minutes. My partner and I had been to another first watch in the USF area  a few times and really enjoyed the food and experience so we had decided it's our anniversary let's check out the closer one here in new tampa, again we had been before so we knew what we were going to order as soon as we were sat. Here's where things started to get a little frustrating;
Our waitress was supposed to bring us water which is no reason to fuss, I assumed she was going to bring it with the meal which I had no qualms with, except Our server actually never came back to our table. Instead there was a young man from the food-line who brought our food out, and we had to ask for water and pretty much everything else as our waitress was circling the room and getting a bit touchy with the young man ( he has dark hair, and one earring in.) who was bussing the tables. Now, I do not expect anyone, especially servers to come at every beck and call, but I couldn't get her attention as she was preoccupied with this kid. 
The other issue was feeling rushed. I did not come to first watch today with the intention of being in and out in less than 20 minutes, again this was our anniversary so we wanted to take our time, enjoy our day together and the breakfast. There was another server, or bud see I am not sure but she hovered near our table (we were in the one table right near the opening of the bathrooms and directly next to the opening to the line) which again, it was no big deal until we were constantly being hovered over and felt rushed. I do not want my plates taken as I am finishing my last bite, I also don't want my receipt or to be interrupted in conversation (with food still being eaten) with the receipt. That alone says to me, we are watching you and want you to pay as soon as you finish and then leave. Mind you, they had a Plethora of open tables and a slow slow trickle into the door of customers, so there is no reason to not allow lingering and at least letting me finish my food and coffee. This is the most frustrating social interaction and breakfasts I've had in quite some time. 

So just as we get the bill, my partner and I got the memo that we were meant to leave as soon as we finished. My partner was pissed and I was ruffled as I really wanted to just enjoy this breakfast and morning. Not even a minute after we gathered our things the same woman came by, took the cash tip on the table and put it in her own pocket and started bussing. We hadn't even walked 3 feet before this happened. Honestly, this is the poorest service I have received in a long time and unfortunately I know that nothing will likely be done but hopefully again, leadership will see this and make a note to correct it before they start to lose clientele. 

Two stars for food ONLY. The service was absolutely unremarkable and not even worth rating. I was tempted to say forget a tip but again I have served and with how little the pay is, tips are a lifeline. 

Bottom line; Do better first watch. Your reputation is not preceding you with this behavior.

My daughter and I have been going to Lutécia since she was a baby. She's now four, and she insists on a muffin every time, and will not share.  Fantastic food, atmosphere & a place to feel "at home." Un grand merci.

Omg the cutest brunch place in the neighborhood!

I walked by countless times but either it looked dark and closed or all the outdoor tables were full and I didn't wanna wait.

Now I know that a) they were actually closed thos times lol, the glass just looks dark from the outside
And b) we have lovely neighbors who are generally respectful and do not dawdle and take up space when others are obviously waiting so the line moves fast. 

The service was very friendly but low key and the food came very quickly. Overall the menu is very no-frills, not trying to be edgy or "interesting" per se. I wouldn't say the food is what draws me here. It's more the ambiance and the whole package. But I do like that none of the food sounded too heavy. Just simple light cafe food. 

I enjoyed a lovely duck salad and a cup of soup. Both were light but comforting and seasoned very well. Was eyeing the quiche or a ham sandwich  but maybe next time! 

Very dog friendly place also. 

The coffee was... Aiight. Would not come here just for coffee. But definitely will be back for a chill day off late morning brunch and friendly neighborhood vibes.

Buyer be ware on this place.... many bait and switches going on. They offer a happy hour from 3:00 to 7:00 but that only applies if you're sitting at the bar. Even though it doesn't state that on the website... the dinner menu has a 20%+ uplift from what is posted on the website. The service was decent and the food prep was good but certainly not worth the significant upcharges. Waaaaay too many good steakhouses not to mention restaurants in and around downtown Tampa to waste your time here.

I've been here a few times recently, experiencing lunch, happy hour and dinner. So I'm giving a fairly informed review. The food is good. I consistently get the Steakhouse salad (basically Malio's salad with filet tips and onion straws) with the house dressing (don't be turned away from the concept of a blue cheese vinaigrette, trust it's really good.) I've also tried pretty much every appetizer from the meatballs, escargot, the shrimp Theresa, the mozzarella malzone and the cheese board. Again, the food is pretty good. But what they lack is service. They go missing for long periods of time, even during lunch service, which really isn't acceptable. Most recently, during dinner, the waitress was just plain rude. She didn't ask how I wanted my filet tips cooked ( I am a medium rare gal) and assumed I wanted well done. Before my meal came, I asked her the temperature of my steak and all she kept saying is "it'll be cooked through." I asked what do you mean? Like we'll? She said yes well done. Presumptuous much??? Also their own menu says they are not responsible for steaks above medium, so make it make sense on why you'd put in well done?!?! I advised I don't like my steak that way, please let it at most be medium. My salad still came out with over cooked steak. I informed my waitress of same and she told me to TAKE THE STEAK OFF MY SALAD, while leaving me with a salad, instead of taking my entire plate. To be a higher end steakhouse, with their prices, that's pretty unacceptable. Also the manager, a woman, was also no help advising the steak tips get cooked at different temperatures and will basically come out however. I say all this to say, come for the food, never the service.

This is was the 40$ lobster looks like. We also got the onion rings but they were chewy and kind of soggy. 2/5 stars. Service was great but the entrees were very overpriced for the level of presentation.

This review is long overdue, but we had a phenomenal experience while dining at the bar in late September. Our bartender (cannot remember her name) was outstanding. Food and service were outstanding!  Thank you!

We celebrated our anniversary at Malio's and had the lobster escargot, a Caesar salad (had to pay extra for anchovies - which I thought was odd), 22oz prime delmonico with lobster tail, and the creme brûlée for dessert. This was enough for two of us to share everything. The lobster escargot was delicious and came with two pieces of Texas toast to dip in the garlic butter goodness that the escargot came in. I thoroughly enjoyed the Caesar salad, but it's had to mess up a classic. The steak was good, but not my favorite - I don't care for the fatty pieces, but I know some people love them. The cold water lobster tail was delicious. Lastly, the dessert was lovely too, and I would recommend it. 

Our server was very fast and attentive. At one point we had to tell him to slow down bc we couldn't eat/drink fast enough to keep up with that he was bringing out. 

The environment was classy, quiet, and a perfect date night location. I would recommend Malio's and go back again.
This place is  i love supporting family run businesses. Good people, who make amazing food. Take all my money please. Authentic

Great food I can't say anything bad 
5 star hope u go check it out the fired tofu was A1

I have come here a few times while at work and they are pretty vegetarian friendly. The Thai chili lemongrass tofu is excellent. I also love the fruit tea here. I think this place is a lot better than Saigon Deli across the street. The food seems to be better quality and flavor for vegetarian options.
Very friendly service and fast. Morning glory order and Thai tea  best pho I've had so far. Keep it up guys!

If you want AMAZING Pho in Tampa this is the spot! Huge portion amazing prices and super quick awesome service! The chicken Pho is perfect on a cold day! We also tried the Viet Potstickers which were fried to perfection! In and out super quick at this super cute quick service restaurant! All the fresh ingredients in the Pho are great too! My favorite Pho spot in Tampa hands down!
Hôm nay lần đầu tiên mình ghé quán này. Mình thấy lẩu Hải sản ăn rất ngon. Chị phục vụ rất ân cần.

Great first visit where we the chef, Jason settled us in and was super welcoming. It was very early afternoon, and the place still had a strong vibe of a great night spot. Food was fresh and hot, my open Cuban was extremely good and everyone at my table was very satisfied. We will definitely be coming back to this gem.
Great spot for a quick bite. Really good specialty sandwiches, salads and soups. The space consists of a bottle shop with hundreds of beers and a nice seating area with TVs

I came here a couple years ago and had a nice soup and sandwich combo.  You order at the counter and seat yourself and they bring the food to your table when it's ready with the order number card on your table.  More recently I went back because I was craving soup and read good reviews about the tomato soup.  It was definitely good (not the best I've ever had, but tasty) and a cool little touch was a hunk of bread with melted cheese on top.  It had a little french onion soup vibe with less cheese.  My issue with it though was the cup of soup was over $8 all said and done.  That's a lot for a small container of soup even with the fancy bread/cheese combo in it.  The place also has a mix of individual beers and ciders to make your own pack if you're into that.  They also sell wine by the bottle but it's a bit pricy.
This place seems to fly under the radar but it's a great low key spot with a menu of many options. The tomato bisque soup is phenomenal! I got that and the grilled cheese. Highly recommend.
I went there for lunch today and got the burger. When I brought it back to work it was raw. Just disgusting , oh and I waited a half an hour for it and it wasn't even busy.

Great concept but needed better execution.  Short Rib Cheesesteak.  Roll was a little too crusty.  Short rib was good but a little dry and bland.  Cheese looked good melted on top but you only got it with a half to a third of your bites.  There was a sauce that was amazing but I only tasted it occasionally.  Really just enough to remind me how good this cheesesteak could be.
I did not like the food. The turkey wings and no flavor and the cabbage was horrible. It was not  worth the $20.
Consistent perfection.  For 35+ years.  Absolute best Asian restaurant ih Philadelphia.  .
Green beans were perfect , added white rice to make it a meal. Not too oily, and just enough garlic and salt

Great Asian place in philadelphia. Ingredients were fresh and very tasty. Loved their firecracker pork, dumplings, wonton soup was very tasty with clear broth. Fried rice was also tasty and fresh. Love the fact they brought out hot lemon scent towels to clean your hands. I would definitely be back!

I ordered delivery.   Blackened chicken.   There is a difference between chicken on the bone and being served kitchen scraps. I was served kitchen scraps / garbage.  There is more chicken on a HALF of a McNugget than on the bones and cartilage I was served.   This is not an exaggeration.  The peppers/onion/veg in the dish also seemed like scraps.   The flavor of the dish was fine.   But I only ate a few bites before I started hunting and pecking around for actual food ingredients, realized what was done, and threw the rest out.   I don't understand how the reviews could be so good and the reality so poor.

Came here for a friend's birthday and was immediately
impressed with how clean and modern the interior was.
Definitely a bit more upscale than your typical hole in
the wall Chinese restaurant. Altogether, 3 of us ordered
5 dishes (including 2 appetizers) : Dan Dan noodles,
scallion pancakes, fatty beef sour radish soup, salt and
pepper dried squid, and spicy lamb chops.
Squid was an easy favorite, but I'm always a sucker for
that chewy goodness. I have to give a special shout out
to the radish soup. I would order this dish again just for
the noodles. They had this almost firm-Jello-like
consistency that gave the most perfect bite! And the
broth itself was delicious and had a nice spicy kick to it.
Wouldn't order the lamb chops again - meat was dry
and it didn't go too well with the cumin marinade.
A bit on the pricier end, but I think it's appropriate for
the vibe and quality of food.
The food taste so bad, it very salty and the service is not good. The food comes out so slow, and one of the server have a bad attitude, never gonna come back again.

E Mei has been one of my favorite restaurants in Chinatown until this afternoon. I visited the restaurant around 4pm today and was greeted by a middle-age lady who kept speaking Chinese to us. I knew her face as I visited E Mei regularly and noticed that her service was not as good as the other two who have been there for a longer time. We asked the table inside politely, yet she answered in a disrespectful way as if she did not care and did not need customers. We left the restaurant as we were denied for the table inside. I hope she realized that there are better ways to say that do not offend people.

Great option for quick, fresh lunch takeaway for workdays (I live around the corner and work from home). 

I haven't tried the rest of the menu (or eat-in or dinner) because I'm happily addicted to fried rice and kung pao chicken. The portions are big enough for  a few meals. I'll be trying the rest.

Every time I come here I just get more and more disappointed. I've tried to give it several chances because it's the closest one to me but it really sucks. Always looks a mess, they barley want to give you any ingredients in your burrito, staff is friendly but they don't all seem to know what they're doing. Overall I just always leave very disappointed and regret coming here in the first place. With that being said I don't think I'll come back again I've learn my lesson the hard way. You'll be better off going somewhere else TRUST ME !!

Wish I could give it no stars.   Will never go back.
Refused to refund my money after they charged me 2 times for the same item.   Wrote to corporate and they just said "contact your bank, we won't help".
Highest priced location in Philly, per clerk.
Filthy.  Tables covered in old food/drink spills.

Please do not go here under any circumstances.  

This specific location contains the most incompetent people on the face of the planet, even by Philadelphia fast food standards. I ordered food for delivery, they deliver the wrong order.  I then call to get a refund and reorder my food, and they literally delivered the food wrong again.  All I ordered was a quesadilla and chips, not some ridiculous hidden menu item, but an item with THREE ingredients.  ITS ASSEMBLING A QUESADILLA. ITS NOT BRAIN SURGERY.  A LITERAL 4 YEAR OLD COULD PRODUCE THIS ORDER.  Its not even just incompetence from employees its just straight up not giving a F about people at all And @jacob you can comment that youre so sorry about my experience and blah blah blah, but at this point theres clearly a pattern of just awful service so I can only assume you're as incompetent as your employees.  DO BETTER.  #QDOBAFO
Perfectly satisfying pizza by the slice. No frills kind of place. The workers are nice and to the point, but some were not wearing masks appropriately.

I love this place! My favorite is their buffalo chicken and basil and tomato pizza. The meat supreme is pretty good too. They only take cash and are open quite late. The slices are huge (1 slice is two meals for me) and they always serve them warm. Highly recommend!

Lazaro's continues to be our favorite neighborhood pizza, cheesesteak, and meatball parmigiana sub joint!

P.S. Be sure to get an order of onion rings and/or curly fries!
Calzones are as big as your head....and delicious!  The sauce on the pizza tasted a little acid but the crust and mozzarella were really good!

They have the best tasting pizza, but it's nearly impossible sometimes to "catch them when they're open." Three separate times i tried to order from here and their cell phone ( which is the line they use to receive orders) is set so you get a "busy signal", - at 8:45pm when their website says they're open till 10pm !  ( I hate that crap- you'd think the least they can do is borrow someone's iphone and update it on the maps program.) Last time before we banned them was because we started ordering on their website at 8:30pm, and by the time we were ready to pay, a message pops up: ONLINE ORDERING  NOT CURRENTLY AVAILABLE. Waste of time for a business who doesn't seem to want any business.

I never saw a McDonald's that closes whenever they want in-spite of having business hours. This location is by far the worst I ever visited since I was born. I really never seen a McDonald's so unprofessional. The teenagers working have attitudes when taking orders and at the window. This location even ran out of burgers at one point, like how??? This location just need to shut down or hire a better manager.

Wow! Nothing like it in the area! 
Fresh Fresh Fresh! Impressive display of Octopus, black grouper, salmon, softshell crab, lobster, giant Stone crab claws, Poke', oysters, ceviche' Even the Yucca fries where the best  I've ever had.

Super clean, great atmosphere, great service by the owner himself :-).

See you again, soon!
#YourTampaMarkets #WaterworksPark 
Wendy Harding

Come join one if our foodie festivals (or we invite you to be a sponsor!!!) 

We're hooked (no pun intended!)

Definitely a cute little spot but overpriced for what you get. The lobster roll was good but kinda skimped on the lobster for $28 compared to others I've had in the area for about $20. Everything was fresh though and the service was good. I would recommend the conch fritters - that sauce was awesome.

Try this place out on my lunch break. Was craving a goof fried fish sandwich and this place fulfilled my needs. The fried grouper was so crispy and fresh. The sauce was delicious. This is my Ned spot for fresh sandwiches

I've had exceptional experiences trying all sorts of seafood here! Everything is so fresh and delicious. I've met the owner and he says he recruits people to go stone crab harvesting each year, just so you know how serious Heights Seafood is about their seafood and the sourcing of their seafood. They do a monthly oyster tasting for about $125 per person, and we probably tasted a dozen oysters, and with each one, the staff explained to us the origin and the expected taste. We also got to try a fried lobster dish and a crawfish sausage and of course sides like salad and seaweed salad! I've come by to eat their self harvested stone crab - delicious. The other dish I had off the menu was a Panang Shrimp. This dish was served with fragrant coconut rice. I love having seafood here!!

We came here for the first time, at first it was kind of intimidating looking at the seafood. I felt I was at Publix, ordering seafood to bring home. However the staff was very friendly and suggested us to try the conch fritters. We also ordered a spicy tuna poke bowl. Both were so good and so fresh. The sauce for the conch fritters was amazing, sweet, savory, spicy, and fruity. Deff will be back to try some new things

Another MISS with the food in downtown Tampa. The food is just NOT good. Ordered the chicken bowl. The rice is mushy, chicken is bland, definitely not grilled as it says on the menu. Overall a disgusting meal. The only good thing about my experience is the lady behind the counter is friendly.

Greasy to say the least. I ordered a taco salad with beef and there was so much ranch and sour cream on it you could not see anything else on the salad. I also tasted my daughters chicken quesadilla and it was not a pleasant flavor.

Ok this place is really....weird for lack of a better word. . Literally worst customer service. The lady just kept cleaning and ignoring customers who were waiting in line to order. Do you not want business ? Very confusing... she was sweeping so close to me I had to put my feet up. Very unprofessional and rude.

Meh... I was hoping this would be a hit like some of the other one off places we've tried in the past. The pictures were appealing and it was close to our hotel So we gave it a try. My family loves Mexican food and will give even average Mexican a thumbs up. This however was a total miss. We ordered a variety of items from burritos, tacos, rice and a taco salad. The rice was not good and had a strange flavor profile. Most of the items were unavailable and items were either missing or wrong on our order. Maybe another location is tastier. We however left hungry and threw most of our food away.

While visiting the great city of Tampa, the family desired a cheap tummy filler without the processed ingredients. A tough task, I know. We discovered Taco Bus, a downtown Mexican eating spot that just so had...Taco Tuesdays! You wouldn't guess the day we drove into Tampa??  Yep, after walking past the mini replica school bus embedded into the building, we walked in to find a near empty establishment. We almost thought they were closing.  The atmosphere is modern but a little worn by the urban traffic.   We examined the menu and quickly settled on the spicy chicken tacos. After waiting, our order was called. The well-proportioned tacos came with shredded cheese, pico and lettuce. The weighty tacos became our cheap tummy filler. They possessed a decent spice, however it appeared lacking in authentic flavor. I think a little more culinary effort would have really made the tacos impressive. Our family of four ate dinner for $8 (2-tacos each)! I give the establishment a three-star because the restaurant itself needed cleaning, touch-up paint, and the bathrooms needed attention.  The customer service wasn't impeccable either. This might be an option for a take out order....just come on Tuesdays.
Terrible all around terrible, hair in my food took 10 minutes to bring out my drink and the service was so slow and bad holy fuck sabba

This is a great spot to come to if you are looking for a bite to eat or a drink in the West Philly area. I had the fish and chips for dinner. The fish was fried wonderfully. 

Personally, I prefer the Brunch over the dinner. Nothing against the dinner menu, however the Brunch is really where this location shines. I wish I could have the chicken and waffles for dinner. Nonetheless, a good spot to come to if you want to catch up with someone over drinks and a meal.

Been to Booker's twice and I've enjoyed the food and service each time! Their cocktails are delicious too! But their bread pudding.... My goodness... It's delicious! Now, I don't like bread pudding, but I just so happen to taste some, I've been hooked ever since! 
Looking forward to my next visit to Booker's!
Always wanted to try this place then I finally did. I had the seafood mac and I fell in love, it was so delicious. Will visit again.

I came here on a beautiful November Sunday to celebrate my friend's birthday and we had a great time!

Though this location is a nice size (not too small, not super large). They do offer outdoor seating which is decorated really nicely. I would say it's not great for large groups. It was 10 of us and we had to be broken up in two groups. My friend was told this prior to booking by the staff so we were prepared. Just a heads up if you're thinking about doing the same, there's no guarantee you'll sit together. I really appreciate the staff because they were able to sit us next to each other, we just had to wait an additional 10 minutes after our reservation time.

Now to the food and drinks! SOOOO GOOD! Those Sweet Thai Chilli Wings, My GOD! I'm a STC wing connoisseur and these are definitely some of the best in the city. I had the veggie omlete which was very tasty. I didn't love the grits because they don't use cheddar cheese so maybe I'll ask next time.

The sunset and mango mimosa were SO tasty- I'm thinking about coming back next weekend. I'm trying the chicken, shrimp and waffles next.

I live in New York and came here during the holiday week for the first time and the food was absolutely delicious. My wife said the shrimp tacos were the best she's ever had. I had the chorizo burrito and it was amazing. Guac was tasty and I love how they fried the wrap. So good!!!

I can't say enough good things about this place. 

Every time I try a new dish from El Molino, it becomes a favorite. 

Those tender, melty, birria tacos are out of this world. And dunked into that spicy, bright consomé? Forget it. Honest to god, best thing I've eaten in the city in a long while. The hand-pounded tortillas really make this dish come to life.

The picadillo empanadas are a total treat, and like my previous review mentioned, the chiles relleños are a can't-miss.....

But the real treasure here is the owners. The delightful duo who single-handedly cook, clean, and serve; who are up at the crack of dawn each morning, filling our neighborhood with the warm scent of flour and corn. They are so, so kind. So welcoming, so gracious, so pleased to share their wonderful food with you. 

Such heart here.

This is it! If you're reading this, you have found the best and most authentic Mexican food in Philadelphia! Truly, Jose and his wife make everything fresh, totally homemade with good ingredients. We got to chat with them since we went during a slow time right when they were closing.  They are making food the way we have eaten in Mexico so many times and it's truly amazing! I highly recommend the mole tacos, a bit glass of horchata, the homemade salsa (with three kinds of peppers and it's the perfect amount of spicy). The tacos de birria (cheese and steak) were also incredible. The fresh salsa and homemade chips were perfect. We can't recommend this spot enough. This is the most authentic Mexican food we have eaten in the United States.

Excellent food!! The chips are to die for, as one would expect from a tortilleria. The guacamole was delish, just the right amount of spice. The owner was delightful - this place will most surely stick around!!

Omg. I think I'm going to eat here every day until I've tried one of everything. Picadillo empanadas were super stuffed. crispy on the outside. Chile rellenos were amazing. Chile was not overcooked, cheese was gooey. Red sauce was not too spicy. Burrito was exploding with deliciousness.  SO GOOOOD.

This place is a real hidden gem in the northeast and honestly some of the best Indian food I've ever had. The place was mostly empty and the staff here are extremely friendly and welcoming. I recommend this place to everyone looking for great Indian food in the area.

Ordered a Cornish hen from the tandoor.  Don't think it ever saw the tandoor oven.  Burnt, dry and no red tandoor color.
Biriyani vegetable rice.  Flavorless.  No cashews as promised.
Wonderful goat korma.
I've here numerous times together with take out.  Must have been an off night.
Probably the best Indian food in the area. Also the prices are very fair and the portions are great. I encourage you to give it a try.

Ordered takeout and got the sag paneer, garlic/ginger naan, and the butter chicken. Everything was packaged securely. No spills. 

The food is pretty good. Sag paneer was really good, super creamy. The garlic naan was fluffy. The only issue I had was with the butter chicken. It was super greasy and oily. Flavor was there but not sure what happened. Maybe the curry separated? This would've been a 5 star review if not for that.

Food is okay. Felt like home cooked food but it was little greasy. The store atmosphere was not so great. It was dark, no AC and they were understaffed.  Everyone was friendly though. I would go back again soon

Vegan Commissary (Steve) has the ability to make you smile all the way to his establishment after a long day. 

When he informed me that he had his deliciously awesome Vegan Chicken Cheesesteak: Classic and Buffalo today I felt pure happiness!

He is the "OG" of Vegan food in Philadelphia. 

My daughter and I are so content and full that it's hard to express in words. My daughter calls it comfort food that gives you a warm hug on a plate. I totally agree!!!

No frills place that hits the spot when I'm looking for something warm and soupy! Not as authentic as Pho 75, but much more conveniently located for me

During the pandemic I learned that you can order takeout with uncooked noodles, and that was a game changer, since takeout noodles always get overly soggy.

Great food, I order take out from here often. My go to items are the vermicelli noodles with pork or chicken. The ban me is also pretty good. I like the flexibility with the online ordering, they let you add and subtract different ingredients to customize almost any item on the menu.

Go to restaurant for vermicelli bowl and banh mi sandwich, I find they give a lot of protein in their sandwiches, for $7.50 or so , such a good deal and tastes amazing! Have probably gone to them 10+ times by now, and will be going back when I'm looking for a quick, yummy, well portioned Vietnamese food!

So I ordered two days in a row because I loved the shrimp hoagie with beef, omg it was perfect. I love a good Vietnamese hoagie and this hit the spot. 

I also ordered brisket pho and shrimp summer roles.
The pho was okay and I don't like that they don't separate the hoisin and siracha for to go orders, but it's better pho in the city even without that minor issue.

The shrimp rolls were average, but the peanut sauce left me confused because again I had better.

So let's talk about this hoagie , whoever made it Monday afternoon perfected it so much so that I ordered another one the next day . The second one wasn't as good as the first but still tasty. It was a huge portion size Monday compared to have the portion on Tuesday. Maybe they have a different chef each day ? Or maybe I got lucky one day but if they made hoagies like that everyday, I would take everyone I know to eat there. I give the hoagie 4 starts and the rest of the food a 3 so I'll leave their rating at 3. Also I asked for utensils and I'm not sure they read notes but two days in a row I didn't get utensils so make sure you have your own pho soup spoon

I got the beef pho for takeout. Ordering is online or at the kiosks inside, and pickup at the counter in the back. Would recommend the deluxe for variety of meats. There's a lot of space inside for seating, but it was pretty deserted on a weekday night. The broth was still warm when I got home and you can get extras of a few toppings for free (I got bean sprouts and extra hoisin) so I very much enjoyed the meal! Would definitely return.

they cell deer ankles as chiken nuggets and squirl elbows . i asked for chiken nuggets not side of the road special . i want fully cooked meat not uncooked meat tf and i wanted all 10 of my nuggets in the box not 9 in the box and 1 in the bag . i wanted a hamburger not a deer meat sandwich . yall needa start seasoning ur fries they taste like dirt . this is the most freest fast food resturant chain thing on the planet . GET REAL MEAT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Every time I have visited this restaurant I have found the bathrooms dirty, greasy floors in the seating area, and people who work there who seems to lack organization!
I parked in the Burger King parking lot and walked over to Taco Bell!

Honestly going to this place its a waste of time they never open at 5am like it states on the site/hours on the door. I stop by this week twice at 5:30 and I see people in there walking around and I saw one employee just staring at us from the drive they window with their headset on and not taking orders which is ridiculous

When I read that Cadence was closing this summer I immediately made a reservation since this spot has been on my list for a while. Boy, am I glad we got in... this was an excellent dinner. I won't go long here reviewing every dish since they are closing but each and every dish we had was delicious. The star of the show, however, is their duck which was SO good my husband ordered an extra plate for just himself. We jokingly told our waitress that the owners should sell their duck recipe to another Philly area restaurant but we were kind of serious, that's how good it is. I'm really sad to see this place go...

When I read about this place causing after august, I immediately texted my closest foodie friends and made plans to go ASAP! Soo sad that we didn't do this sooner! The husband and wife owners have been involved in some of the most notable restaurants in Philly like Will, fork, high street, etc. we all ordered from their 4 course prix fixe menu for $58 pp, I don't think there was any other option to order from. Lol. One of our friends was vegetarian, and they were able to accommodate and honestly some of her dishes tasted better than the meat version. I ordered the steelhead trout crudo, amazingly fresh and light with such a balance of flavors, the seared scallops (must get!) so naturally sweet and decadent with the creme fraiche, the Black Sea bass was my least favorite dish (it didn't taste as fresh or it was frozen too long), which was unfortunate. 

For Dessert I selected the berry sorbet since my friends had ordered the other selections. I thought mine was the best even though it was the "simplest" dessert but it definitely didn't taste like it with a cashew streusel and horchata! My vegetarian friend's sub for the dumplings tasted better than the regular dumplings on the menu!  

And it's a BYOB, with outdoor seating and the sweetest servers. Foodies, make your way over to this restaurant before it closes for good!

Kanella opened back up and is better than ever!  For starters we tried the muhammara, tzatziki, hummus, crispy brussel sprouts and kibbeh. It was served with warm grilled pita. Each bite was tastier than the next. For main course, we ordered the chicken shish and the beef kebab. Both were perfectly charred on the outside and tender and juicy on the inside. When I tell you it's the best grilled chicken I've ever had, I mean I woke up thinking about going back again tonight. The entrees were accompanied with rice or bulgar pilav and a grilled long hot pepper with some dipping paste that complimented the meats. We were perfectly full, but of course I had to try the desserts. If you like pumpkin, get the caramelized pumpkin. It was special. For me, the kunefe was everything I want in a dessert. It was warm, crispy, filled with stretchy cheese and perfect amount of sweetness. All the ingredients were clean and fresh yet full of flavor at the same time! Our server diligent and well informed of the menu. 10 out of 10, would recommend.

New ownership gives this longtime neighborhood spot a delicious, new Turkish flavoring. Well-priced, excellent service, and delicious food. Would highly recommend the eggplant meze, hummus, meze, and Adana lamb Shish kabob. I will be returning, often!

Kanella Grill has been on my list for a while to try. I'm so happy I finally went because everything was so freakin' good. It's really cute on the inside with a calm atmosphere and smells amazing as soon as you walk in. Service was quick. 

We ordered the grilled shrimp, falafel platter, and spanakopita. Lovedddd the flavor of the shrimp, although a bit pricey for 3 (but then again shrimp is always expensive). I'm not a fan of falafel but this one took me away - I really liked it and they give so much rice, salad, pita with the meal. The spanakopita was my favorite, I loved every single bite with the flaky pastry. 

I'll definitely be coming back and bringing my friends to try it out!

I'd do 4.5 stars if I could. The service was good and the food was excellent. The chicken was very well seasoned and grilled just right. The fries were hot, the salad was refreshing, and the hummus was fresh, smooth, and delicious.

I was disappointed that my entree I ordered wasn't what was described on the menu. I actually specifically ordered two dishes for their yogurt mint dressing and didn't get it. My mini meatballs didn't have the jogget dressing and when I asked later he disappeared and came back later to tell me they should have taken it off the menu/reprinted an updated menu because they weren't serving the jogget sauce anymore. When I said I was bummed because that was why I selected those dishes he didn't offer an option to replace or do anything further and just shrugged. Also the grilled octopus arm was great but the salad underneath had a bunch of yellow arugula salad leaves which again is a quality issue if you're serving some old leaves underneath a small dish. It's quite obvious. 
Disappointed to pay $100 for everything
Great food but very slow service. Waited 40 minutes for someone to take our order.  Seems understaffed.

I usually order from banana leaf 2-3x a month and Ive never had a problem until yesterday. I ordered the Indian Mee Goreng and I got food poisoning. The dish was poorly cooked and the shrimp was on the raw side and 20-30 minutes after eating, I ended up throwing up for 3 hours. I would not recommend ordering from Banana Leaf, this was a horrible experience.

Pretty tasty. I have been here twice, once for take out and a second time for in door dining. Lighting inside the restaurant is quite dim, but the food is freshly done. I enjoyed more of the appetizers than the entrees, to be honest. There is a number of vegetarian options here.

This is my SE Asian/Malaysian go-to and it is still as good as it was over a decade ago!  It's still managed by the same owners and the food is still the best in the city.

We came on Christmas Day for lunch and got an amazing roti teleur with that iconic curry dip, beef rendang, oktra with Malaysian shrimp paste, and chicken curry.  
1. The oktra was fantastic - perfectly cooked and the seasoing was bursting with flavor.  
2. The chicken curry was so good (creamy, spicy, and savory) that I ate every grain of rice just so I would not waste a single drop.  
3. The roti telur was the perfect crispiness and fluffliness (it has egg and onion).  Try it crepe style by stuffing it was a spoonful of rice and beef rendang!  We saw them making it in the front and it's definitely amazing to watch.
4. Beef rendang: Bursting with flavor and made with juicy, tender beef (not dry like most places).  It's not a light dish but it's so good that you cannot put it down!

Will be back to get more of the roti and curries!

I've only takeout from this spot but I've enjoyed both times. 

My favorite dish is the mango salad, healthy and very fresh with hints of a spicy sweet and sour sauce and ginger. 

The Banana Leaf chicken satay was also good. I also enjoyed the roti canai though I would've liked a more robust sauce.

The pineapple fried rice was ok. It tasted pleasant but was just not my thing. 

The only thing I wouldn't have again is the Thai basil noodle. I was not a fan of the flavor or noodle texture. 

Overall some great lunch options.
Ok I know they are short staffed but when does a well done steak cone out and get finished eating before sushi?

Went to Samurai Blue on a Sunday for my spouses birthday. We ordered 5 rolls between the two of us and the server brought out a 6 roll that we did not order (we are vegan and this roll had cream cheese/fish that we do not eat). We politely told the server that this roll was not ours and think someone else ordered it and she said "well it was marked on the back". I'm not sure if someone else had marked the sushi sheet as she took the paper away but I'm shocked at the poor service. Due to it being a birthday dinner we ignored it and paid for the roll that we didn't order so it wouldn't ruin my spouses evening but we are just going to throw it in the trash due to our dietary restrictions. We will not be going back after receiving this poor service which is a shame because we've always loved Samurai Blue.
Our server, Brandon, was AMAZING. Food was delish. Crab Rangoons were 10/10, but I've also never had them before.

Best sushi in the Tampa area. Located in Centro Ybor. I recently went to visit Tampa after almost 10
Years and was happy to see they were still there.  Very tasty and fresh sushi and rolls.  Highly recommend it.

One negative is the temperature of the AC. Go with long sleeves! Otherwise the rest is great!
An old warehouse converted to a dining space style. Good quality tasty foods. Apparently currently understaff. Good restaurant in the night live area and not recommend for family with children.

The staff told me to be careful with the chickpea sandwich - that it lived on a razors edge between raving praise and scathing criticism. I dared to ride this culinary wave and am now swimming in its delicious tide, with my tastebuds thankful that we took this ride. Thank you to the wonderful staff of this establishment for embracing new frontiers of sandwich-ry as well as great conversation and hospitality. 

Strong recommendation!

Chris

I will consistently give Matt & Marie's five stars, but that is with a caveat. Under no circumstance get the sandwich or salad with the chickpea patty. You're thinking falafel right, as any respectable person would? WRONG. This is an unseasoned, dry, tastes between cardboard and air, just terrible thing. I'm not sure what they were trying to do here, but they need to fix it. 

On a more positive note, the tuna has a fantastic twist (with balsamic!) and their turkey is on point.

I have complaints but the food was so good I don't care, 5 stars.

Just ordered a hot roast beef. There was issues with ordering and pickup. One being that it actually didn't come out hot, more of hoagie cold meat with hot cheese and bread. (Even though I clarified like 3 times to make it hot.) There's other things that got under my skin but I won't post them here.

But damn is this sandwich good, yumm. Definitely grab a few sandwiches from here and find one you love.

What kind of restaurant serves frozen salmon? I got the charbroiled salmon and seriously it was dry packaged frozen salmon, no words how angry I was. $17 for 2 small pieces of frozen salmon? Unacceptable. The mac and cheese was mediocre at best. The green beans were the only thing that was good. Not enough to make me eat here again. I would not recommend.
O V E R P R I C E D!!!!!!  Cute lil spot ... Music was a vibe but playing from someone's phone so when they get alerts you WILL HEAR THEM.

If I can give it a half a star I  would I do not like to bash any restaurants but I go to restaurants at least two times a week with my family and I can tell you that the food tasted horrible  and it was overpriced In relation to quantity of food they served it is not equivalent to the price you pay forget about the fact that the waiters spoke no English. Nothing about this restaurant screams kebab or Middle Eastern cuisine at all.

Doesn't look like much when you walk past, because it's very small. This is great fried chicken. It's slightly on the pricier end. My only grievance is that I've had an over done piece here and there when I get popcorn chicken. The sandwiches are usually right on point. Great mashed potatoes and mac n cheese. Awesome mustard, awesome workers.
Good place order the chicken sandwich if u black u not gone like the chicken cause of season but everything else good lil gem downtown

Where to begin.. 

I ordered delivery via their app and it was simple enough. The food came and that's where the problems start. The food was delivered to the wrong address, which makes no sense since my numbers are literally on my front door. Thank God I have honest and wonderful neighbors who called and said they have a bag with my name on it. When I finally got the food, which was delivered early, it was soggy and cold. How??? The bag with the sides was so soggy, it ripped apart when trying to pull it out the bag. The chicken was soggy and cold and didn't taste like anything. Do they know what salt and pepper are?? Also, I ordered extra biscuits that weren't in the bag, which might be a good thing because the biscuits weren't good either. The only side I ordered were greens and those taste like Glory greens out the can. I do not recommend this place. Save your time and money.

Would highly recommend if you're looking for a spicy, well seasoned fried chicken. While the buttermilk chicken is commendable, the star of the menu truly is their spicy fried chicken. I've found it is difficult to find fried chicken places on the east coast that actually have 'spicy' fried chicken. Red crest does an incredible job, and I will be returning very soon.

I always struggle to decide what to get here the fried chicken or the buttermilk chicken sandwich lol. I enjoy their sides too. Knocking off a star for the prices in relation to the portion size (which is small). Otherwise an excellent place if you're craving perfectly juicy chicken. Oh. And finding parking in this area is tough so be mindful of that before you come here.
My favorite hoagie in south Philly!!!! Nothing like a old school deli! So thankful this family is still around
Best hoagies in South Philly hands down. Tony's knows what a real hoagie is supposed to look and taste like. Super friendly staff , and very clean. A true mom&pop gem. Thank you Tony's!!!

We had a great time when we visited the 1100 social. They have awesome music that was playing outside that made my wife very happy and she dance they had statues in different memorabilia to see which I got to take pictures of and I enjoyed. There was a Phillies game going on right across the street to the place was really live in Poppin and we had a really fun time and they had drinks and appetizers and just a Lotta good fun was had

Today we went for brunch (which ends at 3P). The menu is really great and the food is as pictured on the website. We order a few different things and everything was pretty tasty. 

FOOD:
We ordered bottomless mimosas, and tried 2 of the 3 sangrias on the menu. Just a note that the mimosas have pulp in them. 

The food itself was cooked well and had great flavor. I'd pulled up pictures before we went and the food looked as pictured so I was happy about that. 

I ordered the doughnut holes that came along with a bourbon maple caramel sauce (I didn't like it) and a chocolate sauce (I also didn't like it). I won't be ordering them again. 

But everything else was great! 

DRINKS
I ordered the Pineapple Express and the Strawberry Lemonade Sangria. I liked the Pineapple Express better. The Strawberry Lemonade was pretty sweet. 

It happened to be game time so the tables filled up FAST within like an hours time. I would definitely recommend you try this place. It's first come, first serve seating.

I got the seared seared salmon which I liked a lot. It was three little pieces of salmon on a bed of arugula and cauliflower rice, quinoa salad type thing. Others got the chicken tacos (good, very small portion), fish and chips, and quinoa salad. Everything was very reasonably priced! Only downside is the small portions... overall good experience and would come back.

My friends and I just had the best night here! Our servers were Kayla and Samantha and they were some of the best servers we've ever had! They gave fantastic recommendations, had such honest and fun conversations with us, and were nothing less than perfect! The food was amazing but the drinks were over the top phenomenal! Highly recommend this place for fun nights with friends or dates!!

By far the best Mac n cheese dishes I've ever tried !! Bar Louie has a ghost kitchen called Mac n Stacks to order on Uber. We ordered The True south mac and Bleu Buffalo Mac & decadent chocolate cake. Both Mac and cheeses are mouth-watering and super savory. It's wasn't repulsive at all, and it was filled with so many flavors. They made my birthday feel special. The chocolate cake is a must-have dessert to end your evening on a good note.

Ordered through Uber Eats this week and totally received the wrong order. We asked for the cheesesteak dip with loaded tots and a cheeseburger with chili fries. We got some dry yucky chicken sandwich and mac & cheese with pulled pork. Normally I wouldn't fully blame the restaurant but they didn't have anything on the bag to help the driver identify the order. Such a disappointment that whoever was the first stop got our food. If we roll the dice and try to order again I'll update my review.
The perfect affordable, yet delicious bfast spot in olde Kensington. Outdoor seating for my dogs, and just so adorable. Very simple menu, love it!

Horrible customer service. We Got up and left after waiting 20 mins without being even approached. Disappointing as we were with our 9 year old on his birthday. Very nice place and good atmosphere. Guess it wasn't our day to try. Hopefully, if I ever do go back I won't have the same experience.

First time exploring Philly. Ran across this spot in Old City. It has a very nice outdoor nature area with tables to eat. 

The mini pancakes were amazing. I asked for strawberries and they actually put it on the skillet, so they are not just thrown on top. They were delicious!!!! 

The espresso milkshake is bomb! 

Chai latte and bagel breakfast sandwich is average. 

The yogurt parfait was good! The granola had cinnamon taste, but yogurt was a bit thin. 

Overall would recommend this place!
Was visiting philly for a couple days ended up going back twice, amazing breakfast food and coffee. The outdoor patio is a great vibe can't say enough good about the place, very nice staff as well

Came here for brunch and BYO our champagne - servers are really attentive and were OK with us staying for a long time. LOVE that you can order an affogato here! The food is delicious, and I recently ordered Luna through Good to Go, which is a food waste app. Got to sample some of their baked goods which were also delicious. Love supporting the owner and I hope Luna is here to stay in the neighborhood. The inside provisions store is also a real gem for the area for some quick groceries.
Theses are som of the best tacos I have eaten in Tampa. When ever I take my sons to baseball at Wellswood I sip and get 4 tacos for 10 dollars. Delicious!!!

grabbed food from this awesome truck on the way back to a friends house the other day. We ate in the car and it was relieving this isn't one of those places that tries to give you a soggy taco that just falls apart and your hands are messy... especially when eating in the car.

We all got the agua frescas which were super yummy especially bc it was a bit warmer that day. 

We got a mixture of food and while I wish I could've tried bites of all my friend's foods - they said it was delicious.. Mexican style chicken tacos were insanely good, my friend got the quesadilla (so cool you can choose the size) and Mexican style chorizo tacos.. boyfriend swears by the steak burrito.. definitely getting the quesadilla the next time I'm in Tampa- a must hit spot if you're on the go!

Wanted to try a new place that felt like home and this place did not MISS! I got a carne asada burrito and it was absolutely delicious and flavorful, the taste is so authentic! Will definitely be back a million more times lol everyone was so kind as well!

Gonna be a regular customer here. For the price and the portions you get this is a bargain for anyone in the area that wants some decent authentic mexican tacos.

Their quesadillas are huge as well. Needless to say this food will fill you up for a good price.

I love locals!! I tried to avoid chain places as much as I can. This is sooooo good!! Coming from California, we have the best Mexican food there and coming to Florida, it's been difficult trying to find a good Mexican place! I think I found a really good hole in the wall Mexican place!! It's delicious!! They have tacos burritos quesadillas. Good pricing tasty food, really small and nice food truck that has cute seating and plenty of Parking. I got the small quesadilla and it was soooooo good, filled w meat and cheese and fairly priced!! $5 will definitely return!!

Park Pizza is a gem for this area, and the owners pride themselves on the food that they serve. From recipes dating back to their ancestors in Italy like the tomato pie to current, homemade originals like the turkey meatballs, you cannot go wrong with your choices even if you are just craving a slice of pizza or a cheesesteak. The restaurant opened during the pandemic, and the staff prioritized the food and service. The chefs will make anything to order to ensure that you are fully satisified. Check out the website at parkpizzeria.com to see pictures and all of the work that went into making this restaurant a place that you will want to go for all of your food wants and needs!

So on a humbug we ordered from here based on the stars and I wish I wouldn't have we ordered 2 cheessteaks and fries well as you can see based on my stars it was not worth it. I ordered extra pickles and got a total of 6 and the steak barely filled up the roll....the fries were crunchy as Idk what but NOT in a good crisp way more like hard bread. So definitely disappointed that I just wasted $30 for not so good food.

I have to admit that I don't usually order pizza, cheese steaks, hoagies, etc. for takeout.  I had tried Park Pizza a few times when it first opened because it was new in the neighborhood and everything was great.  But I haven't tried it since.  I was prompted to try them again when they were featured in an Inquirer article on tomato pies.  They did not disappoint.  It was excellent.  Everything about the experience was great, the ordering, the packaging, the delivery and of course the food.  The tomato pie really is one of the best that I've had.  I am contrite that I didn't continue to frequent this place and I intend to change that.  These guys are great.

This place went from being one of the top spots in west philly to having the worst service I've ever seen. The girls at the front counter answering the phones are running the business into the ground. Picking up and hanging up on customers without saying anything. Blaming everything and everyone else when things go wrong instead of accepting accountability and changing their deplorable attitudes. 

To the business owner: don't let all you've worked for go down the drain because you hired the wrong people. Fix it fast before they close your store. Good food is worthless if the service sends everyone away.

I hoped that this place could continue their quality service when they first launched as it quickly became my favorite. Unfortunately, their customer service has done a complete nose dive. The people working the front just simply don't care. Terrible attitudes. Hanging up on customers. Forgetting to put it orders. Look, even if you're busy you can still respect your customers. There is never a good excuse to treat the people that support your business like trash. Two starts because the food is still good (when they actually get it to you properly).

The beef brisket soup was actually a beef tendon scrap soup. The soup contained 15% meat and was NOT worth it. Order take out at your own risk or check it on the spot 

I didnt want to write a negative review from the beginning & even reached out to the restaurant to fix the matter. They promised a refund and never followed up when I checked my statement this month.
I've tried a lot of Dan Dan noodles and this is probably the best one. I wish the portions were bigger for the price. Will probably go back to try their dry pot.

Delicious Sichuan food - a little lacking in service (you'll need to get up and go to the counter to ask for things like a spoon or bowl for rice, but no trouble getting them after asking). Definitely more authentic than Han Dynasty if you're in the UC area and worth a visit, especially if you're in the mood for spicy!

The menu has adjustable spice levels if members of your party are less (or more) tolerant. The ordering style is self-seat and self-order via QR code. Food will be brought out by staff, and payment is made at the counter at the end of the meal

Was looking for dry pot in university city and this was the spot!! We got takeout - a dry pot and dan dan noodles to share among 3 people and it was more than enough. Delivery (through the restaurant's page) was a bit slow but the food was amazing! Be careful with the spice, it can get pretty hot -- make sure to get plenty of rice to eat with the dry pot.

I'll definitely be coming back here to try some more dishes.
Delicious food, wonderful service. Good environment. Easy to find this location will visit next time

Always fresh food.. great alternative option to other fast food out here. Simple ingredients that taste good can't go wrong with that. You can't see all that was in my bowl from the angle and it's underneath the chicken and steak on top but trust me, you should give this place a try. Especially if you're making an effort to eat healthier/cleaner.

This is a very consistent and quality option for those seeking "healthy" to-go food in center city. I've lived in Philadelphia for quite a few years, and have been vegan or vegetarian on and off since I was a teenager, so I'm attuned to all options in the city that offer vegetables. There has been an influx of places in the past five years, but they doesn't mean they've been good.

Sweetgreen used to be my go-to for fast health food, but when it comes down to it, Dig is higher quality. It simply is. I don't think it's subjective. I do wish I could get a full cashew kale Caesar, sans romaine, but what can you do?

4.5 stars, for lack of consistency with portions!

Pleasantly surprised with this place. The food is hearty and delicious. Sometimes American food can veer on the bland side though that was not the case here. Each bite was extremely delicious. The ingredients really complemented each other and individually tasted great. 

I'm usually not a fan of sweet potato... though here? Extremely in favor. The sweet potato "flourless brownie" is also truly delicious. It also pairs well with the rest of the meal.

Hands down favorite place to eat in Philly. Well balanced ingredients with straight forward description. Eco friendly considerations: we have bags that you can take if you need it, cue pickup area AND on GrubHub, you can specify no utensils. 

I avoid dairy and soy and didn't have to ask for any modifications because all the descriptions list all allergens. I love the freedom of of ordering and not being afraid of what I'm consuming while traveling. 

My salmon bowl was delicious and well balanced with delightful sauces and made me so happy & my husband's spicy meatball bowl (say that three times fast) kept him satiated and he is still talking about how well the carrots were prepared right now. 

Easily my go to place when I'm in town!
Food was delicious. Loved the kale Cesar and the roasted carrots. Thumbs up for the mac & cheese. It would be nice to have the food labeled so you know what the options are.

Made a 9:30 reservation for NYE. Rushed us through everything to get us out in 40 minutes. If they wanted everyone out before 10:30 they should have declined the reservation. I've had good experiences here in the past but this one left a bad taste.

Why 4 stars?  Great steak, casual environment and a solid alternative to other places in the area.  Friendly servers and good wine selection earns this place a multi-visit on my list when my cravings for meat need to be met.

In my most recent travel back to Tampa (my job has me going all over the place), Renzo's is on the list of places I love to go eat at after a long week.  The big meat trays (Parrilla), the wine, and the small restaurant feel is just what is needed to unwind.  

Add some Tostones, Fried Yucca and a caprese salad and you have yourself a solid meal.  Between my wife and I we always have a little extra to bring home as well.  The different cuts of Argentina style beef all have a unique but delicious consistency that we always enjoy.

If you're into having a nice casual steak dinner, with plenty to eat, I wouldn't hesitate to give it a try.  Oh and don't forget to save room for dessert, or bring some home to have :)

My friend group went to the Jake Paul - Tyron Woodley boxing match in Tampa over the weekend. We had a crew of 5 that needed dinner before the long night. After several failed attempts to get a reservation on a holiday weekend, Renzo's was available on the OpenTable app. 

Maria was our waitress, and she brought the energy!!! I would love to come back and check out more of the menu. 

Appetizer:
Shrimp: 8.9
Ahi tuna: 8.5

Dinner: 
shrimp Caesar salad: 8.7

Desserts:
Canoli: 9.1
Cheesecake: 8.6
Chocolate cake: 7.6
Cream Brule: 9.4

Service:
Maria: 9.9

Overall:
9.4/10

Scale system 
10/10 would be what I want for my last meal
9.9-9.3 driving out of my way to get this
9.2-8.0 I love the place and would go back 
7.9-7.0 I would come here again if it were presented and don't have anything bad to say
6.9 and below - thanks but no thanks after try one

We love this place. Whenever we can make it to Tampa we always like to go here. We buy the cake in full and take it home so that everyone can enjoy. My husband can't keep his hands off the frozen cake on the drive home. That's real love!

Dined there with my wife this past Thursday.  The atmosphere is very casual European with bottles of wine on shelves surrounding the back of the restaurant and a wine cellar.  The place was about 1/2 full and not very busy.  Our waitress was nice (I think she was related to the chef/owner) and we started with a bottle of wine which was reasonably priced (about 1/3 mark up) and ordered an appetizer (Aged Provolone seasoned with adobo with bread) my wife ordered the Palmitos salad with shrimp and I ordered the Wagyu skirt steak special medium rare which came with 1 side (I ordered the yucca fries and they complimented the seasoning of the steak exceptionally).  Both were extremely tasty and  above average although pricey (the salad was $20 and my steak was $48)

The only issue we encountered was our entrees came out and we had to inform our waitress that she never brought our appetizer.  Based on this issue and the cost of the meal I would say there are better options in the Tampa area.

The food here never disappoints. Best Chinese-American take out in Oldsmar. Food is ready quickly (15-20 minutes), prices are reasonable, and staff is courteous.

As long as I'm in the area, this will be my go-to spot for my Chinese takeout fix.

Zoo's delivers in more ways than one! Fresh ingredients in the salad, great pizza quality and of course, my favorite, well-topped mega fries for a reasonable price. This place has two Philly locations and they both have been of good quality and quick delivery in my experiences. Loved the meatball za.
This will always be my favorite Gayborhood Pizza. Such an OG spot that always hits it. The fried Stromboli is fire. And their pizza is always crispy. Never change Zios

I got the pistachio pizza and carbonara for takeout. 

The pistachio pizza was out of this world good. The crust had an amazing texture baked to perfection. The addition of matradella was surprisingly perfect and the pistachio cream was delicious. 

The carbonara was slightly less creamy than what I'm used to but the sauce was still packed with flavor.
I was excited to try this place out but the pizza was very interesting shaped and oversized for the content inside. Was very disappointed by the presentation of this calzone pizza

Once again Viva Napoli exceeds expectations in every area:
Food
Wine list
Service
Présentation 

We stated with two glasses of house wine from Napoli.  Delicious, balanced and paired well with our charcuterie board. Speaking of the charcuterie board, some of the freshest meats and cheeses available were served, along with a clearly house made sundries tomato olive oil side that is fantastic! 
We also had rigatoni bolognese and spaghetti carbonara.   The bolognese was absolutely delicious -- a veritable ragu with concentrated flavors and a delightful consistency.   The pasta was cooked absolutely perfectly al dente.  
The spaghetti al carbonara was delightful, pasta cooked al dente, carbonara sauce with lots of flavor. 
A single espresso for me along with a tiramisu for my dining partner who said it was " it was airy, light, full of flavor with a sweet exterior that is an absolute delight". 
This place is one to visit in the Tampa Area!

Had an amazing meal here! Such a hidden gem. My boyfriend and I scope out great Italian food as he speaks fluent Italian. We both had gnocchi and split a margherita pizza because we are not quitters! The pizza was incredible (Neapolitan style) and the gnocchi was the best I've had. All three sauces were great especially the Gorgonzola. The owner and staff are lovely to chat with as well. We will absolutely be returning for more!
